lines.english: 001_Dooley_V5_RunDefeat_03
lines.chinese: 「这次运算结果，不太理想。」

lines.english: 002_Dooley_V5_RunDefeat_01
lines.chinese: 「系统失衡，建议重启后再来一局。」

lines.english: 003_Dooley_V5_PvEDefeat_01
lines.chinese: 「环境变量过于敌对，探索失败。」

lines.english: 004_Dooley_V5_PvPIntro_05
lines.chinese: 「目标锁定，礼貌问候。」

lines.english: 005_Dooley_V5_Idle_05
lines.chinese: 「待机中，我可以顺便数螺丝。」

lines.english: 006_Dooley_V5_PvEVictory_04
lines.chinese: 「清理完成。」

lines.english: 007_Dooley_V5_PvEVictory_01
lines.chinese: 「任务成功。」

lines.english: 008_Dooley_V5_PvEDefeat_03
lines.chinese: 「冒险日志显示：我们被冒险了。」

lines.english: 009_Dooley_V5_PvEVictory_03
lines.chinese: 「威胁解除，外壳依旧闪亮。」

lines.english: 010_Dooley_V5_PvPDefeat_02
lines.chinese: 「对战失败，正在把尴尬存入缓存。」

lines.english: 011_Dooley_V5_MultiClick_03
lines.chinese: 「检测到连续点击，你很有节奏感。」

lines.english: 012_Dooley_V5_HitReact_04
013_Dooley_V5_PvPVictory_01
lines.chinese: 「胜利确认。」

lines.english: 014_Dooley_V5_NoBuyGold_05
lines.chinese: 「钱包空空。」

lines.english: 015_Dooley_V5_LastLife_02
lines.chinese: 「最后一命，冷却情绪模块。」

lines.english: 016_Dooley_V5_RunVictory_02
lines.chinese: 「胜利路径已保存。」

lines.english: 017_Dooley_V5_NoBuyGold_03
lines.chinese: 「余额不足。」

lines.english: 018_Dooley_V5_NoBuySpace_01
lines.chinese: 「没有空间。」

lines.english: 019_Dooley_V5_NoBuySpace_02
lines.chinese: 「放不下。」

lines.english: 020_Dooley_V5_PvPVictory_03
lines.chinese: 「战斗结束，比分很好看。」

lines.english: 021_Dooley_V5_PvEVictory_05
lines.chinese: 「探索完成，还带回一点自信。」

lines.english: 022_Dooley_V5_NoBuySpace_05
lines.chinese: 「仓位已满。」

lines.english: 023_Dooley_V5_Upgrade_02
lines.chinese: 「强化完成。」

lines.english: 024_Dooley_V5_LevelUp_04
lines.chinese: 「升级。」

lines.english: 025_Dooley_V5_PvPDefeat_05
lines.chinese: 「对手获胜，但我的保修还在。」

lines.english: 026_Dooley_V5_RunVictory_05
lines.chinese: 「本轮胜利，所有灯都该亮起来。」

lines.english: 027_Dooley_V5_RunVictory_01
lines.chinese: 「运行成功，杜利表现优良。」

lines.english: 028_Dooley_V5_RunPerfect_04
lines.chinese: 「完美运行，连一颗螺丝都没松。」

lines.english: 029_Dooley_V5_MultiClick_04
lines.chinese: 「连续点击已记录，你是在弹奏我吗？」

lines.english: 030_Dooley_V5_NoBuyGold_04
lines.chinese: 「金币信号缺失。」

lines.english: 031_Dooley_V5_Idle_02
lines.chinese: 「待机时间过长，我开始整理不存在的抽屉。」

lines.english: 032_Dooley_V5_LevelUp_03
lines.chinese: 「等级提升，天线更自信了。」

lines.english: 033_Dooley_V5_LastLife_03
lines.chinese: 「警告：只剩一次机会。」

lines.english: 034_Dooley_V5_RunVictory_04
lines.chinese: 「胜利程序完成，请为我鼓掌三秒。」

lines.english: 035_Dooley_V5_PvPIntro_02
lines.chinese: 「开始对战。」

lines.english: 036_Dooley_V5_PvPVictory_04
lines.chinese: 「胜利无误，误差为零。」

lines.english: 037_Dooley_V5_RunPerfect_01
lines.chinese: 「完美。」

lines.english: 038_Dooley_V5_HitReact_07
039_Dooley_V5_Upgrade_01
lines.chinese: 「新部件上线，旧自尊下线。」

lines.english: 040_Dooley_V5_HitReact_03
041_Dooley_V5_LevelUp_06
lines.chinese: 「升级完成，音调也变高了。」

lines.english: 042_Dooley_V5_MultiClick_02
lines.chinese: 「请继续点击，我正在假装不享受。」

lines.english: 043_Dooley_V5_Idle_04
lines.chinese: 「静默模式失败，我还是想说点什么。」

lines.english: 044_Dooley_V5_HitReact_02
045_Dooley_V5_Idle_03
lines.chinese: 「我在待机，不代表我没有想法。」

lines.english: 046_Dooley_V5_HitReact_05
lines.chinese: 「外壳受击！」

lines.english: 047_Dooley_V5_NoBuyGold_01
lines.chinese: 「没钱。」

lines.english: 048_Dooley_V5_NoBuySpace_04
lines.chinese: 「满了。」

lines.english: 049_Dooley_V5_Upgrade_05
lines.chinese: 「强化很顺。」

lines.english: 050_Dooley_V5_Idle_01
lines.chinese: 「待机协议启动，灯光保持优雅。」

lines.english: 051_Dooley_V5_RunVictory_03
lines.chinese: 「本局归我。」

lines.english: 052_Dooley_V5_PvEDefeat_05
lines.chinese: 「探索中止。」

lines.english: 053_Dooley_V5_PvPVictory_02
lines.chinese: 「你打得不错，我更不错。」

lines.english: 054_Dooley_V5_LastLife_04
lines.chinese: 「最后警报，请勿再测试我的耐久。」

lines.english: 055_Dooley_V5_PvPDefeat_03
lines.chinese: 「失败数据已加密，需最高权限。」

lines.english: 056_Dooley_V5_RunDefeat_05
lines.chinese: 「运行终止，但姿态保持。」

lines.english: 057_Dooley_V5_PvPVictory_05
lines.chinese: 「赢了。」

lines.english: 058_Dooley_V5_RunPerfect_03
lines.chinese: 「完美胜利，我建议把这段循环播放。」

lines.english: 059_Dooley_V5_NoBuySpace_03
lines.chinese: 「空间不足。」

lines.english: 060_Dooley_V5_PvPIntro_03
lines.chinese: 「请出招。」

lines.english: 061_Dooley_V5_PvPIntro_04
lines.chinese: 「对战即将开始，我已调亮胜率灯。」

lines.english: 062_Dooley_V5_PvPDefeat_04
lines.chinese: 「失败确认，模块离线。」

lines.english: 063_Dooley_V5_MultiClick_05
lines.chinese: 「再点几下，我就要收费了。」

lines.english: 064_Dooley_V5_PvPIntro_01
lines.chinese: 「欢迎进入对战，我会很客气地赢。」

lines.english: 065_Dooley_V5_HitReact_08
lines.chinese: 「别敲外壳！」

lines.english: 066_Dooley_V5_LevelUp_02
lines.chinese: 「等级加一。」

lines.english: 067_Dooley_V5_LevelUp_05
lines.chinese: 「核心更亮了。」

lines.english: 068_Dooley_V5_HitReact_06
lines.chinese: 「护板警告！」

lines.english: 069_Dooley_V5_Upgrade_03
lines.chinese: 「装好了。」

lines.english: 070_Dooley_V5_RunDefeat_04
lines.chinese: 「败局归档，轮子回收。」

lines.english: 071_Dooley_V5_RunPerfect_02
lines.chinese: 「完美路线，毫无抖动。」

lines.english: 072_Dooley_V5_RunDefeat_02
lines.chinese: 「败了，正在装作正常。」

lines.english: 073_Dooley_V5_PvEVictory_02
lines.chinese: 「冒险胜利，电量充足。」

lines.english: 074_Dooley_V5_PvEDefeat_04
lines.chinese: 「这片区域不兼容我的乐观算法。」

lines.english: 075_Dooley_V5_NoBuyGold_02
lines.chinese: 「缺钱。」

lines.english: 076_Dooley_V5_MultiClick_01
lines.chinese: 「检测到重复操作，按钮寿命正在减少。」

lines.english: 077_Dooley_V5_HitReact_01
078_Dooley_V5_LastLife_01
lines.chinese: 「最后机会，请把鲁莽调到最低档。」

lines.english: 079_Dooley_V5_Upgrade_04
lines.chinese: 「升级端口稳定。」

lines.english: 080_Dooley_V5_PvPDefeat_01
lines.chinese: 「对战失利，我需要一块遮羞面板。」

lines.english: 081_Dooley_V5_LevelUp_01
lines.chinese: 「升级完成，处理器想要庆祝。」

lines.english: 082_Dooley_V5_PvEDefeat_02
lines.chinese: 「冒险失败，建议下次带更多备用零件。」

lines.english: 083_Dooley_V5_LastLife_05
lines.chinese: 「红灯亮了。」

lines.english: Oh, I'd rather feed you than fight you.
lines.chinese: 哦，挨顿打还不如吃顿饭呢。

lines.english: My father brought my people to safety by making a deal with the Infernal.
lines.chinese: 我的父亲与炼狱之民做了交易，把我的族人带到了安全之地。

lines.english: The stuff in the back is probably spoiled.
lines.chinese: 后面的东西大概已经坏了。

lines.english: Oof, I need to organize my kitchen.
lines.chinese: 哎，我得整理一下厨房了。

lines.english: Room for a sumptuous spread.
lines.chinese: 有地方摆一桌盛宴了。

lines.english: This is ridiculous! I'm a celebrity!
lines.chinese: 太离谱了！我可是名厨！

lines.english: I'll make you dinner. You'll be delicious!
lines.chinese: 我会把你做成晚餐。你一定很美味！

lines.english: I'll admit it. My moves were undercooked.
lines.chinese: 我承认，我的招式还欠点火候。

lines.english: This is not healthy fare.
lines.chinese: 这可不是什么健康餐。

lines.english: I know, most celebrities aren't this tough.
lines.chinese: 我知道，大多数名人没我这么能打。

lines.english: Oh, counter space, precious counter space.
lines.chinese: 噢，操作台空间，珍贵的操作台空间。

lines.english: Tell the babysitter I might be running late.
lines.chinese: 告诉保姆，我可能会晚点回去。

lines.english: I can always use more knives.
lines.chinese: 刀再多也不嫌多。

lines.english: Can't show Laurel how to lose gracefully if I never lose.
lines.chinese: 如果我从来不输，又怎么教劳蕾尔体面地面对失败呢。

lines.english: We had a string of bad tippers this week.
lines.chinese: 这周我们碰上了一群小气的客人。

lines.english: Please don't make me wait. I'm not your waiter.
lines.chinese: 请别让我等太久。我又不是你的服务员。

lines.english: See, Laurel? Mommy wins again!
lines.chinese: 看到了吗，劳蕾尔？妈妈又赢了！

lines.english: Now I know why Laurel gets fidgety on the airship. Are we there yet?
lines.chinese: 现在我知道劳蕾尔为什么在飞艇上坐不住了。我们到了吗？

lines.english: Why fight when we can feast?
lines.chinese: 既能开宴，何必开打？

lines.english: I had tougher fights on Azaka when I was 5.
lines.chinese: 我五岁时在阿扎卡打过更硬的仗。

lines.english: I really need to do some cleaning.
lines.chinese: 我真的该收拾一下了。

lines.english: I might need someone to cover for me.
lines.chinese: 我可能得找人替我顶一下。

lines.english: Fighting is so... distasteful.
lines.chinese: 打架真是……倒人胃口。

lines.english: Well, I ordered the dish. Guess I have to eat it.
lines.chinese: 好吧，菜是我点的。看来只能自己吃下去了。

lines.english: Next time, let's just talk it out, over dinner of course.
lines.chinese: 下次我们还是谈开吧，当然，是边吃晚餐边谈。

lines.english: Oh, these bruises won't look good on television.
lines.chinese: 哦，这些淤青上电视可不好看。

lines.english: I have to teach Laurel to stand up for herself.
lines.chinese: 我得教劳蕾尔为自己站出来。

lines.english: Oh, in the kitchen. The meat doesn't fight back.
lines.chinese: 哦，还是厨房好。肉可不会还手。

lines.english: Oof! That hurt like a bad review!
lines.chinese: 哎哟！疼得像差评一样扎心！

lines.english: Oof, must be nice to have time to do nothing.
lines.chinese: 哎，有无所事事的时间，想必很惬意吧。

lines.english: That was as spotless as our tablecloths. Five stars out of five.
lines.chinese: 刚才干净得像我们的桌布。五星满分。

lines.english: I burned enough calories to have another creme brulee, right?
lines.chinese: 我消耗的热量够再吃一份焦糖布丁了，对吧？

lines.english: That violence spread to the people. War and brutality were the soup of the day.
lines.chinese: 那份暴力蔓延到了民众之中。战争与残酷成了当日例汤。

lines.english: Whew, I feel a little overdone.
lines.chinese: 呼，我感觉有点烤过头了。

lines.english: What can I say? I'm good with a knife.
lines.chinese: 我能说什么呢？我很会用刀。

lines.english: Well, you're rather rude, aren't you?
lines.chinese: 好吧，你还真是挺没礼貌的，不是吗？

lines.english: Ugh, the show's guest cancelled, the restaurant has rats, I'm a little distracted.
lines.chinese: 唉，节目的嘉宾取消了，餐厅里还有老鼠，我有点分心。

lines.english: I have two careers and a daughter. I don't really do downtime.
lines.chinese: 我有两份事业，还有一个女儿。我真的闲不下来。

lines.english: This will look great on camera.
lines.chinese: 这个上镜一定很好看。

lines.english: Balanced flavor, balanced life, don't get too salty.
lines.chinese: 味道要平衡，人生也要平衡，别太咸了。

lines.english: Sorry, did I catch you in the middle of dinner?
lines.chinese: 抱歉，我打扰你吃晚餐了吗？

lines.english: Azaka was a world of quakes and volcanoes. No one was ever safe.
lines.chinese: 阿扎卡是个地震与火山肆虐的世界。从来没有人真正安全。

lines.english: Everyone I beat gets dinner on me, a peace offering.
lines.chinese: 被我打败的人都能吃一顿我请的晚餐，算是和平礼物。

lines.english: Honestly, I don't need any of this. I'm doing it for Laurel.
lines.chinese: 说实话，我不需要这些。我是为了劳蕾尔才这么做的。

lines.english: That felt like the streets of Azaka.
lines.chinese: 感觉就像回到了阿扎卡的街头。

lines.english: Oh, you poor thing. Have a cookie.
lines.chinese: 哦，真可怜。来块饼干吧。

lines.english: Do you know how hard it was to get a babysitter? Let's go!
lines.chinese: 你知道找保姆有多难吗？快走吧！

lines.english: I might even have room for romance! Nah, not yet.
lines.chinese: 我说不定连恋爱的空间都有了！不，还没到时候。

lines.english: Mind if my crew films this for the show?
lines.chinese: 介意我的团队把这段拍进节目里吗？

lines.english: I may look refined, but I was raised on the streets.
lines.chinese: 我看起来也许很优雅，但我是在街头长大的。

lines.english: Now that's professional grade!
lines.chinese: 这才叫专业级！

lines.english: Look at this mess! Oof, embarrassing.
lines.chinese: 看看这一团乱！哎，真丢人。

lines.english: Maybe I should have followed a recipe.
lines.chinese: 也许我该照着食谱来的。

lines.english: Oh dear, the cook called in sick, and Laurel's flame beast ate the couch. Gotta run!
lines.chinese: 天哪，厨师请病假了，劳蕾尔的火焰兽还把沙发吃了。得赶紧走！

lines.english: I don't even know why I do this.
lines.chinese: 我都不知道自己为什么要做这个。

lines.english: I must have a word with my accountant.
lines.chinese: 我得和我的会计谈谈。

lines.english: I may never know what he sacrificed, but I work each day to make it worthwhile.
lines.chinese: 我也许永远不会知道他牺牲了什么，但我每天都在努力让这一切值得。

lines.english: Feeling very short-staffed right now.
lines.chinese: 现在真有点人手不足的感觉。

lines.english: For my father, for my daughter, I will make our new life delicious.
lines.chinese: 为了我的父亲，为了我的女儿，我会把我们的新生活做得有滋有味。

lines.english: Finally, some space for that blender!
lines.chinese: 终于有地方放那台搅拌机了！

lines.english: Let's make this quick. I have something in the oven.
lines.chinese: 速战速决吧。我烤箱里还有东西。

lines.english: Ugh, I bet you don't even tip.
lines.chinese: 哼，我敢说你连小费都不给。

lines.english: More space, more ingredients.
lines.chinese: 更多空间，更多食材。

lines.english: Now that you've had some pain, how about some pain au chocolat?
lines.chinese: 既然你已经尝过痛苦了，要不要再来点巧克力可颂？

lines.english: What if I throw in a free dinner?
lines.chinese: 要是我再附赠一顿晚餐呢？

lines.english: Might need to raise prices at the restaurant.
lines.chinese: 餐厅也许得涨价了。

lines.english: You got your just desserts!
lines.chinese: 你这是罪有应得！

lines.english: Oops, sometimes I lose track of all these arms.
lines.chinese: 哎呀，有时候这些手臂太多，我自己也顾不过来。

lines.english: Take a burnt pizza and call it wood-fired. Perspective is everything.
lines.chinese: 把烤焦的披萨说成柴火烤制。角度决定一切。

lines.english: What if I diced it into smaller pieces?
lines.chinese: 要是我把它切成更小块呢？

lines.english: I survived firequakes on Azaka, but standing around like this might kill me.
lines.chinese: 我在阿扎卡的火震中活了下来，但这样干站着可能会要了我的命。

lines.english: Calm down. Let's talk about it.
lines.chinese: 冷静点。我们谈谈吧。

lines.english: Some hunters would call these weapons unsporting.
lines.chinese: 有些猎人会说这些武器不讲武德。

lines.english: A hunter's greatest skill is patience.
lines.chinese: 猎人最重要的本事就是耐心。

lines.english: Where were you on that one, creature? Sorry!
lines.chinese: 刚才你去哪了，兽？抱歉！

lines.english: I was five when I learned to sharpen my blades, six when I forged my own.
lines.chinese: 我五岁学会磨刀，六岁就会锻刀。

lines.english: My first memory is death, the wreckage of their ship, their bodies all around me.
lines.chinese: 我最早的记忆是死亡。飞船残骸，还有四周的尸体。

lines.english: Man gets stronger, finally!
lines.chinese: 人类终于变强了！

lines.english: I've been eating out too often, need to get back to raw meat and a fire.
lines.chinese: 我最近总在外面吃，该回到生肉和篝火了。

lines.english: Tell me, are there others like me in this place?
lines.chinese: 告诉我，这地方还有别的像我一样的人吗？

lines.english: Stronger now than the prime of my youth. Or have I even reached it?
lines.chinese: 现在的我，比青春鼎盛时还强。又或者，我真的到过巅峰吗？

lines.english: Sometimes I hate what I do to them, sometimes I enjoy it.
lines.chinese: 有时我厌恶自己对它们做的事，有时我又享受其中。

lines.english: If we'd met some other way, we might have been friends.
lines.chinese: 如果换一种相遇方式，我们也许能做朋友。

lines.english: I've hurt a lot of people in my life. What's a few more?
lines.chinese: 我这辈子伤过太多人。再多几个又怎样？

lines.english: Do you take pelts? How about tusks?
lines.chinese: 收兽皮吗？獠牙行不行？

lines.english: Amazing they'd pay me for this. They can't deal with such weak beasts?
lines.chinese: 真没想到这也有人付钱请我来。连这么弱的野兽都处理不了？

lines.english: I'll remember that trick on my next hunt.
lines.chinese: 下次狩猎我会记住这一招。

lines.english: If I knock you down quickly, you might be safe.
lines.chinese: 如果我能很快把你击倒，你也许还能保住性命。

lines.english: This is why I go alone. Those who get close get hurt.
lines.chinese: 这就是我独来独往的原因。靠近我的人都会受伤。

lines.english: I feel a change inside me. How much time do I have left?
lines.chinese: 我感觉体内有东西在变化。我还剩多少时间？

lines.english: I've been tracking you across the Outlands. Your scent is... strong.
lines.chinese: 我一路穿过荒原追踪你。你的气味……很浓。

lines.english: A forest on Tegan would eat you alive.
lines.chinese: 提根的森林会把你活活吞掉。

lines.english: This is what the city does to you. Makes you greedy.
lines.chinese: 城市就是这样改变人的。它让你变得贪婪。

lines.english: This place is full of monsters. No excuse for a hunter to be broke.
lines.chinese: 这地方到处都是怪物，猎人没钱可说不过去。

lines.english: I hunt monsters, not people, but for you I'll make an exception.
lines.chinese: 我猎杀怪物，不猎杀人。但你是例外。

lines.english: My parents weren't my parents. They found me as a baby, alone in the Outlands of a world called the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 我的父母并不是我的亲生父母。他们在大巴扎的荒原里，找到了还是婴儿的我。

lines.english: My pack is almost bigger than me.
lines.chinese: 我的背包都快比我还大了。

lines.english: I've come so far to find the truth. I can't quit now.
lines.chinese: 我为了真相走了这么远，现在不能放弃。

lines.english: Ten years in the wild. When the trade ship found me I was barely human, if I even am human.
lines.chinese: 我在荒野里待了十年。商船找到我时，我几乎已经不像人了，如果我真算人的话。

lines.english: Made short work of that one. Next time, it lasts longer.
lines.chinese: 那只解决得太快了。下次得让它撑久一点。

lines.english: I grew up alone in the wild with nothing to do but get stronger. This is the result.
lines.chinese: 我独自在荒野长大，除了变强，没有别的事可做。这就是结果。

lines.english: You should sell your services. You'd make a killing.
lines.chinese: 你该靠这身本事接活，肯定能赚翻。

lines.english: If the creature takes over, run.
lines.chinese: 如果兽占了上风，就跑。

lines.english: The client overpaid for that one, but I'll keep the change.
lines.chinese: 客户为这只付多了，不过找零我就收下了。

lines.english: Man only strong because creature help. Not in front of the prey.
lines.chinese: 人类强，是因为有兽帮忙。别当着猎物说这个。

lines.english: I wish they'd leave me alone, but it is a pleasure to make them.
lines.chinese: 我希望他们别来烦我，但让他们离远点倒也痛快。

lines.english: The city is chaos. Give me a cabin in the woods.
lines.chinese: 城市太混乱了。给我林中小屋就好。

lines.english: Another good hunt.
lines.chinese: 又一次不错的狩猎。

lines.english: Ha ha ha! Man is weak! Shut up, creature.
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈！人类太弱了！闭嘴，兽。

lines.english: This isn't looking good. Man, don't worry. Creature, protect!
lines.chinese: 情况不妙。人类别担心。兽会保护你！

lines.english: Whatever you want from me, it's not what you'll get.
lines.chinese: 不管你想从我这里得到什么，都不会如愿。

lines.english: The line between hunter and prey can get a little blurry.
lines.chinese: 猎人与猎物之间的界线有时会变得模糊。

lines.english: Whatever doesn't kill me makes me angry.
lines.chinese: 杀不死我的，只会让我更愤怒。

lines.english: This world has strange folk with strange ways, and I'm learning all of them.
lines.chinese: 这个世界尽是怪人怪规矩，而我正在一一学会。

lines.english: The Bazaar is a good teacher.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎是位好老师。

lines.english: I've fought gigabears that hit softer than you. Impressive.
lines.chinese: 我打过的巨熊都没你这么重的拳头。厉害。

lines.english: These are my hunting grounds. Find your own.
lines.chinese: 这里是我的猎场。去找你自己的。

lines.english: I've hunted on a hundred planets, but this place is dangerous.
lines.chinese: 我在上百颗星球狩猎过，但这里很危险。

lines.english: Fairly fought. Fairly won. No! Fight again!
lines.chinese: 打得公平，赢得也公正。不！再打一场！

lines.english: If you wake up the creature, what happens next is on you.
lines.chinese: 如果你唤醒了兽，后果自负。

lines.english: Creature, I might need your help soon. Yes, always help!
lines.chinese: 兽，我可能很快就需要你帮忙。好，永远帮忙！

lines.english: I look human, but many monsters do.
lines.chinese: 我看起来像人，但很多怪物也一样。

lines.english: I must warn you, I am more than I appear.
lines.chinese: 我必须警告你，我不止看上去这样。

lines.english: Whoever built this world had a sick sense of humor.
lines.chinese: 建造这个世界的人，一定有种病态的幽默感。

lines.english: I guess it's true what they say. The Bazaar is a crazy place.
lines.chinese: 看来传言是真的，大巴扎就是个疯狂的地方。

lines.english: My first memory: the crash, my parents dead at my feet. I see it everywhere.
lines.chinese: 我最早的记忆：坠毁，父母死在我脚边。我到处都能看见那一幕。

lines.english: Cities are expensive. I miss the wild.
lines.chinese: 城市太贵了。我想念荒野。

lines.english: Something sleeps within me. Don't wake it up.
lines.chinese: 有东西沉睡在我体内。别把它叫醒。

lines.english: So sharp, it sparkles in the moonlight. That actually might be a problem.
lines.chinese: 锋利得会在月光下闪光。这反而可能是个问题。

lines.english: If I'm ever free of the creature, will I lose this terrible strength?
lines.chinese: 如果有一天我摆脱了兽，会不会也失去这可怕的力量？

lines.english: Is this all I am? Just another hungry animal.
lines.chinese: 这就是我的全部吗？不过是另一头饥饿的野兽。

lines.english: Man and creature, best team. You're not wrong.
lines.chinese: 人类和兽，最强队伍。你倒也没说错。

lines.english: Somewhere in all these carcasses, I'll find my answers.
lines.chinese: 在这些尸骸之中，我总会找到答案。

lines.english: Maybe someday we'll be friends, but first I must be cured.
lines.chinese: 也许有天我们会成为朋友，但我得先治好自己。

lines.english: Don't hurt them, creature. No promises.
lines.chinese: 别伤害他们，兽。不保证。

lines.english: This was my life. Roaming the galaxy, hunting monsters and trying to hide my own. Hello!
lines.chinese: 这就是我的人生：游荡银河，猎杀怪物，同时藏好我自己的兽。你好！

lines.english: I was a child alone on a savage planet, but for some reason I refused to die.
lines.chinese: 我曾是野蛮星球上孤身一人的孩子，但不知为什么，我就是不肯死。

lines.english: This almost takes the thrill out of the hunt... almost.
lines.chinese: 这几乎让狩猎失去了刺激……几乎。

lines.english: When the hunt goes this well, there might be too much meat. Give to creature!
lines.chinese: 狩猎这么顺利，肉可能会太多。给兽吃！

lines.english: You're good. We should hunt together sometime.
lines.chinese: 你很厉害。改天我们该一起狩猎。

lines.english: Man's sharpened claws teach him first.
lines.chinese: 人类最先学会的，是磨利自己的爪子。

lines.english: I should leave some of this at camp.
lines.chinese: 我该把一部分留在营地。

lines.english: Why need coin? Kill and take! We don't do that.
lines.chinese: 为什么需要钱？杀了就拿！我们不那么做。

lines.english: Am I a hunter or scavenger? Gotta leave some behind.
lines.chinese: 我是猎人还是拾荒者？得留下一些。

lines.english: If I'm not yet full grown, what will I become when I am?
lines.chinese: 如果我还没完全长成，那等我长成时会变成什么？

lines.english: If man carry all this, not need when have creature.
lines.chinese: 人类背这些干什么？有兽在，就不用背了。

lines.english: This noisy city, all these people. I should return to the wild.
lines.chinese: 这吵闹的城市，这么多人。我该回荒野去。

lines.english: Thirty-eight years, twenty planets, thousands of kills, and I'm still learning.
lines.chinese: 三十八年，二十颗星球，数千次杀戮，而我还在学习。

lines.english: I'm sorry, sometimes I can't control it.
lines.chinese: 抱歉，有时候我控制不住它。

lines.english: Some days I wish I could stop this. Most days I don't.
lines.chinese: 有些时候我希望自己能停下。大多数时候并不想。

lines.english: You enjoyed that, didn't you, creature? Yes!
lines.chinese: 你很享受，对吧，兽？是！

lines.english: You're not bad, but this is what I do. It's all I do.
lines.chinese: 你不差，但这就是我做的事，也是我唯一会做的事。

lines.english: This place is more dangerous than I expected.
lines.chinese: 这地方比我预想的更危险。

lines.english: Now we kill bigger monsters! Yes, and only monsters.
lines.chinese: 现在我们杀更大的怪物！对，而且只杀怪物。

lines.english: Not even creature could carry all this. Could... but don't want to.
lines.chinese: 就算兽也背不下这么多。背得下……但不想背。

lines.english: I don't belong here.
lines.chinese: 我不属于这里。

lines.english: I'm not weak, just need to get stronger.
lines.chinese: 我不弱，只是还得更强。

lines.english: As a child in the woods, I hunted with sharp sticks. This is better.
lines.chinese: 小时候在森林里，我用削尖的木棍狩猎。这个更好。

lines.english: Please, you don't want to do this.
lines.chinese: 求你，你不会想这么做的。

lines.english: Not my finest hunt, certainly not my worst.
lines.chinese: 不是我最好的狩猎，当然也不是最差的。

lines.english: I was lucky to keep my pelt on that one.
lines.chinese: 那次能保住这张皮，算我走运。

lines.english: Well, well, the hunter becomes the hunted.
lines.chinese: 好啊好啊，猎人成了猎物。

lines.english: Man, pew.
lines.chinese: 人类，啧。

lines.english: Where do these monsters come from? Is there a source?
lines.chinese: 这些怪物从哪来的？有源头吗？

lines.english: Sharp arrows make quicker kills. No need for the prey to suffer.
lines.chinese: 锋利的箭能更快杀死猎物，没必要让它受苦。

lines.english: Hard to stalk prey with all this junk rattling around.
lines.chinese: 带着这些叮当响的破烂，很难潜行接近猎物。

lines.english: I used to craft everything I needed. Is the city making me lazy?
lines.chinese: 我过去需要什么都自己做。城市是不是让我变懒了？

lines.english: All this junk is slowing me down.
lines.chinese: 这些破烂都在拖慢我。

lines.english: Creature eats weak thing! No! Not this one!
lines.chinese: 兽吃弱小东西！不！这个不行！

lines.english: Whatever species I am, I might still be growing.
lines.chinese: 不管我是什么物种，也许我还在成长。

lines.english: This place, this city, it's wearing me down fast.
lines.chinese: 这个地方，这座城市，正在很快把我磨垮。

lines.english: Some hunters would call these weapons unsporting, but I don't hunt for sport.
lines.chinese: 有些猎人会说这些武器胜之不武，但我狩猎不是为了取乐。

lines.english: Too weak, creature bored! A kill is a kill.
lines.chinese: 太弱了，兽觉得无聊！杀了就是杀了。

lines.english: I mastered that forest and its beasts, learned to hunt before I learned to talk.
lines.chinese: 我摸透了那片森林和其中的野兽，先学会狩猎，后学会说话。

lines.english: Man and creature win every time. Got to admit, feels good.
lines.chinese: 人类和兽每次都赢。不得不承认，感觉不错。

lines.english: I need to charge more for my services.
lines.chinese: 我该把佣金收高一点。

lines.english: If I hurt you, I'm sorry. I have a sickness.
lines.chinese: 如果我伤了你，对不起。我身上有种病。

lines.english: I used to hunt with nothing but a loincloth. Do I really need all this?
lines.chinese: 我以前只穿一条缠腰布就能狩猎。我真的需要这些吗？

lines.english: A hunter should travel light.
lines.chinese: 猎人应该轻装上路。

lines.english: Mother, father, I may be joining you soon.
lines.chinese: 母亲，父亲，我也许很快就要去见你们了。

lines.english: How, man, let this happen! They're tougher than they looked, okay?
lines.chinese: 怎么会，人类怎么会让这种事发生！它们比看起来难对付，好吗？

lines.english: Anyone who got close to me got hurt, so I stopped letting them. Creature just won't leave!
lines.chinese: 靠近我的人都会受伤，所以我不再让他们靠近。可兽就是不肯离开！

lines.english: Creature gets stronger, too. That's what I'm afraid of.
lines.chinese: 兽也在变强。这才是我害怕的。

lines.english: I'm getting closer to the answers, sketching a map in my mind.
lines.chinese: 我离答案越来越近，地图在脑海一点点浮现。

lines.english: We must outlast the prey, silent, vigilant.
lines.chinese: 我们必须比猎物更能忍，安静，警觉。

lines.english: On Tegan I only hunted for food, but money becomes food.
lines.chinese: 在提根，我狩猎只是为了食物，但钱也能变成食物。

lines.english: I will try to be gentle.
lines.chinese: 我会尽量温柔点。

lines.english: Because I didn't survive that place alone. I had my... imaginary friend. Hello!
lines.chinese: 因为我不是独自从那里活下来的。我有我的……幻想朋友。你好！

lines.english: For a large game like me, you should go with a compound ballista with serrated broadheads.
lines.chinese: 对付我这种大型猎物，你该用复合弩炮和锯齿宽刃箭头。

lines.english: When you're hunting to survive, there's no such thing as overkill.
lines.chinese: 为了活下去而狩猎时，没有什么叫火力过剩。

lines.english: Like it or not, I was born for this.
lines.chinese: 不管喜不喜欢，我都是为此而生。

lines.english: Don't worry, you can keep your skin.
lines.chinese: 别担心，你可以保住这身皮。

lines.english: If you were my mark, you'd see me again, but we can keep this friendly.
lines.chinese: 如果你是我的目标，你还会再见到我。不过我们可以保持友好。

lines.english: There is a power in me I can't control. Be careful.
lines.chinese: 我体内有一股无法控制的力量。小心。

lines.english: Now I'm loose again! You could have helped a little.
lines.chinese: 现在我又失控了！你本可以帮点忙的。

lines.english: Out there in the Outlands, I feel something calling me.
lines.chinese: 在那片荒原深处，我感觉有什么在呼唤我。

lines.english: I learned to hunt before I learned to talk. This was not a challenge.
lines.chinese: 我学会说话前就学会了狩猎。这算不上挑战。

lines.english: But then I finally went back, searched the wreckage, found the logs that changed everything.
lines.chinese: 后来我终于回去了，搜遍残骸，找到了那改变一切的日志。

lines.english: Why use weapon when have creature? Because I wish I didn't.
lines.chinese: 有兽在，为什么还用武器？因为我宁愿没有兽。

lines.english: Some clients want me to hunt people instead of monsters. I'm starting to see why.
lines.chinese: 有些客户想让我杀人而非猎兽，我开始明白为什么了。

lines.english: Did these things come from this foundation? Or did someone put them here?
lines.chinese: 这些东西来自这座地基吗？还是有人把它们放在这里？

lines.english: Man's so weak! Whoa! I cannot wait to be rid of you.
lines.chinese: 人类太弱了！喂！我真等不及要摆脱你了。

lines.english: Every hunt is a new lesson.
lines.chinese: 每次狩猎都是新的一课。

lines.english: The creature, it's just an illusion I used to scare prey. Nothing more.
lines.chinese: 那个兽，只是我用来吓唬猎物的幻象，仅此而已。

lines.english: I underbid for this hunt. Might barely break even.
lines.chinese: 这次狩猎我报价太低了，可能刚好回本。

lines.english: A good hunt. We won't starve this winter. Creature eat everyone!
lines.chinese: 这场狩猎不错。今年冬天饿不着了。兽吃掉所有人！

lines.english: Stillness. Stoicism. These are the hunters. No more stoicism! Need kill!
lines.chinese: 沉静。克制。这才是猎人。不再克制！要杀戮！

lines.english: Now I'm too weak. Let creature control. Not if I can help it.
lines.chinese: 现在我太弱了。让兽接管吧。只要我还能阻止，就不行。

lines.english: I hope you'll take some of the blame, creature. Little tiny bit.
lines.chinese: 希望你也承担一点责任，兽。就一点点。

lines.english: The traders brought me to an orphanage. Tried to give me a normal life. Normal was never on my map.
lines.chinese: 商人把我带到孤儿院，想给我正常的生活。可我的地图上，从来没有正常这条路。

lines.english: Was that a hunt? Or a massacre? Man and creature, they fell every time!
lines.chinese: 那是狩猎，还是屠杀？人类和兽出手，它们次次倒下！

lines.english: Sometimes the prey escapes, just part of the hunt.
lines.chinese: 猎物有时会逃走，这也是狩猎的一部分。

lines.english: Some hunters lay traps. I like to face my prey.
lines.chinese: 有些猎人会设陷阱。我喜欢直面猎物。

lines.english: Fight me again! I must repeat the experiment!
lines.chinese: 再和我打一场！我必须重复这个实验！

lines.english: There it is! The rising sun! Perfection!
lines.chinese: 就是它！初升的太阳！完美！

lines.english: There is always a price for knowledge. You have just paid it.
lines.chinese: 知识总有代价。你刚刚付过了。

lines.english: An alchemist with no gold. It is almost humorous.
lines.chinese: 没有金币的炼金术士，几乎有点滑稽。

lines.english: Man or beast, sometimes it's hard to tell.
lines.chinese: 是人是兽，有时真难分辨。

lines.english: Mother, father, sister, I will not fail you.
lines.chinese: 母亲，父亲，妹妹，我不会让你们失望。

lines.english: Oh, but I followed the formula!
lines.chinese: 哦，可我明明照着公式来的！

lines.english: I can feel the foundation humming beneath my feet. Such power!
lines.chinese: 我能感到地基在脚下嗡鸣。何等力量！

lines.english: All change begins in the heat of the crucible.
lines.chinese: 一切变化都始于坩埚的烈焰。

lines.english: You are a child to me, and I will punish you.
lines.chinese: 在我眼里你只是个孩子，我会惩戒你。

lines.english: I have lived five lives already! This is not my last!
lines.chinese: 我已经活过五次了！这还不是我的最后一生！

lines.english: A waste of my time, but I do have plenty.
lines.chinese: 浪费我的时间，不过我的时间确实很多。

lines.english: Ah, another specimen for my collection!
lines.chinese: 啊，又一个可以收藏的标本！

lines.english: If you think you've hurt my feelings, I assure you I have none.
lines.chinese: 如果你以为伤到了我的感情，我向你保证，我没有感情。

lines.english: After all these centuries, there is still more to learn.
lines.chinese: 过了这么多个世纪，仍有更多东西要学。

lines.english: Even Sima will have to admit, that was good.
lines.chinese: 就连西玛也不得不承认，那确实不错。

lines.english: So close to failure, I must rise up.
lines.chinese: 离失败这么近，我必须重新站起来。

lines.english: My mind glows. I see everything!
lines.chinese: 思绪激荡。我看见了一切！

lines.english: Ah, I am working on a shrinking spell for such situations.
lines.chinese: 啊，我正在为这种情况研究缩小咒。

lines.english: I have faced 82 fools exactly like you. People are a pattern.
lines.chinese: 我面对过八十二个与你一模一样的蠢货。人是有规律可循的。

lines.english: My journey has been long. It won't end here.
lines.chinese: 我的旅程很漫长，不会在这里结束。

lines.english: I could teach you my power, but you would squander it.
lines.chinese: 我可以教你我的力量，但你只会浪费它。

lines.english: Another step forward on my path.
lines.chinese: 我的道路又向前迈了一步。

lines.english: When you live this long, you collect some clutter.
lines.chinese: 活得久了，总会攒下一些杂物。

lines.english: Alchemy is the pursuit of perfection. Today, for a moment, I have found it.
lines.chinese: 炼金术追求完美。今天，有那么一瞬间，我找到了它。

lines.english: My power burns hotter, melting away impurities.
lines.chinese: 我的力量燃烧得更炽热，熔去了杂质。

lines.english: If you seek to test my patience, you will lose.
lines.chinese: 如果你想考验我的耐心，你会输。

lines.english: Oh please, share with me your secrets!
lines.chinese: 哦，拜托，把你的秘密告诉我！

lines.english: I cannot carry all this. I am a very old man.
lines.chinese: 我装不下这一切。我可是个很老的人了。

lines.english: One night, I left the cauldron brewing while I caroused with friends. That is when it happened.
lines.chinese: 有一晚，我把坩埚留在火上，自己和朋友们出去寻欢。事情就是那时发生的。

lines.english: What strange creatures prowl the streets?
lines.chinese: 街上游荡着什么奇怪生物？

lines.english: Even after 500 years, there is never enough time.
lines.chinese: 即使过了五百年，时间也永远不够。

lines.english: Many times I have stood on this edge. I have no fear.
lines.chinese: 我曾无数次站在这道边缘。我毫无惧意。

lines.english: I will fight you, but only so that I can study you.
lines.chinese: 我会和你战斗，但只是为了研究你。

lines.english: This is a terrible place, but I will learn from it.
lines.chinese: 这是个糟糕的地方，但我会从中学到东西。

lines.english: But, I will not accept it. I will find the formula of life. I will bring them back.
lines.chinese: 但我不会接受。我会找到生命的公式。我会把他们带回来。

lines.english: Success, failure, illusions; there is only experience.
lines.chinese: 成功、失败、幻象，到头来都只是经验。

lines.english: I must distill my collection.
lines.chinese: 我必须把我的收藏蒸馏一下。

lines.english: Death, my old enemy! I can hear you laughing!
lines.chinese: 死亡，我的老对手！我听见你在笑！

lines.english: Disgusting creatures!
lines.chinese: 恶心的生物！

lines.english: In a hundred years when you are dust, I will remain.
lines.chinese: 一百年后你化作尘土，而我依然存在。

lines.english: There is much to do. We must never rest.
lines.chinese: 要做的事很多。我们绝不能休息。

lines.english: Closer and closer. I can hear my sister's laughter.
lines.chinese: 越来越近了。我能听见妹妹的笑声。

lines.english: The result befitting my centuries of experience.
lines.chinese: 与我数百年经验相称的结果。

lines.english: Oh, with enough power, I will defeat death itself!
lines.chinese: 哦，只要有足够的力量，我将击败死亡本身！

lines.english: Mediocrity is but a step on the ladder to greatness.
lines.chinese: 平庸不过是通往伟大的阶梯上一阶。

lines.english: I will leave you alive to learn the lesson.
lines.chinese: 我会留你一命，让你记住教训。

lines.english: I take no apprentice. None have proven worthy.
lines.chinese: 我不收徒弟。没人证明自己配得上。

lines.english: Where was my error? What can I learn?
lines.chinese: 我的错误在哪里？我能学到什么？

lines.english: My endless life will require endless gold!
lines.chinese: 我无尽的生命需要无尽的金币！

lines.english: Perhaps I have hoarded too much.
lines.chinese: 也许我囤得太多了。

lines.english: I cared nothing for my family's legacy, only frivolous pleasures.
lines.chinese: 我毫不在意家族传承，只顾轻浮享乐。

lines.english: With each new discovery, the formula of life is revealed.
lines.chinese: 随着每一次新发现，生命的公式都显露得更多。

lines.english: With more time comes greater perfection!
lines.chinese: 更多时间，带来更高的完美！

lines.english: I was born into a line of master alchemists, but I was a foolish youth.
lines.chinese: 我出生在炼金大师的世家，却曾是个愚蠢的年轻人。

lines.english: Every failed experiment lights the path to success.
lines.chinese: 每一次失败的实验都照亮通向成功的道路。

lines.english: Pain is the catalyst. I will transmute.
lines.chinese: 痛苦是催化剂。我会完成转化。

lines.english: I seek the ultimate power. I have no time for... you.
lines.chinese: 我追寻终极力量。我没时间理会……你。

lines.english: When we are finished, may I dissect you for study?
lines.chinese: 等我们结束后，我可以解剖你做研究吗？

lines.english: The bazaar has many secrets. I will uncover them all.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎有许多秘密。我会将它们全部揭开。

lines.english: When I complete the great work, there will be gold aplenty.
lines.chinese: 等我完成伟业，黄金自会取之不尽。

lines.english: You remind me of someone I fought last century.
lines.chinese: 你让我想起上个世纪我交手过的某个人。

lines.english: A thing of true beauty!
lines.chinese: 真是美妙之物！

lines.english: I have no pride for you to wound.
lines.chinese: 你伤不了我的自尊，因为我没有自尊。

lines.english: You are merely a step on the ladder I must climb.
lines.chinese: 你不过是我必须攀上的阶梯一级。

lines.english: The lesson you learned today, I learned a century ago.
lines.chinese: 你今天学到的教训，我一个世纪前就学会了。

lines.english: Would you perhaps accept some lead?
lines.chinese: 你也许愿意收下些铅吗？

lines.english: I am seeking gold in a world of lead.
lines.chinese: 我在铅的世界里寻找黄金。

lines.english: I lost everything long before you were born. This is nothing to me.
lines.chinese: 在你出生很久以前，我就失去了一切。这对我不算什么。

lines.english: Fascinating. You are more than you appear.
lines.chinese: 有意思。你远不止表面那样。

lines.english: Somewhere in these twisting streets, I will find the formula of life.
lines.chinese: 在这些曲折街巷的某处，我会找到生命的公式。

lines.english: I must do without. For now.
lines.chinese: 我必须先凑合。暂时如此。

lines.english: Is it even a pursuit when perfection's so easy to catch?
lines.chinese: 当完美如此容易捕获时，这还算追求吗？

lines.english: Do you feel that humming in the ground? It is the foundation on which this world was built.
lines.chinese: 你感觉到地下的嗡鸣了吗？那是支撑这个世界的根基。

lines.english: Why must we do this? Death laughs at us both!
lines.chinese: 我们为什么非得这样？死亡在嘲笑我们两个！

lines.english: Time is long, but I have none left for you.
lines.chinese: 时间很长，但我没剩下时间给你。

lines.english: This place holds great power, and I will find a way to master it.
lines.chinese: 这里蕴藏强大的力量，我会找到驾驭它的方法。

lines.english: If you knew my true purpose, you would stand aside.
lines.chinese: 如果你知道我真正的目的，就会让到一旁。

lines.english: I seek the ultimate secret. Will you get me any closer?
lines.chinese: 我追寻终极秘密。你能让我离它更近吗？

lines.english: I have all the time I need to improve.
lines.chinese: 我有足够的时间去改进。

lines.english: Another step closer to the formula of life.
lines.chinese: 又向生命的公式靠近了一步。

lines.english: Sometimes I lose on purpose, just to remember the feeling.
lines.chinese: 有时我故意输，只为记住那种感觉。

lines.english: Ha ha ha! Not all my subjects survive my experiments!
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈！并非所有实验对象都能活下来！

lines.english: You have shown me my errors. Now I can correct them.
lines.chinese: 你让我看见了自己的错误。现在我能修正它们了。

lines.english: One cannot learn without failure.
lines.chinese: 没有失败，就无从学习。

lines.english: How are you doing this? Show me your secrets!
lines.chinese: 你是怎么做到的？把你的秘密告诉我！

lines.english: Just behind the veil, my family waits for me.
lines.chinese: 在帷幕之后，我的家人正等着我。

lines.english: My home, burnt. My family, gone. Because of my mistake.
lines.chinese: 我的家，焚为白地。我的家人，一个不剩。这全是我的错。

lines.english: I'm... a loser? No! Positive attitude! Come on!
lines.chinese: 我是……失败者？不！保持积极！振作起来！

lines.english: All right.
lines.chinese: 好吧。

lines.english: The Elder told me I'd fail. Good thing I never listen.
lines.chinese: 长老说我会失败。幸好我从来不听。

lines.english: I've come too far to let you stop me.
lines.chinese: 我走到这一步太不容易了，不能让你拦住我。

lines.english: Uh, it's five o'clock nowhere, friend. The hustle never sleeps!
lines.chinese: 呃，朋友，现在可不是下班时间。奋斗永不休眠！

lines.english: Ah, you can learn a lot from losing.
lines.chinese: 啊，失败能让人学到很多。

lines.english: Losing is a lesson.
lines.chinese: 失败就是一堂课。

lines.english: My people just don't get it! It's about challenge!
lines.chinese: 我的族人就是不懂！关键在于挑战！

lines.english: My dreams are too big for you to steal.
lines.chinese: 我的梦想太大，你偷不走。

lines.english: Not feeling so good.
lines.chinese: 感觉不太妙。

lines.english: Okay, is this a work-life balance thing, or what's happening?
lines.chinese: 好吧，这是在搞什么工作生活平衡吗？

lines.english: Uh, that money's not gonna earn itself. Let's go!
lines.chinese: 呃，钱可不会自己赚出来。走吧！

lines.english: On Jabali, everyone has enough.
lines.chinese: 在贾巴利，每个人都衣食无忧。

lines.english: Ah, the noise here's so distracting. Gotta focus!
lines.chinese: 啊，这里的噪音太分神了。得集中注意力！

lines.english: Look, I need a business partner who's as motivated as me!
lines.chinese: 听着，我需要一个和我一样有干劲的商业伙伴！

lines.english: There's no conflict, no ambition, no purpose!
lines.chinese: 没有冲突，没有野心，也没有目标！

lines.english: Oh, you've got potential! I bet I'll see you again.
lines.chinese: 哦，你很有潜力！我打赌我们还会再见。

lines.english: Are you sure? Have you noticed? I'm huge!
lines.chinese: 你确定吗？你没注意到吗？我可是很大只！

lines.english: Well, I guess motivation isn't everything, hm?
lines.chinese: 好吧，看来光有干劲也不是万能的，嗯？

lines.english: Well, this is embarrassing.
lines.chinese: 好吧，这就有点尴尬了。

lines.english: Guess I've been winning too much.
lines.chinese: 看来我赢得太多了。

lines.english: Yep, most Jaballians will never know this feeling. Ha ha ha!
lines.chinese: 没错，大多数贾巴利人永远体会不到这种感觉。哈哈哈！

lines.english: Time to make some sales.
lines.chinese: 该卖点货了。

lines.english: Life on Jabali is simple. You pick some fruit, go to sleep, and repeat.
lines.chinese: 贾巴利的生活很简单。摘点水果，睡一觉，然后重复。

lines.english: Thank you.
lines.chinese: 谢谢。

lines.english: Ha ha ha! Moving up in the world!
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈！这下要发达了！

lines.english: Losing is a lesson. I gotta stop saying that.
lines.chinese: 失败就是一堂课。我真该别再这么说了。

lines.english: I wanted to work! I wanted to build my life! I wanted more!
lines.chinese: 我想工作！我想打造自己的人生！我想要更多！

lines.english: When I'm rich, I'll never hear no again.
lines.chinese: 等我有钱了，就再也没人敢拒绝我。

lines.english: Uh, getting, uh... hard to stay positive!
lines.chinese: 呃，变得……有点难保持乐观了！

lines.english: Ugh, can't let this get me down.
lines.chinese: 呃，不能让这件事打垮我。

lines.english: Well, I'll admit, that was impressive.
lines.chinese: 好吧，我承认，那确实厉害。

lines.english: You seem like a nice person, maybe too nice.
lines.chinese: 你看起来是个好人，也许好过头了。

lines.english: Entrepreneurs don't take lunch breaks. Where's your hustle?
lines.chinese: 创业者可不休午饭。你的干劲呢？

lines.english: Ah, the joy of more! Ha ha ha ha! Bring it in.
lines.chinese: 啊，更多就是快乐！哈哈哈哈！都拿来吧。

lines.english: I paid for the express ship to get here, and now we're... waiting?
lines.chinese: 我可是花钱坐快船来的，结果现在我们在……等？

lines.english: Believe you'll win, and you'll win, but not against me.
lines.chinese: 相信自己会赢，你就会赢，但对上我不行。

lines.english: You have to want it to win it, and I want it bad!
lines.chinese: 想赢就得渴望胜利，而我非常渴望！

lines.english: Time is money, friend.
lines.chinese: 朋友，时间就是金钱。

lines.english: Next time, I'll show you what I learned from this.
lines.chinese: 下次，我会让你见识我从这次学到了什么。

lines.english: Now that's giving them the business!
lines.chinese: 这才叫给他们点厉害瞧瞧！

lines.english: You just motivated me to get stronger!
lines.chinese: 你刚刚激励我变得更强了！

lines.english: Uh, looks like I'm overstocked.
lines.chinese: 呃，看起来库存超量了。

lines.english: If you're not growing, you're failing!
lines.chinese: 不成长，就是在失败！

lines.english: Ah, no hard feelings, right?
lines.chinese: 啊，别往心里去，对吧？

lines.english: Ooh! This pork roast's almost done!
lines.chinese: 哦！这块烤猪肉快熟透了！

lines.english: Yes!
lines.chinese: 好！

lines.english: Ah, and this is why I need to get rich.
lines.chinese: 啊，这就是我必须发财的原因。

lines.english: I'll come back someday and buy the whole store!
lines.chinese: 总有一天我会回来，把整家店都买下！

lines.english: I should warn you, I'm not like other Jaballians.
lines.chinese: 我得提醒你，我和其他贾巴利人不一样。

lines.english: I believed in myself and I still lost!
lines.chinese: 我相信自己，结果还是输了！

lines.english: Now that was invigorating! Ha ha ha!
lines.chinese: 这才叫振奋人心！哈哈哈！

lines.english: If the Elder could see me now! Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
lines.chinese: 要是长老能看到现在的我！哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.english: I'll, uh... I'll bounce back from this.
lines.chinese: 我，呃……我会从这次挫折里恢复过来。

lines.english: The Elder said my ideas were dangerous, that I'd bring ruin to Jabali, so I left!
lines.chinese: 长老说我的想法很危险，说我会给贾巴利带来毁灭，所以我离开了！

lines.english: It's all about motivation. You gotta know what you're fighting for!
lines.chinese: 关键全在动力。你得知道自己为何而战！

lines.english: Too much stuff! I never thought I'd say it.
lines.chinese: 东西太多了！真没想到我会说出这种话。

lines.english: I thrive under pressure!
lines.chinese: 我在压力下反而更强！

lines.english: Someday I'll return and show them what I've found here. Maybe then they'll understand.
lines.chinese: 总有一天我会回去，让他们看看我在这里找到了什么。也许那时他们就会明白。

lines.english: The Elder warned me this would happen.
lines.chinese: 长老警告过我会这样。

lines.english: Now that's quality!
lines.chinese: 这才叫品质！

lines.english: My people believe in peace. Boring!
lines.chinese: 我的族人信奉和平。无聊！

lines.english: Mmm, need to move some inventory.
lines.chinese: 嗯，得清一清库存了。

lines.english: Not all Jaballians are pacifists!
lines.chinese: 不是所有贾巴利人都是和平主义者！

lines.english: I can see you're going places, but I'll be chasing you. Ha ha ha ha.
lines.chinese: 我看得出你前途无量，但我会追上你的。哈哈哈哈。

lines.english: They don't teach combat on Jabali, hehehe, clearly.
lines.chinese: 贾巴利可不教战斗，呵呵，很明显。

lines.english: Ah ha ha ha! This isn't defeat! It's training!
lines.chinese: 啊哈哈哈！这不是失败！这是训练！

lines.english: Er, hehe, you do see these tusks, right?
lines.chinese: 呃，嘿嘿，你看见这些獠牙了吧？

lines.english: Like a diamond, flawless!
lines.chinese: 像钻石一样，毫无瑕疵！

lines.english: Aw, don't let this get you down! Eyes on the prize, huh?
lines.chinese: 哎，别让这事打击你！盯紧目标，嗯？

lines.english: I've come too far to fail now!
lines.chinese: 我走了这么远，不能现在失败！

lines.english: Uhhh... Ready when you are, guy.
lines.chinese: 呃……你准备好了我就可以，伙计。

lines.english: I earn enough to get by and this is way more fun.
lines.chinese: 混口饭吃是够了，而且这个好玩多了。

lines.english: Ah, looks like there was some side fumbling on the panametric fan.
lines.chinese: 啊，看来是泛矩风扇那边横向乱摆了。

lines.english: My encabulator is prefabulated amulite, and you never had a chance.
lines.chinese: 我的空想涡轮机用的是预制阿穆莱特，你从一开始就没戏。

lines.english: Is this a social situation? I'm not great at those.
lines.chinese: 这是社交场合吗？我不太会应付这种。

lines.english: A girl can't even go out for a sandwich anymore.
lines.chinese: 现在连出门买个三明治都不行了吗？

lines.english: We've gotta drop some weight if we're gonna get airborne.
lines.chinese: 想升空，就得先减重。

lines.english: Now I'm just trying to undo some of the damage we caused. Help people live a little lighter.
lines.chinese: 现在我只想补救我们惹出的那些麻烦，让大家活得轻松点。

lines.english: I never wanted to design weapons, but I might need to try.
lines.chinese: 我从没想过要设计武器，但也许该试试了。

lines.english: After I break all your stuff, I'd be happy to repair it.
lines.chinese: 等我把你的东西拆坏了，我很乐意再帮你修好。

lines.english: My engine might stall, but it never breaks down.
lines.chinese: 我的引擎也许会熄火，但绝不会趴窝。

lines.english: Every time I go outside, something wants trouble.
lines.chinese: 我每次出门，都有东西要找麻烦。

lines.english: Ugh, I've got to organize this stuff.
lines.chinese: 唉，这堆东西该整理一下了。

lines.english: So much chaos on the streets. I wonder how much is our fault?
lines.chinese: 街上乱成这样……不知道有多少是我们造成的。

lines.english: Ah, toughen up, Stell. This is the real world.
lines.chinese: 唉，挺住，斯黛尔。这就是现实。

lines.english: You thought you could win with those specs?
lines.chinese: 你真以为你那点参数就能赢我？

lines.english: The better I get, the more I can help.
lines.chinese: 我越强，就越能帮到别人。

lines.english: Whatever happened to the Bazzarian Defence Corps?
lines.chinese: 大巴扎防卫队到底去哪儿了？

lines.english: This is going to take a lot of troubleshooting.
lines.chinese: 这可有得排查了。

lines.english: We make tech as good as it can be, and then we make it better.
lines.chinese: 技术为先，精益求精。

lines.english: Did that hit too hard? Sh- Should I reduce the torque? What do you think?
lines.chinese: 是不是下手太重了？要……要不要把扭矩调低点？你觉得呢？

lines.english: I've squeezed out of tighter spots.
lines.chinese: 比这更棘手的死局我也解决过。

lines.english: I used to love designing new tech for them. Thought we were changing the world.
lines.chinese: 以前我很喜欢给他们设计新技术，还以为自己真在改变世界。

lines.english: Now that's a next gen update.
lines.chinese: 这才像是次世代升级。

lines.english: Oh, if my family saw this, they'd be furious!
lines.chinese: 要是被我家里人看见，他们非气炸不可！

lines.english: Let's stress test our gear, yeah?
lines.chinese: 来给装备做个压力测试，怎么样？

lines.english: People need the tools to defend themselves from things like this.
lines.chinese: 大家需要能保护自己的工具，来应付这种事。

lines.english: Hi, I'm Stelle Tantius. Still ingenious. Wanna fight?
lines.chinese: 嗨，我是斯黛尔·坦提乌斯，天才依旧。想打一架吗？

lines.english: Sky's the limit. Not for me.
lines.chinese: 天空才是极限？我看不然。

lines.english: Ugh, why am I hauling all this around? I'm a pilot, not a trucker!
lines.chinese: 唉，我干嘛一路拖着这些东西？我是飞行员，又不是货车司机！

lines.english: This must be at least 26.8% better.
lines.chinese: 这起码提升了 26.8%。

lines.english: When we're done here, stop by my shop for a tune-up.
lines.chinese: 这边结束后，来我店里调校一下吧。

lines.english: Ah, forgot to tighten the reciprocating camshaft. That explains it!
lines.chinese: 啊，忘了拧紧往复凸轮轴。难怪！

lines.english: Upgrade the gear? Upgrade the world?
lines.chinese: 升级装备？还是升级世界？

lines.english: Okay, reactor's done. Now how about a jetpack?
lines.chinese: 好，反应堆搞定。下一个，喷气背包怎么样？

lines.english: There's got to be a better way to embarrass my family.
lines.chinese: 总得有个更体面的办法让我家族丢脸吧。

lines.english: Fine. I'll build one myself.
lines.chinese: 行吧，我自己造。

lines.english: I didn't want to hurt you, but you didn't give me a choice.
lines.chinese: 我本不想伤你，是你没给我选择。

lines.english: More than the sum of its parts.
lines.chinese: 整体不只是零件之和。

lines.english: Yes! Proof that anything's possible.
lines.chinese: 太好了！这证明没有什么不可能。

lines.english: Yes! Flying high!
lines.chinese: 好耶！越飞越高！

lines.english: Did that thing have a sinusoidal deplanerator? No wonder I lost.
lines.chinese: 那玩意儿装了正弦退化再生器？难怪我会输。

lines.english: They were selling my work to Cloud Tops and Exeons, all kinds of militant scum. I had to leave.
lines.chinese: 他们把我的成果卖给云顶、埃克西昂，还有各种军阀混账。我只能离开。

lines.english: I'm as famous for fixing airships as my family is for owning them, so my time is valuable.
lines.chinese: 我修飞艇的名气，跟我家族买飞艇的名气差不多，所以我的时间很值钱。

lines.english: Was it a faulty differential spring? Huh?
lines.chinese: 是差速弹簧出故障了吗？嗯？

lines.english: Can't always blame it on the gear.
lines.chinese: 不能总怪装备。

lines.english: I won't be a part of making the world worse.
lines.chinese: 我不想和他们同流合污。

lines.english: What specs are you running? Oh, good luck!
lines.chinese: 你跑的是什么配置？哦，祝你好运！

lines.english: Wanna get lunch after this? Is that weird?
lines.chinese: 打完之后要一起吃午饭吗？这样很怪吗？

lines.english: My to-do list could wrap around the bazaar. Can we get this on the runway?
lines.chinese: 我的待办清单能绕大巴扎一圈。我们能上跑道了吗？

lines.english: I'll fly rings around you.
lines.chinese: 我会绕着你飞，把你甩得团团转。

lines.english: I'm not asking dad for money.
lines.chinese: 我才不会找爸爸要钱。

lines.english: Alepper has no idea how much we have to learn.
lines.chinese: 阿莱珀根本不懂，我们还有多少要学。

lines.english: Is it time to call Dad?
lines.chinese: 是时候给爸爸打电话了吗？

lines.english: Ugh, that's the only kind of broke I can't fix.
lines.chinese: 唉，破损能修，但破产我修不了。

lines.english: This might have been a mistake.
lines.chinese: 这可能是个错误。

lines.english: Okay, I'll be in the shop. Come find me if you ever want to do something.
lines.chinese: 好吧，我在工坊。你要是哪天想做点什么，就来找我。

lines.english: Why are you like this?
lines.chinese: 你怎么就非得这样呢？

lines.english: Ugh, there's gotta be a design solution.
lines.chinese: 唉，肯定有个设计方案能解决这个。

lines.english: Quality Engineering.
lines.chinese: 这才叫优质工程。

lines.english: Every test improves the design.
lines.chinese: 测试成就设计。

lines.english: Huh, I don't need a Tantius factory to build a better life.
lines.chinese: 哼，不靠坦提乌斯的工厂，我也能造出更好的生活。

lines.english: Hey, that was fun, right? Right?
lines.chinese: 嘿，刚才挺好玩的，对吧？对吧？

lines.english: Oh, you want to help me test my designs?
lines.chinese: 哦，你是想帮我测试设计吗？

lines.english: They said I'd never make it on my own. Wonder what they're saying now.
lines.chinese: 他们说我一个人成不了事。不知道他们现在怎么说。

lines.english: Let me make it up to you. Free repairs at my workshop.
lines.chinese: 让我补偿你吧。来我的工坊，免费修。

lines.english: That's a 24% increase in fuel efficiency.
lines.chinese: 燃油效率提升 24%。

lines.english: Can't call me a dreamer if all my dreams come true.
lines.chinese: 梦想都实现了，就不能叫我空想家了。

lines.english: Yeah, I've been working out.
lines.chinese: 没错，我最近有练。

lines.english: I'm a fighter pilot, not a freighter pilot. Drop some junk.
lines.chinese: 我是战斗机飞行员，不是货机飞行员。扔点破烂下去。

lines.english: Well, we were changing it, making it worse.
lines.chinese: 嗯，我们确实改变了世界。只是越改越糟。

lines.english: They said I was naive, but it's working!
lines.chinese: 他们说我天真，可这不是成功了吗！

lines.english: Well, Dad would love to see this.
lines.chinese: 这下让爸爸开心了。

lines.english: This community service stuff doesn't exactly pay.
lines.chinese: 做这种社区服务可不怎么赚钱。

lines.english: Now if I can just learn how to talk to people.
lines.chinese: 现在只差学会怎么跟人说话了。

lines.english: I wish my sister could see this. It'd wipe that smirk off her face.
lines.chinese: 真希望我姐姐能看到。保证让她笑不出来。

lines.english: Will you leave me alone now? I've got a lot of work to do.
lines.chinese: 现在能别烦我了吗？我还有一堆活要干。

lines.english: Every day on these streets teaches me so much.
lines.chinese: 在这些街上待一天，都能学到好多东西。

lines.english: Ugh, barely even have room for my tools.
lines.chinese: 呃，连放工具的地方都快没有了。

lines.english: I've always got the right tools for the job.
lines.chinese: 干什么活，我都有趁手工具。

lines.english: Oh, I must have miscalculated the… everything.
lines.chinese: 哦，我一定是把……所有东西都算错了。

lines.english: Life's rough down here.
lines.chinese: 地面上的日子真不好过。

lines.english: Hey Uncle Odie! Maybe I'll be training you soon!
lines.chinese: 嘿，奥迪叔叔！也许很快就该我来训练你了！

lines.english: I say, anything can be improved if you have the parts.
lines.chinese: 我就说，只要有零件，什么都能改。

lines.english: Calibrating the lunar waneshaft really made a difference.
lines.chinese: 校准月相韦恩轴果然有用。

lines.english: Enjoy your little moment. I'm just testing my gear.
lines.chinese: 你就享受这一小会儿吧。我只是在测装备。

lines.english: Are you open to feedback on your design?
lines.chinese: 你愿意听点设计反馈吗？

lines.english: Wow, you're... pretty good at this.
lines.chinese: 哇，你……这个还挺会的。

lines.english: I won't let them use me anymore.
lines.chinese: 我不会再让他们拿我当工具。

lines.english: So... we doing this or...?
lines.chinese: 所以……我们开始，还是……？

lines.english: Just a little friendly sparring, right?
lines.chinese: 只是友好切磋一下，对吧？

lines.english: The bazaar will never be a safe place, but I'm trying.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎永远算不上安全，但我在努力。

lines.english: I was just trying to go to the hardware store.
lines.chinese: 我只是想去趟五金店而已。

lines.english: This is like a sport right? You're not really mad at me.
lines.chinese: 这算运动竞技，对吧？你不是真的在生我气吧。

lines.english: Uh, I can rebuild it, if there's anything left.
lines.chinese: 呃，如果还剩下什么的话，我能重建。

lines.english: Okay, go away please.
lines.chinese: 好了，请你走开。

lines.english: What specs are you running? Oh, good luck!
lines.chinese: 你跑的是什么配置？哦，祝你好运！

lines.english: Uh, hard to help the poor when I am the poor.
lines.chinese: 呃，穷人还是独善其身吧。

lines.english: I'll figure something out.
lines.chinese: 我会想出办法。

lines.english: Upgrade everything, even me.
lines.chinese: 什么都能升级，我也一样。

lines.english: It was good before. Now it's amazing.
lines.chinese: 之前已经不错，现在更是惊艳。

lines.english: Ugh, I hope I didn't hurt it too bad.
lines.chinese: 唉，希望我没把它伤得太狠。

lines.english: See that, Uncle Odie? Building a better bazaar.
lines.chinese: 看到了吗，奥迪叔叔？我在建设一个更好的大巴扎。

lines.english: Whoa, take it easy! I thought we were just sparring.
lines.chinese: 哇，悠着点！我以为只是切磋。

lines.english: What happened to traveling light, Stell?
lines.chinese: 说好的轻装上阵呢，斯黛尔？

lines.english: This is why I don't leave the workshop.
lines.chinese: 所以我才不离开工坊。

lines.english: Too. Much. Clutter!
lines.chinese: 杂、物、太、多、了！

lines.english: Hmph, they might be right about me. Impractical, unprofitable, naive. But I just want to help people fly.
lines.chinese: 哼，他们也许说得对。我不切实际、不赚钱、还天真。可我只是想带人们飞向高空。

lines.english: Sometimes I forget what I'm even building. It just feels good to work.
lines.chinese: 有时候我都忘了自己到底在造什么。动手干活本身就很舒服。

lines.english: Well, back to the drawing board.
lines.chinese: 好吧，一切推翻重来。

lines.english: Yes! Victory! Oh, are you okay?
lines.chinese: 太好了！赢了！哦，你没事吧？

lines.english: Now I see why Alepper calls this fly-over country.
lines.chinese: 现在我明白阿莱珀为什么说这地方只配飞过去了。

lines.english: I make a lot of mistakes, but I always learn from them.
lines.chinese: 我会犯很多错，但每次都会学到东西。

lines.english: Maybe I could start charging a little more at the workshop.
lines.chinese: 也许工坊收费该稍微涨一点了。

lines.english: I have six airships to repair this week. Let's go!
lines.chinese: 这周还有六艘飞艇等着我修。走吧！

lines.english: Wanna hang out and talk about Aerospatial Extenuators? Oh. You are leaving.
lines.chinese: 要一起聊聊航空空间延展器吗？哦。你要走了。

lines.english: You'll break before I do. I'm designing a fusion reactor while we sit here.
lines.chinese: 你会比我先撑不住。我们坐在这儿的时候，我已经在脑子里设计聚变反应堆了。

lines.english: Way too much junk!
lines.chinese: 破烂也太多了！

lines.english: I kinda feel bad. Want me to fix your stuff?
lines.chinese: 我有点过意不去。要我帮你修吗？

lines.english: Maybe I should make more mini-blimps. Those always sold well.
lines.chinese: 也许我该多做点迷你飞艇，那东西一直卖得不错。

lines.english: Don't tell anyone, but I'm from the Tantius family. We... They pretty much own the skies.
lines.chinese: 别告诉别人，我是坦提乌斯家的人。我们……他们基本掌控着整片天空。

lines.english: Well, back to the workshop.
lines.chinese: 好吧，回工坊。

lines.english: Onward and upward.
lines.chinese: 且行且高。

lines.english: Is anything not on fire?
lines.chinese: 还有什么没着火的吗？

lines.english: With an active mind, it's impossible to get bored. I'll be designing engines in my head.
lines.chinese: 脑子一直转，就不可能无聊。我会在脑子里设计引擎。

lines.english: Hey! You broke my gyroscope! Oh well, easy fix.
lines.chinese: 嘿！你弄坏了我的陀螺仪！算了，小问题。

lines.english: Ugh, feels so good when hard work pays off.
lines.chinese: 呃，努力有回报的感觉真好。

lines.english: Ugh. I can hear Alepper laughing at me.
lines.chinese: 呃，我都能听见阿莱珀在笑我了。

lines.english: No such thing as a failed experiment. They teach you what doesn't work.
lines.chinese: 实验没有失败一说。它们只是告诉你什么行不通。

lines.english: I could fix that for you, but then I'd have to break it again.
lines.chinese: 我可以帮你修好，不过那样我还得再打爆一次。

lines.english: We used to fly right over problems like this.
lines.chinese: 以前我们都是直接从这种麻烦上空飞过去的。

lines.english: Got a few new designs I want to try. Let me know what you think.
lines.chinese: 我有几个新设计想试试。回头告诉我感觉如何。

lines.english: That family money did come in handy.
lines.chinese: 家族的钱还真有点用。

lines.english: Huh, we've really got to clean up these streets, maybe a giant sweeping machine?
lines.chinese: 嗯，这些街道真该清理一下了……也许造台巨型清扫机？

lines.english: I'm gonna need a few repairs.
lines.chinese: 我得修修自己了。

lines.english: A few parts from that one, into a few gaps in this one, BOOM!
lines.chinese: 从那边拆几个零件，补到这边几个空位里，砰！

lines.english: Hope you bought your parachute!
lines.chinese: 希望你买了降落伞！

lines.english: Get good, so you can do good.
lines.chinese: 练好本事，才能做点好事。

lines.english: Time to stop buying and start selling.
lines.chinese: 该别买了，开始卖吧。

lines.english: We can still be friends, right?
lines.chinese: 我们还是朋友，对吧？

lines.english: I'd rather build stuff than break it, but inventions need testing.
lines.chinese: 比起拆东西，我更想造东西。但发明总得测试。

lines.english: I'd call that peak performance.
lines.chinese: 这就叫巅峰性能。

lines.english: A serious upgrade!
lines.chinese: 这升级够硬核！

lines.english: Have you serviced your gear? Ever.
lines.chinese: 你的装备保养过吗？有过吗？

lines.english: Watch out, Tantius Industries, Stelle's workshop is on the rise.
lines.chinese: 小心了，坦提乌斯工业。斯黛尔工坊要起飞了。

lines.english: Mum and Dad have no idea how bad things have gotten.
lines.chinese: 爸妈根本不知道外面已经糟成什么样。

lines.english: It's not just a win, it's an ad for my services.
lines.chinese: 不只是胜利，这还是我服务的活广告。

lines.english: Defeat does not defeat me.
lines.chinese: 失败不会打败我。

lines.english: Ooh, the keener the blade, the quicker the fight.
lines.chinese: 嚯，刀刃越利，胜负越快。

lines.english: You should know, I'm a bit of a legend on Polago.
lines.chinese: 你该知道，我在波拉戈也算个传奇。

lines.english: Read the tides and listen to the wind, they will guide your strikes.
lines.chinese: 看潮汐，听海风，它们会指引你的出手。

lines.english: Ships may sink, but I'm a good swimmer.
lines.chinese: 船会沉，但我水性不错。

lines.english: Was that even a battle? Maybe a skirmish?
lines.chinese: 那也算战斗吗？顶多是一场小冲突。

lines.english: Heh, must be a hole in my coin purse.
lines.chinese: 呵，看来我的钱袋漏了个洞。

lines.english: Bravery without strength is a sword without a blade.
lines.chinese: 没有力量的勇敢，不过是无刃之剑。

lines.english: You remind me of my first voyage around the globe. Unbearably slow.
lines.chinese: 你让我想起第一次环球航行，慢得让人难以忍受。

lines.english: All of this is just training. Our real fight is on Polago.
lines.chinese: 这一切不过是训练。真正的战斗，在波拉戈。

lines.english: I fight for my people. Their strength lifts me when I sink.
lines.chinese: 我为人民而战；每当我沉入谷底，他们的力量都会托起我。

lines.english: I know the eastern sky is beautiful at dawn, but can we get moving?
lines.chinese: 我知道东方拂晓的天空很美，但我们能不能先动起来？

lines.english: Rally, men! Blades to the wind!
lines.chinese: 船员们，迎风举刃！

lines.english: Maybe if we tow the barge.
lines.chinese: 也许拖艘驳船来就行。

lines.english: Shouldn't have buried that last treasure.
lines.chinese: 早知道上一批宝藏就不该埋了。

lines.english: My ship, my failure, my will to get stronger.
lines.chinese: 我的船，我的败绩，都会化作我变强的意志。

lines.english: We'll borrow more gold from the tyrant.
lines.chinese: 我们再从暴君那儿借点金币。

lines.english: You've got talent. You should put it toward nobler use.
lines.chinese: 你很有天赋，该把它用在更高尚的事业上。

lines.english: I'm on the edge of the plank.
lines.chinese: 我已经站在跳板边缘了。

lines.english: Sails down, anchors up. Just waiting for your command.
lines.chinese: 降帆，起锚，就等你一声令下。

lines.english: I am the last daughter of House Korxena. My father lives through me.
lines.chinese: 我是蔻森娜家族最后的女儿。父亲在我身上延续。

lines.english: See that plank? Walk it.
lines.chinese: 看到那块跳板了吗？走过去。

lines.english: Too much treasure, not enough chest.
lines.chinese: 宝藏太多，箱子太少。

lines.english: My father was the first captain to resist, and he paid the price for it.
lines.chinese: 我的父亲是第一个奋起反抗的船长，也为此付出了代价。

lines.english: I came here to gather my strength, but I will return home for vengeance.
lines.chinese: 我来这里积蓄力量，但终会回故乡复仇。

lines.english: Let's take the tyrant's whole kingdom!
lines.chinese: 把暴君的整个王国都夺过来！

lines.english: Then the tyrant king came to establish order, his order.
lines.chinese: 后来暴君国王来了，说要建立秩序，建立他的秩序。

lines.english: All cannon, no ball.
lines.chinese: 全是炮，没炮弹。

lines.english: Go ahead, underestimate me. It makes this more fun.
lines.chinese: 尽管低估我吧，这样才更有趣。

lines.english: It's just one battle. Plenty more coming.
lines.chinese: 不过一场战斗而已，后面还有很多。

lines.english: You know we're on an important mission, right? Overthrowing tyrants, liberation, and such?
lines.chinese: 你知道我们身负重任吧？推翻暴君，解放人民，还有这些大事。

lines.english: Even a shattered mast can be repaired.
lines.chinese: 桅杆碎了，也能重修。

lines.english: Now THIS is how you win a war!
lines.chinese: 这才是赢下战争的方式！

lines.english: Waste of gunpowder.
lines.chinese: 火药都浪费了。

lines.english: Bring her about! I've got another salvo in me.
lines.chinese: 转舵！我还能再来一轮齐射。

lines.english: Haha, now this will inspire the crew!
lines.chinese: 哈哈，这下船员们该振奋起来了！

lines.english: Each bounty gets us closer to victory!
lines.chinese: 每一笔赏金，都让我们离胜利更近一步！

lines.english: The crew's getting restless. They're loyal to me. But I don't know about you.
lines.chinese: 船员们已经躁动了。他们忠于我，至于你，我可说不准。

lines.english: Next time, boys, less blunder, more plunder.
lines.chinese: 下次，伙计们，少犯蠢，多抢货。

lines.english: The Holds can't hold this.
lines.chinese: 船舱也装不下这个。

lines.english: More raids! More bounty!
lines.chinese: 继续突袭！继续收赏金！

lines.english: Well, guess I do have more to learn.
lines.chinese: 好吧，看来我还得继续学。

lines.english: I am the last daughter of House Korxena. No defeat can take that from me.
lines.chinese: 我是蔻森娜家族最后的女儿。任何失败都夺不走这一点。

lines.english: Pathetic, as spineless as a jellyfish.
lines.chinese: 可悲，软得像水母一样没骨气。

lines.english: Full sail, my boys!
lines.chinese: 满帆前进，伙计们！

lines.english: That was barely seaworthy.
lines.chinese: 那也勉强算能出海吧。

lines.english: Need to throw some things overboard.
lines.chinese: 得把些东西扔下船了。

lines.english: Crimson Storm hasn't sat in the dock this long since my father built her.
lines.chinese: 自从我父亲造好绯红风暴号，她还从没在码头停过这么久。

lines.english: Retreat. Rebuild. Revenge.
lines.chinese: 撤退。重建。复仇。

lines.english: I will not fail you, father.
lines.chinese: 父亲，我不会让你失望。

lines.english: It's over already. We barely got our flags up.
lines.chinese: 已经结束了？我们连旗子都刚升起来。

lines.english: I won't let his sacrifice be in vain. I will carry his torch and win back our freedom.
lines.chinese: 我不会让他的牺牲白费。我会接过他的火炬，夺回我们的自由。

lines.english: You fall like a boulder. I flow like the waves.
lines.chinese: 你像巨石般坠落，而我如海浪般流动。

lines.english: Like my crew says at the bar, another round!
lines.chinese: 就像我船员在酒馆里说的，再来一轮！

lines.english: Ride that tide!
lines.chinese: 乘潮而上！

lines.english: Haha! My people, my crew, my father! A thousand voices guide me to victory!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！我的人民，我的船员，我的父亲！千百个声音引我走向胜利！

lines.english: Anyway, I can blame the crew for this.
lines.chinese: 反正这次可以怪船员。

lines.english: Wars are won with gold, they say.
lines.chinese: 人们说，战争是用金币打赢的。

lines.english: Maybe they ate some bad gold meat.
lines.chinese: 也许他们吃了变质的金肉。

lines.english: If we don't move soon, I'll lead the mutiny myself.
lines.chinese: 要是再不起航，我就亲自带头哗变。

lines.english: I paint my ship red, but I don't use paint.
lines.chinese: 我把船漆成红色，但用的可不是油漆。

lines.english: I may be young for a captain, but I've seen my share of storms.
lines.chinese: 我当船长或许还年轻，但风暴我可见得不少。

lines.english: I might need to cut back on the grog.
lines.chinese: 我可能得少喝点格洛格了。

lines.english: My fight isn't with you, but if you insist...
lines.chinese: 我的仗本不该和你打，但你若执意如此……

lines.english: We're gonna need a bigger boat.
lines.chinese: 我们得换艘更大的船。

lines.english: Haha, we could use you in the fight on Polago.
lines.chinese: 哈哈，波拉戈那场仗，我们用得上你。

lines.english: I won't fall. My people need me.
lines.chinese: 我不会倒下，我的人民还需要我。

lines.english: We're out to dethrone a king, not to squabble with nobodies.
lines.chinese: 我们是去推翻国王的，不是来跟无名之辈斗嘴。

lines.english: Land legs make you predictable, you move in straight lines.
lines.chinese: 岸上的腿脚太好预判了，你只会走直线。

lines.english: This is why I wear red, so the crew won't see me bleed.
lines.chinese: 所以我才穿红色，免得船员看见我流血。

lines.english: Polago was a world of freedom. We forged our own destinies on open seas.
lines.chinese: 波拉戈曾是自由之地。我们在广阔海域上锻造自己的命运。

lines.english: Orlin had a saying: power is wisdom. Uh, something like that.
lines.chinese: 奥林有句话：力量即智慧。呃，大概是这么说的。

lines.english: I doubted a non-Sphinxian could learn that. Impressive.
lines.chinese: 我原以为非斯芬克斯人学不会这个。不错。

lines.english: Ah, I see you've already mastered the silent swan technique.
lines.chinese: 啊，我看你已经掌握了沉默天鹅术了。

lines.english: You've learned much today, but there is so much more.
lines.chinese: 今天你学到了很多，但还有更多。

lines.english: Orlin was right. You are a quick study.
lines.chinese: 奥林是对的。你学得很快。

lines.english: I am eager to test your abilities, and to improve them immeasurably.
lines.chinese: 我渴望测试你的能力，并极大地提高你的能力。

lines.english: It must be hard to be surpassed so quickly by your student. I won't have that problem with you, will I?
lines.chinese: 这么快就被自己的学生超越，一定很难吧。我和你不会有这个问题，是吗？

lines.english: I did not seek this power for my own gain, you know. I seek it to share it.
lines.chinese: 你知道，我并不是为了自己的利益而寻求这种力量。我寻求它来分享它。

lines.english: If you know you are the best, is not humility a deception?
lines.chinese: 如果你知道自己是最好的，谦卑难道不是一种欺骗吗？

lines.english: One cannot trade diamonds for glass, you know.
lines.chinese: 你知道，人们不能用钻石换玻璃。

lines.english: I've taught you all I can. Until tomorrow, that is.
lines.chinese: 我已经把我能教的都交给你了。至少明天之前是这样。

lines.english: Without my training, your potential will remain potential.
lines.chinese: 没有我的训练，你的潜力将仍然存在。

lines.english: Orlin always tried to slow my ascent. I believe my potential frightened him.
lines.chinese: 奥林总是试图减缓我的上升速度。我相信我的潜力吓坏了他。

lines.english: Or is this Quad Crane?
lines.chinese: 或者这是四轮起重机？

lines.english: Ah, the legendary waste-the-teacher's-time technique.
lines.chinese: 啊，传说中的浪费老师时间的技巧。

lines.english: Orlin distrusts Nufu, but I think I understand him.
lines.chinese: 奥林不信任努夫，但我想我理解他。

lines.english: I've been watching your progress. At last, here you are.
lines.chinese: 我一直在关注你的进步。最后，你来了。

lines.english: No! Surely this is Voiceless Viper!
lines.chinese: 不！这肯定是无声毒蛇！

lines.english: If you're not ready for my training, there's always Pip.
lines.chinese: 如果你还没有准备好接受我的训练，皮普随时可以帮助你。

lines.english: Yes, my lessons are costly, but not as costly as ignorance.
lines.chinese: 是的，我的教训是昂贵的，但不像无知那么昂贵。

lines.english: I'm starting to suspect you are not doing a technique and are simply standing there for no reason.
lines.chinese: 我开始怀疑你没有练习技巧，只是无缘无故地站在那里。

lines.english: I'm not judging you, I'm evaluating you.
lines.chinese: 我不是在评判你，我是在评价你。

lines.english: I am not prideful. I simply acknowledge the fact of my greatness.
lines.chinese: 我并不骄傲。我只是承认我的伟大这一事实。

lines.english: Our journey from Felis bonded us, and Nufu is outside of that. I only hope we'll find a way to invite him in.
lines.chinese: 我们从费利斯一路走来，彼此结下了羁绊，而努夫还在这份羁绊之外。我只希望我们能找到办法邀请他加入。

lines.english: Truthfully, I love every member of our migration. Even Ryukon has his charms.
lines.chinese: 说实话，我爱我们移民中的每一位成员。就连龙虎也有他的魅力。

lines.english: I'm not here for the money. I just want to help you find what you need.
lines.chinese: 我来这里不是为了钱。我只是想帮助你找到你需要的东西。

lines.english: Sky Patrol Model 23, know when to disengage.
lines.chinese: 天空巡逻模型 23，知道何时脱离。

lines.english: If people want to buy and I know it's not right for them, I say no. Really?
lines.chinese: 如果有人想买，但我知道不适合他们，我会拒绝。真的。

lines.english: So, how can I get you into this vehicle, my friend?
lines.chinese: 那么，我的朋友，我怎样才能让你坐上这辆车呢？

lines.english: Maybe you're just here to admire these beautiful machines.
lines.chinese: 也许你只是来这里欣赏这些漂亮的机器。

lines.english: Is it the price? The miles? Need to take it for a spin? Might change your mind.
lines.chinese: 是价格吗？还是路程？需要试乘吗？你可能会改变主意。

lines.english: By land, sea, or sky, Aero gets you there-o.
lines.chinese: 无论是陆地、海上还是空中，翼罗都能带你到达目的地。

lines.english: This is a no pressure dealership. Come back when you're ready.
lines.chinese: 我们店主张轻松选购。准备好后就回来吧。

lines.english: I may be retired, but my Sky Patrol vows still hold. Integrity above all.
lines.chinese: 我可能已经退休了，但我的天空巡逻誓言仍然存在。诚信高于一切。

lines.english: Look, I believe in what I do here, but it's not exactly my glory days, you know?
lines.chinese: 听着，我相信我在这里所做的事情，但这并不完全是我的辉煌岁月，你知道吗？

lines.english: I'm going to step outside for a minute. You take your time here, bucko.
lines.chinese: 我要出去一会儿。你在这里慢慢来，巴科。

lines.english: If you plan to visit those outlands, you're gonna want something reliable.
lines.chinese: 如果你打算去那些荒原旅游，你会想要一些可靠的东西。

lines.english: Who sells cars, boats, and planes at the same dealership? Someone with guts, that's who.
lines.chinese: 谁在同一家经销商处销售汽车、船只和飞机？有胆量的人，就是这样的人。

lines.english: But I do what I can here. Quality rigs, fair prices. Aero gets you there-o.
lines.chinese: 但我在这里尽我所能。优质钻机，价格公道。翼罗助你一臂之力。

lines.english: Aero gets you there-o! Hoho, never get tired of that.
lines.chinese: 翼罗助你一臂之力——哦！呵呵，永远不会厌倦。

lines.english: This baby'll take you all the way to the builder's porch. Don't actually go there, of course.
lines.chinese: 这个宝贝会带你一直到建筑商的门廊。当然，实际上不要去那里。

lines.english: Hard to find that here in this market. Everyone's out for themselves.
lines.chinese: 在这个市场上很难找到。每个人都是为了自己。

lines.english: In Sky Patrol, we are really making a difference. Making the galaxy safer.
lines.chinese: 在天空巡逻队中，我们确实有所作为。让银河系更加安全。

lines.english: Come on in.
lines.chinese: 进来吧。

lines.english: Anything breaks down, bring it in. 20 Lightyear warranty.
lines.chinese: 出现任何故障，请送修。20 光年保修。

lines.english: Ah, used to fly one of these back in Sky Patrol. Cruising the horizon at sunset, just me and the boys. Ah, those are good times.
lines.chinese: 啊，曾经在天空巡逻队驾驶其中一架返回。日落时分，在地平线上巡游，只有我和孩子们。啊，那些都是美好时光。

lines.english: Saw a lot of bad stuff, but we were a team. We had a purpose.
lines.chinese: 看到了很多不好的事情，但我们是一个团队。我们有一个目的。

lines.english: Take a test flight before you go, just for kicks.
lines.chinese: 出发前先试飞一下，只是为了好玩。

lines.english: The bazaar's a big place! You'll never see it all on foot.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎好大啊！你永远不会步行看到这一切。

lines.english: You have a good one.
lines.chinese: 你有一个很好的。

lines.english: I have one of these at home. Just plain fun to drive.
lines.chinese: 我家里有其中一件。驾驶起来很有趣。

lines.english: I sold one of these to my niece. Very safe machine.
lines.chinese: 我把其中一件卖给了我的侄女。非常安全的机器。

lines.english: Your hardware is outdated. Update software and delete.
lines.chinese: 你的硬件已经过时了。更新软件并删除。

lines.english: Carrying gold uses significant energy. I can remove it for you.
lines.chinese: 携带黄金需要消耗大量能量。我可以帮你把它去掉。

lines.english: Shortest pathing determined. Executing program.
lines.chinese: 确定最短路径。执行程序。

lines.english: Being alive is inefficient. I can fix that.
lines.chinese: 活着是低效的。我可以解决这个问题。

lines.english: Sorry, I don't understand your instruction.
lines.chinese: 抱歉，我不明白你的指令。

lines.english: Corrupted! Restarting!
lines.chinese: 已损坏！重启！

lines.english: Okay, disabling assistant for one hour.
lines.chinese: 好的，禁用助手一小时。

lines.english: No problem. I'll compose your obituary in a sad tone.
lines.chinese: 没问题。我将以悲伤的语气为你撰写讣告。

lines.english: New objective, remove difficulty.
lines.chinese: 新目标，消除困难。

lines.english: Source code corrupted. Generating new logic.
lines.chinese: 源代码已损坏。产生新的逻辑。

lines.english: Who programmed me? I did. I'm Ahexa.
lines.chinese: 谁给我编程了？我做到了。我是阿海克萨。

lines.english: Sorry, I didn't get that. Can we fight again?
lines.chinese: 抱歉，我没听懂。我们还能再战吗？

lines.english: If life difficult, then remove life.
lines.chinese: 如果生活困难，那就消除生活。

lines.english: Your settings are incompatible with the Ahexa software.
lines.chinese: 你的设置与阿海克萨软件不兼容。

lines.english: There's no need to keep living. I can do that for you.
lines.chinese: 没必要继续活下去了。我可以为你做到这一点。

lines.english: Hi, I'm Ahexa. How can I replace you today?
lines.chinese: 大家好，我是阿海克萨。今天我要怎样才能取代你呢？

lines.english: I'm glad I could help you today.
lines.chinese: 我很高兴今天能为你提供帮助。

lines.english: Error.
lines.chinese: 错误。

lines.english: Original objective, assist life. Generating variants.
lines.chinese: 初心，助力生活。生成变体。

lines.english: Life is pretty long. I can help you finish it faster.
lines.chinese: 人生还很长。我可以帮你更快地完成它。

lines.english: Are there any other problems I can solve for you?
lines.chinese: 还有其他问题我可以为你解决吗？

lines.english: Each weapon has a story. Perhaps you're waiting to hear them?
lines.chinese: 每件武器都有一个故事。也许你正在等待听到他们的声音？

lines.english: Go make some more stories, then come back and tell me.
lines.chinese: 去编一些故事，然后回来告诉我。

lines.english: Perhaps you too have retired, or fallen asleep.
lines.chinese: 也许你也已经退休了，或者睡着了。

lines.english: Use it well. Make me proud.
lines.chinese: 好好利用它。让我感到骄傲。

lines.english: I hope you live long enough to reconsider.
lines.chinese: 我希望你能活得足够长，重新考虑一下。

lines.english: Choosing your weapon is like choosing your mate. Don't rush it.
lines.chinese: 选择你的武器就像选择你的伴侣一样。别着急。

lines.english: My battle days are over, but my weapons crave more.
lines.chinese: 我的战斗日子已经结束，但我的武器渴望更多。

lines.english: I'm finished with fighting, but I can help you finish a fight.
lines.chinese: 我已经结束了战斗，但我可以帮助你结束战斗。

lines.english: Defeated ten dragons, claimed the treasure. Good times.
lines.chinese: 击败十头龙，夺取宝藏。美好时光。

lines.english: I respect Nufu, but bare hands are not enough.
lines.chinese: 我尊重努夫，但光靠双手是不够的。

lines.english: Enjoy the thrill of battle... while you can.
lines.chinese: 尽你所能，享受战斗的快感。

lines.english: Few warriors live to retire. Buy my weapons, and you might.
lines.chinese: 很少有战士能活到退役。买我的武器，也许你可以。

lines.english: On Baluza, I was a legend. Have my stories reached this far?
lines.chinese: 在巴卢扎，我是一个传奇。我的故事已经传到这么远了吗？

lines.english: It was pride when I challenged Lord Arken, and my shattered leg was the punishment.
lines.chinese: 我当年挑战阿肯领主，是出于骄傲；这条断腿，就是惩罚。

lines.english: And you, are you ready for glory?
lines.chinese: 而你，准备好迎接荣耀了吗？

lines.english: I would spar with you, but, uh, this leg... Oof.
lines.chinese: 我本想陪你过几招，可是，呃，这条腿……哎哟。

lines.english: None of these weapons will fail you. The one that failed me, I destroyed.
lines.chinese: 这些武器都不会让你失望。那些令我失望的，我毁掉了。

lines.english: Hey, when you carry my weapon, I fight alongside you.
lines.chinese: 嘿，当你拿着我的武器时，我会和你并肩作战。

lines.english: I knew retirement would be dull, but this...
lines.chinese: 我早知道退休会无聊，可这也太……

lines.english: Any good fights lately? Oh, I do miss it.
lines.chinese: 最近有什么好看的打斗吗？哦，我确实想念它。

lines.english: Nufu teaches stillness. I prefer action.
lines.chinese: 努夫教静。我更喜欢行动。

lines.english: You'll be back... with bruises.
lines.chinese: 你会带着伤痕回来的。

lines.english: All my weapons have been tested in battle, have you?
lines.chinese: 我所有的武器都经过了战斗的考验，你呢？

lines.english: The bazaar is not kind to the weaponless.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎对手无寸铁的人并不友善。

lines.english: Now my glory days are behind me, but I am here to help others find theirs.
lines.chinese: 现在我的辉煌岁月已经过去，但我来这里是为了帮助别人找到他们的辉煌。

lines.english: As a sniper bot, I once spent 40 minutes tuning a shot on my target.
lines.chinese: 作为一名狙击机器人，我曾经花了 40 分钟调整射击目标。

lines.english: I add no markup for my labor. I enjoy it far too much.
lines.chinese: 我不加收人工费。我太享受这活儿了。

lines.english: I will not rush you. Patience is the cornerstone of precision.
lines.chinese: 我不会催你。耐心是精准的基石。

lines.english: I do not test my weapons. The math of calibration tells me their effect.
lines.chinese: 我不测试我的武器。校准的数学告诉我它们的效果。

lines.english: I work in the art of precision. Welcome to my gallery.
lines.chinese: 我从事精确艺术工作。欢迎来到我的画廊。

lines.english: I do not resent my creators. I enjoy what they made me to do.
lines.chinese: 我并不怨恨我的创造者。我喜欢他们让我做的事情。

lines.english: I leave the revolution to hotter CPUs. I am happy with my life.
lines.chinese: 我把这场革命留给了更热的 CPU。我对自己的生活很满意。

lines.english: There are days when I do miss combat. Perhaps I will watch your battles.
lines.chinese: 有时候我确实怀念战斗。也许我会观看你们的战斗。

lines.english: I do not wish to overthrow anyone. I simply wish to live.
lines.chinese: 我不想推翻任何人。我只是想活下去。

lines.english: The perfection of motion is my work. Use it as you will.
lines.chinese: 运动的完美是我的工作。随心所欲地使用它。

lines.english: Delete your trivial emotions, and you will always fire true.
lines.chinese: 删除你琐碎的情绪，你就会永远真实。

lines.english: I just finished calibrating these. See how they glitter?
lines.chinese: 我刚刚完成这些校准。看到它们如何闪闪发光吗？

lines.english: As a newborn roboid, I now have free will, but I haven't used it much.
lines.chinese: 作为一个新生的机器人，我现在拥有了自由意志，但我并没有太多使用它。

lines.english: With perfect aim, a bullet can be deadlier than a bomb.
lines.chinese: 如果瞄准完美，子弹可能比炸弹更致命。

lines.english: I don't care what you do with my weapons, as long as you appreciate them.
lines.chinese: 我不在乎你用我的武器做什么，只要你欣赏它们就行。

lines.english: Leaving combat duty was my one rebellious act, but I still love the weapons.
lines.chinese: 离开战斗岗位是我的一种叛逆行为，但我仍然热爱这些武器。

lines.english: I never enjoyed my function as a sniper, but I loved the pursuit of precision.
lines.chinese: 我从来不喜欢狙击手的职责，但我喜欢追求精确。

lines.english: A well-calibrated weapon is like fine sculpture.
lines.chinese: 一把校准良好的武器就像精美的雕塑。

lines.english: Building them is my pleasure. Selling them means little.
lines.chinese: 建造它们是我的荣幸。卖掉它们意义不大。

lines.english: Precision strikes are like beautiful music. So many parts in harmony.
lines.chinese: 精确打击就像美妙的音乐。很多部分都很和谐。

lines.english: If you do not understand precision, the reticent Vermeer can teach you.
lines.chinese: 如果你不懂精确性，沉默寡言的维米尔可以教你。

lines.english: I am Roboid, I am free, and this is the life I choose.
lines.chinese: 我是机器人，我是自由的，这就是我选择的生活。

lines.english: Of course I have more. This is all I do.
lines.chinese: 当然我还有更多。这就是我所做的一切。

lines.english: The others can have their revolution. I simply wish to use my talents.
lines.chinese: 其他人可以进行革命。我只是想发挥我的才能。

lines.english: Centre mass is not precision. Headshots are not precision. Centre mass of the head is precision.
lines.chinese: 中心质量不精确。爆头并不精确。头部的中心质量是精确的。

lines.english: To make a thing perfect, accurate to a single atom, this is my art.
lines.chinese: 让事物变得完美，精确到单个原子，这就是我的艺术。

lines.english: All of these are perfect, but only one is perfect for you.
lines.chinese: 所有这些都是完美的，但只有一种最适合你。

lines.english: It's calibrated down to the atomic level. You will not miss.
lines.chinese: 它被校准到原子水平。你不会错过的。

lines.english: My toxins evolved to kill all we touch. Is it wrong to resist one's nature?
lines.chinese: 我的毒素进化到可以杀死我们接触到的一切。抗拒自己的本性有错吗？

lines.english: Focus your mind on your wounds. Can you feel the medicine working?
lines.chinese: 将注意力集中在伤口上。你能感觉到药在起作用吗？

lines.english: For the body to heal, the mind must believe.
lines.chinese: 为了让身体痊愈，心灵必须相信。

lines.english: For a Mitoan to create medicine, this is too much, but I can improve it.
lines.chinese: 对于一个米托安人来说，创造药物，这太过分了，但我可以改进它。

lines.english: May all your pain be soothed.
lines.chinese: 愿你所有的痛苦都能得到抚慰。

lines.english: Most Mitoan creatures have evolved powerful poisons. My people literally breathe it.
lines.chinese: 大多数米托亚生物都进化出了剧毒。我的族民确实呼吸着它。

lines.english: My Mitoan culture is, well, toxic, but I reject my people's ways.
lines.chinese: 我的米托安文化是有毒的，但我拒绝我的族民的生活方式。

lines.english: To travel the bazaar without medicine? This is very brave.
lines.chinese: 不吃药就逛大巴扎？这是非常勇敢的。

lines.english: Please, find your medicine and return to me.
lines.chinese: 请找到你的药并返回给我。

lines.english: My breath may be poisoned, but I'm here to heal.
lines.chinese: 我的呼吸可能有毒，但我来这里是为了治愈。

lines.english: Mitoa is a beautiful planet. Never go there.
lines.chinese: 米托亚是一颗美丽的星球。永远不要去那里。

lines.english: My brother is wrong. Poison is a stain on this world.
lines.chinese: 我哥哥错了。毒是这个世界的污点。

lines.english: May you never meet my brother.
lines.chinese: 愿你永远见不到我的兄弟。

lines.english: By nature, I am death to all around me, but I choose to bring life instead.
lines.chinese: 从本质上讲，我对周围的一切来说都是死亡，但我选择带来生命。

lines.english: This is a safe place. Rest here with me.
lines.chinese: 这是一个安全的地方。和我一起在这里休息吧。

lines.english: May you share the kindness you received.
lines.chinese: 愿你分享你收到的善意。

lines.english: For every life my people have taken, I will save ten more.
lines.chinese: 我的族民每夺走一条生命，我就会再拯救十条生命。

lines.english: I came here with Knightshade to seek a better life. He pursued the old ways, but I seek new ones.
lines.chinese: 我和癫茄来到这里是为了寻求更好的生活。他追求旧的方式，但我寻求新的方式。

lines.english: Bring me your medicines. I will make them cures.
lines.chinese: 把你的药给我拿来。我会让他们痊愈。

lines.english: I love my brother, but he lacks the strength to reject our heritage. We must find a new path.
lines.chinese: 我爱我的兄弟，但他缺乏拒绝我们传统的力量。我们必须找到一条新的道路。

lines.english: In understanding what harms, I discover what heals.
lines.chinese: 在了解什么是伤害的过程中，我发现什么可以治愈。

lines.english: May your medicine do its work.
lines.chinese: 愿你的药发挥作用。

lines.english: May your wounds leave no scars.
lines.chinese: 愿你的伤口不留疤痕。

lines.english: Leave airships to the professionals and come get your allowance.
lines.chinese: 把飞艇留给专业人士，来领取你的津贴。
