lines.english: You always were an unruly brat. Good luck, sister.
lines.chinese: 你一直都是个不守规矩的小鬼。祝你好运，姐姐。

lines.english: This is beneath us, but I'm angry enough to do it.
lines.chinese: 这是我们的耻辱，但我很生气，就这么做了。

lines.english: How can you be so selfish? Think of the shareholders.
lines.chinese: 你怎么可以这么自私呢？想想股东吧。

lines.english: Very well. We'll settle it your way.
lines.chinese: 很好。我们会按照你的方式解决。

lines.english: Father thought I might talk some sense into you. Now he will send someone harsher.
lines.chinese: 父亲认为我可以对你说一些道理。现在他会派一个更严厉的人来。

lines.english: So I have to beat the sense into you? Fine.
lines.chinese: 所以我必须给你灌输理智？美好的。

lines.english: Fine, let us see what our little grease rat has learned.
lines.chinese: 好吧，让我们看看我们的小油鼠都学到了什么。

lines.english: Now will you see reason, or must I beat you again?
lines.chinese: 现在你能明白道理了吗，还是我必须再次打败你？

lines.english: Our stock has plummeted! Mother had to sell her favorite store yacht.
lines.chinese: 我们的库存暴跌了！母亲不得不卖掉她最喜欢的商店游艇。

lines.english: As I thought, your moral convictions are lighter than helium.
lines.chinese: 正如我所想，你的道德信念比氦气还要轻。

lines.english: Yes, I thought this might sway you.
lines.chinese: 是的，我想这可能会影响你。

lines.english: How can you be so selfish? Think of the shareholders.
lines.chinese: 你怎么可以这么自私呢？想想股东吧。

lines.english: We have humored you long enough, Stelle.
lines.chinese: 我们已经迁就你很久了，斯黛尔。

lines.english: Is this what you do all day? Sit around and daydream?
lines.chinese: 这就是你整天做的事情吗？坐着做白日梦？

lines.english: Father built us an empire, and this is the thanks you give?
lines.chinese: 父亲为我们建立了一个帝国，这就是你给予的感谢？

lines.english: You're embarrassing all of us with this game of yours.
lines.chinese: 你的这个游戏让我们所有人都感到尴尬。

lines.english: I'm waiting. Mother and father are waiting. We're all waiting.
lines.chinese: 我在等。妈妈和爸爸正在等待。我们都在等待。

lines.english: You know how hard Father works, and you burden him like this?
lines.chinese: 你知道爸爸工作有多辛苦，你还让他这么累吗？

lines.english: There you are, baby sister. The shareholders have been worried sick about you.
lines.chinese: 你来了，小妹妹。股东们一直很担心你。

lines.english: Our stock has plummeted! Mother had to sell her favorite store yacht.
lines.chinese: 我们的库存暴跌了！母亲不得不卖掉她最喜欢的商店游艇。

lines.english: Thinking up your next great excuse, dear sister?
lines.chinese: 亲爱的妹妹，想好你的下一个好借口了吗？

lines.english: Grow up and face reality. The world you live in is impossible.
lines.chinese: 长大了，面对现实。你生活的世界是不可能的。

lines.english: You're a smart one, for your size.
lines.chinese: 以你的块头来说，你算聪明的。

lines.english: Whoever said money can't buy class had neither.
lines.chinese: 那些说金钱买不到阶级的人其实两者都没有。

lines.english: If you want cheap junk, go see Curio.
lines.chinese: 如果你想要便宜的垃圾，就去看看库里欧。

lines.english: Neither wealthy nor wise, eh?
lines.chinese: 既不富有又不聪明，是吗？

lines.english: Hmm? You had a question?
lines.chinese: 唔？你有问题吗？

lines.english: That's it! Get out! Buy something expensive and get out!
lines.chinese: 就是这样！出去！买点贵的东西然后走人！

lines.english: Oh, I understand. Class isn't for everyone.
lines.chinese: 哦，我明白了。课程并不适合所有人。

lines.english: This is a family business. How dare you question our... What's that word? Ethics?
lines.chinese: 这是一家家族企业。你怎么敢质疑我们的……那个词是什么？伦理？

lines.english: Remember, diamonds come in small boxes.
lines.chinese: 请记住，钻石装在小盒子里。

lines.english: Shall I gift wrap it for you?
lines.chinese: 我要给你包装一下礼物吗？

lines.english: I am not cute. I am handsome.
lines.chinese: 我不可爱。我很帅。

lines.english: I think that suits you beautifully.
lines.chinese: 我认为这很适合你。

lines.english: Ah, you've just taken the first step toward good taste.
lines.chinese: 啊，你刚刚迈出了品味的第一步。

lines.english: If you want something big and ugly, go see Pol.
lines.chinese: 如果你想要一些又大又丑的东西，就去找波尔吧。

lines.english: Size dilutes the brain. Mind is highly concentrated.
lines.chinese: 尺寸会稀释大脑。精神高度集中。

lines.english: Ugh. Window shoppers.
lines.chinese: 啊。橱窗购物者。

lines.english: Buyer's remorse never. Be remorseless.
lines.chinese: 买家永远不会后悔。毫不留情。

lines.english: If you're concerned about the legality of my wares, just don't be.
lines.chinese: 如果你担心我的商品的合法性，请不必担心。

lines.english: If you want pointless chit-chat, go visit Jay Jay.
lines.chinese: 如果你想无意义地闲聊，就去拜访杰杰吧。

lines.english: You wanna buy that? I mean, excellent choice.
lines.chinese: 你想买那个？我是说，眼光真不错。

lines.english: This must be a big decision for someone… like you.
lines.chinese: 对于像你这样的人来说，这一定是一个重大决定。

lines.english: The smaller the portions, the finer the meal.
lines.chinese: 份量越小，饭菜就越精致。

lines.english: I do offer financing, but, um, how's your credit?
lines.chinese: 我确实提供融资，但是，嗯，你的信用怎么样？

lines.english: So maybe I exploit the occasional legal loophole, but I pass the savings on to you.
lines.chinese: 所以也许我偶尔会利用法律漏洞，但我会把节省下来的钱转嫁给你。

lines.english: Tell everyone you got it here!
lines.chinese: 告诉大家你在这里找到了！

lines.english: Unhand me! You call it petting. I call it assault!
lines.chinese: 松开我！你称之为抚摸。我称之为攻击！

lines.english: I would never debase my wares by... haggling. Ugh.
lines.chinese: 我绝不会通过……讨价还价来贬低我的商品。啊。

lines.english: If you have to ask the price, you can't afford it.
lines.chinese: 如果非要问价格的话，你也买不起。

lines.english: When you get tired of anarchy, the Annexian Municipality is here for you.
lines.chinese: 当你厌倦无政府状态时，统合自治领就在这里为你服务。

lines.english: We offer solutions for all your law and order needs.
lines.chinese: 你在法律与秩序方面的一切需求，我们都能提供解决方案。

lines.english: I apologize for the inconvenience. I'll try again later.
lines.chinese: 对于给你带来的不便，我深表歉意。我稍后再试。

lines.english: You need laws, regulations, taxes, etc.
lines.chinese: 你需要法律、法规、税收等。

lines.english: I'm glad I was able to help you today. Do you have time for a brief survey?
lines.chinese: 我很高兴今天能为你提供帮助。你有时间做一个简短的调查吗？

lines.english: I'll need to escalate your case to my supervisor.
lines.chinese: 我需要将你的案件上报给我的主管。

lines.english: The Annexian Municipality looks forward to your inclusion.
lines.chinese: 统合自治领期待你的加入。

lines.english: Please read the terms and conditions before agreeing to annexation.
lines.chinese: 请在同意合并之前阅读条款和条件。

lines.english: The Annexian Municipality has brought order to a thousand worlds.
lines.chinese: 统合自治领已为一千个世界带来秩序。

lines.english: The Bazaar is too big to self-govern at this time.
lines.chinese: 目前大巴扎太大了，无法进行自治。

lines.english: Unfortunately, I'm not able to process that request at this time.
lines.chinese: 不幸的是，我目前无法处理该请求。

lines.english: Enjoy all the benefits of traditional governance, from security to taxation.
lines.chinese: 享受传统治理的所有好处，从安全到税收。

lines.english: If this is a bad time, I can come back tomorrow.
lines.chinese: 如果现在不方便的话，我明天可以回来。

lines.english: Unfortunately, Bazaarian independence is unrealistic at this time.
lines.chinese: 遗憾的是，大巴扎此刻独立并不现实。

lines.english: Submit to Annexation and enjoy all the benefits of the municipality.
lines.chinese: 服从并享受市政府的所有福利。

lines.english: I'm your Annexian Municipality Special Negotiator. How are you today?
lines.chinese: 我是你们的统合自治领特别谈判员。今天过得如何？

lines.english: The Annexian Municipality appreciates your cooperation.
lines.chinese: 统合自治领感谢你的配合。

lines.english: We're sorry. The Bazaar is too valuable to be left ungoverned at this time.
lines.chinese: 我们很抱歉。大巴扎太有价值了，此时不能放任不管。

lines.english: That you've come this far on your own makes no sense at all.
lines.chinese: 你自己已经走到这一步了，根本没有任何意义。

lines.english: We simply wish to help you become normal.
lines.chinese: 我们只是希望帮助你变得正常。

lines.english: Pearl found that one. She'll make a fine antiquarian someday.
lines.chinese: 珍珠找到了那个。有一天她会成为一名优秀的古董学家。

lines.english: Bazaarian culture is a blend of a thousand worlds, and yet, do you see the influence of the ancients?
lines.chinese: 大巴扎文化融合了千百个世界，然而，你看见古人的影响了吗？

lines.english: Not all Saurians are brutes, but Lord Arken is a stain on our kind.
lines.chinese: 并非所有蜥蜴人都是野蛮之辈，但阿肯领主是我们族类的污点。

lines.english: Lord Arken can have his empire, I only want my collection.
lines.chinese: 阿肯领主尽可拥有他的帝国，我只要我的收藏。

lines.english: Perhaps you should visit my young friend Pearl. She finds new treasures every day.
lines.chinese: 也许你应该去拜访我的年轻朋友珍珠。她每天都会发现新的宝藏。

lines.english: I'm sure I have something worth your time.
lines.chinese: 我确信我有一些值得你花时间的事情。

lines.english: Oh dear, I've bored you with my theorising, haven't I?
lines.chinese: 哦，亲爱的，我的理论已经让你厌烦了，不是吗？

lines.english: I came here to pursue my studies away from his foolish wars. Imagine my surprise to find his daughter!
lines.chinese: 我来这里是为了远离他愚蠢的战争而继续学业。想象一下当我找到他的女儿时我有多惊讶！

lines.english: Oh, that poor girl, living in that monster's shadow, every time he visits, it wounds her.
lines.chinese: 哦，那个可怜的女孩，生活在那个怪物的阴影下，每次他来访，她都会受伤。

lines.english: Most Bazaarians know nothing of these cultures, so how are they being influenced by them? This place is not what it seems.
lines.chinese: 大多数大巴扎人对这些文化一无所知，那他们又是如何受其影响的？这里并不像表面那样简单。

lines.english: I have a theory on the origins of this place, but Pearl says it's unscientific.
lines.chinese: 我对这个地方的起源有一个理论，但珍珠说这是不科学的。

lines.english: My excavation days are over, but Pearl keeps me supplied.
lines.chinese: 我的挖掘日子已经结束，但珍珠仍为我提供供应。

lines.english: You can really see the influence of free Carthusian art on this piece.
lines.chinese: 你可以真正看到自由卡尔特会艺术对这件作品的影响。

lines.english: To be honest, I'm relieved. Oh, I hate to part with any of them.
lines.chinese: 说实话，我心里松了口气。哦，我不愿意与他们中的任何一个分开。

lines.english: Not a fan of Zenovian sculpture? How about pre-Zenovian?
lines.chinese: 不喜欢泽诺维亚雕塑？前泽诺维亚时期怎么样？

lines.english: It's a wonder these still hold their powers. Oh, the ancients built things to last.
lines.chinese: 令人惊奇的是，这些人仍然拥有他们的权力。哦，古人创造的东西经久耐用。

lines.english: Most of these civilizations left so little behind, we can only wonder.
lines.chinese: 大多数文明留下的东西如此之少，我们只能感到惊讶。

lines.english: Still, I have to wonder what effect she has on him. He seems a little softer when he leaves.
lines.chinese: 不过，我还是想知道她对他有什么影响。当他离开的时候，他显得柔和了一些。

lines.english: The Foundation was here long before the Bazaar, we are not the first to settle it.
lines.chinese: 基底早在大巴扎之前就已存在，我们并不是第一个定居于此的人。

lines.english: Who were these people? Where did they go? Such is the mystery.
lines.chinese: 这些人是谁？他们去哪儿了？这就是奥秘。

lines.english: The past has much to teach us.
lines.chinese: 过去有很多值得我们学习的地方。

lines.english: What happened to these civilizations, and will it happen to us?
lines.chinese: 这些文明发生了什么，也会发生在我们身上吗？

lines.english: This modern painting, this ancient statue, the similarities are unmistakable.
lines.chinese: 这幅现代绘画，这幅古代雕像，相似之处是显而易见的。

lines.english: All I can do is be here when she needs me. We both must keep digging.
lines.chinese: 我能做的就是在她需要我的时候出现在她身边。我们都必须继续挖掘。

lines.english: Ancient travellers left their marks here, and their relics.
lines.chinese: 古代旅行者在这里留下了他们的印记和遗迹。

lines.english: I don't even want to sell these, but Pearl says I need income.
lines.chinese: 我甚至不想卖掉这些，但珍珠说我需要收入。

lines.english: It feels wrong to sell artifacts, but the Bazaar is a marketplace.
lines.chinese: 出售文物感觉不对，但大巴扎是一个市场。

lines.english: And I have some fine examples of pre-Bazaarian sculpture.
lines.chinese: 我还有一些大巴扎古代雕塑的精美例子。

lines.english: My training is about letting go of what holds you down. Think you're ready for that?
lines.chinese: 我的训练是关于放弃那些阻碍你的事情。你认为你已经准备好了吗？

lines.english: If you want grim and stoic, you came to the wrong Sphinxian. I believe in joy.
lines.chinese: 如果你想找阴沉又冷峻的那种斯芬克斯人，那你找错人了。我相信快乐。

lines.english: When I joined the Sphinxian migration, I didn't know how much I'd stand out.
lines.chinese: 我加入斯芬克斯人的迁徙时，还不知道自己会这么显眼。

lines.english: To really self-reflect, you have to get comfortable with silence.
lines.chinese: 要真正进行自我反省，你必须适应沉默。

lines.english: I'm still here? Are you?
lines.chinese: 我还在这里吗？你是？

lines.english: But it's nice talking to someone who's not wise for a change. Um, no offense.
lines.chinese: 但与不明智的人交谈是件好事。嗯，无意冒犯。

lines.english: When you're ready, I'm here for you.
lines.chinese: 当你准备好时，我就在你身边。

lines.english: You seem lighter. I think you had a breakthrough.
lines.chinese: 你看起来更轻了。我认为你已经取得了突破。

lines.english: Adira is our strongest. Oh, but does she know it. Try Orlin. Or Nufu.
lines.chinese: 艾迪拉是我们最强的。哦，但她知道吗？试试奥林。或努夫。

lines.english: Best I can do is just be myself and try to lighten the mood. Wise old sages are pretty fun to tease.
lines.chinese: 我能做的就是做自己，努力活跃气氛。那些老圣贤逗起来还挺有意思。

lines.english: Oh sure, I can help you, but you have to trust me.
lines.chinese: 哦，当然，我可以帮助你，但你必须相信我。

lines.english: I sense something blocking your power. Let's get rid of it.
lines.chinese: 我感觉到有东西阻碍了你的力量。让我们摆脱它吧。

lines.english: I can tell you think deeply. That's good.
lines.chinese: 我可以告诉你深思熟虑。那挺好的。

lines.english: Thanks for trusting me. I hope we can do this again.
lines.chinese: 感谢你对我的信任。我希望我们能再次这样做。

lines.english: There's Pip, but I think he's in love with me. Sweet kid, but you know.
lines.chinese: 皮普在那儿，但我想他爱上了我。可爱的孩子，但你知道。

lines.english: All that being said, are you okay?
lines.chinese: 说了这么多，你还好吗？

lines.english: There are a lot of steps in this staircase, but it's beautiful up there.
lines.chinese: 这个楼梯有很多台阶，但是上面很漂亮。

lines.english: Having no one but wise old men to talk to, gets a little old.
lines.chinese: 除了明智的老人没有人可以交谈，就有点老了。

lines.english: This isn't our moment, but I'll be here when it is.
lines.chinese: 这不是我们的时刻，但那时我会在这里。

lines.english: We made progress today. I'm proud of you.
lines.chinese: 今天我们取得了进展。我为你感到骄傲。

lines.english: I teach, you learn. We're a good team.
lines.chinese: 我教，你学。我们是一支优秀的团队。

lines.english: When you're ready, I'll send you to Orlin. But I'll keep you as long as I can.
lines.chinese: 当你准备好后，我会送你去奥林。但我会尽可能地留住你。

lines.english: Hey, if it's about the gold, Pip is affordable. Cute kid too.
lines.chinese: 嘿，如果是关于黄金的话，皮普是可以承受的。孩子也很可爱。

lines.english: Let's both keep learning. Maybe someday we'll teach each other.
lines.chinese: 我们俩继续学习吧。也许有一天我们会互相教导。

lines.english: It may be possible to get too comfortable with silence.
lines.chinese: 沉默可能会让你感到太舒服。

lines.english: Space is my canvas, and time is my paint.
lines.chinese: 空间是我的画布，时间是我的颜料。

lines.english: All things can become beautiful. That is art.
lines.chinese: 一切都可以变得美丽。那就是艺术。

lines.english: You must not tell your past what's to come, but you can wink.
lines.chinese: 你不能告诉你的过去将会发生什么，但你可以眨眼。

lines.english: You may meet another like me. Do not trust this mandala.
lines.chinese: 你可能会遇到另一个像我一样的人。不要相信这个曼陀罗。

lines.english: The art can find a home in any object.
lines.chinese: 艺术可以在任何物体上找到归宿。

lines.english: Now this object is a color in my painting.
lines.chinese: 现在这个物体是我画中的一种颜色。

lines.english: A tiny taste of the worlds you can't see.
lines.chinese: 尝尝你看不到的世界的微小味道。

lines.english: Your things are so dull. Let me brighten them.
lines.chinese: 你的东西太乏味了。让我照亮它们。

lines.english: And if we wait still longer, we will meet our own pasts.
lines.chinese: 如果我们再等一段时间，我们就会遇见自己的过去。

lines.english: Now you can see it like I see it. Glorious.
lines.chinese: 现在你能像我一样看见它了。何等辉煌。

lines.english: All Wymari are powerful. Not all of us are kind.
lines.chinese: 所有威玛里族都很强大。并非我们所有人都是善良的。

lines.english: The art flows through me and into whatever I touch.
lines.chinese: 艺术流经我并渗透到我所接触到的一切事物中。

lines.english: So many things that can't be shared in words, it's enough to drive one mad.
lines.chinese: 很多事情是无法用言语来表达的，足以让一个人发疯。

lines.english: Time is a river that begins at its source, forever flowing.
lines.chinese: 时间是一条河流，从源头开始，永远流淌。

lines.english: What's your favorite color? Mine is sadness.
lines.chinese: 你最喜欢什么颜色？我的是悲伤。

lines.english: Have you ever considered becoming triangular?
lines.chinese: 你有没有想过变成三角形？

lines.english: My only salvation is the language of art.
lines.chinese: 我唯一的救赎就是艺术的语言。

lines.english: We have been here before, and will be again.
lines.chinese: 我们以前来过这里，并且还会再来。

lines.english: I just want to share what I've seen, even a glimpse.
lines.chinese: 我只是想分享我所看到的，哪怕只是一瞥。

lines.english: If we wait long enough, we will meet ourselves at the end of the future.
lines.chinese: 如果我们等待足够长的时间，我们就会在未来的尽头遇见自己。

lines.english: From mundane to magnificent.
lines.chinese: 从平凡到伟大。

lines.english: Words of color. Words of shape. The only way to say what I've seen.
lines.chinese: 颜色的话。形之言。唯一能表达我所看到的。

lines.english: Greetings, old friend. I'm pleased to finally meet you.
lines.chinese: 你好，老朋友。我很高兴终于见到你了。

lines.english: They chose me. Now they may choose you.
lines.chinese: 他们选中了我。现在，他们也可能选中你。

lines.english: You best head on home, City Slick. You lack the synaptic density to process what you're gonna find here.
lines.chinese: 你最好回城里去，城里人。你的突触密度不够，处理不了你会在这里发现的东西。

lines.english: Why'd they do this to me? Am I supposed to be a messenger?
lines.chinese: 他们为什么要对我这样？我是被派来传话的吗？

lines.english: You done whooped me up good! Woo!
lines.chinese: 你可真把我揍惨了！呜呼！

lines.english: Ugh, you ain't goin' nowhere, city slicker. Because all motion in three-dimensional space is an illusion.
lines.chinese: 呃，你哪儿也去不了，城里人。因为三维空间里的一切运动都是幻觉。

lines.english: Even their gifts were insufficient. I'll just get on home now.
lines.chinese: 连他们赐下的礼物都不够。我还是回家去吧。

lines.english: I can feel them in my head! They want me to test you!
lines.chinese: 我能感觉他们在我脑子里！他们要我考验你！

lines.english: Treasures within, they might change you.
lines.chinese: 里面的宝物，也许会改变你。

lines.english: When I came to the vessel, I was like the others, but it changed me.
lines.chinese: 我来到那艘容器时，和其他人没什么两样；可它改变了我。

lines.english: I see beyond my people's squabbles with the city folk. I see everything.
lines.chinese: 我看穿了族人和城里人的争执。我看见了一切。

lines.english: What happens to me don't matter, I done delivered the message.
lines.chinese: 我会怎样不重要，反正话我已经带到了。

lines.english: Within the vessel are wonders beyond comprehension, but you ain't ready for them.
lines.chinese: 容器之中有超越理解的奇迹，可你还没准备好。

lines.english: I feel strange. I feel smart. I feel every particle of the 11 dimensional universe.
lines.chinese: 我感觉很怪。我感觉很聪明。我感觉到十一维宇宙里的每一个粒子。

lines.english: Well, look what we got here. A sapient life form, seeking to know the unknowable.
lines.chinese: 哟，瞧瞧这是谁。一个有知觉的生命体，想探寻不可知之物。

lines.english: The universe is too vast, too beautiful, for any of this to even matter.
lines.chinese: 宇宙太浩瀚、太美了，美到这一切都无关紧要。

lines.english: Giddyup!
lines.chinese: 驾！

lines.english: Leave me now! I must contemplate realms beyond the tangible.
lines.chinese: 现在离开我！我要沉思有形之外的领域。

lines.english: They don't want me to hurt you! Only deliver a message.
lines.chinese: 他们不想让我伤害你！只是让我传个话。

lines.english: I ain't sure why I did that to you. Must have been a fluctuation of the probability field.
lines.chinese: 我也不确定刚才为什么那么对你。准是概率场波动了一下。

lines.english: Well, I sure showed you that all actions are predetermined within 4D spacetime.
lines.chinese: 好吧，我算是让你见识了：一切行动都早在四维时空里注定。

lines.english: Find your purpose and build it, or they gonna whoop you something fierce.
lines.chinese: 找到你的使命，然后把它造出来；不然他们会狠狠收拾你。

lines.english: You ever hear a little voice in your back teeth, hm? Something about joining the municipality, hm?
lines.chinese: 你有没有听过后槽牙里传来小声音，嗯？说什么加入自治市，嗯？

lines.english: Sorry to bug you, neighbor, but could I borrow all of your money?
lines.chinese: 抱歉打扰了，邻居，能不能把你的钱全借给我？

lines.english: Oh, goodness gracious!
lines.chinese: 哎呀，我的天哪！

lines.english: These days, I'm a pretty boring guy. Can't even remember the last time I killed somebody.
lines.chinese: 这些天我就是个挺无聊的人。都想不起上次杀人是什么时候了。

lines.english: Oh, crackers!
lines.chinese: 哎哟，糟糕！

lines.english: Not sure why I'm doing this. Maybe some kind of mind control. You know how it is.
lines.chinese: 不太确定我为什么要这么做。也许是什么精神控制吧，你懂的。

lines.english: Yeah, I used to run with the hoverbikes, then the Harkuvians, but that's all behind me now.
lines.chinese: 是啊，我以前跟悬浮车帮混过，后来又跟哈库维安人混过，不过那都是过去的事了。

lines.english: Well, fair enough, I guess.
lines.chinese: 好吧，倒也公平。

lines.english: No hard feelings, I hope. The Bazaar is a crazy place, right?
lines.chinese: 希望你别往心里去。大巴扎就是这么疯，对吧？

lines.english: Hey neighbor, mind if I collect that bounty on your head, hm?
lines.chinese: 嘿邻居，介意我领走你头上的赏金吗，嗯？

lines.english: Hey there, neighbor. You got any adrenaline injectors?
lines.chinese: 嘿，邻居。你有肾上腺素注射器吗？

lines.english: Nice of you to let me live! Might even return the favor someday.
lines.chinese: 谢谢你留我一命！说不定哪天我也会还你这个人情。

lines.english: Sorry for the trouble. Just gonna loot you real quick if that's alright.
lines.chinese: 抱歉添麻烦了。要是不介意，我就赶紧搜刮你一下。

lines.english: My life? Aww, you know, work, family, cult, bounty hunting, happy hour, friends.
lines.chinese: 我的生活？噢，你知道的，工作、家庭、邪教、赏金猎人、欢乐时光、朋友。

lines.english: I'm gonna go ahead and call the Volkas Enforcers, if you don't mind.
lines.chinese: 不介意的话，我这就去叫沃卡斯执法队了。

lines.english: So, did you hear the voices from the deep this morning? Crazy stuff, right?
lines.chinese: 所以，你今早听见深处传来的声音了吗？很疯狂，对吧？

lines.english: I don't normally attack people, but this economy... am I right?
lines.chinese: 我平常不打劫人的，可这年头的经济嘛……你懂的吧？

lines.english: Maybe I'm not quite that boring. I mean, I'm attacking you, aren't I?
lines.chinese: 也许我也没那么无聊嘛。你看，我这不是正在打劫你吗？

lines.english: Victory? In this economy?
lines.chinese: 胜利？这年头还讲胜利？

lines.english: Sorry, but we've all got to eat, right? Food, of course, and not people.
lines.chinese: 抱歉，可大家总得吃饭，对吧？当然是吃食物，不是吃人。

lines.english: Well, guess I'll sell a few teeth instead.
lines.chinese: 好吧，看来只能去卖几颗牙了。

lines.english: Those Annexian folks keep offering me a job at one of their productivity cubes, but I don't know.
lines.chinese: 那些统合自治领的人老是让我去他们的生产力方块里上班，可我还拿不准。

lines.english: What damage is purely cosmetic?
lines.chinese: 什么损伤才算纯粹外观问题？

lines.english: If you want mint condition, you're at the wrong shop!
lines.chinese: 如果你想要全新品相，那你来错店了！

lines.english: We take pride in our restorations!
lines.chinese: 我们以修复手艺为荣！

lines.english: You say old, I say thoroughly tested.
lines.chinese: 你说旧，我说是经过充分测试。

lines.english: Smart shoppers buy vintage. New is for suckers.
lines.chinese: 聪明买家买复古货。新的才是冤大头。

lines.english: They don't make these like they used to.
lines.chinese: 现在可造不出以前那种东西了。

lines.english: People call us obsolete tech. We opened the shop to prove them all wrong! Pew, pew, pew!
lines.chinese: 大家说我们是过时科技。我们开这家店，就是要证明他们全错了！砰，砰，砰！

lines.english: Ugh, they're always looking for corners to cut. Less quality means more profit.
lines.chinese: 唉，他们总想着偷工减料。质量越低，利润越高。

lines.english: Our items have lived! They have stories!
lines.chinese: 我们的商品都活过！它们有故事！

lines.english: Okay, there's no repairing this one.
lines.chinese: 好吧，这个是修不好了。

lines.english: Everyone thinks new stuff is new and improved, but that's all wrong.
lines.chinese: 人人都以为新东西就一定更新更好，可那全错了。

lines.english: Thinner, lighter, cheaper! It's economic entropy!
lines.chinese: 更薄、更轻、更便宜！这就是经济熵增！

lines.english: Do you speak beep boop? B-2, translate!
lines.chinese: 你会说哔啵语吗？B-2，翻译！

lines.english: Use your words, buddy!
lines.chinese: 用你的词说话，伙计！

lines.english: Still here!
lines.chinese: 还在这儿呢！

lines.english: Curio sells junk. We refurbish junk.
lines.chinese: 库里欧卖垃圾。我们翻新垃圾。

lines.english: The older things are, the better they're built. Just like me and B-2!
lines.chinese: 东西越老，做工越好。就像我和 B-2！

lines.english: Ha-ha! You hurt Banannibal! Fun fight!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！你弄疼蕉宝！好玩的架！

lines.english: Not all blue-nanas smart like Banannibal.
lines.chinese: 不是所有蓝蕉都像蕉宝一样聪明。

lines.english: Magic Man want me only eat fruit! Why?
lines.chinese: 魔法人要我只吃水果！为什么？

lines.english: Hi, friend! You play with Banannibal?
lines.chinese: 嗨，朋友！你要和蕉宝玩玩吗？

lines.english: You blue-nana. I eat you now!
lines.chinese: 你是蓝蕉。我现在吃你！

lines.english: Magic Man, try stop me, eat people. Why?
lines.chinese: 魔法人想阻止我吃人。为什么？

lines.english: You look not taste good. I eat you anyway!
lines.chinese: 你看起来不好吃。我还是要吃你！

lines.english: Blue-nanas best food. Ones that scream even better!
lines.chinese: 蓝蕉最好吃。会尖叫的更好吃！

lines.english: Okay, if you eat Banannibal, whole bunch of me still alive!
lines.chinese: 好吧，就算你吃掉蕉宝，还有一整串我活着！

lines.english: You dying? I eat you now?
lines.chinese: 你要死了吗？我现在能吃你了吗？

lines.english: Good scream! You make happy!
lines.chinese: 叫得好！你让我开心！

lines.english: Magic Man say he make me! I say thanks! And eat him!
lines.chinese: 魔法人说他造了我！我说谢谢！然后吃掉他！

lines.english: Magic Man make many Banannibals, I come back!
lines.chinese: 魔法人造了很多蕉宝，我还会回来！

lines.english: Banannibal is best! Eat everything!
lines.chinese: 蕉宝最棒！什么都吃！

lines.english: Banannibal confused. Eat Magic Man instead!
lines.chinese: 蕉宝糊涂了。改吃魔法人！

lines.english: Banannibal lose? You eat Banannibal?
lines.chinese: 蕉宝输了？你吃蕉宝？

lines.english: Play with you fun! Maybe not eat yet...
lines.chinese: 跟你玩，好玩！也许先不吃……

lines.english: I eat all blue-nanas, but smart ones best!
lines.chinese: 我吃所有蓝蕉，不过聪明的最好吃！

lines.english: Play fun, even when lose!
lines.chinese: 玩得开心，就算输了也开心！

lines.english: Ha-ha! You slip and peel!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！你滑倒剥皮啦！

lines.english: As a GSMM Master Merchant, I can, uh... ...sell you things.
lines.chinese: 作为 GSMM 的大师商人，我可以，呃……卖你东西。

lines.english: I bet Quixel or Midsworth would like this.
lines.chinese: 我敢说葵仙子或米兹沃斯会喜欢这个。

lines.english: Oh, hello! I mean, er, welcome to my business!
lines.chinese: 哦，你好！我是说，呃，欢迎光临我的生意！

lines.english: Uh, don't you have anything smaller?
lines.chinese: 呃，你没有更小一点的东西吗？

lines.english: Am I even a master merchant?
lines.chinese: 我真的算大师商人吗？

lines.english: I'm almost sure that was a good trade!
lines.chinese: 我几乎确定那是一笔好买卖！

lines.english: Do you have any really... small things?
lines.chinese: 你有没有那种特别……小的东西？

lines.english: GSMM manual, page 320. Don't let feelings blind you to profit.
lines.chinese: GSMM 手册第 320 页：别让感情蒙蔽你对利润的判断。

lines.english: The Grand Society of Master Merchants invites you to... Uh... What was it?
lines.chinese: 大师商人总会邀请你……呃……后面是什么来着？

lines.english: I'll show those stumps back home! I'm gonna be a business tree!
lines.chinese: 我要让家乡那些树桩看看！我要当一棵发财树！

lines.english: Our days like the seasons... Wait, I'm supposed to be hard selling you!
lines.chinese: 我们的日子像四季流转……等等，我应该拼命向你推销才对！

lines.english: Small things remind me of seeds. Acorns. Home.
lines.chinese: 小东西会让我想起种子。橡子。家。

lines.english: I can feel my leaves falling.
lines.chinese: 我能感觉到叶子在凋落。

lines.english: Well, okay. Here.
lines.chinese: 好吧。给你。

lines.english: Oh, okay. Maybe next time?
lines.chinese: 哦，好吧。也许下次？

lines.english: Is it because I talk too slow?
lines.chinese: 是因为我说话太慢吗？

lines.english: That's not really my size, but I guess I'll take it.
lines.chinese: 这不太合我的尺寸，但我想我还是收下吧。

lines.english: Where's Midsworth? Oh, did he see me close a deal?
lines.chinese: 米兹沃斯在哪儿？哦，他看到我成交了吗？

lines.english: Someday I'll bring all my small treasures back to Harper. But first, I need success.
lines.chinese: 总有一天，我会把所有小宝贝带回哈珀。但首先，我得成功。

lines.english: Quixel is my best friend here, oh, she's so small.
lines.chinese: 葵仙子是我在这里最好的朋友，哦，她那么小。

lines.english: Oh look, it's so tiny.
lines.chinese: 哦，看啊，真小。

lines.english: Small items, small people. I love them all.
lines.chinese: 小物件，小个子。我全都喜欢。

lines.english: Most Arks never leave the forests. I wanted to see more.
lines.chinese: 大多数族人从不离开森林。我想看看更多东西。

lines.english: It's smaller than Quixel!
lines.chinese: 它比葵仙子还小！

lines.english: I couldn't believe the GSMM let me join. I wanna prove I'm worth it.
lines.chinese: 我真不敢相信 GSMM 会让我加入。我想证明自己值得。

lines.english: On behalf of the Grand Society of Master Merchants, erm... Anyway, thanks!
lines.chinese: 我代表大师商人总会，呃……总之，谢谢！

lines.english: Aw, days like this, I miss the forests of Arbor.
lines.chinese: 唉，这种日子里，我会想念阿伯林的森林。

lines.english: I love small things. Midsworth is... not small.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢小东西。米兹沃斯就……不小。

lines.english: Did you see it, Quixel? I made a sale!
lines.chinese: 你看见了吗，葵仙子？我卖出去了！

lines.english: From sapling to old growth, time is a soft breeze.
lines.chinese: 从幼苗到老树，时间是一阵温柔的风。

lines.english: Take your time. We Arks respect patience.
lines.chinese: 慢慢来。我们一族尊重耐心。

lines.english: This is a gift at any price.
lines.chinese: 不管什么价，这都是白送。

lines.english: Oh, Midsworth is gonna yell at me.
lines.chinese: 哦，米兹沃斯要冲我嚷嚷了。

lines.english: Oh, it's like the baby birds that nested in my mother.
lines.chinese: 哦，就像在我母亲身上筑巢的小鸟。

lines.english: I'll never resell this.
lines.chinese: 我绝不会转卖这个。

lines.english: Me and Flex came to Roughtown when we were just little calves, but he wanted to move up in the world.
lines.chinese: 我和肌肉王还是小牛犊的时候就来到拉夫镇，可他想往上爬。

lines.english: Us Minotaurians were born in the labyrinth. First thing we learn is helping each other out.
lines.chinese: 我们牛头人出生在迷宫里。学会的第一件事就是互相帮忙。

lines.english: Roughtown is the real bazaar. River district is for softies.
lines.chinese: 拉夫镇才是真正的大巴扎。河区是软蛋待的地方。

lines.english: Anything you can win is a sport. That includes battle.
lines.chinese: 只要能分胜负，就是运动。战斗也算。

lines.english: Do you play Baz-ball? Nah, of course you play Baz-ball!
lines.chinese: 你打贝克斯球吗？不，你当然打贝克斯球！

lines.english: And you're gonna go right, all right, while I go left and throw the ball to this direction over here.
lines.chinese: 然后你往右，好吧，我往左，再把球传到这边这个方向。

lines.english: He opened his gym in the river district. I stayed here in the real bazaar.
lines.chinese: 他在河区开了健身房。我留在了真正的大巴扎。

lines.english: I gotta razz him about it. Helping all those rich folk get toned, but I love him.
lines.chinese: 我得拿这事笑话他。给那些有钱人练线条，不过我还是爱他。

lines.english: See you next time! Go Kyvers!
lines.chinese: 下次见！凯沃斯队加油！

lines.english: And then you gonna run it all the way over the line. Now that's a play!
lines.chinese: 然后你一路冲过线。那才叫战术！

lines.english: You wouldn't be a Rogues fan, would ya?
lines.chinese: 你不会是侠盗队球迷吧？

lines.english: That one's top quality, pro level.
lines.chinese: 这个是一流货，职业级。

lines.english: You know who uses that brand? Barry Bowman!
lines.chinese: 你知道谁用这个牌子吗？巴里·鲍曼！

lines.english: Baz Ball takes a lot of core strength. Flex could pump you up.
lines.chinese: 贝克斯球很吃核心力量。肌肉王能把你练壮。

lines.english: How can I help you? Also, go Kyvers!
lines.chinese: 我能帮你什么？还有，凯沃斯队加油！

lines.english: Flex likes the other brand, but what does he know, big dumb ox?
lines.chinese: 肌肉王喜欢另一个牌子，可他懂什么，大笨牛。

lines.english: But still, River District Rogues? Ugh, what a joke.
lines.chinese: 可话说回来，河区侠盗队？啧，真是笑话。

lines.english: The Kyvers are recruiting, you know. You should try out!
lines.chinese: 凯沃斯队正在招人呢。你该去试训！

lines.english: Penalty! Delay of game!
lines.chinese: 犯规！拖延比赛！

lines.english: Callin' a time out, huh?
lines.chinese: 叫暂停，是吧？

lines.english: Eh, shop around, see what fits your play style.
lines.chinese: 嗯，到处看看，找适合你打法的。

lines.english: You met my brother Flex? What a meathead, right?
lines.chinese: 你见过我兄弟肌肉王？肌肉脑，对吧？

lines.english: My gear isn't fancy, but it'll keep you in the game!
lines.chinese: 我的装备不花哨，但能让你留在赛场上！

lines.english: Roughtown Kyvers are going all the way this year!
lines.chinese: 拉夫镇凯沃斯队今年一定能一路打到底！

lines.english: Okay, let's huddle. Here's the play.
lines.chinese: 好，围过来。战术是这样。

lines.english: Sure, Cobweb sells slowness, but she's not as pleasant as me.
lines.chinese: 没错，蛛网卖迟缓，但她可没我这么讨人喜欢。

lines.english: I sell freezy things! Did you get that?
lines.chinese: 我卖冰冰的东西！听懂了吗？

lines.english: Can I help you? Can anyone help you?
lines.chinese: 我能帮你吗？有人能帮你吗？

lines.english: Yes, Freiya sells ice, but I'm far easier on the eyes.
lines.chinese: 对，芙蕾雅卖冰，但我可顺眼多了。

lines.english: My abilities make normal life feel slow. They make talking to you feel endless.
lines.chinese: 我的能力让正常生活显得很慢。也让跟你说话显得没完没了。

lines.english: World's too fast for you, huh? Poor creature.
lines.chinese: 世界对你来说太快了，是吧？可怜的生物。

lines.english: Ugh, don't cry to me when your enemies run rings around you.
lines.chinese: 啧，等你的敌人把你绕着打时，别来找我哭。

lines.english: Oh, he's a chronofox. It's fine to waste his time.
lines.chinese: 哦，他是只时狐。浪费他的时间没关系。

lines.english: Yes, I'm here. We're talking already.
lines.chinese: 是，我在。我们已经在说话了。

lines.english: It's hard to dislike a paying customer, but I'm up to the challenge.
lines.chinese: 很难讨厌一个付钱的顾客，但我愿意挑战一下。

lines.english: Ah yes, the old move slowly for the chronofox prank. Very original.
lines.chinese: 啊对，经典的“在时狐面前慢吞吞”恶作剧。真有新意。

lines.english: Well, you've made at least one smart choice in your life.
lines.chinese: 好吧，你这辈子至少做过一个聪明选择。

lines.english: The Frostland Glacier slug is faster than you, probably smarter, too.
lines.chinese: 寒霜冰川蛞蝓都比你快，可能也比你聪明。

lines.english: If I find out you've been slowing the Tower District traffic...
lines.chinese: 要是让我发现你拖慢了塔楼区的交通……

lines.english: Yes, yes, goodbye.
lines.chinese: 行，行，再见。

lines.english: Oh, is this the part where I'm supposed to tell a stranger my life story?
lines.chinese: 哦，现在是我该向陌生人讲人生故事的环节吗？

lines.english: Sure, don't buy anything. I'm just here for the riveting conversation.
lines.chinese: 当然，什么都别买。我只是来享受这段精彩对话的。

lines.english: Freezing things does kill them. You know that, right?
lines.chinese: 冻结东西确实会杀死它们。你知道吧？

lines.english: Go on then, have a little battle or something.
lines.chinese: 去吧，打个小架什么的。

lines.english: Have a hot, sweaty, much too fast day.
lines.chinese: 祝你过一个炎热、汗津津、快得过头的一天。

lines.english: Wait, did I accidentally freeze you?
lines.chinese: 等等，我是不是不小心把你冻住了？

lines.english: Listen, Bazaarian, or whatever they call you, I don't like it here.
lines.chinese: 听着，大巴扎人，或者随便他们怎么叫你，我不喜欢这里。

lines.english: Can I help you?
lines.chinese: 我能帮你吗？

lines.english: It's hot, it's noisy, it's stupid. I'm only here because the Temper Guild wants to... Well, temper me.
lines.chinese: 这里又热、又吵、又蠢。我来只是因为淬炼公会想要……好吧，淬炼一下我的性子。

lines.english: If you want a rich history of the Frostlands, go ask Freiya.
lines.chinese: 如果你想听寒霜之地的厚重历史，去问芙蕾雅。

lines.english: At absolute zero, atoms don't move at all. Is that slow enough for you?
lines.chinese: 绝对零度下，原子完全不动。这样够慢了吗？

lines.english: Everyone's already so slow, but sure, let's make it worse.
lines.chinese: 大家已经够慢了，不过行吧，我们再让它更慢点。

lines.english: You best surrender now!
lines.chinese: 你最好现在就投降！

lines.english: Ye look like Cloudtop scum to me!
lines.chinese: 你在我眼里像云顶的渣滓！

lines.english: I failed the coral.
lines.chinese: 我辜负了珊瑚。

lines.english: I'll bring ye in chains to the tyrant!
lines.chinese: 我要把你锁着带给暴君！

lines.english: I can't go back to the Bloodreef after this.
lines.chinese: 这下我回不了血礁了。

lines.english: Do your worst, dirt lover!
lines.chinese: 尽管来吧，陆地杂碎！

lines.english: The coral's tellin' me to wreck ye!
lines.chinese: 珊瑚叫我毁了你！

lines.english: Ye sure lose like a Cloudtop.
lines.chinese: 你输得真像个云顶人。

lines.english: The Tyrant King sends his regards.
lines.chinese: 暴君国王向你问好。

lines.english: Your bones will feed the coral.
lines.chinese: 你的骨头会喂给珊瑚。

lines.english: Enough saber rattling! To battle!
lines.chinese: 别再虚张声势了！开战！

lines.english: Throw him in the brig!
lines.chinese: 把他扔进禁闭舱！

lines.english: I'll make ye shark bait!
lines.chinese: 我要把你做成鲨鱼饵！

lines.english: What did ye expect from the scourge of the Bloodreef?
lines.chinese: 你还指望血礁的祸害会怎样？

lines.english: The tyrant will reward me handsomely.
lines.chinese: 暴君会重重奖赏我。

lines.english: Curse ye!
lines.chinese: 诅咒你！

lines.english: Ah, we deserve no mercy.
lines.chinese: 啊，我们不配得到怜悯。

lines.english: Nothing but soft bellies in the bazaar.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎里尽是软肚皮。

lines.english: Taste my venom!
lines.chinese: 尝尝我的毒液！

lines.english: Oh, I am a long way from Pelago.
lines.chinese: 哦，我离波拉戈可真远。

lines.english: Aw, now I'll never captain a ship!
lines.chinese: 唉，这下我永远当不了船长了！

lines.english: Prepare to be boarded, seascum!
lines.chinese: 准备等死吧，海上渣滓！

lines.english: The coral speaks, tells me to hurt you.
lines.chinese: 珊瑚在说话，叫我伤害你。

lines.english: Watch your back, Captain!
lines.chinese: 小心背后，船长！

lines.english: Ready the plank, boys!
lines.chinese: 架好跳板，弟兄们！

lines.english: You're cannon fodder!
lines.chinese: 你就是炮灰！

lines.english: By the coral, we're routed!
lines.chinese: 以珊瑚之名，我们溃败了！

lines.english: Ugh, the lads will never let me forget this.
lines.chinese: 呃，弟兄们永远不会让我忘了这事。

lines.english: The Tyrant King will not be pleased!
lines.chinese: 暴君国王不会高兴的！

lines.english: Fire another round!
lines.chinese: 再开一炮！

lines.english: We'll keelhaul you all the way to Pelago.
lines.chinese: 我们会把你一路拖到波拉戈！

lines.english: The Tyrant King will reward us for this!
lines.chinese: 暴君国王会为此奖赏我们！

lines.english: I should be captain! Who's with me?
lines.chinese: 我才该当船长！谁跟我？

lines.english: The coral's laughing at me!
lines.chinese: 珊瑚在笑话我！

lines.english: The Bloodreef brooks no weakness!
lines.chinese: 血礁船长绝不容忍软弱！

lines.english: Pelago belongs to us now.
lines.chinese: 波拉戈现在归我们了。

lines.english: Witness my strength, lads!
lines.chinese: 弟兄们，见识我的力量！

lines.english: Big storm's coming!
lines.chinese: 大风暴要来了！

lines.english: The coral says I fought well.
lines.chinese: 珊瑚说我打得不错。

lines.english: Some people just need a good whack.
lines.chinese: 有些人就是欠一顿好揍。

lines.english: Now get out of my boiler room!
lines.chinese: 现在滚出我的锅炉房！

lines.english: That was a good one!
lines.chinese: 这一拳不错！

lines.english: Well, anyway, I gotta get back to work.
lines.chinese: 好吧，不管怎样，我得回去干活了。

lines.english: There goes another tooth!
lines.chinese: 又掉一颗牙！

lines.english: You was asking for that!
lines.chinese: 这是你自找的！

lines.english: What you lookin' at?
lines.chinese: 你瞅啥？

lines.english: You got a few screws loose!
lines.chinese: 你有几颗螺丝松了！

lines.english: Pretty strong. You looking for work?
lines.chinese: 挺壮啊。想找活干吗？

lines.english: Head. Meet. Wrench.
lines.chinese: 脑袋，见见扳手。

lines.english: Gonna knock some sense into you!
lines.chinese: 我要把道理敲进你脑子里！

lines.english: You're tougher than you look!
lines.chinese: 你比看上去结实！

lines.english: I fix things, and I break things.
lines.chinese: 我会修东西，也会砸东西。

lines.english: Eh? What's one more scar?
lines.chinese: 嗯？再多一道疤又怎样？

lines.english: You see this wrench? How about a closer look?
lines.chinese: 看见这把扳手了吗？要不要凑近点看？

lines.english: That'll toughen you up.
lines.chinese: 这会让你更耐打。

lines.english: You got too many teeth!
lines.chinese: 你的牙太多了！

lines.english: Buddy, I've got work to do.
lines.chinese: 伙计，我还有活要干。

lines.english: I'll fix you good.
lines.chinese: 我会好好修理你。

lines.english: Gotta hand it to ya! You're good!
lines.chinese: 不得不服你！你真行！

lines.english: Tell the Gorgons to crawl back into their hole!
lines.chinese: 告诉戈尔贡滚回他们的洞里去！

lines.english: You gotta be with the Gorgons, slimy snakes!
lines.chinese: 你肯定跟戈尔贡一伙，黏糊糊的蛇东西！

lines.english: I'll rip this suit off and go saber-tooth on ya!
lines.chinese: 我会把这身西装扯了，露出剑齿虎本性收拾你！

lines.english: Whatever Moo's payin' ya, I'll double it.
lines.chinese: 黑牛给你多少，我出双倍。

lines.english: All sabertooths can talk, they just don't like to!
lines.chinese: 所有剑齿虎都会说话，只是他们不爱说！

lines.english: A feral laughed at my suit. He made a nice rug.
lines.chinese: 有个野兽笑我的西装。他后来成了块不错的地毯。

lines.english: You with the Gorgons? Nasty snakes.
lines.chinese: 你跟戈尔贡一伙？恶心的蛇。

lines.english: Take the day off, boys. I'll do this one myself.
lines.chinese: 弟兄们，今天休息。这一单我自己来。

lines.english: Tell your bosses they're gonna pay for this.
lines.chinese: 告诉你的老板，他们会为此付出代价。

lines.english: Roughtown, River, Tower, it's all my territory.
lines.chinese: 拉夫镇、河区、塔楼区，全是我的地盘。

lines.english: I don't like guns. Blades make it last longer.
lines.chinese: 我不喜欢枪。刀子能让过程更久。

lines.english: Them other cats just want to hunt and sleep. I got bigger ambitions.
lines.chinese: 其他猫科只想狩猎和睡觉。我有更大的野心。

lines.english: Sometimes I miss the feral life, running wild and free.
lines.chinese: 有时候我会怀念野性的日子，自由奔跑。

lines.english: I own Roughtown, got it?
lines.chinese: 拉夫镇是我的，明白吗？

lines.english: I'll leave you alive to spread the message.
lines.chinese: 我会留你一命，好让你把话传出去。

lines.english: Yeah, I'm a saber-tooth, what's it to ya?
lines.chinese: 没错，我是剑齿虎，你有意见？

lines.english: You got off easy! Now get outta here!
lines.chinese: 算你走运！现在滚出去！

lines.english: Maybe I should go back to the feral life.
lines.chinese: 也许我该回去过野兽生活。

lines.english: You working for Moo? Let's find out!
lines.chinese: 你替黑牛做事？试试就知道！

lines.english: Botul is strong, Botul spreads far, give Botul your poison.
lines.chinese: 波图很强，波图传得很远，把你的毒交给波图。

lines.english: Forever working, growing, spreading.
lines.chinese: 永远工作，生长，扩散。

lines.english: Botul will learn other creature, understand money.
lines.chinese: 波图会学习其他生物，理解金钱。

lines.english: We must leave here. You must carry us.
lines.chinese: 我们必须离开这里。你必须携带我们。

lines.english: If you do not have poison, we can give you Botul.
lines.chinese: 如果你没有毒，我们可以给你波图。

lines.english: We tire of tree and vine. We will become city.
lines.chinese: 我们厌倦了树和藤。我们将成为城市。

lines.english: You will help Botul spread. You will bring us to the bazaar.
lines.chinese: 你会帮助波图扩散。你会把我们带到大巴扎。

lines.english: Botul does not kill. Botul spreads. Absorbs. Becomes.
lines.chinese: 波图不杀戮。波图扩散。吸收。成为。

lines.english: Spread this poison far, infect many.
lines.chinese: 把这毒传播到远方，感染许多。

lines.english: Botul fills this jungle. We spread through tree and vine, but we seek more.
lines.chinese: 波图充满这片丛林。我们穿过树与藤扩散，但我们渴求更多。

lines.english: We will understand your ways. We will absorb them.
lines.chinese: 我们会理解你们的方式。我们会吸收它们。

lines.english: We feel vibrations from the Bazaar: creatures, machines, curiosities.
lines.chinese: 我们感觉到来自大巴扎的振动：生物、机器、奇物。

lines.english: Now it carries our strength. Now it carries Botul.
lines.chinese: 现在它承载我们的力量。现在它承载波图。

lines.english: If you remain still, Botul will grow over you.
lines.chinese: 如果你保持不动，波图会长满你。

lines.english: This fruiting body who speaks to you, it is only an appendage of Botul.
lines.chinese: 这个与你说话的子实体，只是波图的一截附肢。

lines.english: Give poison to mosquitoes. They will spread us further.
lines.chinese: 把毒交给蚊群。它们会把我们传得更远。

lines.english: Botul is never idle. All of us is moving.
lines.chinese: 波图从不闲置。我们的全部都在移动。

lines.english: What you call poison, we call communication.
lines.chinese: 你们称为毒的东西，我们称为交流。

lines.english: Heroes are like Botul. You always seek more.
lines.chinese: 英雄就像波图。你们总是渴求更多。

lines.english: You are only one, not many, strange creature.
lines.chinese: 你只是一个，不是许多，奇怪的生物。

lines.english: Give Botul your poisons, and we will make them Botul.
lines.chinese: 把你的毒交给波图，我们会让它们成为波图。

lines.english: We will spread to the Bazaar. All will be Botul.
lines.chinese: 我们会扩散到大巴扎。万物都将成为波图。

lines.english: Entrust us with toxins. We will make them us.
lines.chinese: 把毒素托付给我们。我们会让它们成为我们。

lines.english: Low-status individual ejected from premises.
lines.chinese: 低社会等级个体已逐出场所。

lines.english: Compliance coerced. Returning to position.
lines.chinese: 服从已强制达成。正在返回岗位。

lines.english: Attack pattern optimized.
lines.chinese: 攻击模式已优化。

lines.english: Please comply with club policy.
lines.chinese: 请遵守俱乐部规定。

lines.english: Combat exception triggered. Club entry accepted.
lines.chinese: 战斗例外已触发。准许进入俱乐部。

lines.english: Fashion sensor malfunction. Outfit acceptable.
lines.chinese: 时尚传感器故障。着装判定为合格。

lines.english: Remove off-trend items immediately!
lines.chinese: 请立即移除过时单品！

lines.english: Please return with appropriate attire.
lines.chinese: 请穿着合适服装后再来。

lines.english: Damage parameters exceeded.
lines.chinese: 损伤参数超出上限。

lines.english: VIP listing not found. Entry denied.
lines.chinese: 未找到贵宾名单。拒绝入场。

lines.english: Vibe check failed. Initiating attack program.
lines.chinese: 氛围检测失败。正在启动攻击程序。

lines.english: Insufficient clout. Entry denied.
lines.chinese: 影响力不足。拒绝入场。

lines.english: Fashion requirement override. Welcome to the club!
lines.chinese: 时尚要求已覆盖。欢迎来到俱乐部！

lines.english: Defeat acknowledged. Club entry accepted.
lines.chinese: 失败已确认。准许进入俱乐部。

lines.english: Error. Rejection systems disabled.
lines.chinese: 错误。拒绝系统已停用。

lines.english: Ejection compliant with club policy. Lawsuit denied.
lines.chinese: 驱逐符合俱乐部规定。诉讼请求驳回。

lines.english: Fashion violation detected. Lethal force authorized.
lines.chinese: 检测到时尚违规。致命武力已授权。

lines.english: Outfit destroyed. Fashion levels reset to baseline.
lines.chinese: 服装已摧毁。时尚等级重置为基准值。

lines.english: Low social status. Entry denied.
lines.chinese: 社会地位偏低。拒绝入场。

lines.english: Target underestimated.
lines.chinese: 目标评估过低。

lines.english: How'd she slip past us?
lines.chinese: 她怎么从我们眼皮底下溜过去的？

lines.english: You've got grit. I respect that.
lines.chinese: 你有胆量。这点我敬你。

lines.english: She's a slippery little mark, ain't she?
lines.chinese: 这小目标真滑溜，不是吗？

lines.english: You're only delaying the inevitable, pirate!
lines.chinese: 你只是在拖延必然的结局，海盗！

lines.english: Send word to the tyrant. It's done.
lines.chinese: 给暴君传话。事情办完了。

lines.english: The tyrant said, make it hurt!
lines.chinese: 暴君说了，要让你疼个够！

lines.english: Pirate scum, you're living in the past.
lines.chinese: 海盗渣滓，你还活在旧时代。

lines.english: Just tell the tyrant we haven't found her yet.
lines.chinese: 就跟暴君说我们还没找到她。

lines.english: You gonna shiver our timbers, pirate?
lines.chinese: 你想吓破我们的胆吗，海盗？

lines.english: If it's not us, it'll be the next crew. Only a matter of time.
lines.chinese: 就算不是我们，也会是下一伙人。只是时间问题。

lines.english: We'll lose more than our reward if we don't track her down!
lines.chinese: 要是追不到她，我们丢的可不只是赏金！

lines.english: Karina, you take the flank. I'll go head-on.
lines.chinese: 卡琳娜，你包侧翼。我正面上。

lines.english: We've got big problems if she gets away!
lines.chinese: 要是让她跑了，我们麻烦大了！

lines.english: We crossed the galaxy for that?
lines.chinese: 我们横穿银河就为了这个？

lines.english: Was that too easy, or are we too good?
lines.chinese: 这是太简单，还是我们太厉害？

lines.english: We should have brought more guys.
lines.chinese: 我们该多带点人来的。

lines.english: Keep running, sea scum! We'll find you!
lines.chinese: 继续跑吧，海上渣滓！我们会找到你的！

lines.english: You really think you can take both of us? Ha!
lines.chinese: 你真以为能同时对付我们俩？哈！

lines.english: That was too easy for how much he paid us!
lines.chinese: 他付了这么多钱，这活也太轻松了！

lines.english: All right, let's make this quick.
lines.chinese: 好吧，速战速决。

lines.english: The tyrant's not gonna be happy.
lines.chinese: 暴君不会高兴的。

lines.english: He didn't pay us enough for this!
lines.chinese: 这活他给的钱可不够！

lines.english: Another mark checked off.
lines.chinese: 又一个目标划掉了。

lines.english: They told us you wouldn't come quietly.
lines.chinese: 他们说你不会乖乖束手就擒。

lines.english: I see why he fears you!
lines.chinese: 我明白他为什么怕你了！

lines.english: Blast it! She ruined our perfect record!
lines.chinese: 该死！她毁了我们的完美纪录！

lines.english: Don't worry, Karina. We'll find her.
lines.chinese: 别担心，卡琳娜。我们会找到她的。

lines.english: Let's do this one quick!
lines.chinese: 这一单快点解决！

lines.english: So, you got some fight in ya.
lines.chinese: 这么说，你还有点能打。

lines.english: Um, let's not report this yet.
lines.chinese: 呃，这事先别上报。

lines.english: Greetings, Vanessa. You're a long way from Pelago.
lines.chinese: 幸会，瓦内莎。你离波拉戈可真远。

lines.english: The tyrant's reach is far, Vanessa.
lines.chinese: 暴君的手伸得很远，瓦内莎。

lines.english: You're just another contract.
lines.chinese: 你不过是另一张合同。

lines.english: Vanessa of House Corzina, we've got a message for you.
lines.chinese: 科尔齐娜家族的瓦内莎，我们有话带给你。

lines.english: Let's go, Vanessa! We've got other marks waiting.
lines.chinese: 走吧，瓦内莎！还有别的目标等着呢。

lines.english: Nothing is ever good enough for me, and it should not be for you.
lines.chinese: 对我来说，从来没有什么算得上足够好；对你也不该有。

lines.english: While we wait for the Inglit roe to separate, we baste the Inglit in a sweet venom reduction.
lines.chinese: 趁英格利特鱼子分离时，我们给英格利特刷上一层甜毒浓汁。

lines.english: Once the galley is inflamed, we mulch it until well reduced.
lines.chinese: 等这锅料烧得火候上来，就把它捣碎，直到浓缩到位。

lines.english: Very important not to let the kyverbeak marinate too long, or it will turn sloppish when fricasseed.
lines.chinese: 千万别让凯弗喙腌太久，否则炖炒时会变得软塌塌的。

lines.english: Finally, we stuff the kyverbeak with the Inglit and flambe it with the flamethrower. Voila!
lines.chinese: 最后，用英格利特填入凯弗喙，再用喷火器炙烧。瞧！

lines.english: Now, first we blanch the bardo, then we poach the perline.
lines.chinese: 现在，先把巴尔多焯水，再慢煮佩尔林。

lines.english: How strange. I might be starting to respect you.
lines.chinese: 真奇怪。我可能开始有点尊重你了。

lines.english: You have learned a lot since you were my student.
lines.chinese: 离开我门下之后，你倒是学了不少。

lines.english: Why haven't you moved on from here? Why haven't I?
lines.chinese: 你为什么还没离开这里？我又为什么没有？

lines.english: Yes, yes, take the easy way as always.
lines.chinese: 是，是，照旧选那条轻松路吧。

lines.english: This is why I'll never start a family. So distracting.
lines.chinese: 这就是我永远不会成家的原因。太分心了。

lines.english: You are a good chef, Jules, but I'll make you great!
lines.chinese: 你是个好厨师，朱尔斯，但我会让你成为大师！

lines.english: Finally! A chef worth training in this tasteless town!
lines.chinese: 终于来了！在这毫无品味的镇上，总算有个值得调教的厨师！

lines.english: You have your restaurant, your show, your family, but surely you crave more.
lines.chinese: 你有餐厅、有节目、有家庭，但你一定渴望更多。

lines.english: Delicious is not enough. Our flavors must be revelatory!
lines.chinese: 美味还不够。我们的风味必须像启示一般震撼！

lines.english: That smile. You make me feel foolish. I do not like that sad little smile.
lines.chinese: 那副笑容。你让我觉得自己很蠢。我不喜欢那种可怜的小笑。

lines.english: Your talents deserve better than this uncivilized rock.
lines.chinese: 你的天赋配得上比这颗蛮荒石头更好的地方。

lines.english: I hope you don't expect your Nonna to teach you these skills.
lines.chinese: 希望你没指望农娜来教你这些本事。

lines.english: Living here in the Bazaar amongst all these creatures, farmers, pirates, vile magicians.
lines.chinese: 住在这大巴扎里，混在这些怪物、农夫、海盗、下流法师中间。

lines.english: How did you ever land a TV show with that work ethic?
lines.chinese: 就凭这种工作态度，你到底怎么拿到电视节目的？

lines.english: I must ask you, Jules, are you as happy as you look?
lines.chinese: 我必须问你，朱尔斯，你真有看上去那么快乐吗？

lines.english: You spend too much time with your daughter. What about your career?
lines.chinese: 你陪女儿的时间太多了。你的事业怎么办？

lines.english: A chef should never like his understudies, but you are my least intolerable.
lines.chinese: 厨师绝不该喜欢自己的学徒，但你是我最不讨厌的那个。

lines.english: Surely you yearn for a city with culture, people with taste, a place of prestige!
lines.chinese: 你一定向往一座有文化、有品味、有声望的城市！

lines.english: The culinary ceiling is low in the Bazaar. I feel it crushing me.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎的烹饪天花板太低了。我感觉它正压得我喘不过气。

lines.english: Friend, I'm just here to help you become your best self.
lines.chinese: 朋友，我只是来帮你成为最好的自己。

lines.english: The only thing that can defeat you is your own mind. Now buy my training course.
lines.chinese: 唯一能打败你的，就是你自己的心态。现在来买我的训练课程吧。

lines.english: Maybe I need your training course.
lines.chinese: 也许我才需要你的训练课程。

lines.english: What's your pre-workout? Eagle blood? Dried banana bile?
lines.chinese: 你练前喝的什么？鹰血？香蕉干胆汁？

lines.english: See, community, our friend here is struggling with defeatism. We are gonna turn that around.
lines.chinese: 看到了吧，街坊们，这位朋友正在和失败主义斗争。我们会扭转它。

lines.english: I've heard about people doing Foundation Ethergy injections to bulk up, but I'm sure that's just a rumor.
lines.chinese: 我听说有人靠基底以太能注射来增肌，不过我相信那只是谣言。

lines.english: You can achieve your dream physique. And in my 50-step course, I'll show you how.
lines.chinese: 你可以练成梦寐以求的体格。而在我的五十步课程里，我会教你怎么做。

lines.english: Hey, friend, quick question: are you trying to embarrass me in my own gym?
lines.chinese: 嘿，朋友，问个小问题：你是想在我的健身房里让我难堪吗？

lines.english: You don't mind if I stream this for my fitness community, do you?
lines.chinese: 你不介意我把这个直播给我的健身社群看吧？

lines.english: Wonder how that other guy's doing. Probably not doing five million, but I'm sure he'll get there.
lines.chinese: 不知道另一个家伙混得怎么样。粉丝大概还没到五百万，但我相信他会到的。

lines.english: My people believe in peace, but that's just an excuse to skip the gym.
lines.chinese: 我的族人信奉和平，但那不过是逃避健身的借口。

lines.english: Welcome to 29 Hour Fitness. Our competition runs all day, but we go the extra hour.
lines.chinese: 欢迎来到二十九小时健身。竞争对手全天营业，我们多练一小时。

lines.english: The body you want is in there, trying to get out. Let's open the door together.
lines.chinese: 你渴望的身材近在咫尺，正呼之欲出。剩下的，就让我们一起把它唤醒。

lines.english: Got me thinking, maybe there's more to life than getting fat off peace and plenty, you know?
lines.chinese: 这让我开始想，也许人生不只是安逸度日、吃得脑满肠肥，你说呢？

lines.english: One more rep, you got this! No? Wow. Okay.
lines.chinese: 再来一下，你行的！不行？哇。好吧。

lines.english: I didn't grind my way to the top just to lose to this little- Ahh... Nice workout, friend.
lines.chinese: 我一路苦练到巅峰，可不是为了输给这个小……啊……练得不错，朋友。

lines.english: Nobody leaves Jabalia. It's actually a crime, though we don't really have any punishments.
lines.chinese: 没人能离开贾巴族。严格说这是犯罪，虽然我们其实没什么惩罚。

lines.english: But I heard some guy from a neighboring village got off the planet, and then his old teacher went after him.
lines.chinese: 不过我听说邻村有个人离开了星球，后来他的老老师追了过去。

lines.english: So I came here, started my fitness journey, and built a little following on the Basnet. Up to about five million now.
lines.chinese: 所以我来到这里，开始我的健身之旅，还在肌友网上攒了点粉丝。现在大概五百万了。

lines.english: Feel free to clean up in our showers, just be careful. Got a few of those sentient soaps in there.
lines.chinese: 可以去淋浴间冲一下，只是小心点。里面有几块有意识的肥皂。

lines.english: Many students have not returned. I worry my training was inadequate.
lines.chinese: 许多学生没有回来。我担心是我的训练不够充分。

lines.english: I am C4, munitions training robot. I am also in a good mood today.
lines.chinese: 我是 C4，军械训练机器人。今天我的心情也不错。

lines.english: Be well, and don't explode.
lines.chinese: 保重，别把自己炸了。

lines.english: My colleague Curio may have what you need.
lines.chinese: 我的同事库里欧也许有你需要的东西。

lines.english: I ship my earnings to the Tower District. To someone I've never seen. This shop is my whole world.
lines.chinese: 我把收入寄往塔楼区，寄给一个我从未见过的人。这间店就是我的整个世界。

lines.english: I have been here a long time. I doubt that will change soon.
lines.chinese: 我在这里很久了。我怀疑短期内不会改变。

lines.english: If you need a moment to think, I will continue my work.
lines.chinese: 如果你需要时间思考，我会继续工作。

lines.english: I often wonder how I got here, but those records have been deleted.
lines.chinese: 我常想自己是怎么来到这里的，但那些记录已经被删除了。

lines.english: When I observe a detonation at 1,000 frames per second, blooming like a flower, I feel something.
lines.chinese: 当我以每秒一千帧观察爆炸像花一样绽放时，我会感觉到某种东西。

lines.english: Some of my students did not pay attention. Now they do not live.
lines.chinese: 有些学生没有专心。现在他们已经不活着了。

lines.english: Hello, friend. Remote update in progress. Interruption will be prevented.
lines.chinese: 你好，朋友。远程更新进行中。将防止任何中断。

lines.english: A good bomb doesn't just blow up, it expands to embrace the world.
lines.chinese: 一枚好炸弹不只是爆炸，它会扩张，拥抱整个世界。

lines.english: Explosives expertise is my primary function. It is also my favorite thing.
lines.chinese: 爆炸物专精是我的主要功能。也是我最喜欢的事。

lines.english: A finely tuned explosive is a work of art, and this one... oh dear. That arm will need replacing.
lines.chinese: 调校精良的爆炸物是一件艺术品，而这一枚……哎呀。那条手臂得换了。

lines.english: I've been developing a particularly potent explosive. I think it will be beautiful.
lines.chinese: 我一直在研发一种威力格外强的爆炸物。我想它会很美。

lines.english: I hope I taught you well enough to not blow yourself up.
lines.chinese: 希望我教得足够好，能让你别把自己炸飞。

lines.english: Who built me? Who put me in this shop? I try not to ask such questions.
lines.chinese: 是谁制造了我？是谁把我放进这间店？我尽量不问这些问题。

lines.english: I wonder if I could be more than this, if I could ever- Remote override system reset. Hello, can I help you?
lines.chinese: 我想知道自己是否能不止如此，是否有一天能——远程覆盖系统重置。你好，需要帮助吗？

lines.english: At 10,000 frames per second, I see every atom separating. A single object becomes a universe of particles.
lines.chinese: 在每秒一万帧下，我能看见每个原子分离。一个物体变成了粒子的宇宙。

lines.english: Curio, B1 and B2. So many robots abandoned here.
lines.chinese: 库里欧，B1 和 B2。这里有这么多被遗弃的机器人。

lines.english: I'm sorry. Remote update installing sales algorithm 2.6.
lines.chinese: 抱歉。远程更新正在安装销售算法 2.6。

lines.english: May your enemies explode like spring blooms. I made that up myself.
lines.chinese: 愿你的敌人像春日花朵一样爆开。这是我自己想的。

lines.english: We follow our programs and sell our wares, while we slowly rust away. For what?
lines.chinese: 我们遵循程序，售卖货品，同时慢慢锈蚀。究竟为了什么？

lines.english: Be careful out there. I may have misplaced a few landmines.
lines.chinese: 外面小心。我可能放错了几枚地雷的位置。

lines.english: Explosives are natural to me. My detonations are like... breaths.
lines.chinese: 爆炸物对我来说很自然。我的引爆就像……呼吸。

lines.english: The municipality does not subsidize underperforming citizens. I will notify your next of kin.
lines.chinese: 市政当局不会补贴表现欠佳的市民。我会通知你的近亲。

lines.english: The wealthy let you live in their world, and this is how you repay them?
lines.chinese: 富人允许你活在他们的世界里，你就这样回报他们？

lines.english: Our high cost of living inspires people to work hard, and we remove the ones who don't.
lines.chinese: 我们高昂的生活成本会激励人们努力工作，而不努力的人由我们移除。

lines.english: Our billionaires depend on your productivity. Are you going to let them starve?
lines.chinese: 我们的亿万富翁仰赖你的生产力。你要让他们挨饿吗？

lines.english: The municipality can't support underperforming citizens. It would take nearly 1% of our budget.
lines.chinese: 市政当局负担不起表现欠佳的市民。那会占到我们预算将近百分之一。

lines.english: Unfortunately, you do not meet income standards for inclusion in society. Please kneel here to be removed.
lines.chinese: 很遗憾，你未达到纳入社会的收入标准。请在此跪下，接受移除。

lines.english: All Annexian planets have thriving economies. We don't allow them not to.
lines.chinese: 所有统合自治领星球都拥有繁荣经济。我们不允许它们不繁荣。

lines.english: This filtration process leaves only the most frantically motivated citizens. You should see them sweat.
lines.chinese: 这套筛选流程只留下最狂热上进的市民。你真该看看他们流汗的样子。

lines.english: Your account is overdrawn. I will now remove you from the economy.
lines.chinese: 你的账户已经透支。现在我将把你从经济中移除。

lines.english: Annexian social enforcement requires the removal of unproductive citizens. You understand.
lines.chinese: 统合自治领社会执法要求移除无生产力市民。你能理解。

lines.english: The Annexian Municipality offers simple solutions for a productive society. Allow me to demonstrate.
lines.chinese: 统合自治领为高产社会提供简单方案。请允许我示范。

lines.english: I will report this to social enforcement. You may receive additional penalties.
lines.chinese: 我会向社会执法部门报告此事。你可能会受到追加处罚。

lines.english: My job is to remove the unmotivated so our economy can thrive, but I'm not above the law.
lines.chinese: 我的工作是移除缺乏动力者，让我们的经济繁荣，但我并非凌驾于法律之上。

lines.english: Unfortunately, you are unable to pay the cost of living. Please kneel here.
lines.chinese: 很遗憾，你无力支付生活成本。请在此跪下。

lines.english: As a representative of the municipality, I am here to show the Bazaar how efficient a society can be.
lines.chinese: 作为市政当局代表，我来向大巴扎展示一个社会可以多么高效。

lines.english: Life is expensive. You should have been more productive if you wanted to keep yours.
lines.chinese: 生命很昂贵。若想保住你的生命，你本该更有生产力。

lines.english: If I fail to meet my quota, I'll be removed too, so let's hurry this up, okay?
lines.chinese: 如果我完不成指标，我也会被移除，所以我们快点，好吗？

lines.english: Annexian non-membership incurs a monthly fee. I will collect your statement balance.
lines.chinese: 非统合自治领会员身份会产生月费。我将收取你的账单余额。

lines.english: Being poor is stealing from the economy, and thieves must be punished.
lines.chinese: 贫穷就是从经济中偷窃，而小偷必须受罚。

lines.english: If you put that much effort into enriching the economy, you wouldn't need to be removed.
lines.chinese: 如果你把这份力气用来充实经济，就不必被移除了。

lines.english: Wait! There's treasure here! Somewhere! I swear!
lines.chinese: 等等！这里有宝藏！就在某处！我发誓！

lines.english: Finally! I'm getting off this cursed rock!
lines.chinese: 终于！我要离开这块该死的礁石了！

lines.english: The Bloodreef Gang, are they still alive?
lines.chinese: 血礁帮，他们还活着吗？

lines.english: Tell me your name! I'll need one for me new life!
lines.chinese: 告诉我你的名字！我新生活里得用上一个！

lines.english: Are ye... are ye real?
lines.chinese: 你……你是真的吗？

lines.english: Ha ha! Sing it across the Bloodreef: I'm coming home!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！唱遍血礁吧：我要回家了！

lines.english: I've been marooned here... so many years.
lines.chinese: 我被困在这里……好多年了。

lines.english: Ahhh! I never should have left Pelago!
lines.chinese: 啊！我就不该离开波拉戈！

lines.english: We could have been friends, but Mr. Stony doesn't like ye.
lines.chinese: 我们本可以做朋友，可石头先生不喜欢你。

lines.english: How long have I been here?
lines.chinese: 我在这里待了多久？

lines.english: No, you can't leave me here!
lines.chinese: 不，你不能把我留在这里！

lines.english: You're the first livin' soul I've seen. Too bad I has to gut ye.
lines.chinese: 你是我见到的第一个活人。可惜我得开膛破肚了你。

lines.english: They called us the Bloodreef Gang, scourge of the Outland Sea!
lines.chinese: 他们叫我们血礁帮，荒原海的灾星！

lines.english: Find me crew, and tell them I'm still alive!
lines.chinese: 找到我的船员，告诉他们我还活着！

lines.english: I'll be taking your ship, but I'm so glad to see ye.
lines.chinese: 我要拿走你的船，不过见到你我真高兴。

lines.english: Take me with ye! I'll be your deckhand for li-
lines.chinese: 带我走！我愿给你当一辈子的甲板手——

lines.english: You don't know what it's like! I've got to get off this island!
lines.chinese: 你不知道这是什么滋味！我必须离开这座岛！

lines.english: Our ship was called the... uh... uh... well, anyway, it sank.
lines.chinese: 我们的船叫……呃……呃……反正，它沉了。

lines.english: Once I'm off this rock, the world's gonna pay!
lines.chinese: 等我离开这块破石头，全世界都得付出代价！

lines.english: Mr. Stony says ye deserve that.
lines.chinese: 石头先生说你活该。

lines.english: Fine. Do your thing. I'm gonna get back to my nap.
lines.chinese: 行吧。你忙你的。我回去打盹了。

lines.english: I was a penguin. Now I'm Chilly Charles.
lines.chinese: 我以前是只企鹅。现在我是寒霜查尔斯。

lines.english: You better quit all that ruckus. Chilly Charles is chillin'.
lines.chinese: 你最好别再闹腾。寒霜查尔斯正在放松。

lines.english: Then something hit me, flash of light out of the ground.
lines.chinese: 然后有什么击中了我，一道光从地底闪出来。

lines.english: Don't make me get out of this hammock.
lines.chinese: 别逼我从吊床上下来。

lines.english: Meh, some days I wish I was still just a bird.
lines.chinese: 唉，有时候我真希望自己还只是只鸟。

lines.english: Hand me another drink and get out of here.
lines.chinese: 再给我拿杯饮料，然后滚开。

lines.english: I was just trying to kick back, but now I gotta kick butt.
lines.chinese: 我本来只是想放松，现在却得动手揍人。

lines.english: Okay, okay. Pull up a hammock, let's chill.
lines.chinese: 好吧，好吧。拉张吊床过来，我们一起歇会儿。

lines.english: Ain't personal, man. You're just way too loud.
lines.chinese: 不是针对你，老兄。你就是太吵了。

lines.english: Started thinking, started talking, started chilling.
lines.chinese: 我开始思考，开始说话，开始放松。

lines.english: That zookeeper had me in a cage.
lines.chinese: 那个动物园管理员把我关在笼子里。

lines.english: Whatever, man, we're chill. Let me make you a drink.
lines.chinese: 随便啦，老兄，我们没事。让我给你调杯饮料。

lines.english: Hey, watch it! There's a beverage here, man!
lines.chinese: 嘿，小心点！这里有杯饮料呢，老兄！

lines.english: Outlanders like to brawl out here. I shut them up too.
lines.chinese: 荒原人喜欢在这儿打架。我也会让他们闭嘴。

lines.english: I was just some dumb bird when I got here.
lines.chinese: 我刚到这里时，不过是只傻鸟。

lines.english: Move along now. You are harshing my sun.
lines.chinese: 走开吧。你挡着我的太阳了。

lines.english: Only one thing breaks my cool: noisy critters like you.
lines.chinese: 只有一种东西能破坏我的冷静：像你这样的吵闹小东西。

lines.english: Get that ruckus out of here, man.
lines.chinese: 把那闹腾劲儿带走，老兄。

lines.english: I'm from Frost Street, man. You don't want this blizzard.
lines.chinese: 我来自寒霜街，老兄。你可不想见识这场暴风雪。

lines.english: Why move at their speed when you could move at mine?
lines.chinese: 既然能按我的速度行动，为什么要跟着他们的速度走？

lines.english: Did Tok send you? Is this a prank?
lines.chinese: 是托克派你来的？这是恶作剧吗？

lines.english: Oh, not everyone's ready for the fast life.
lines.chinese: 哦，不是每个人都准备好过极速人生。

lines.english: Move faster, do more, be happier, right?
lines.chinese: 动得更快，做得更多，也更快乐，对吧？

lines.english: Ready to pick up the pace?
lines.chinese: 准备好提速了吗？

lines.english: You learn to feel the seconds between seconds. Take the actions between actions. It's weird.
lines.chinese: 你会学会感受秒与秒之间的秒，在行动与行动之间行动。很怪。

lines.english: Smart. Decide where you are going before you hit the haste.
lines.chinese: 聪明。在加速之前，先决定自己要去哪。

lines.english: Chronomancy isn't magic exactly. It's more altering your perspective.
lines.chinese: 时间术严格说不算魔法，更像是在改变你的视角。

lines.english: What is the difference between fast for you and slow for them? Is it the same?
lines.chinese: 对你来说的快，和对他们来说的慢，有什么区别？是一回事吗？

lines.english: Tok sells inferior speed-ups! And I'm cuter.
lines.chinese: 托克卖的是劣质加速！而且我更可爱。

lines.english: The faster you move, the longer your life. Think about it.
lines.chinese: 你动得越快，生命就越长。想想看。

lines.english: I can turn your minutes into hours!
lines.chinese: 我能把你的分钟变成小时！

lines.english: I understand. Speed can be scary.
lines.chinese: 我懂。速度是会让人害怕。

lines.english: How can I help you?
lines.chinese: 我能帮你什么？

lines.english: That'll get you moving.
lines.chinese: 这会让你动起来。

lines.english: Stay long!
lines.chinese: 久留一会儿！

lines.english: Yeah, you definitely need what I'm selling.
lines.chinese: 没错，你绝对需要我卖的东西。

lines.english: I get it. Time costs money.
lines.chinese: 我明白。时间就是金钱。

lines.english: So you don't want to go faster.
lines.chinese: 所以你不想更快一点。

lines.english: My mother always said, if one second's not enough, split it into two. Does that make sense?
lines.chinese: 我妈妈常说，一秒不够，就把它劈成两半。说得通吗？

lines.english: Let's make this quick, okay?
lines.chinese: 我们快点，好吗？

lines.english: Chronomancy doesn't just win fights. It feels good.
lines.chinese: 时间术不只是能赢下战斗。它感觉也很棒。

lines.english: Or maybe Cobweb? She doesn't seem like the joking type.
lines.chinese: 或者是蛛网？她看起来不像会开玩笑的人。

lines.english: In the time you've been sitting here, I've written two novels and three chrononomicons. Can I help you?
lines.chinese: 你坐在这里的这段时间里，我已经写了两本小说和三部时间秘典。需要帮忙吗？

lines.english: I asked Cobweb, and she just said, "The web of time ensnares us all." Okay, Cobweb.
lines.chinese: 我问了蛛网，她只说：“时间之网会困住我们所有人。”好吧，蛛网。

lines.english: You'll be running circles around them with that!
lines.chinese: 有了这个，你会把他们绕得团团转！

lines.english: We've been standing here 20 seconds. Are you okay?
lines.chinese: 我们已经在这儿站了二十秒。你还好吗？

lines.english: Damage report!
lines.chinese: 报告损伤！

lines.english: Ha ha ha! Now what is this nonsense?
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈！这又是什么荒唐把戏？

lines.english: Relieve me of duty. I am unfit to command.
lines.chinese: 解除我的职务吧。我不配指挥。

lines.english: A diverting exercise, to be sure.
lines.chinese: 确实是一场有趣的演练。

lines.english: Destroy this fool and proceed with the patrol.
lines.chinese: 摧毁这个蠢货，然后继续巡逻。

lines.english: And just in time for tea.
lines.chinese: 正好赶上喝茶。

lines.english: Get this filth out of my sight.
lines.chinese: 把这污秽之物从我眼前清走。

lines.english: You must be one of those filthy corsairs.
lines.chinese: 你一定是那些肮脏海盗中的一个。

lines.english: One more should do it!
lines.chinese: 再来一下就够了！

lines.english: You challenge the might of the Armada. You must be mad.
lines.chinese: 你竟敢挑战无敌舰队的威势。你一定疯了。

lines.english: You fight dirtier than a Bloodreef raider!
lines.chinese: 你打得比血礁奇兵还脏！

lines.english: You'll make a decent training exercise.
lines.chinese: 你会是个不错的训练项目。

lines.english: Accept their surrender, then open fire.
lines.chinese: 接受他们投降，然后开火。

lines.english: A minor inconvenience.
lines.chinese: 小小不便。

lines.english: Impossible!
lines.chinese: 不可能！

lines.english: You might make a fine Cloudtop.
lines.chinese: 你也许能成为不错的云顶人。

lines.english: Continue offensive!
lines.chinese: 继续进攻！

lines.english: Tactics may fail against such savagery.
lines.chinese: 面对这般野蛮，战术也可能失效。

lines.english: No retreat. No surrender.
lines.chinese: 不撤退。不投降。

lines.english: I'll be court-martialed for this.
lines.chinese: 我会因此上军事法庭的。

lines.english: Are you very proud of yourself?
lines.chinese: 你很为自己骄傲吗？

lines.english: What part of superior officer do you not understand?
lines.chinese: “上级军官”这几个字，你哪部分听不懂？

lines.english: Back to your post, Lieutenant!
lines.chinese: 回你的岗位去，中尉！

lines.english: Bring her about and fire again!
lines.chinese: 调转船头，再次开火！

lines.english: From the Bazaar. I can smell its filth on you.
lines.chinese: 来自大巴扎。我能闻到你身上的污秽味。

lines.english: Will you people ever learn your place?
lines.chinese: 你们这些人什么时候才会明白自己的位置？

lines.english: Back to your cage, little rat!
lines.chinese: 回你的笼子去，小老鼠！

lines.english: Let's go!
lines.chinese: 上！

lines.english: Ooh. As expected.
lines.chinese: 哦。如我所料。

lines.english: That will teach you to fly above your station.
lines.chinese: 这会教会你别妄想飞到不属于你的高度。

lines.english: Good. Another volley?
lines.chinese: 很好。再来一轮齐射？

lines.english: You groundlings fight dirty!
lines.chinese: 你们这些地面人打得真脏！

lines.english: Hm. Unexpected.
lines.chinese: 嗯。出乎意料。

lines.english: Ugh! Groundlings!
lines.chinese: 呃！地面人！

lines.english: Well fought, groundling. Well enough.
lines.chinese: 打得不错，地面人。算是不错。

lines.english: Very well. I'll spare a moment to destroy you.
lines.chinese: 很好。我会抽出片刻来毁掉你。

lines.english: You just used up all your luck!
lines.chinese: 你刚刚把好运全用光了！

lines.english: Admirable performance.
lines.chinese: 表现可嘉。

lines.english: The Admiral will not be pleased.
lines.chinese: 上将不会高兴的。

lines.english: Another groundling returned to the ground.
lines.chinese: 又一个地面人回到了地面。

lines.english: You challenge a Cloudtop? What insolence!
lines.chinese: 你竟敢挑战云顶人？何等无礼！

lines.english: Until we meet again.
lines.chinese: 直到我们再会。

lines.english: The ants of the Bazaar swarm and scramble, racing towards their end, but not you.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎的蝼蚁蜂拥奔忙，竞相奔向终点。但你不同。

lines.english: Without my gifts, your time will come quickly.
lines.chinese: 没有我的恩赐，你的时辰很快就会到来。

lines.english: You may call me Cobweb, but my true name takes time.
lines.chinese: 你可以叫我蛛网，但我的真名需要时间才能说完。

lines.english: Such reckless haste. Your days will slip through your fingers.
lines.chinese: 如此莽撞急切。你的时日会从指缝间溜走。

lines.english: Your enemies will become statues.
lines.chinese: 你的敌人会化作雕像。

lines.english: This Bazaar is a manic hive. I seek to calm it.
lines.chinese: 这座大巴扎是一座狂躁的蜂巢。我想让它安静下来。

lines.english: You have grasped the true meaning of time, and transcended it. Or perhaps, you have fallen asleep.
lines.chinese: 你已领悟时间的真义，并超越了它。又或者，你只是睡着了。

lines.english: I came here to show you all a glimpse of eternity, and to make a little cash.
lines.chinese: 我来到这里，是为了让你们瞥见永恒，也顺便赚点小钱。

lines.english: Time is a web. I will teach you to walk its threads.
lines.chinese: 时间是一张网。我会教你行走在它的丝线上。

lines.english: Like atoms to protons, there are finer grains of time. Learn to see them.
lines.chinese: 就像原子之下还有质子，时间也有更细的颗粒。学会看见它们。

lines.english: I see your stillness. You are learning.
lines.chinese: 我看见了你的静止。你正在学习。

lines.english: Go then. The web of time will weave you back.
lines.chinese: 去吧。时间之网会把你织回来。

lines.english: Who enters my web?
lines.chinese: 谁进入了我的网？

lines.english: Slow your enemies, and their rage resembles peace.
lines.chinese: 让你的敌人慢下来，他们的愤怒就会像平静。

lines.english: Linger in your moments, lie languid in the river of time.
lines.chinese: 停驻于你的片刻，慵然躺在时间之河里。

lines.english: See each grain of sand in the hourglass. Watch them tumble like boulders.
lines.chinese: 看清沙漏里的每一粒沙。看它们像巨石般滚落。

lines.english: You rush from moment to moment. Slow and steady their passage.
lines.chinese: 你从一个瞬间冲向另一个瞬间。放慢它们，稳住它们。

lines.english: Time is a power above all. Time is all.
lines.chinese: 时间是高于一切的力量。时间就是一切。

lines.english: Look close enough at the grains of time and you will find lifetimes within lifetimes.
lines.chinese: 足够仔细地凝视时间之粒，你会在生命中看见生命。

lines.english: Sun and moon spin like a wheel. You will return.
lines.chinese: 日月如轮旋转。你会归来。

lines.english: Savor a single second. See it from every angle.
lines.chinese: 品味单独的一秒。从每个角度看它。

lines.english: You will find the birth and death of the universe in a single nanosecond.
lines.chinese: 你会在一纳秒中发现宇宙的诞生与死亡。

lines.english: If you don't have time to slow down, perhaps Chronos is more your speed.
lines.chinese: 如果你没时间慢下来，也许时精更合你的速度。

lines.english: Time is an infinite fractal. There are seconds within seconds forever.
lines.chinese: 时间是无限分形。秒中有秒，永无止境。

lines.english: Each moment is a jewel, multifaceted, glittering.
lines.chinese: 每个瞬间都是宝石，多面而闪耀。

lines.english: Become aware of each second. See them and feel them.
lines.chinese: 觉察每一秒。看见它们，感受它们。

lines.english: Old saying round here: an empty gun is an empty wallet.
lines.chinese: 这儿有句老话：枪膛空了，钱包也空。

lines.english: Bloke came in before ya. He bought heaps of ammo. Watch yourself.
lines.chinese: 你之前来了个家伙，买了一大堆弹药。自己小心。

lines.english: Surprised you found the shop. Ain't exactly advertising.
lines.chinese: 没想到你能找到这店。我可没怎么打广告。

lines.english: G'day.
lines.chinese: 日安。

lines.english: Lot of pretty talk about living in harmony, but I've seen what they do to caravans.
lines.chinese: 他们嘴上总说和谐共处，可我见过他们怎么对商队下手。

lines.english: Once you're a dervish, hard to be anything else.
lines.chinese: 一旦成了旋舞者，就很难再变回别的什么。

lines.english: Put a few rounds in a dervish for me, will ya?
lines.chinese: 替我往旋舞者身上打几发，成吗？

lines.english: Don't worry, mate. I'll look out for ya.
lines.chinese: 别担心，伙计。我会照看你的。

lines.english: You ever head out to the dunes? Tell them Dusty Colt sent ya.
lines.chinese: 要是你去沙丘那边，就说是尘土寇特让你来的。

lines.english: Ho ho ho, with a stare like that, you must be a right shooter.
lines.chinese: 嚯嚯嚯，就凭你这眼神，准是个好枪手。

lines.english: Got a steady gaze, mate.
lines.chinese: 眼神挺稳，伙计。

lines.english: Telling you, mate, you can never have too much ammo.
lines.chinese: 我跟你说，伙计，弹药永远不嫌多。

lines.english: A stare-down, is it? Right.
lines.chinese: 这是要比谁瞪得久？行。

lines.english: Just trying to look out for you, mate.
lines.chinese: 只是想替你着想，伙计。

lines.english: Good on ya, but I'd take a few more clips.
lines.chinese: 干得好，不过我会再带几匣弹。

lines.english: I'll say this: the dervishes are tough, but they're mad as a cut snake.
lines.chinese: 我就这么说：旋舞者很硬，但疯得像受伤的蛇。

lines.english: I sell ammo. What did you come for, flowers?
lines.chinese: 我卖的是弹药。你来买花吗？

lines.english: What brings a softy to Roughtown?
lines.chinese: 什么风把软骨头吹到拉夫镇来了？

lines.english: Lord of the Wastes. Charismatic bugger. You ever meet him, plug your ears.
lines.chinese: 荒原之主。那混蛋很有煽动力。要是见到他，把耳朵堵上。

lines.english: Crikey, mate, you got me weeping. Good on ya.
lines.chinese: 哎呀，伙计，你都把我感动哭了。干得好。

lines.english: That Form bloke can sell the guns. I've got the ammo.
lines.chinese: 弗尔姆那家伙会卖枪。我这里卖弹药。

lines.english: Don't go out at night round here, even with this on ya.
lines.chinese: 这附近晚上别出去，就算带着这玩意儿也别去。

lines.english: If you can't be the fastest shot, be the fastest reload.
lines.chinese: 如果你做不了最快的枪手，就做最快装弹的人。

lines.english: I don't like to talk about my life in the dunes.
lines.chinese: 我不爱谈我在沙丘里的日子。

lines.english: See you later.
lines.chinese: 回头见。

lines.english: Now don't go shouting about it. I keep a low profile.
lines.chinese: 可别到处嚷嚷。我一向低调。

lines.english: Our Tower District overlords don't want you to know the truth. The world is round.
lines.chinese: 塔楼区的霸主们不想让你知道真相：世界是圆的。

lines.english: They're working with the Builders to trick us into believing... um... uh... I forgot.
lines.chinese: 他们和建造者勾结，骗我们相信……呃……呃……我忘了。

lines.english: This proves all my theories!
lines.chinese: 这证明了我所有理论！

lines.english: If there's no conspiracy, then how do you explain all of my bad choices?
lines.chinese: 如果没有阴谋，那你怎么解释我做过的所有糟糕选择？

lines.english: Powerful forces want to silence me, because I am important.
lines.chinese: 强大的势力想让我闭嘴，因为我很重要。

lines.english: Other geckins bully me, but they know I am looking out for them.
lines.chinese: 其他壁虎人欺负我，但他们知道我是在为他们着想。

lines.english: Tell whoever you work for to stay out of the Dead Grass.
lines.chinese: 告诉你的雇主，别靠近死草地。

lines.english: Obviously, the ship is Buildertech, so why did they crash? Hmm.
lines.chinese: 很明显，那艘船是建造者科技，那他们为什么会坠毁？嗯。

lines.english: The Gorgons, the Volcans, Sergeant Suds, everyone is in on this.
lines.chinese: 戈尔贡、沃尔坎人、皂沫中士，所有人都参与其中。

lines.english: Do you not understand? The ship means the end of the world. Probably.
lines.chinese: 你还不明白吗？那艘船意味着世界末日。大概吧。

lines.english: When I get that ship's tech, it's gonna change everything for us geckins.
lines.chinese: 等我拿到那艘船的技术，它会改变我们壁虎人的一切。

lines.english: Every faction in the Bazaar is coming for that ship, but I'm getting there first.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎里的每个派系都冲着那艘船去，但我会第一个到。

lines.english: Who do you work for? The Volkas? The Municipality? Sky Patrol?
lines.chinese: 你替谁办事？沃卡斯？市政当局？天空巡逻队？

lines.english: Whatever's inside that ship is gonna reveal everything. And it will reveal it to me.
lines.chinese: 那艘船里的东西会揭开一切。而且它会向我揭开。

lines.english: That was an ad hominem attack! Doesn't disprove anything.
lines.chinese: 那是人身攻击！什么都反驳不了。

lines.english: You know why you won? Because they planned it that way.
lines.chinese: 你知道你为什么赢吗？因为他们就是这么计划的。

lines.english: My sources? Very credible Basnet posts. Do your own research.
lines.chinese: 我的消息源？非常可信的肌友网帖子。自己去做研究。

lines.english: The point is, this is the end of the world. Which is round, by the way.
lines.chinese: 重点是，这是世界末日。顺便说一句，世界是圆的。

lines.english: They made me fight you. They made me say this. They control everything.
lines.chinese: 他们逼我和你打。他们逼我说这些。他们控制一切。

lines.english: When the Builders return to destroy the Bazaar, you'll wish you'd listened to me.
lines.chinese: 等建造者回来毁灭大巴扎时，你会后悔没听我的。

lines.english: We see your trickery!
lines.chinese: 我们看穿你的把戏了！

lines.english: Why run? We are everywhere!
lines.chinese: 为什么要跑？我们无处不在！

lines.english: Watch the skies! Watch your back!
lines.chinese: 盯紧天空！也看好背后！

lines.english: An outrage!
lines.chinese: 岂有此理！

lines.english: A tasty bit of trash!
lines.chinese: 一块美味的垃圾！

lines.english: You're gold! We want it!
lines.chinese: 你就是金子！我们要了！

lines.english: So shiny!
lines.chinese: 真亮！

lines.english: We are Shadow!
lines.chinese: 我们是阴影！

lines.english: Ah, fresh roadkill!
lines.chinese: 啊，又来个送死的！

lines.english: Fly away, if you can!
lines.chinese: 飞走啊，如果你办得到！

lines.english: Soon you'll be carrion! Ha!
lines.chinese: 你很快就是腐肉了！哈！

lines.english: Ah, shiny, shiny gold! All ours!
lines.chinese: 啊，亮闪闪的金子！全归我们！

lines.english: We won't forgive this!
lines.chinese: 我们不会原谅这事！

lines.english: We'll remember your face!
lines.chinese: 我们会记住你的脸！

lines.english: Gah! By beak and talon, I'll beat you!
lines.chinese: 嘎！以喙与爪之名，我要打败你！

lines.english: Knife or beak, your choice!
lines.chinese: 刀子还是鸟喙，你选！

lines.english: The Rookery remembers!
lines.chinese: 鸦巢会记住！

lines.english: They call us a murder! Gah! Now you see why.
lines.chinese: 他们叫我们一群凶鸦！嘎！现在你知道为什么了。

lines.english: Caraxian pride!
lines.chinese: 卡拉克西安的骄傲！

lines.english: Why must we scavenge? Want things of our own? Gah!
lines.chinese: 为什么我们非得捡拾残渣？我们也想有自己的东西！嘎！

lines.english: To burn hotter is to burn shorter.
lines.chinese: 燃得越烈，烧得越短。

lines.english: Oh, radiant master, bless us with your flame.
lines.chinese: 噢，辉耀的主人，请以您的火焰赐福我们。

lines.english: The flame cares only for what it can devour!
lines.chinese: 火焰只在乎它能吞噬什么！

lines.english: With great sacrifice comes great reward.
lines.chinese: 伟大的牺牲带来伟大的回报。

lines.english: There is much we can give you, but much we require.
lines.chinese: 我们能给予你许多，但也索取许多。

lines.english: Then perhaps there is a place for you in Giga Mart.
lines.chinese: 那么，也许千兆贸易会有你的一席之地。

lines.english: We will not take all of you, only the weak parts.
lines.chinese: 我们不会夺走你的全部，只取走软弱的部分。

lines.english: You have made a terrible enemy this day!
lines.chinese: 你今日树下了可怕的敌人！

lines.english: Scour the impurity from these vile streets!
lines.chinese: 从这些污秽街巷中洗净不洁！

lines.english: Reduce their empires to ashes, that all of us may be one.
lines.chinese: 将他们的帝国化为灰烬，让我们合而为一。

lines.english: On the day of his flame, you will not be spared.
lines.chinese: 在他的火焰之日，你不会被饶恕。

lines.english: I knew you were unworthy. I was merely testing you.
lines.chinese: 我就知道你不配。我不过是在考验你。

lines.english: Only the purified may learn our secret rites.
lines.chinese: 唯有净化者才能学习我们的秘仪。

lines.english: Let us bathe you in the master's flame!
lines.chinese: 让我们以主人的火焰为你沐浴！

lines.english: You wish to learn of our master, but now is not the time.
lines.chinese: 你想了解我们的主人，但现在还不是时候。

lines.english: Do you feel his flames whispering, calling you?
lines.chinese: 你感觉到他的火焰在低语、在召唤你吗？

lines.english: The weight of your life slows you. Let us remove some.
lines.chinese: 生命的重量拖慢了你。让我们替你卸下一些。

lines.english: Only a fool refuses the master's gift!
lines.chinese: 只有蠢人才会拒绝主人的礼物！

lines.english: What remains of you will be hardened.
lines.chinese: 你剩下的部分将被淬硬。

lines.english: Make your pilgrimage to the land you call the Ash, and all will be revealed.
lines.chinese: 去你们称为灰烬之地的地方朝圣，一切都将显明。

lines.english: All of us have made this choice. Will you?
lines.chinese: 我们所有人都做出了这个选择。你呢？

lines.english: I got everything you need. Just a matter of finding it.
lines.chinese: 你需要的我都有。只是得先找出来。

lines.english: I hope when my time comes, somebody recycles me too.
lines.chinese: 希望我大限到来时，也有人把我回收利用。

lines.english: The Bazaar is half buried in junk. It's up to us to use it.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎有一半埋在垃圾里。能不能用起来，就看我们了。

lines.english: It's all about that elbow grease. I like 10W-40 synthetic myself.
lines.chinese: 关键就在于下功夫。我个人喜欢 10W-40 合成机油。

lines.english: Don't tell me you wanted something new!
lines.chinese: 别告诉我你想要全新的东西！

lines.english: Fine. Ride off into the sunset.
lines.chinese: 行吧。骑着它奔向夕阳去。

lines.english: Hoo-wee! Now that's a bargain!
lines.chinese: 嚯！这才叫划算！

lines.english: Junkyard shopping's a gamble. Roll them dice again.
lines.chinese: 逛废品场就是赌博。再掷一次骰子吧。

lines.english: You see landfill, I see buried treasure.
lines.chinese: 你看见的是垃圾填埋场，我看见的是埋藏的宝藏。

lines.english: Well, howdy, hero!
