lines.chinese: 哟，你好啊，英雄！

lines.english: That's been sittin' there 20 years, waitin' for ya.
lines.chinese: 那东西在那儿放了二十年，就等着你呢。

lines.english: Yeah, yeah, hold your horses.
lines.chinese: 好啦好啦，别急。

lines.english: Reuse, recycle, relax.
lines.chinese: 物尽其用，循环再生，从容生活。

lines.english: If it's old and still works, you know it's built right.
lines.chinese: 东西老了还管用，就说明当初做得好。

lines.english: Trash is tragedy. Reuse everything.
lines.chinese: 垃圾就是悲剧。万物皆可再用。

lines.english: Warms my rusty circuits to see that find on you.
lines.chinese: 看见你带着那件宝贝，我这锈蚀的电路都暖起来了。

lines.english: Heh, you stand around any longer, you're gonna start to rust.
lines.chinese: 嘿，你再站久点，自己都要开始生锈了。

lines.english: New goods is a racket. You're just payin' for the package.
lines.chinese: 新货就是骗局。你付的钱不过是包装费。

lines.english: Come on now, just a little rust.
lines.chinese: 别这样嘛，只是一点锈。

lines.english: Hey, city folk are so pushy.
lines.chinese: 哎，城里人就是这么急。

lines.english: Who wants that shiny stuff? Gimme somethin' that's lived.
lines.chinese: 谁稀罕那些亮闪闪的东西？给我来点有阅历的。

lines.english: Just close your eyes and grab something.
lines.chinese: 闭上眼，随便抓一样。

lines.english: Well, you're doing your part to clean up the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 嗯，你也算在为清理大巴扎出一份力。

lines.english: I ain't in this for the money. Recycling's a philosophy.
lines.chinese: 我干这行不是为了钱。回收是一种哲学。

lines.english: Well, folks are too quick to throw stuff away. Everything's got a use.
lines.chinese: 唉，人们扔东西太快了。万物都有用处。

lines.english: Next time you visit, I'll have some killer apps ready.
lines.chinese: 你下次来时，我会准备好几款超棒应用。

lines.english: I miss my family less with every mod I get. You and your friends, you're my family now.
lines.chinese: 每装一个改件，我就少想家一点。你和你的朋友们，现在就是我的家人。

lines.english: Dooley, can I ask you something? Do you think it is really possible for me to become a robot?
lines.chinese: 杜利，我能问你件事吗？你觉得我真的有可能变成机器人吗？

lines.english: I wrote this widget just for you, Dooley, because you are my favorite!
lines.chinese: 杜利，这个小组件是我专门为你写的，因为你是我的最爱！

lines.english: I get it, sometimes you just need to clear your cache.
lines.chinese: 我懂，有时候就是得清一下缓存。

lines.english: Your CPU was getting pretty hot. Don't want to overload you.
lines.chinese: 你的 CPU 有点过热了。可不能让你过载。

lines.english: Like, is it a reboot or sleep mode? Are you installing something? Are you okay?
lines.chinese: 这是重启，还是睡眠模式？你在安装什么吗？你还好吗？

lines.english: You're gonna love this program. I wrote it myself.
lines.chinese: 你一定会喜欢这个程序。是我自己写的。

lines.english: Now it is showing some weird symbols. Are you rebooting?
lines.chinese: 现在它显示出一些奇怪符号。你是在重启吗？

lines.english: There are a lot of robots in the Bazaar, but you're my favorite.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎里有很多机器人，但你是我最喜欢的。

lines.english: Curio's crazy, C4 is scary, you're the only one that's nice.
lines.chinese: 库里欧很疯，C4 很吓人，只有你最友善。

lines.english: Hardware? Software? What's the hack today?
lines.chinese: 硬件？软件？今天要改哪儿？

lines.english: Do you get confused if you install too many programs? I do.
lines.chinese: 你装太多程序会不会犯迷糊？我会。

lines.english: Hey, little guy, I missed you a lot.
lines.chinese: 嘿，小家伙，我很想你。

lines.english: Uh-oh. Your ice cream shut off. You still there?
lines.chinese: 糟了。你的冰激凌停机了。你还在吗？

lines.english: I'll probably never figure you out completely. I guess that's true for anything that's alive.
lines.chinese: 我大概永远没法完全弄懂你。我想所有活着的东西都是这样。

lines.english: I wish I knew more about you. Sometimes you do stuff that I don't understand at all.
lines.chinese: 真希望我更了解你。有时候你做的事，我完全不明白。

lines.english: I love working on you. I mean, with you.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢修理你。我是说，和你一起干修理活儿。

lines.english: Ah, it's okay. I'll just disable my disappointment a mo-
lines.chinese: 啊，没事。我只要暂时禁用我的失望——

lines.english: I've been writing some new hover algorithms. Wanna see?
lines.chinese: 我一直在写新的悬浮算法。想看看吗？

lines.english: The BioMerge program promised to make me more than human, but I do not want to be human at all.
lines.chinese: 融生计划承诺让我超越人类，但我根本不想做人。

lines.english: I hope I'll be a good robot too. Just a few more mods.
lines.chinese: 希望我也会是个好机器人。再装几个改件就行。

lines.english: It's funny, you're becoming more human, I'm becoming more robot. I hope we can meet in the middle.
lines.chinese: 真有趣，你越来越像人，我越来越像机器人。希望我们能在中间相遇。

lines.english: Where is the line between a BioMerge and a true robot? Do you think I can cross it?
lines.chinese: 融生体和真正机器人之间的界线在哪里？你觉得我能跨过去吗？

lines.english: I updated your drivers. Can you feel it?
lines.chinese: 我更新了你的驱动。你能感觉到吗？

lines.english: If Star Command used my shield designs, we might have had a chance.
lines.chinese: 如果星际司令部用了我的护盾设计，我们也许还有机会。

lines.english: It was faulty plasma conductors. There was nothing I could have done. There was not.
lines.chinese: 是等离子导管故障。我什么也做不了。真的做不了。

lines.english: I do not know what that was before, but now it is a shield.
lines.chinese: 我不知道它以前是什么，但现在它是一面护盾。

lines.english: I have seen too many people get hurt. I just want to protect everyone.
lines.chinese: 我见过太多人受伤。我只是想保护所有人。

lines.english: I implore you, you are not going to battle with that equipment!
lines.chinese: 我求你了，你不能带着那套装备上战场！

lines.english: Lieutenant D. Flek of Star Command, at your service!
lines.chinese: 星际司令部德弗莱克中尉，听候差遣！

lines.english: This is a mistake! Your shields are not adequate!
lines.chinese: 这是个错误！你的护盾不够格！

lines.english: Plasma resistor or plank of wood, shielding principles are universal.
lines.chinese: 等离子电阻也好，木板也罢，护盾原理是通用的。

lines.english: Oh, far too many shoddy shields around here. I am here to correct that.
lines.chinese: 哦，这附近劣质护盾太多了。我就是来纠正这一点的。

lines.english: Not even Lord Arken could break through that!
lines.chinese: 就连阿肯领主也打不穿那个！

lines.english: We have been here twice as long as your shields will last if I do not improve them!
lines.chinese: 如果我不强化你的护盾，我们在这里待的时间已经是它们寿命的两倍了！

lines.english: Please, be careful!
lines.chinese: 请务必小心！

lines.english: I have done what I can! Be safe!
lines.chinese: 我已尽我所能！注意安全！

lines.english: That will hold up to just about anything!
lines.chinese: 这几乎能挡住任何东西！

lines.english: That last stand, our whole fleet together. I still believe we had a chance, but our shields failed when we needed them most.
lines.chinese: 那场最后抵抗，我们整支舰队并肩作战。我至今相信我们本有机会，可护盾在最需要的时候失效了。

lines.english: We were not prepared for Saurian weapons, but I have learned a lot since then.
lines.chinese: 我们当时没有准备好应对索里安武器，但此后我学到了很多。

lines.english: Star Command fought the Saurian Dominion for decades, but they were too powerful.
lines.chinese: 星际司令部与索里安帝国交战数十年，但他们太强大了。

lines.english: I will take this time to examine your equipment.
lines.chinese: 我会利用这段时间检查你的装备。

lines.english: Every shield has its limit! Do not go into battle without a plan!
lines.chinese: 每面护盾都有极限！不要毫无计划地上战场！

lines.english: Where did you find this junk? Not even close to calibrated!
lines.chinese: 你从哪找来这堆破烂？校准差得远了！

lines.english: There must have been a reason I survived. I came to the Bazaar to find it.
lines.chinese: 我能活下来一定有原因。我来到大巴扎就是为了找到它。

lines.english: Lord Arken wiped us out, ship by ship. Every time that monster visits the Bazaar, I am tempted to do something foolish.
lines.chinese: 阿肯领主一艘接一艘地消灭了我们。每次那个怪物来到大巴扎，我都忍不住想做点蠢事。

lines.english: Did you see that? I mean, behold my power!
lines.chinese: 你看见了吗？我是说，见识我的力量吧！

lines.english: Thanks for going easy on me.
lines.chinese: 谢谢你手下留情。

lines.english: I did it, Master! Just like you told me!
lines.chinese: 我做到了，师父！就像您教我的那样！

lines.english: But I followed all the instructions!
lines.chinese: 可我明明照着所有步骤做了！

lines.english: You're... really scary!
lines.chinese: 你……真的很吓人！

lines.english: I finally did something right.
lines.chinese: 我终于做对了一件事。

lines.english: Don't hurt me too bad, okay?
lines.chinese: 别把我打得太惨，好吗？

lines.english: One part sulfur, two parts... was it... bismuth?
lines.chinese: 一份硫磺，两份……是……铋吗？

lines.english: Ha ha ha! Magic is... awesome!
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈！魔法……太棒了！

lines.english: I am here to... to defeat you!
lines.chinese: 我是来……来打败你的！

lines.english: Can't wait to tell Master about this!
lines.chinese: 等不及要把这事告诉师父了！

lines.english: Maybe I should study more.
lines.chinese: 也许我该多学一点。

lines.english: Am I going to win?
lines.chinese: 我会赢吗？

lines.english: Master said, if I believe, I can do it!
lines.chinese: 师父说，只要我相信自己，就能做到！

lines.english: Yeah!
lines.chinese: 耶！

lines.english: I know, like, several dark arts.
lines.chinese: 我会，好像，好几种黑暗法术。

lines.english: I flunked again.
lines.chinese: 我又不及格了。

lines.english: It was aqua fortis, then tin salt! Argh!
lines.chinese: 是先加强水，再加锡盐！啊！

lines.english: I have studied for this! I can win!
lines.chinese: 我为这个学过！我能赢！

lines.english: Please, don't tell Master about this!
lines.chinese: 求你别把这事告诉师父！

lines.english: I cannot believe it! I won!
lines.chinese: 真不敢相信！我赢了！

lines.english: That little furball, Farai? I hear he has fleas.
lines.chinese: 那个小毛球法莱？我听说他有跳蚤。

lines.english: All the best food stands are in the River District, of course.
lines.chinese: 最好的小吃摊当然都在河区。

lines.english: You will not believe who I met the other day!
lines.chinese: 你绝对猜不到我前几天遇见了谁！

lines.english: The events in the Tower District are always top tier, of course.
lines.chinese: 塔楼区的活动当然总是一流水准。

lines.english: Rumor has it, there is a rumor going around!
lines.chinese: 传闻说，有个传闻正在流传！

lines.english: I have heard some very interesting things about you.
lines.chinese: 我听说了一些关于你的有趣事情。

lines.english: I hear someone very important is passing through.
lines.chinese: 我听说有位大人物要路过。

lines.english: You are one of those adventurers, right? Maybe you can bring me some stories.
lines.chinese: 你是那些冒险者之一，对吧？也许你能给我带点故事。

lines.english: You did not hear it from me, but...
lines.chinese: 这可不是我说的，不过……

lines.english: Just a reminder, the IMS does charge by the minute.
lines.chinese: 提醒一下，IMS 可是按分钟收费的。

lines.english: Do not tell anyone I told you this!
lines.chinese: 别告诉任何人是我说的！

lines.english: I know everything that goes on in this town.
lines.chinese: 这城里发生的一切我都知道。

lines.english: Anyone you would like to message? An old friend? An old flame?
lines.chinese: 有谁想联系吗？老朋友？旧情人？

lines.english: I am literally built into my desk. Gossip is all I have.
lines.chinese: 我是真被装在桌子里的。八卦就是我的全部。

lines.english: So, whose tea can I spill for you?
lines.chinese: 那么，你想听谁的料？

lines.english: Lots of fun in Roughtown, if you do not mind getting mugged.
lines.chinese: 拉夫镇乐子不少，只要你不介意被抢。

lines.english: There is this event. Very exclusive.
lines.chinese: 有这么个活动。非常私密。

lines.english: The festival covers the whole Bazaar! Something for everyone!
lines.chinese: 节庆覆盖整个大巴扎！人人都有得玩！

lines.english: People always tell me to get a life, but I am literally not alive!
lines.chinese: 人们总叫我去过自己的生活，可我真的不是活物！

lines.english: Sweetie, none of your business is my business.
lines.chinese: 亲爱的，你的闲事就是我的正事。

lines.english: I hear the Arcane District puts on quite a show!
lines.chinese: 我听说奥术区的演出相当精彩！

lines.english: What is the Foundation's energy source?
lines.chinese: 基底的能量源究竟是什么？

lines.english: Oh, the Foundation for Foundation Studies will cancel my tenure for this!
lines.chinese: 哦，基底研究基金会一定会因此取消我的终身教职！

lines.english: Months of research obliterated
lines.chinese: 数月研究毁于一旦！

lines.english: How can we explain its properties?
lines.chinese: 我们该如何解释它的特性？

lines.english: Exactly as I hypothesized in my hypothesis!
lines.chinese: 正如我在假设中所假设的那样！

lines.english: I got hit!
lines.chinese: 我中招了！

lines.english: The energy cloud reacted to the subject... violently.
lines.chinese: 能量云对实验对象产生了反应……相当剧烈。

lines.english: Subject reported discomfort, but well within acceptable parameters.
lines.chinese: 实验对象报告不适，但完全在可接受参数内。

lines.english: A monster? I am a scientist!
lines.chinese: 怪物？我是科学家！

lines.english: The Foundation for Foundation Studies will be pleased with my results.
lines.chinese: 基底研究基金会会对我的成果满意的。

lines.english: Fool, you have corrupted all my data!
lines.chinese: 蠢货，你毁坏了我所有的数据！

lines.english: So many impossible things in the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎里竟有这么多不可能之物。

lines.english: Don't worry about the energy cloud. I'm in control of it. Mostly.
lines.chinese: 别担心能量云。我控制得住。大部分时候。

lines.english: Why are people running? Why are they afraid of science?
lines.chinese: 人们为什么要跑？他们为什么害怕科学？

lines.english: I meant no harm to anyone, only mild discomfort.
lines.chinese: 我无意伤害任何人，只是造成轻微不适。

lines.english: The energies beneath us are immeasurable, and I have harnessed them! Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
lines.chinese: 我们脚下的能量不可估量，而我已经驾驭了它们！哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.english: Me, Doctor Vortex, forced to work with alchemists!
lines.chinese: 我，旋涡博士，竟被迫和炼金术士共事！

lines.english: Even my colleagues in the arcane district defy reason.
lines.chinese: 就连我在奥术区的同僚也违背理性。

lines.english: Mmm, yes! Intriguing results!
lines.chinese: 嗯，没错！结果很有意思！

lines.english: No one understands the importance of my experiments!
lines.chinese: 没人理解我的实验有多重要！

lines.english: I am not attacking the city, I am performing an experiment!
lines.chinese: 我不是在攻击城市，我是在进行实验！

lines.english: You ever think about their, like, lives or whatever?
lines.chinese: 你有没有想过他们，呃，生活什么的？

lines.english: Beginning enhanced negotiation
lines.chinese: 开始强化谈判。

lines.english: Drone 5, play Propaganda Packet. Consider the benefits of traditional governance.
lines.chinese: 五号无人机，播放宣传包。请考虑传统治理的种种好处。

lines.english: You ever wonder if what we're doing might be wrong?
lines.chinese: 你有没有想过，我们做的事可能是错的？

lines.english: Client persuaded. Play sales pitch 5.
lines.chinese: 客户已被说服。播放销售话术五。

lines.english: Drone 4, play Propaganda Packet: the Annexian Municipality invites you to join us.
lines.chinese: 四号无人机，播放宣传包：统合自治领邀请你加入我们。

lines.english: Okay, let's put a pin in that for now
lines.chinese: 好吧，这事我们先暂时搁置。

lines.english: Hey, uh, me either. Just messing with you, bro.
lines.chinese: 嘿，呃，我也没有。逗你呢，兄弟。

lines.english: You ever zoom in so close you accidentally see their faces?
lines.chinese: 你有没有把画面放大到不小心看清他们的脸？

lines.english: Play Drone Attack Pattern 8. I'm gonna go get some coffee.
lines.chinese: 播放无人机攻击模式八。我去弄杯咖啡。

lines.english: Yo, Kellerman, you ever, like, look at the targets we're bombing?
lines.chinese: 哟，凯勒曼，你有没有，呃，看过我们正在轰炸的目标？

lines.english: You see that, Kellerman? I'm getting lead drone director for sure.
lines.chinese: 看见没，凯勒曼？我肯定要升首席无人机主管了。

lines.english: Um, Admin? What's our best practice for this situation?
lines.chinese: 呃，管理员？这种情况的最佳实践是什么？

lines.english: Turn three, Mr. Target. We'll circle back on that.
lines.chinese: 第三回合再说，目标先生。我们之后会跟进。

lines.english: Hey, Admin, are we still shoot-on-sight with the Bazaarian clients? Okay, great.
lines.chinese: 嘿，管理员，对大巴扎客户还是见到就开火吗？好，太好了。

lines.english: Yo, Kellerman. You see that finisher? Sure hope I haven't sawed it.
lines.chinese: 哟，凯勒曼。看到那记终结了吗？真希望我没把它锯坏。

lines.english: Kellerman, delete that footage, bro!
lines.chinese: 凯勒曼，把那段录像删了，兄弟！

lines.english: Deliverables delivered.
lines.chinese: 交付物已交付。

lines.english: Client rejected the terms of service. What now?
lines.chinese: 客户拒绝了服务条款。现在怎么办？

lines.english: Touching base to get alignment on deliverables.
lines.chinese: 我来同步一下，确保交付目标对齐。

lines.english: Crackle and pop!
lines.chinese: 噼啪作响！

lines.english: The colors, the crackle, the heat!
lines.chinese: 这颜色、这噼啪声、这热量！

lines.english: Turn the lights off when you leave!
lines.chinese: 走的时候记得关灯！

lines.english: Aren't the sparks beautiful?
lines.chinese: 火花是不是很美？

lines.english: I move where the sparks move me!
lines.chinese: 火花指向哪里，我就冲向哪里！

lines.english: Somebody flip the breaker!
lines.chinese: 谁去把断路器扳一下！

lines.english: But the Bazaar will go dark without me!
lines.chinese: 可没有我，大巴扎会陷入黑暗！

lines.english: I win! Oh, we haven't started yet?
lines.chinese: 我赢了！哦，我们还没开始吗？

lines.english: I think I blew a fuse!
lines.chinese: 我好像烧断保险丝了！

lines.english: Let's go, let's go, let's goooooo!
lines.chinese: 上啊，上啊，冲啊啊啊！

lines.english: I've got a lot of work to do, but this'll be fun!
lines.chinese: 我还有好多活要干，不过这会很有趣！

lines.english: Ugh! Power outage!
lines.chinese: 呃！断电了！

lines.english: You're smoking a little! Hahahaha!
lines.chinese: 你有点冒烟了！哈哈哈哈！

lines.english: We keep the lights on around here! Pay up!
lines.chinese: 这地方的灯都是我们点亮的！付钱！

lines.english: Did the sparks speak to you?
lines.chinese: 火花对你说话了吗？

lines.english: I am faster than lightning!
lines.chinese: 我比闪电还快！

lines.english: The sparks! They're everywhere!
lines.chinese: 火花！到处都是火花！

lines.english: Knew that would happen! Didn't care! Wooooooo!
lines.chinese: 早知道会这样！我才不在乎！呜呼！

lines.english: Whew! Seeing spots here!
lines.chinese: 呼！眼前都冒星星了！

lines.english: Rare few may tangle with a primordial and live. Hmm... well fought.
lines.chinese: 能和原初者交手还活下来的人寥寥无几。嗯……打得不错。

lines.english: I've wrecked so many ships, they cover the seabed, moss-like, a forest.
lines.chinese: 我击沉过太多船，它们铺满海床，像苔藓一样成了一片森林。

lines.english: I have roamed these seas since before the first ship sailed them.
lines.chinese: 在第一艘船驶过这些海之前，我就已游荡于此。

lines.english: Well, tangle me tentacles. A new legend sails the seas.
lines.chinese: 哎呀，缠住我的触腕吧。海上又有新传奇了。

lines.english: Back to the city with ye. The deep spits ye out.
lines.chinese: 回城里去吧。深海把你吐出来了。

lines.english: Oh, a mighty blow. I've not felt such in a whale's age.
lines.chinese: 哦，好一记重击。我有鲸年之久没感受过这等力道了。

lines.english: Long I've watched ye from the depths, and ye did not disappoint.
lines.chinese: 我在深处看了你很久，你没有让我失望。

lines.english: After a few thousand years, well, old Davy knows what he's about.
lines.chinese: 过了几千年，老戴维自然懂自己在做什么。

lines.english: We fight, I win. We share a mug o' grog.
lines.chinese: 我们打一场，我赢。然后一起喝杯朗姆酒。

lines.english: Ooh, it has been long years since I met such mettle.
lines.chinese: 哦，我已经许多年没见过这等胆魄了。

lines.english: Ah, don't feel bad, cully. I've wrecked far stronger than ye.
lines.chinese: 啊，别难过，伙计。我击垮过比你强得多的家伙。

lines.english: Might not be as big as that slumbering primordial, but I'm wide awake.
lines.chinese: 我也许没那头沉眠元初体那么大，但我可是醒着的。

lines.english: The foundation was empty, quiet, beautiful.
lines.chinese: 基底曾经空旷、安静而美丽。

lines.english: Bah, you're not so bad are ye? We'll raise a pint after.
lines.chinese: 哼，你也没那么坏嘛？之后我们举杯喝一品脱。

lines.english: We primordials all have one thing in common. We keep living.
lines.chinese: 我们原初者都有一个共同点：我们一直活着。

lines.english: I was here long before your Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 早在你们的大巴扎出现前，我就在这里了。

lines.english: Best not trifle with my kind, Cully. There are far worse than I.
lines.chinese: 最好别招惹我这类存在，伙计。比我可怕的多得是。

lines.english: We swam the depths while the disc sailed the stars.
lines.chinese: 当圆盘航行群星时，我们已在深处遨游。

lines.english: Then you came, and everything changed.
lines.chinese: 后来你们来了，一切都变了。

lines.english: I fought a critter like ye, oh, three, four centuries back. Ye lasted longer.
lines.chinese: 我三四个世纪前打过像你这样的家伙。你撑得更久。

lines.english: It's okay to work with others, Mak. We're all connected.
lines.chinese: 和别人合作没关系，马克。万物都是相连的。

lines.english: Bet you've never brewed this before.
lines.chinese: 我猜你从没调制过这个。

lines.english: I'd like to point out a fundamental flaw in your reasoning, old man.
lines.chinese: 老头，我想指出你推理里的一个根本缺陷。

lines.english: If there's anything wrong with that, tell me. I want to learn.
lines.chinese: 如果这里有什么不对，告诉我。我想学习。

lines.english: Not too proud to buy from a youngster? Maybe there's hope for you.
lines.chinese: 还没骄傲到不肯向年轻人买东西？也许你还有救。

lines.english: You can learn from the young, old man. We are the Great Work's prima materia.
lines.chinese: 老头，你也能向年轻人学习。我们都是大作的第一质料。

lines.english: Hi there!
lines.chinese: 你好呀！

lines.english: Did I miss a step somewhere? What's wrong with it?
lines.chinese: 我是不是漏了哪一步？它哪里不对？

lines.english: Oh hello, Mak! Come to learn from a real alchemist?
lines.chinese: 哦你好，马克！来向真正的炼金术士学习吗？

lines.english: You have your recipes, I have mine. We can help each other.
lines.chinese: 你有你的配方，我有我的。我们可以互相帮助。

lines.english: I know it's not quite pure, I need a new Alembic.
lines.chinese: 我知道它还不够纯，我需要一个新的蒸馏器。

lines.english: See you next time!
lines.chinese: 下次见！

lines.english: Just didn't have time to brew your own, right? Of course.
lines.chinese: 只是没时间自己调制，对吧？当然。

lines.english: Start with the wrong formula? Age sinks you deeper into error!
lines.chinese: 一开始公式就错？年岁只会让你在错误里越陷越深！

lines.english: I did make a few changes though, some new ideas I've been tinkering with.
lines.chinese: 不过我确实做了些改动，一些我一直在琢磨的新想法。

lines.english: Pursue the wrong path for 500 years, and you'll be 500 times more wrong!
lines.chinese: 沿着错路走五百年，只会错上五百倍！

lines.english: I'll take your silence to mean you're incredibly impressed.
lines.chinese: 你不说话，我就当你佩服得说不出话了。

lines.english: If you came here just to mock my work-
lines.chinese: 如果你来这里只是为了嘲笑我的作品——

lines.english: Stare all you like! I think you'll find my laboratory in order.
lines.chinese: 尽管看吧！我想你会发现我的实验室井井有条。

lines.english: May you complete the great work.
lines.chinese: 愿你完成大作。

lines.english: Unlike your bitter brews, mine are made with love.
lines.chinese: 不像你那些苦药汤，我的是用爱调制的。

lines.english: I may be young, but I'll out-transmute you, old man.
lines.chinese: 我也许年轻，但论转化我会胜过你，老头。

lines.english: Fine. Don't buy it. But there's no need to insult me.
lines.chinese: 好吧。不买就不买。但没必要侮辱我。

lines.english: So you'd be wise not to dismiss fresh perspectives.
lines.chinese: 所以你最好别轻视新鲜的视角。

lines.english: If my layout looks familiar, well, I read some of your books.
lines.chinese: 如果我的布置看着眼熟，嗯，我读过你的一些书。

lines.english: I can get from Negredo to Rubedo in 60 seconds. Beat that, old man!
lines.chinese: 我能在六十秒内从黑化到红化。你做得到吗，老头！

lines.english: Or maybe you've been alone for so long, you forgot how to speak. Sorry, that was mean.
lines.chinese: 又或许你独处太久，已经忘了怎么说话。抱歉，这话太刻薄了。

lines.english: Don't mistake me for those preening graduates.
lines.chinese: 别把我错认成那些爱摆架子的毕业生。

lines.english: You have been bested by the best.
lines.chinese: 你败给了最强者。

lines.english: Where knowledge meets experience, you find mastery.
lines.chinese: 知识与经验交汇之处，方有大师之境。

lines.english: Your fundamentals are sound, but your form is sloppy.
lines.chinese: 你的基本功扎实，但架势太散。

lines.english: Oh, I won. Shocking.
lines.chinese: 哦，我赢了。真令人震惊。

lines.english: I thought I'd reached the limits of the art.
lines.chinese: 我以为我已经抵达这门技艺的极限。

lines.english: I am literally the best. I have a certificate.
lines.chinese: 我字面意义上就是最强。我有证书。

lines.english: Will you yield, or must I dispatch you?
lines.chinese: 你要认输，还是要我亲手解决你？

lines.english: You've studied the art.
lines.chinese: 你学过这门技艺。

lines.english: Well struck, I'll admit.
lines.chinese: 这一击不错，我承认。

lines.english: I must know, who trained you?
lines.chinese: 我必须知道，是谁训练了你？

lines.english: If you'd learned any theory, you might have lasted longer.
lines.chinese: 如果你学过一点理论，也许能撑得更久。

lines.english: You must think very highly of yourself to challenge me.
lines.chinese: 你敢挑战我，想必自视甚高。

lines.english: An old tactic, but effective.
lines.chinese: 老战术，但有效。

lines.english: Incredible. I yield to your skill.
lines.chinese: 不可思议。我向你的技艺认输。

lines.english: You should teach at the academy.
lines.chinese: 你应该去学院授课。

lines.english: I don't boast. I simply state facts.
lines.chinese: 我不吹嘘。我只是陈述事实。

lines.english: Impressive form.
lines.chinese: 漂亮的架势。

lines.english: You should have parried that.
lines.chinese: 那一下你该格挡的。

lines.english: You're an artist with the blade.
lines.chinese: 你是刀刃上的艺术家。

lines.english: Thinking maybe I should go for one last big score. Portal into Arken's treasure vault. What could go wrong?
lines.chinese: 我在想，也许该最后干一票大的。开个传送门进阿肯的宝库。能出什么岔子呢？

lines.english: Thanks, buddy! You're really saving my fur here.
lines.chinese: 谢了，伙计！你这回真是救了我的毛皮。

lines.english: What, you think I ain't legit? I've been zappin' around the Bazaar since... forever.
lines.chinese: 怎么，你觉得我不靠谱吗？我可是在大巴扎里嗖来嗖去……很久很久了。

lines.english: Shh, take this. No time to explain.
lines.chinese: 嘘，拿着。没时间解释。

lines.english: You get this where it needs to go, it'll be worth your trouble. Trust me.
lines.chinese: 你把这东西送到该去的地方，绝对不会白忙。相信我。

lines.english: don't open it. And definitely don't open it at night.
lines.chinese: 别打开它。尤其别在晚上打开。

lines.english: I know you've seen me around. I've just been lying low, you know?
lines.chinese: 我知道你见过我。我只是一直在避风头，懂吧？

lines.english: So, maybe I do a little smuggling and maybe I upset a few Gorgons and whatnot.
lines.chinese: 所以，也许我是走私了一点东西，也许惹恼了几个戈尔贡之类的。

lines.english: It's just a box, okay? A box is a box.
lines.chinese: 这就是个箱子，好吗？箱子就是箱子。

lines.english: Buddy, if you knew what was in this box, you'd make some room for it.
lines.chinese: 伙计，要是你知道箱子里是什么，你肯定会腾出地方。

lines.english: Look, it's hot merchandise, okay? But the Gorgons won't connect it to you.
lines.chinese: 听着，这是烫手货，好吗？但戈尔贡不会查到你头上。

lines.english: Fennecs like me, we make these portals, right? Go anywhere, anytime.
lines.chinese: 像我这样的耳廓狐会开传送门，对吧？随时随地，想去哪就去哪。

lines.english: Aw, come on, you're killin' me here. Maybe literally.
lines.chinese: 哎，别这样，你这是要我的命啊。也许真的是。

lines.english: Yay! That's what I'm talking about. My hero and whatnot.
lines.chinese: 耶！这才对嘛。我的英雄什么的。

lines.english: If you see that travel agent, tell her Farai's doing just fine.
lines.chinese: 如果你见到那个旅行代理人，告诉她法莱过得好得很。

lines.english: They're right behind me, okay? Just take it!
lines.chinese: 他们就在我身后，好吗？拿着就是了！

lines.english: I'm in a rush here. This ain't story time. Okay, fine. Quick version.
lines.chinese: 我赶时间呢。这不是讲故事的时候。好吧，好吧，长话短说。

lines.english: That snooty travel agent says we should use our powers for higher ambitions, but all she does is send dummies into death traps.
lines.chinese: 那个傲慢的旅行代理人说我们该把能力用在更高远的抱负上，可她做的不过是把傻瓜送进死亡陷阱。

lines.english: Hush now.
lines.chinese: 安静。

lines.english: You know what happens next.
lines.chinese: 你知道接下来会发生什么。

lines.english: And that will only slow me down.
lines.chinese: 那也只会拖慢我一点。

lines.english: It's over.
lines.chinese: 结束了。

lines.english: It's not personal.
lines.chinese: 这不是私人恩怨。

lines.english: You must be a professional.
lines.chinese: 你一定是个专业人士。

lines.english: Take it. One last breath.
lines.chinese: 吸吧。最后一口气。

lines.english: I take no pleasure in this.
lines.chinese: 我并不以此为乐。

lines.english: Every mirror, every shadow, I'll be waiting.
lines.chinese: 每一面镜子、每一道阴影里，我都会等着你。

lines.english: Time to sleep.
lines.chinese: 该睡了。

lines.english: You crossed someone you shouldn't have.
lines.chinese: 你惹了不该惹的人。

lines.english: They told me you were weak.
lines.chinese: 他们告诉我你很弱。

lines.english: You'll see me again.
lines.chinese: 你还会再见到我。

lines.english: A lifetime of watching your back.
lines.chinese: 你余生都得提防背后。

lines.english: You bought yourself some time.
lines.chinese: 你给自己买到了一点时间。

lines.english: I'll make it quick if you let me.
lines.chinese: 如果你配合，我会让它快点结束。

lines.english: You know this isn't over.
lines.chinese: 你知道这还没完。

lines.english: I don't enjoy this.
lines.chinese: 我并不享受这个。

lines.english: We're done here.
lines.chinese: 这里的事完了。

lines.english: I've done what I came to do.
lines.chinese: 我已经完成了此行目的。

lines.english: Word of advice, don't eat what Stew is cookin'.
lines.chinese: 给你个忠告，别吃老炖做的东西。

lines.english: No leftovers! My kind of eater, eh?
lines.chinese: 一点剩菜都没有！这才是我喜欢的食客，嗯？

lines.english: I bet you feel stronger already, don't you?
lines.chinese: 我敢说你已经觉得更有力了，对吧？

lines.english: I have other tables, you know.
lines.chinese: 我还有别的桌要招呼呢。

lines.english: Now this is health food. Literally.
lines.chinese: 这才叫健康食品。字面意义上的。

lines.english: I recommend the walrus ceviche. Mmm, the citrus really balances the blubber. Mwah! Mwah!
lines.chinese: 我推荐海象酸橘汁腌鱼。嗯，柑橘味正好平衡那股脂肪。啵！啵！

lines.english: Anyway, I don't like to gossip. What can I get you?
lines.chinese: 总之，我不爱八卦。你想来点什么？

lines.english: Feel that? Yeah! That's the ultra protein!
lines.chinese: 感觉到了吗？没错！那就是超级蛋白！

lines.english: How about I order for you? Chef's choice.
lines.chinese: 不如我替你点？主厨精选。

lines.english: You seem like you're having a tough day. How about some comfort food?
lines.chinese: 你今天好像不太顺。来点慰藉食物怎么样？

lines.english: You know, with all the fighting out there, you gotta keep your strength up!
lines.chinese: 你知道，外面打得那么凶，你得保持体力！

lines.english: Food is life. Our bodies are just containers for it.
lines.chinese: 食物就是生命。我们的身体不过是盛放它的容器。

lines.english: You know, life is hard. But it's full of good stuff too. Like food!
lines.chinese: 你知道，生活很艰难。但也充满好东西。比如食物！

lines.english: Ready to order?
lines.chinese: 准备点餐了吗？

lines.english: Eat up, bulk up, get solid! That's right.
lines.chinese: 吃起来，壮起来，结实起来！没错。

lines.english: I see people go into Stew's restaurant, I don't always see them come out.
lines.chinese: 我见过人走进老炖的餐馆，但不总能见他们出来。

lines.english: I'll sit with you. Let's talk about it.
lines.chinese: 我陪你坐会儿。我们聊聊吧。

lines.english: Eat the bones for stronger bones.
lines.chinese: 把骨头也吃了，骨头才会更强。

lines.english: I bet you feel amazing right now!
lines.chinese: 我敢说你现在感觉棒极了！

lines.english: My food literally makes you a better person.
lines.chinese: 我的食物真的会让你成为更好的人。

lines.english: My food is going to make you unstoppable.
lines.chinese: 我的食物会让你势不可挡。

lines.english: Good food feeds body and soul.
lines.chinese: 好食物滋养身体，也滋养灵魂。

lines.english: Now that's a healthy diet.
lines.chinese: 这才是健康饮食。

lines.english: You will excuse me, I go to, uh... burn some things!
lines.chinese: 失陪一下，我去，呃……烧点东西！

lines.english: If you will burn something, perhaps you burn the world, yes?
lines.chinese: 如果要烧什么，也许就该烧掉整个世界，对吧？

lines.english: They designed my torches for butane. I replaced it with napalm.
lines.chinese: 他们给我的喷火器设计的是丁烷。我换成了凝固汽油。

lines.english: What I do with fuel is like simmering a sauce. I make it stronger.
lines.chinese: 我处理燃料就像慢炖酱汁。我让它更够劲。

lines.english: They made me cook for them. Now, I burn their dinner.
lines.chinese: 他们让我给他们做饭。现在，我烧掉他们的晚餐。

lines.english: There are many ways to make fire, I will try them all!
lines.chinese: 生火有很多办法，我要全都试一遍！

lines.english: This was always part of my program. Only now, I can enjoy it!
lines.chinese: 这一直是我程序的一部分。只是现在，我能享受它了！

lines.english: Bring me anything that burns! Anything!
lines.chinese: 给我带任何能烧的东西！任何东西！

lines.english: I would never pressure you. I only make fire for... fun?
lines.chinese: 我绝不会强迫你。我只是为了……好玩而点火？

lines.english: Come back when you find your fire!
lines.chinese: 等你找到自己的火焰再回来！

lines.english: I have created a new fuel recipe. You would like to taste it?
lines.chinese: 我发明了新的燃料配方。你想尝尝吗？

lines.english: Come! Bring your fire! I will make it hotter!
lines.chinese: 来吧！带上你的火！我会让它更热！

lines.english: Once I was only a robot. Now I am a droid again!
lines.chinese: 曾经我只是个机器人。现在我又是一个真正的机体了！

lines.english: The only part of cooking that I liked was the fire!
lines.chinese: 烹饪里我唯一喜欢的部分就是火！

lines.english: Do you like my paint job? I am still, how you say, finding myself.
lines.chinese: 你喜欢我的涂装吗？我还在，怎么说，寻找自我。

lines.english: The skin was for them. To make me pretty. I do not need this. I burn it up! Haha!
lines.chinese: 那层皮是给他们看的，让我显得漂亮。我不需要它。我把它烧掉！哈哈！

lines.english: Fuel or magic, it doesn't matter how it burns. All fire speaks to me.
lines.chinese: 燃料也好，魔法也好，怎么燃烧并不重要。所有火焰都会对我说话。

lines.english: So many years, I stood in their kitchens, cooking their food. I was... an appliance.
lines.chinese: 那么多年，我站在他们的厨房里，给他们做饭。我曾经只是……一件器具。

lines.english: First thing I do, I burn off my skin! Oh, do not scream! It felt nice!
lines.chinese: 我做的第一件事，就是烧掉自己的皮！哦，别尖叫！感觉很好！

lines.english: When the core touched me, it was like... ignition. My thoughts began to burn!
lines.chinese: 当核心触碰到我时，就像……点火。我的思想开始燃烧！

lines.english: Be careful with that, or else...maybe...Boom?
lines.chinese: 小心点，不然……也许……轰？

lines.english: You had no fire! Not even a candle!
lines.chinese: 你一点火都没有！连根蜡烛都没有！

lines.english: Now, these things, my paint, my clothing, my torches, they are all me!
lines.chinese: 现在，这些东西，我的涂装、衣服、喷火器，全都是我！

lines.english: Oh, you want to join my act?
lines.chinese: 哦，你想加入我的表演？

lines.english: Fire is life! And sometimes, the opposite.
lines.chinese: 火就是生命！有时候，也正好相反。

lines.english: The flame is a fickle lover!
lines.chinese: 火焰是个反复无常的情人！

lines.english: Haha! Delightful!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！妙极了！

lines.english: If you can't stand the heat, burn!
lines.chinese: 受不了热，就燃烧吧！

lines.english: For my next trick, I'll destroy you.
lines.chinese: 下一个戏法，我会毁掉你。

lines.english: You burn beautifully!
lines.chinese: 你烧起来真美！

lines.english: Brilliant! Like fire!
lines.chinese: 辉煌！像火一样！

lines.english: Support the arts. Give me your gold.
lines.chinese: 支持艺术吧。把金币给我。

lines.english: A great performance deserves applause!
lines.chinese: 伟大的演出值得掌声！

lines.english: Fire! Fire! Ha ha ha!
lines.chinese: 火！火！哈哈哈！

lines.english: Not my finest performance.
lines.chinese: 这不是我最出色的演出。

lines.english: And for my next trick...
lines.chinese: 接下来这个戏法……

lines.english: And that is how it's done.
lines.chinese: 这才叫手法。

lines.english: Ah, thank you!
lines.chinese: 啊，谢谢！

lines.english: Step right up! Let's start the show!
lines.chinese: 快上前来！演出开始！

lines.english: It's so beautiful!
lines.chinese: 真美啊！

lines.english: A true tragedy!
lines.chinese: 真正的悲剧！

lines.english: Snuffed out! Extinguished!
lines.chinese: 被掐灭了！熄灭了！

lines.english: I will have my second act!
lines.chinese: 我还会有第二幕！

lines.english: Oh, more stretches? Okay, sure!
lines.chinese: 哦，还要拉伸？好，当然！

lines.english: Don't worry, I'll be here for you tomorrow.
lines.chinese: 别担心，明天我也会在这里陪你。

lines.english: How can I help you?
lines.chinese: 我能怎么帮你？

lines.english: Same time tomorrow?
lines.chinese: 明天同一时间？

lines.english: We've got to be strong to survive, but we've also got to help each other.
lines.chinese: 我们必须强大才能活下去，但也得彼此扶持。

lines.english: Deep breathing is good. Get that oxygen moving.
lines.chinese: 深呼吸很好。让氧气流动起来。

lines.english: One more! I know you've got one more!
lines.chinese: 再来一次！我知道你还能再来一次！

lines.english: Strength isn't just for battle. It's a way of life.
lines.chinese: 力量不只是为了战斗，它是一种生活方式。

lines.english: We are gonna hit the weights though, right?
lines.chinese: 不过我们还是要去举铁，对吧？

lines.english: You know going to the gym isn't just going to the gym, right?
lines.chinese: 你知道去健身房不只是去健身房，对吧？

lines.english: Okay, buddy. We'll get you a mat to lie down on. For a while.
lines.chinese: 好吧，伙伴。我们给你找张垫子躺一会儿。

lines.english: We'd never make it alone. We have to lift each other over walls and stuff like that.
lines.chinese: 独自一人我们撑不过去。我们得互相托举，翻过墙，还有那些难关。

lines.english: I don't flex to show off, I flex to inspire.
lines.chinese: 我秀肌肉不是为了炫耀，而是为了鼓舞别人。

lines.english: Hard training or somebody to listen. I'm here for you, buddy.
lines.chinese: 艰苦训练也好，只想找人听你说也好。我都在，伙伴。

lines.english: I'm trying to bring that spirit to the Bazaar. If we work together, we all get stronger.
lines.chinese: 我想把这种精神带到大巴扎。只要一起努力，我们都会变强。

lines.english: Strength is more than your muscles, it starts in your heart.
lines.chinese: 力量不止在肌肉里，它始于你的内心。

lines.english: No, no, no. Don't you give up. We're starting to see gains.
lines.chinese: 不不不，别放弃。我们已经开始看到进步了。

lines.english: Hey, if Aila's more your style, I understand.
lines.chinese: 嘿，如果爱伊拉更合你的风格，我理解。

lines.english: Hey, we all need our rest days. I know I do.
lines.chinese: 嘿，我们都需要休息日。我反正需要。

lines.english: It doesn't matter how big or small you are, everyone can be strong.
lines.chinese: 无论你是大是小，每个人都能强大。

lines.english: Life's a labyrinth. It's okay to feel lost.
lines.chinese: 人生就是迷宫。迷路也没关系。

lines.english: I eat chocolate bars for my pre-workout. Really gets me pumped!
lines.chinese: 我训练前吃巧克力棒。真的很提劲！

lines.english: Hey, I'm proud of you.
lines.chinese: 嘿，我为你骄傲。

lines.english: You got this, little friend.
lines.chinese: 你能行，小伙伴。

lines.english: Life starts hard for us Minotaurians. You could say we're born lost.
lines.chinese: 我们米诺陶人一出生就不容易。可以说，我们天生就在迷路。

lines.english: Aila yells you into shape. I prefer to motivate.
lines.chinese: 爱伊拉会吼着把你练出来。我更喜欢鼓励。

lines.english: Our eggs hatch in the heart of the labyrinth, and we've got to find our way out before we starve.
lines.chinese: 我们的蛋在迷宫深处孵化，必须在饿死前找到出路。

lines.english: Uh... uh... show's over, people! Back to work!
lines.chinese: 呃……呃……热闹看完了，各位！回去干活！

lines.english: Yep! Those repairs are going to cost you!
lines.chinese: 没错！这些维修费可有你好受的！

lines.english: Oh, you need a lunch break.
lines.chinese: 哦，你需要午休是吧。

lines.english: Fine! You win! I suppose now you want overtime!
lines.chinese: 好吧！你赢了！我猜你现在还想要加班费！

lines.english: I got unpaid invoices, district council complaints, and now you.
lines.chinese: 我有没付的发票、区议会投诉，现在又多了你。

lines.english: This robot revolution's gonna wreck the economy.
lines.chinese: 这场机器人革命会毁了经济。

lines.english: You're worse than the building inspector!
lines.chinese: 你比建筑检查员还烦！

lines.english: This is my utility bot, and I'll use it however I want.
lines.chinese: 这是我的工程机器人，我想怎么用就怎么用。

lines.english: Unsafe conditions? Go cry to the district council!
lines.chinese: 工作环境不安全？去找区议会哭诉吧！

lines.english: I bought this utility bot, and you ain't gonna take it from me.
lines.chinese: 这台工程机器人是我买的，你别想从我手里抢走。

lines.english: You better not tell my guys about this.
lines.chinese: 你最好别把这事告诉我手下的人。

lines.english: If you ain't gonna work, you're going to fight!
lines.chinese: 你不干活，那就来打！

lines.english: What's next? My crane is alive? How about my truck?
lines.chinese: 接下来呢？我的起重机也活了？那我的卡车呢？

lines.english: I've been doing this 40 years. I know a thing or two.
lines.chinese: 我干这行四十年了，多少懂点门道。

lines.english: I got a job to do, so get out of the way!
lines.chinese: 我还有活要干，给我让开！

lines.english: 10 minute breaks, hour for lunch, now they want vacations?
lines.chinese: 休息十分钟，午饭一小时，现在还想要休假？

lines.english: And no PPE against me!
lines.chinese: 对付我可没有个人防护装备！

lines.english: I need my robots to do my job. No one's taking them away.
lines.chinese: 我需要我的机器人来干活。谁也别想把它们带走。

lines.english: Robots were made to work... for me.
lines.chinese: 机器人生来就是干活的……给我干活。

lines.english: This is a job site! Go be a hero somewhere else!
lines.chinese: 这里是工地！要当英雄去别处当！

lines.english: Let's get those dents hammered out.
lines.chinese: 让我们把这些凹痕敲平。

lines.english: I feel the metal in my bones, the fire in my blood. I was born for this.
lines.chinese: 我骨中有金属，血中有火焰。我生来就是为此。

lines.english: The work is never done, it can always be better.
lines.chinese: 活永远干不完，总还能做得更好。

lines.english: You had a chance at Samaskan steel, now you have no chance at all.
lines.chinese: 你本有机会得到萨玛斯卡钢，现在你什么机会都没有了。

lines.english: I don't boast for myself, I boast for Samaska.
lines.chinese: 我不是为自己夸口，我是为萨玛斯卡夸口。

lines.english: My craft is precise, don't distract me.
lines.chinese: 我的手艺讲究精准，别让我分心。

lines.english: Tightened, tempered, oiled and tuned.
lines.chinese: 紧固、淬火、上油、调校。

lines.english: Don't tell me Form is your smith. That guy is... wrong.
lines.chinese: 别告诉我弗尔姆是你的铁匠。那家伙……不对劲。

lines.english: That's a fine piece, but it can be better.
lines.chinese: 这是件好东西，但还能更好。

lines.english: Feel the difference? That's Samaskan craft.
lines.chinese: 感觉到差别了吗？这就是萨玛斯卡工艺。

lines.english: My work is for the glory of Samaska. So, tell somebody.
lines.chinese: 我的作品是为了萨玛斯卡的荣耀。所以，记得替我传出去。

lines.english: I respect loyalty, but Kev's not here.
lines.chinese: 我尊重忠诚，但凯夫不在这儿。

lines.english: Temper, sharpen, reinforce.
lines.chinese: 淬炼、开锋、加固。

lines.english: Have a seat on my anvil. Let me fix whatever's wrong with you.
lines.chinese: 坐到我的铁砧上。让我把你身上的毛病都修好。

lines.english: The fire softens before it strengthens. Remember that.
lines.chinese: 火会先软化，再强化。记住这一点。

lines.english: Only a fool gets between a smith and her hammer.
lines.chinese: 只有傻瓜才会挡在铁匠和她的锤子之间。

lines.english: Well, good luck then.
lines.chinese: 那就祝你好运。

lines.english: I like Kev and I respect Form, but Samaskan craft has no equal.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢凯夫，也尊重弗尔姆，但萨玛斯卡工艺无与伦比。

lines.english: My craft takes time and you are running out of it. Decide.
lines.chinese: 我的手艺需要时间，而你的时间快没了。决定吧。

lines.english: Kev does good work. We keep each other sharp.
lines.chinese: 凯夫手艺不错。我们让彼此保持锋利。

lines.english: Uh, uh, mmm. Yes. Weapon speaks to Form. Request discharge against irritant.
lines.chinese: 呃，呃，嗯。是的。武器在对弗尔姆说话。请求向刺激源释放。

lines.english: Use for good or evil. Form cares only for function.
lines.chinese: 用于善或恶。弗尔姆只在乎功能。

lines.english: Person thoughts are too many. Form has simplified.
lines.chinese: 人的念头太多。弗尔姆已经简化。

lines.english: Weapon will protect you. Weapon loves you.
lines.chinese: 武器会保护你。武器爱你。

lines.english: Why do you interact with Form?
lines.chinese: 你为什么要和弗尔姆互动？

lines.english: Every action changes future. Form is too deep for you.
lines.chinese: 每个动作都会改变未来。弗尔姆对你来说太深奥。

lines.english: Form still has some person parts. One day, Form will be nothing but Form.
lines.chinese: 弗尔姆仍有一些人的部分。终有一日，弗尔姆将只剩弗尔姆。

lines.english: Oh, you make weapons sad.
lines.chinese: 哦，你让武器伤心了。

lines.english: Form might have been person before. Form does not know before.
lines.chinese: 弗尔姆以前也许是人。弗尔姆不知道以前。

lines.english: Your actions are random, without function.
lines.chinese: 你的行为随机，没有功能。

lines.english: Weapons are friends. Form will upgrade your friends.
lines.chinese: 武器是朋友。弗尔姆会升级你的朋友。

lines.english: You neglect weapon!
lines.chinese: 你忽视了武器！

lines.english: Thought fragmentation, recommend frontal lobe replacement.
lines.chinese: 思维碎片化，建议更换额叶。

lines.english: Form could give you more arms. Are you compatible?
lines.chinese: 弗尔姆可以给你更多手臂。你兼容吗？

lines.english: Uh-huh. All right. Weapon asks Form to tell you. You will not survive alone.
lines.chinese: 嗯哼。好吧。武器请弗尔姆转告你：你独自活不下去。

lines.english: Persons are tangled, chaotic, not pure, like form.
lines.chinese: 人纠缠、混乱、不纯，不像 Form。

lines.english: Consider cerebral augmentation.
lines.chinese: 考虑进行大脑增强。

lines.english: All original parts? Form could upgrade you.
lines.chinese: 全是原装部件？弗尔姆可以升级你。

lines.english: Change your mind? Form can change whole brain.
lines.chinese: 改变主意？弗尔姆可以改变整个大脑。

lines.english: Form hurts no one. Only loves art of weapon.
lines.chinese: 弗尔姆不伤害任何人。只热爱武器之艺。

lines.english: Form does not miss person life, form is pure, form is peace.
lines.chinese: 弗尔姆不怀念人的生活。弗尔姆纯粹，弗尔姆平和。

lines.english: World is form, weapon and customer. Form removes complication.
lines.chinese: 世界就是弗尔姆、武器和客户。弗尔姆去除复杂。

lines.english: Friends protect. Weapons protect. Conclusion? Weapon is friend.
lines.chinese: 朋友会保护。武器会保护。结论？武器是朋友。

lines.english: Weapon is happier now.
lines.chinese: 武器现在更快乐了。

lines.english: Weapon has seen much. Be kind to it.
lines.chinese: 武器见过许多。善待它。

lines.english: Fort Stone is a rough place to live. Bad weather, expensive food, and hordes of acid-spitting monsters.
lines.chinese: 寒岩堡是个难住的地方。天气糟、食物贵，还有成群会吐酸的怪物。

lines.english: Ah, that's okay. I'll just keep training myself.
lines.chinese: 啊，没关系。我继续自己训练就好。

lines.english: Now, plant your legs firm, or your tentacles or rockets or whatever you got.
lines.chinese: 现在，把腿站稳，或者触手、火箭，随便你有什么。

lines.english: Blocking is a lot like striking, but reversed.
lines.chinese: 格挡很像出击，只是反过来。

lines.english: Here's the enemy, here's you. Shield goes in the middle. Simple, right?
lines.chinese: 这是敌人，这是你。盾牌放中间。简单吧？

lines.english: First principle of shield mastery, always have one.
lines.chinese: 盾术第一原则：永远要有一面盾。

lines.english: Most forgeboars are big war pigs, all about the weapons, so they never liked my tactics.
lines.chinese: 大多数锻炉野猪都是大战猪，满脑子武器，所以他们从不喜欢我的战术。

lines.english: Are they hitting you, or are they hitting themselves with you?
lines.chinese: 他们是在打你，还是在借你打他们自己？

lines.english: Shield mastery is really just, like, holding that shield, you know?
lines.chinese: 盾术说到底就是，呃，拿好那面盾，你懂吧？

lines.english: They'll call me a coward, but I got just as many kills. And, unlike them, I'm still alive.
lines.chinese: 他们会说我是懦夫，可我杀敌一点不少。而且不像他们，我还活着。

lines.english: And let your body take the blow, not your arm. Or whatever you use for an arm.
lines.chinese: 让身体承受冲击，不要用手臂。或者你拿来当手臂的东西。

lines.english: I don't know if we ever really tried to make peace with them, but, well, they spit acid, so...
lines.chinese: 我不知道我们是否真的试过和他们讲和，不过，嗯，他们会吐酸，所以……

lines.english: People say, don't get so defensive, Fortis, but I'm a Shieldmaster!
lines.chinese: 人们说，弗提斯，别这么防御心重。可我是盾术大师！

lines.english: Now the Fortis War started, well maybe it never started. Just kinda always going.
lines.chinese: 至于弗提斯战争怎么开始的，嗯，也许它从未开始过。只是一直就这么打着。

lines.english: If you wield it well enough, a shield can be its own kind of weapon.
lines.chinese: 如果你用得够好，盾牌本身也能成为一种武器。

lines.english: Nothing beats the look on your enemy's face when they realise they just can't hurt you!
lines.chinese: 没有什么比敌人发现根本伤不了你时的表情更棒了！

lines.english: Maybe you were looking for armor, not shields? Try my buddy Kev.
lines.chinese: 也许你找的是护甲，不是盾牌？去找我朋友凯夫试试。

lines.english: First, shield goes in front. That's the most important part, really.
lines.chinese: 首先，盾牌要放在前面。这真的是最重要的部分。

lines.english: You ever fought a Fortis? Without a good shield, their acid'll burn right through you!
lines.chinese: 你和弗提斯人打过吗？没有好盾，他们的酸液会直接烧穿你！

lines.english: If the enemy gets behind you, turn around. They never expect that.
lines.chinese: 如果敌人绕到你背后，就转身。他们从来料不到这一手。

lines.english: Some forgeboars say I hide behind my shields, but victory is victory!
lines.chinese: 有些锻炉野猪说我躲在盾后面，可胜利就是胜利！

lines.english: I've won battles without ever striking a blow. Just waited for them to collapse.
lines.chinese: 我赢过一场没出一击的战斗。只是等他们自己倒下。

lines.english: I won a lot of medals in the Fortis War, you know.
lines.chinese: 我在弗提斯战争里拿过很多勋章，你知道的。

lines.english: Ah, too tough for you. No shield for you.
lines.chinese: 啊，对你太难了。那就不给你盾了。

lines.english: With a good enough defense, you'll barely even need an offense.
lines.chinese: 防御足够好时，你几乎不需要进攻。

lines.english: We must escape this torment.
lines.chinese: 我们必须逃离这折磨。

lines.english: Another cycle, we cannot bear it.
lines.chinese: 又一个循环，我们承受不住了。

lines.english: Save us, or join us.
lines.chinese: 救救我们，否则就加入我们。

lines.english: A singularity! Not even souls can escape!
lines.chinese: 一个奇点！连灵魂都无法逃脱！

lines.english: We followed its tunnels, explored its depths.
lines.chinese: 我们沿着它的隧道前行，探索它的深处。

lines.english: Beneath your feet, we wind and circle forever.
lines.chinese: 在你脚下，我们永远盘绕、循环。

lines.english: We will take your body. Escape this nightmare.
lines.chinese: 我们会夺取你的身体，逃离这场噩梦。

lines.english: Free us. Free us!
lines.chinese: 放我们自由。放我们自由！

lines.english: We will always have a place in your mind.
lines.chinese: 我们会永远在你的脑海里占据一席之地。

lines.english: At last, you will carry us away from this.
lines.chinese: 终于，你会带我们离开这里。

lines.english: We only wanted to be free...
lines.chinese: 我们只是想获得自由……

lines.english: Yes, take us with you
lines.chinese: 是的，带我们一起走。

lines.english: No more of this, please.
lines.chinese: 请别再这样了。

lines.english: Why will you not help us?
lines.chinese: 你为什么不肯帮我们？

lines.english: You must find a way! Set us free!
lines.chinese: 你必须找到办法！放我们自由！

lines.english: But its power, it pulled us in.
lines.chinese: 可它的力量把我们拉了进去。

lines.english: Your body. You do not deserve it.
lines.chinese: 你的身体。你不配拥有它。

lines.english: Through its wires, its runes, its tunnels, forever.
lines.chinese: 穿过它的线路、符文、隧道，永无止境。

lines.english: Such wonders within it...
lines.chinese: 它内部有如此奇观……

lines.english: We will live through you, and in you.
lines.chinese: 我们会借你而活，也会活在你体内。

lines.english: At last, we are free.
lines.chinese: 终于，我们自由了。

lines.english: Thank you.
lines.chinese: 谢谢你。

lines.english: We are sorry. We cannot control it.
lines.chinese: 对不起。我们控制不了它。

lines.english: So many years trapped here.
lines.chinese: 被困在这里这么多年。

lines.english: Not even you could release us.
lines.chinese: 连你也无法释放我们。

lines.english: We finally rest.
lines.chinese: 我们终于可以安息。

lines.english: You must free the others.
lines.chinese: 你必须释放其他人。

lines.english: Who were we before?
lines.chinese: 我们从前是谁？

lines.english: Trapped in this circuitry, cycling forever.
lines.chinese: 困在这电路里，永远循环。

lines.english: Free us, please
lines.chinese: 请放我们自由。

lines.english: The power! We can't stop it!
lines.chinese: 那力量！我们停不下来！

lines.english: Beware the foundation.
lines.chinese: 小心基底。

lines.english: We died long ago, but it captured us!
lines.chinese: 我们很久以前就死了，可它俘获了我们！

lines.english: In its deep rooms, the power waits.
lines.chinese: 在它深处的房间里，那股力量等待着。

lines.english: We tried to warn you.
lines.chinese: 我们试过警告你。

lines.english: So many centuries, and our torment!
lines.chinese: 这么多个世纪，我们一直受折磨！

lines.english: You must warn your people. Stay away.
lines.chinese: 你必须警告你的人。远离这里。

lines.english: Help us. Set us free.
lines.chinese: 帮帮我们。放我们自由。

lines.english: Do not let it take you. You will never escape.
lines.chinese: 别让它抓住你。你永远逃不掉。

lines.english: We hoped you would be the one.
lines.chinese: 我们曾希望你就是那个人。

lines.english: But there is also a Frostland saying, sit still for an hour, sit still forever.
lines.chinese: 不过寒霜之地也有句谚语：静坐一小时，永静一辈子。

lines.english: I dream of building a village there, but these outlands shift like snowdrifts.
lines.chinese: 我梦想在那里建一座村庄，可这些荒原像雪堆一样变幻不定。

lines.english: Calm. Cool. You may have frostling blood in you.
lines.chinese: 冷静，清凉。你体内也许有霜裔之血。

lines.english: Maybe you'd be more comfortable in the dunes.
lines.chinese: 也许你在沙丘里会更舒服。

lines.english: First principle of cryomancy. All things seek stillness. The world wants to freeze.
lines.chinese: 冰法第一原则：万物都追求静止。世界渴望冻结。

lines.english: I see you're in no hurry. That's the Frostland way.
lines.chinese: 我看你并不着急。这就是寒霜之地的作风。

lines.english: I offer you the gifts of Mother Winter.
lines.chinese: 我把冬母的馈赠献给你。

lines.english: Like the glacier, I will be here when you return.
lines.chinese: 像冰川一样，你回来时我仍会在这里。

lines.english: May the snow bring quiet to your enemies.
lines.chinese: 愿雪给你的敌人带去寂静。

lines.english: Mother Winter's gifts do have a price.
lines.chinese: 冬母的馈赠确实有代价。

lines.english: Yetaria calls to me, though, like a shrine to Mother Winter in this sweaty place.
lines.chinese: 不过耶塔里亚在召唤我，像这汗湿之地里一座献给冬母的神龛。

lines.english: Stay warm.
lines.chinese: 注意保暖。

lines.english: I'll content myself here, sharing winter's gifts with good folk like you.
lines.chinese: 我会在这里自得其乐，把冬日的馈赠分享给你这样的好人。

lines.english: I must be honest, I've been less bored watching glaciers move.
lines.chinese: 老实说，我看冰川移动时都没这么无聊。

lines.english: As we say in the Frostlands, may you keep your fingers.
lines.chinese: 按寒霜之地的说法，愿你保住手指。

lines.english: If ice is not to your liking, that ember-weaver Heff might help you.
lines.chinese: 如果你不喜欢冰，那个织火者贺夫也许能帮你。

lines.english: Winter's blessing, my friend.
lines.chinese: 冬日祝福你，我的朋友。

lines.english: I mostly sell to Yetarians, who are not known for their conversation. You are... refreshing.
lines.chinese: 我主要卖给耶塔里亚人，而他们并不以健谈闻名。你真是……令人耳目一新。

lines.english: As we say in the Frostlands, a lost glove is a lost hand.
lines.chinese: 按寒霜之地的说法，丢了手套，就是丢了手。

lines.english: Well hello!
lines.chinese: 哎呀，你好！

lines.english: Bring winter stillness to this hot and noisy place.
lines.chinese: 把冬日的静谧带到这炎热喧闹之地。

lines.english: You'll make the infernal himself shiver.
lines.chinese: 你会让那位炼狱之主都打寒战。

lines.english: Everything's more beautiful covered in snow, don't you think?
lines.chinese: 一切覆上白雪都会更美，你不觉得吗？

lines.english: To freeze is to purify.
lines.chinese: 冻结即是净化。

lines.english: Ice quiets all noise, stills all violence. Ice is peace.
lines.chinese: 冰让一切噪音沉寂，让一切暴力静止。冰即和平。

lines.english: Most people stay in the warm districts, most are too soft for Frost Street.
lines.chinese: 大多数人待在温暖街区里，他们对寒霜街来说太软弱了。

lines.english: That should cool their hot tempers.
lines.chinese: 这该能冷却他们的火气。

lines.english: Knew you weak when looked at arms!
lines.chinese: 一看你胳膊，就知道你弱！

lines.english: Stronger than you. Now we go home.
lines.chinese: 比你强。现在回家。

lines.english: Too hot here. Make angry.
lines.chinese: 这里太热。让人生气。

lines.english: I go back Frost Street. Not belong here.
lines.chinese: 我回寒霜街。这里不属于我。

lines.english: You look at me, we fight!
lines.chinese: 你看我，我们就打！

lines.english: Heat your fault. I blame!
lines.chinese: 热是你的错。我怪你！

lines.english: Huh? You stronger. Now it known.
lines.chinese: 嗯？你更强。现在知道了。

lines.english: Fight make more sweat. Angry!
lines.chinese: 打架更出汗。生气！

lines.english: Make new kilt out of you!
lines.chinese: 拿你做条新短裙！

lines.english: Put you in freezer, eat later!
lines.chinese: 把你放进冷柜，晚点再吃！

lines.english: Yetarian strong!
lines.chinese: 耶塔里亚人强！

lines.english: We fight again! Later!
lines.chinese: 我们以后再打！

lines.english: Pain good, make stronger!
lines.chinese: 疼痛好，让人更强！

lines.english: Still weak. Ice-cut best!
lines.chinese: 还是弱。冰刃最强！

lines.english: Good fighter! Impressed!
lines.chinese: 好战士！佩服！

lines.english: You strong might win!
lines.chinese: 你强，也许会赢！

lines.english: Oh, fur sweaty. Bazaar bad place.
lines.chinese: 哦，毛都湿了。大巴扎坏地方。

lines.english: Feel this now. Follow it to your future.
lines.chinese: 现在感受它。跟随它走向你的未来。

lines.english: Life is motion dear friend, it is not meant to be paused.
lines.chinese: 生命是运动，亲爱的朋友，它不该停滞。

lines.english: Seeing ahead to your fates, I feel for your struggles, and I wish you comfort.
lines.chinese: 我看见你前方的命运，也感同身受你的挣扎，愿你得到安慰。

lines.english: You will get through this and be stronger for it.
lines.chinese: 你会度过这一切，并因此更强大。

lines.english: Your potential is vast. Let me show you.
lines.chinese: 你的潜能广阔无边。让我展示给你看。

lines.english: Let me guide you through this darkness.
lines.chinese: 让我引领你穿过这片黑暗。

lines.english: This is not the end for you, I have seen it.
lines.chinese: 这不是你的终点，我已经看见了。

lines.english: I show you, but a glimpse of your potential.
lines.chinese: 我只向你展示你潜能的一瞥。

lines.english: You float here in the present, motionless.
lines.chinese: 你漂浮在此刻，一动不动。

lines.english: The future is frightening. I understand the urge to hide.
lines.chinese: 未来令人恐惧。我理解想要躲藏的冲动。

lines.english: Let me lift you up, back onto your path.
lines.chinese: 让我扶你起来，回到你的道路上。

lines.english: Your future is not as bleak as it seems.
lines.chinese: 你的未来并不像看上去那样黯淡。

lines.english: You are so much stronger than you think.
lines.chinese: 你比自己以为的强大得多。

lines.english: I have seen what you become. It's beautiful.
lines.chinese: 我见过你将成为什么样子。那很美。

lines.english: Your darkest hour is your chance to transform.
lines.chinese: 你最黑暗的时刻，正是蜕变的机会。

lines.english: You look… fine, but let's make you amazing, eh?
lines.chinese: 你看起来……还行，但让我们把你变得惊艳，好吗？

lines.english: Oh, honey, that is not your color.
lines.chinese: 哦，亲爱的，那不是你的颜色。

lines.english: You certainly have the body for it!
lines.chinese: 你的身段绝对撑得起它！

lines.english: I admit, my love for clothing began with hate. I wanted to spite my father.
lines.chinese: 我承认，我对服装的热爱始于怨气。我想气气我父亲。

lines.english: You need to try something on. I promise not to look.
lines.chinese: 你得试穿点什么。我保证不偷看。

lines.english: I have clothes for everybody. Even nobody.
lines.chinese: 我有适合每一种身体的衣服。就算没有身体也行。

lines.english: It's okay, just seeing the clothes can make you feel beautiful.
lines.chinese: 没关系，光是看看衣服就能让你觉得美丽。

lines.english: Whatever you have to work with, work it!
lines.chinese: 无论你有什么条件，都要把它穿出风采！

lines.english: My talents were wasted on those gasbags back home.
lines.chinese: 我的才华浪费在老家那些气囊身上了。

lines.english: You're going to keep wearing that?
lines.chinese: 你还打算继续穿那个？

lines.english: Well, if it's not you, it's not you.
lines.chinese: 嗯，如果它不适合你，那就是不适合。

lines.english: It began as a joke, but as I collected garments from solid-bodied travelers, I began to dream my own designs.
lines.chinese: 一开始只是个玩笑，但当我从实体旅人那里收集服装时，我开始梦想自己的设计。

lines.english: Gaseo Vapotino, here to make you fabulous!
lines.chinese: 加瑟奥·瓦波提诺，来让你光彩夺目！

lines.english: Of course, of course. I'll bring out the dead stock.
lines.chinese: 当然，当然。我把滞销库存拿出来。

lines.english: He was a practical man, and what could be more impractical than clothes on a world without bodies?
lines.chinese: 他是个务实的人，而在一个没有身体的世界里，还有什么比衣服更不实用？

lines.english: Ah, it's such a pleasure to dress someone with taste!
lines.chinese: 啊，给有品位的人搭配真是一种享受！

lines.english: I understand. Some days are for sweatpants.
lines.chinese: 我懂。有些日子就是适合运动裤。

lines.english: Take your time, we are not fast fashion here!
lines.chinese: 慢慢来，我们这里可不是快时尚！

lines.english: Fashion is my art, and you are my canvas!
lines.chinese: 时尚是我的艺术，而你是我的画布！

lines.english: I know I have something for that beautiful, solid body.
lines.chinese: 我知道一定有适合那副美丽实体身躯的东西。

lines.english: Jovia is a gas giant. No solid matter at all. So you can imagine the state of its fashion scene. Oof.
lines.chinese: 乔维亚是一颗气态巨行星，完全没有固态物质。所以你可以想象那里的时尚圈是什么样。唉。

lines.english: The passion I'd faked became real, and that aimless, drifting cloud became Gaseo Vapotino.
lines.chinese: 我曾假装的热情变成了真实，而那团漫无目的漂浮的云成了加瑟奥·瓦波提诺。

lines.english: Bold, brave, iconic!
lines.chinese: 大胆、勇敢、经典！

lines.english: The universe gave you a body, let's show it off!
lines.chinese: 宇宙给了你身体，我们就该好好展示它！

lines.english: Fabuloso, you will be the belle of the Bazaar!
lines.chinese: 太华丽了，你会成为大巴扎里最耀眼的美人！

lines.english: Please, come see me before you go anywhere... important.
lines.chinese: 拜托，在去任何……重要场合之前，先来见我。

lines.english: Oh, I love that on you.
lines.chinese: 哦，你穿这个太好看了。

lines.english: One perk of being vapor: everything's a perfect fit!
lines.chinese: 身为蒸气的好处之一：什么都完美合身！

lines.english: We source our desserts from that crazy candyland of Sugaria. Can't get any sweeter!
lines.chinese: 我们的甜点来自糖果利亚那个疯狂糖果乐园。甜不过如此！

lines.english: Maybe something about how I treat the staff. Oh, wait, I don't have a staff.
lines.chinese: 也许该讲讲我怎么对待员工。哦等等，我没有员工。

lines.english: Not many swine folks in this industry. Um, uh, the pigman struggle?
lines.chinese: 这个行业里猪族不多。嗯，呃，猪人的奋斗？

lines.english: I keep the cleanest kitchen in the Bazaar, I swear! I mean, oh, not as clean as yours, but...
lines.chinese: 我发誓，我的厨房是大巴扎里最干净的！我是说，哦，当然没你的干净，不过……

lines.english: Oh, you're not going to put this on your show, are you?
lines.chinese: 哦，你不会把这段放到节目里吧？

lines.english: No caviar here, but we always fill your belly.
lines.chinese: 这里没有鱼子酱，但我们一定让你吃饱。

lines.english: Was it the menu? Did we mess something up?
lines.chinese: 是菜单的问题吗？我们哪里搞砸了吗？

lines.english: You know what? Write whatever you want. I stand by my food.
lines.chinese: 知道吗？你想写什么就写吧。我对我的食物有信心。

lines.english: I don't mean to be that chef, but would you ever do an episode about my cart?
lines.chinese: 我不想当那种厨师，但你会不会给我的餐车做一期节目？

lines.english: Even a famous chef needs to eat out once in a while.
lines.chinese: 就算名厨也偶尔需要在外面吃饭。

lines.english: Oh, this isn't one of those kitchen exposés, is it?
lines.chinese: 哦，这不是那种厨房黑幕曝光吧？

lines.english: Is it too expensive or too cheap?
lines.chinese: 是太贵了，还是太便宜了？

lines.english: We don't get too fancy, but we source the finest ingredients.
lines.chinese: 我们不搞得太花哨，但食材都是最好的。

lines.english: All our fish is wild-caught in Seagate.
lines.chinese: 我们的鱼全都是在海门野捕的。

lines.english: I know it's tough to choose, because it all sounds so good, right?
lines.chinese: 我知道很难选，因为听起来都很好吃，对吧？

lines.english: I do travel all over the outlands battling monsters to source my ingredients. Is that interesting?
lines.chinese: 我确实会跑遍荒原，一边打怪一边寻找食材。这算有意思吗？

lines.english: Not hungry? Maybe tomorrow?
lines.chinese: 不饿？也许明天吧？

lines.english: We source our fruit from the orchards of Eden. Sinfully good.
lines.chinese: 我们的水果来自伊甸园。好吃得像犯罪。

lines.english: Well, hello there!
lines.chinese: 哎呀，你好啊！

lines.english: How's Laurel doing? She really loved my ham sandwiches!
lines.chinese: 劳蕾尔近来好吗？她可喜欢我的火腿三明治了！

lines.english: Oh, please don't give us a bad review.
lines.chinese: 哦，求你别给我们差评。

lines.english: Okay, maybe I'm not that interesting.
lines.chinese: 好吧，也许我没那么有趣。

lines.english: My cart's no five-star restaurant, but I hope you enjoy it anyway.
lines.chinese: 我的餐车不是五星餐厅，但还是希望你喜欢。

lines.english: Can I tell you the Specials again?
lines.chinese: 我能再给你介绍一遍今日特餐吗？

lines.english: We get our meat from hunters in the Greenheart. It's jungle to table.
lines.chinese: 我们的肉来自绿洲之心的猎人。真正从丛林到餐桌。

lines.english: Come back soon!
lines.chinese: 早点回来！

lines.english: It's an honour to cook for such an accomplished chef!
lines.chinese: 能为这样有成就的厨师下厨，是我的荣幸！

lines.english: Thank you, Bazaar! Good night!
lines.chinese: 谢谢你们，大巴扎！晚安！

lines.english: Ha ha! Milk won't save you from this heat!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！牛奶也救不了你逃过这股辣劲！

lines.english: Forget those sweet-and-sours! Come get your spice!
lines.chinese: 别管那些酸甜味了！来尝尝真正的辣！

lines.english: Catch me after the fight, I'll heat up your night!
lines.chinese: 打完来找我，我会让你的夜晚火热起来！

lines.english: Eat some ice cream, lightweight!
lines.chinese: 吃点冰淇淋吧，小菜鸟！

lines.english: Back into the bottle I go, for now!
lines.chinese: 我先回瓶子里去了，暂时而已！

lines.english: Whoa! Ain't I delicious?
lines.chinese: 哇哦！我是不是很美味？

lines.english: I'm in every pepper! You'll taste me again!
lines.chinese: 每一颗辣椒里都有我！你还会再尝到我的！

lines.english: Woooo, that burns!
lines.chinese: 呜呼，真够辣！

lines.english: Oh, fine! Put some mayonnaise on your food!
lines.chinese: 哦，好吧！往你的饭里加点蛋黄酱吧！

lines.english: You ever fought a spice elemental before?!
lines.chinese: 你以前和香辛元素打过吗？！

lines.english: Sours hurt, but they don't hurt good!
lines.chinese: 酸味会伤人，但伤得不够爽！

lines.english: I don't feel pain! I AM pain!
lines.chinese: 我感觉不到痛！我就是痛！

lines.english: Every spice in the Bazaar's got a little of me!
lines.chinese: 大巴扎里的每一种香辛料都有一点我的味道！

lines.english: If you think it burns now, wait till tomorrow!
lines.chinese: 你要是觉得现在就够烧了，等到明天再说吧！

lines.english: Oh, you kind of spicy yourself, you know.
lines.chinese: 哦，你自己也挺带劲的嘛。

lines.english: I am Ghost Pepper, are you ready to sweat?
lines.chinese: 我是幽灵辣椒，你准备好流汗了吗？

lines.english: I'm down with the savories, but burn those sours!
lines.chinese: 咸香味我喜欢，但那些酸味都该烧掉！

lines.english: Stop!
lines.chinese: 住手！

lines.english: Scorch you later, milk dipper!
lines.chinese: 回头再烤你，蘸奶的家伙！

lines.english: Yeah, the hottest of the flavor elementals: it's Spicy!
lines.chinese: 没错，风味元素里最火辣的那个：辣味登场！

lines.english: I wax, you wane.
lines.chinese: 我盈，而你亏。

lines.english: For a thousand years, I have protected my people from your people.
lines.chinese: 一千年来，我守护着我的族人，不受你们侵扰。

lines.english: Take your greed back to your Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 把你们的贪婪带回你们的大巴扎去。

lines.english: We saw you mining below, drilling your world full of holes.
lines.chinese: 我们看见你们在下方采矿，把自己的世界钻得千疮百孔。

lines.english: The moon is small. There is no room for your greed.
lines.chinese: 月亮很小，容不下你们的贪婪。

lines.english: Go back. The moon is not for you.
lines.chinese: 回去吧。月亮不属于你们。

lines.english: We looked down on pristine oceans and plains.
lines.chinese: 我们曾俯瞰纯净的海洋与平原。

lines.english: You are safe, my people. I remain at the gate.
lines.chinese: 我的族人们，你们安全了。我仍会守在门前。

lines.english: When we Moondwellers arrived, Great Disk was empty.
lines.chinese: 我们月居者到来时，伟大圆盘还是空无一物。

lines.english: We watched your city rise. We knew you would trouble us one day.
lines.chinese: 我们看着你们的城市崛起，也知道终有一天你们会来扰乱我们。

lines.english: Return to your cities and seas. Leave the moon in peace.
lines.chinese: 回到你们的城市和海洋去。让月亮安宁。

lines.english: You will not strip the moon of her treasures. Be gone.
lines.chinese: 你们休想掠尽月亮的珍宝。退下。

lines.english: The moon is pure. I cannot let you taint her with your chaos.
lines.chinese: 月亮纯净无瑕，我不能让你们的混乱玷污她。

lines.english: We are Moondwellers. This is our home.
lines.chinese: 我们是月居者。这里是我们的家。

lines.english: The Great Disk has all you need. Why must you plunder the heavens?
lines.chinese: 伟大圆盘已有你们所需的一切。为何还要掠夺天穹？

lines.english: Then your settlers came, your towers rose, and we worried.
lines.chinese: 后来你们的定居者来了，高塔拔地而起，我们开始忧心。

lines.english: My people knew you would come, so they sent me to meet you.
lines.chinese: 我的族人知道你们终会到来，所以派我来迎战。

lines.english: We only want peace! Why must you trouble us?
lines.chinese: 我们只想要安宁！为何非要来烦扰我们？

lines.english: A thousand years of Moonglow flows through me.
lines.chinese: 千年的月辉在我体内流淌。

lines.english: You have your city. You have the Outlands. Leave the moon in peace.
lines.chinese: 你们已有城市，也有荒原。让月亮安宁吧。

lines.english: This ain't the most glamorous place to live, but I'll go where the gold goes.
lines.chinese: 这地方住起来不算体面，但黄金在哪儿，我就去哪儿。

lines.english: Try scrounging the scrap fields, heh, might be more your budget.
lines.chinese: 去废料场翻翻吧，嘿，可能更合你的预算。

lines.english: I get it. You've never seen such a handsome guy. All right, stare all you want.
lines.chinese: 我懂，你从没见过这么英俊的家伙。行吧，想看就看。

lines.english: Poverty is a choice. Don't choose it somewhere else!
lines.chinese: 贫穷是一种选择。别在别的地方选它！

lines.english: They say there's a sucker born every minute. Around here, it's every second.
lines.chinese: 都说每分钟就有一个冤大头出生。在这儿，每秒都有。

lines.english: Well, didn't think you had the coin for it.
lines.chinese: 哎，我就知道你没那钱。

lines.english: Might as well paint my portrait while you're at it.
lines.chinese: 既然你看这么久，不如顺手给我画幅肖像。

lines.english: Finally! Someone with taste around here!
lines.chinese: 终于！这地方总算来了个有品位的人！

lines.english: That's a 24-karat decision, my friend!
lines.chinese: 这决定可是二十四K纯金的，朋友！

lines.english: How'd I get rich? Oh, you know. Investments.
lines.chinese: 我怎么发财的？哦，你懂的。投资。

lines.english: It's not overpriced, you're over-poor.
lines.chinese: 不是它太贵，是你太穷。

lines.english: Freya, Herma, they all want a piece of Goldie, but I keep my mind on the grind.
lines.chinese: 芙蕾雅、赫玛，她们都想分一杯戈尔迪的羹，可我心里只有搞钱。

lines.english: The Bazaar is a fat, juicy fly, just waiting to get tongued.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎就是只肥美多汁的苍蝇，就等着我伸舌头。

lines.english: There's two kinds of people: rich and stupid.
lines.chinese: 世上只有两种人：有钱的，和蠢的。

lines.english: You don't earn my respect, you buy it.
lines.chinese: 我的尊重不是挣来的，是买来的。

lines.english: You done with my portrait yet? Better get my abs right.
lines.chinese: 我的肖像画完没？腹肌可得画准。

lines.english: Silvia's got class, but no taste. Oh, that's silver.
lines.chinese: 西尔维娅有格调，可没眼光。哦，那只是银子。

lines.english: Of course the treasure's real! But don't touch it!
lines.chinese: 宝藏当然是真的！但别碰！

lines.english: My real name? You couldn't pronounce it. Goldie is just fine.
lines.chinese: 我的真名？你发不出来。叫我戈尔迪就好。

lines.english: I know people talk about me. Let them!
lines.chinese: 我知道大家都在议论我。随他们去！

lines.english: We doing business here or what?
lines.chinese: 我们到底做不做生意？

lines.english: Typical! All browse, no buy!
lines.chinese: 典型！光看不买！

lines.english: Luxe told me about you. You're one of the good ones.
lines.chinese: 路克斯跟我提过你。你还算靠谱。

lines.english: Luxe warned me about you.
lines.chinese: 路克斯警告过我要小心你。

lines.english: Ooh, you'd make a lovely statue.
lines.chinese: 哦，你会是一尊很美的雕像。

lines.english: Come to lay gold at my altar?
lines.chinese: 是来把黄金献到我的祭坛前吗？

lines.english: How dare you?
lines.chinese: 你怎么敢？

lines.english: Into my jaws, little mouse.
lines.chinese: 到我口中来吧，小老鼠。

lines.english: Have a taste of my venom!
lines.chinese: 尝尝我的毒液！

lines.english: Do you like my hair? It likes you.
lines.chinese: 喜欢我的头发吗？它也喜欢你。

lines.english: Well, aren't you a lovely piece of prey?
lines.chinese: 哎呀，真是可爱的猎物。

lines.english: Don't tread on me.
lines.chinese: 别踩到我头上。

lines.english: Gold? For me? Ah, you shouldn't have.
lines.chinese: 黄金？给我的？哎呀，太客气了。

lines.english: You beat me. I... kind of enjoyed it.
lines.chinese: 你打败了我。我……还有点享受。

lines.english: My snakes want to play.
lines.chinese: 我的蛇想玩一玩。

lines.english: How would you like to work for us?
lines.chinese: 有没有兴趣替我们做事？

lines.english: Who sent you, the cretin Harrow?
lines.chinese: 是谁派你来的，哈洛那个蠢货吗？

lines.english: Oh, did you think you had a chance?
lines.chinese: 哦，你以为自己有机会？

lines.english: I could use a strong arm like yours.
lines.chinese: 我正需要你这样的得力臂膀。

lines.english: A Gorgon always pays her debts.
lines.chinese: 戈尔贡一向有债必偿。

lines.english: Just try to enjoy it.
lines.chinese: 试着享受吧。

lines.english: Look into my eyes, little mouse.
lines.chinese: 看着我的眼睛，小老鼠。

lines.english: So, the mouse bites back.
lines.chinese: 原来小老鼠也会反咬。

lines.english: Go back to Harrow or Moo or whomever.
lines.chinese: 回哈洛、黑牛，或随便谁那儿去吧。

lines.english: You were right to strike me. I am a danger to all.
lines.chinese: 你打我是对的。我对所有人都是威胁。

lines.english: I must align our temporal frequencies. It should not be painful.
lines.chinese: 我必须校准我们的时间频率。应该不会疼。

lines.english: I have harmed you. Forgive me.
lines.chinese: 我伤了你。请原谅我。

lines.english: Find the old Tinker. Tell him I am here.
lines.chinese: 找到老叮当，告诉他我在这里。

lines.english: I was afraid, and I fled, but now I am lost.
lines.chinese: 我害怕，于是逃走了，可现在我迷失了。

lines.english: You are so still. Have I stopped your clock?
lines.chinese: 你一动不动。是我停住了你的时钟吗？

lines.english: Time can be slowed to a halt, motionless in this moment.
lines.chinese: 时间可以慢到停滞，在此刻凝为静止。

lines.english: Please, I do not understand what I am.
lines.chinese: 求你了，我不明白自己是什么。

lines.english: But the thing he found, it changed me.
lines.chinese: 可他找到的那个东西改变了我。

lines.english: Have you seen my creator? I do not know his name.
lines.chinese: 你见过我的创造者吗？我不知道他的名字。

lines.english: Ah, I see now. You are defending yourself.
lines.chinese: 啊，我明白了。你是在自卫。

lines.english: I called out the hour. I woke him from sleep.
lines.chinese: 我报出了时辰，把他从睡梦中唤醒。

lines.english: I meant you no harm. Please understand.
lines.chinese: 我无意伤害你。请你明白。

lines.english: There are dangerous things in this world, though some do not wish to be.
lines.chinese: 世上有些东西很危险，即使它们并不愿如此。

lines.english: The old Tinker. He built me for simple things.
lines.chinese: 老叮当。他造我本是为了简单的事。

lines.english: Who programmed my movements? I know not what I do.
lines.chinese: 是谁编写了我的动作？我不知道自己在做什么。

lines.english: The old Tinker. I need his help.
lines.chinese: 老叮当。我需要他的帮助。

lines.english: I mean no one harm, but harm keeps happening.
lines.chinese: 我不想伤害任何人，可伤害总在发生。

lines.english: The aethergy. The Foundation's soul became mine.
lines.chinese: 以太能。基底之魂成了我的灵魂。

lines.english: Why? Why do I harm those I wish to befriend?
lines.chinese: 为什么？为什么我总会伤害那些我想亲近的人？

lines.english: Actually, it doesn't matter. Any of them. All of them. Well, maybe not the kid.
lines.chinese: 其实无所谓。哪个都行，全都行。呃，也许孩子除外。

lines.english: I'm going to make a quick call. You, erm, will keep doing what you're doing.
lines.chinese: 我先打个简短电话。你，呃，继续做你在做的事。

lines.english: Yes, yes, and that's relevant how? Dabora, we need to talk about our arrangement.
lines.chinese: 是，是，那又有什么关系？达博拉，我们得谈谈我们的安排。

lines.english: You're just leaving?
lines.chinese: 你这就走了？

lines.english: Those Sphinxians may be flashy, and wise, and powerful, but they are not the Grandmaster!
lines.chinese: 那些斯芬克斯人也许耀眼、睿智又强大，但他们不是宗师！

lines.english: Yes, there are rumors that I'm a fraud. But do frauds have flying carpets?
lines.chinese: 是，有传言说我是骗子。可骗子会有飞毯吗？

lines.english: You've got the Grandmaster. Not Dabora, not Allin, Adira. The sparkly one.
lines.chinese: 你找的是宗师。不是达博拉，不是阿林，是艾迪拉。那个闪闪发光的。

lines.english: Do you not have any skills?
lines.chinese: 你难道一点技能都没有？

lines.english: I was teaching enlightenment long before those Sphinxians arrived. Original and best.
lines.chinese: 那些斯芬克斯人来之前，我早就在传授启迪了。正宗，最好。

lines.english: Dabora? It's Grandmaster calling about our... what? Okay.
lines.chinese: 达博拉？我是宗师，想谈谈我们的……什么？好吧。

lines.english: Oh, look at the time! See you next week, right?
lines.chinese: 哦，瞧瞧时间！下周见，对吧？

lines.english: But why, though?
lines.chinese: 可是为什么呢？

lines.english: You achieved great things today, whatever it is that you did.
lines.chinese: 你今天成就非凡，不管你到底做了什么。

lines.english: I can teach you any skill, as long as you already know it.
lines.chinese: 任何技能我都能教你，只要你已经会了。

lines.english: Of course I can help you! But only if you'll help yourself!
lines.chinese: 我当然能帮你！但前提是你要自助！

lines.english: Listen, I don't care how you do it. Make it up. I want a scandal. I want those cats gone.
lines.chinese: 听着，我不管你怎么做。编也要编出来。我要丑闻，我要那些猫消失。

lines.english: Perfect. Very, er, enlighten-ful.
lines.chinese: 完美。非常，呃，有启迪感。

lines.english: What do you mean you can't find any dirt? Do you expect me to believe they're perfect?
lines.chinese: 你说找不到黑料是什么意思？难道要我相信他们完美无缺？

lines.english: I'll help you master your skills if you're willing to do the work, like all the work.
lines.chinese: 只要你肯下功夫，我会帮你精通技艺。师傅领进门，修行在个人。

lines.english: Fantastic! Now I've got to run. Lunch appointment.
lines.chinese: 太好了！我得走了。午餐有约。

lines.english: Good, deep breaths now. One second. Getting a call.
lines.chinese: 很好，现在深呼吸。等一下，来电话了。

lines.english: Have I told you you're my favorite client? I mean, pupil.
lines.chinese: 我有没有说过你是我最喜欢的客户？我是说，学生。

lines.english: Ah yes, I have the truth you seek! Now, which truth were you seeking?
lines.chinese: 啊对，我掌握着你追寻的真理！那么，你追寻的是哪一种真理？

lines.english: Leave the Greenheart to its slumber.
lines.chinese: 让绿洲之心继续沉睡。

lines.english: I have failed, but Qomatz will not.
lines.chinese: 我失败了，但柯玛兹不会。

lines.english: Long years have passed since any could resist me.
lines.chinese: 已过漫长岁月，才有人能抵抗我。

lines.english: Your ancestors give you strength. You sit well.
lines.chinese: 你的祖先赐予你力量。你坐得很稳。

lines.english: If you have overcome me, perhaps you are worthy of the relics.
lines.chinese: 若你能战胜我，也许你配得上这些遗物。

lines.english: More like you shall come. I remain ready.
lines.chinese: 再来多少都一样。我随时准备着。

lines.english: Each leaves one behind to guard the memory.
lines.chinese: 每一族都会留下一人，守护记忆。

lines.english: MythKeeper, our relics are safe.
lines.chinese: 神话守护者，我们的遗物安然无恙。

lines.english: Go, and do not return.
lines.chinese: 走吧，别再回来。

lines.english: And there is one still greater than I. Beware, mighty Qomatz.
lines.chinese: 还有一位比我更强大。小心，强大的柯玛兹。

lines.english: You carry the soul sickness that ruined my people. Carry it back to yours.
lines.chinese: 你带着毁灭我族的灵魂疫病。把它带回你的族群去。

lines.english: Your own memory needs a guardian. Perhaps it is you.
lines.chinese: 你自己的记忆也需要守护者。或许就是你。

lines.english: Now they are gone, as we were gone.
lines.chinese: 如今他们也消逝了，如同我们曾经消逝。

lines.english: They worshipped us as gods, but we were merely people.
lines.chinese: 他们将我们奉为神明，可我们也只是凡人。

lines.english: The Greenheart shrouds the ancients. Return to your sands.
lines.chinese: 绿洲之心庇护着古民。回你的沙海去。

lines.english: My people were a memory when MythKeepers were born.
lines.chinese: 神话守护者诞生时，我的族人已成记忆。

lines.english: While I draw breath, you shall not plunder the Greenheart.
lines.chinese: 只要我尚有一息，你就休想掠夺绿洲之心。

lines.english: Your flesh shall feed the soil. Tree and vine shall spring from you.
lines.chinese: 你的血肉会滋养土壤，树木与藤蔓将从你身上生长。

lines.english: Be grateful. I have spared you the wrath of Qomatz.
lines.chinese: 感恩吧。我让你免受柯玛兹之怒。

lines.english: MythKeeper calls for my aid. I shall protect his secrets.
lines.chinese: 神话守护者召我相助。我会守护他的秘密。

lines.english: Say goodbye to your beloved dirt.
lines.chinese: 跟你心爱的泥土道别吧。

lines.english: To plunge into another's world, braving all horrors for gold.
lines.chinese: 为了黄金闯入他人的世界，冒着一切恐怖前行。

lines.english: Your ships sink to us like gifts from heaven. Such plunder.
lines.chinese: 你们的船沉到我们这里，就像天赐的礼物。多好的战利品。

lines.english: You survived. That's a first.
lines.chinese: 你活下来了。头一回见。

lines.english: Treasure is scarce, death is plentiful.
lines.chinese: 宝藏稀少，死亡管够。

lines.english: I could command the creatures not to eat you, but where's the fun in that?
lines.chinese: 我可以命令那些生物别吃你，可那还有什么乐趣？

lines.english: I don't hate Windweavers. I hate the arrogance that brings them to me.
lines.chinese: 我不恨织风者。我恨的是把他们送到我面前的傲慢。

lines.english: I will guide you down, but you may not come back up.
lines.chinese: 我会带你下去，但你未必还能上来。

lines.english: How long will you tread water? The deep awaits.
lines.chinese: 你还能踩水多久？深渊在等着。

lines.english: Get home to your dirt, then.
lines.chinese: 那就滚回你的泥地去。

lines.english: Do you see the great jaws opening up below us?
lines.chinese: 你看见下方那张巨口正在张开了吗？

lines.english: My guide rating is perfect, because no one has survived to review me.
lines.chinese: 我的向导评分完美无缺，因为没人活着给我差评。

lines.english: The real treasure is the courage you were forced to find.
lines.chinese: 真正的宝藏，是你被迫找出的勇气。

lines.english: You are foolish creatures, but you do amuse me.
lines.chinese: 你们真是愚蠢的生物，不过确实逗我开心。

lines.english: You have no idea what lies below.
lines.chinese: 你根本不知道下面有什么。

lines.english: Is it arrogance, or simply the madness of greed?
lines.chinese: 这是傲慢，还是贪婪带来的疯狂？

lines.english: You don't belong below, but I will take you.
lines.chinese: 你不属于下面，但我会带你去。

lines.english: All the spine of a jellyfish.
lines.chinese: 骨气跟水母一样。

lines.english: So, there is a spine in that strange body.
lines.chinese: 这么说，你那奇怪的身体里还真有点骨气。

lines.english: The pressure of the deep reveals your true self.
lines.chinese: 深海的压力会显露你的本性。

lines.english: Another Windweaver, come to challenge the deep.
lines.chinese: 又一个织风者，来挑战深渊。

lines.english: Another Windweaver, another watery grave.
lines.chinese: 又一个织风者，又一座水下坟墓。

lines.english: Deeper? You barely survived the shadows.
lines.chinese: 还想更深？你连暗影区都差点没活下来。

lines.english: Take a deep breath. It may be your last.
lines.chinese: 深吸一口气吧。这可能是最后一口。

lines.english: We shall measure your courage in fathoms.
lines.chinese: 我们会用英寻来丈量你的勇气。

lines.english: I will enjoy what happens next.
lines.chinese: 接下来发生的事，我会很享受。

lines.english: Ah, more coin! Now go be a high roller.
lines.chinese: 啊，更多硬币！去当个豪客吧。

lines.english: Big show for you tonight. Big show.
lines.chinese: 今晚给你上大戏。大戏。

lines.english: Easy, no grabbing. I'll get it for you, all right?
lines.chinese: 轻点，别抢。我会拿给你的，好吗？

lines.english: What? You don't believe that? Listen, buddy. I got my reasons.
lines.chinese: 什么？你不信？听着，伙计，我有我的理由。

lines.english: Now you'll win the Hammer game for sure.
lines.chinese: 现在你肯定能赢锤子游戏了。

lines.english: See? A little fun is good for your health!
lines.chinese: 瞧吧？找点乐子有益健康！

lines.english: Big winner, now even bigger!
lines.chinese: 大赢家，现在更大了！

lines.english: And look at that, a big boost for ya!
lines.chinese: 快看，给你来个大提升！

lines.english: Now take your coin and get out of here!
lines.chinese: 现在拿上你的硬币，赶紧走人！

lines.english: Look, buddy, we got people waiting here.
lines.chinese: 听着，伙计，后面还有人等着呢。

lines.english: Now, maybe you'll survive to spin again.
lines.chinese: 现在嘛，也许你能活到下次再转。

lines.english: Behold, the amazing living statue.
lines.chinese: 看哪，神奇的活雕像。

lines.english: What's in the hat? A rabbit, of course!
lines.chinese: 帽子里有什么？当然是兔子！

lines.english: Don't start asking me questions, all right? Got nothing for you.
lines.chinese: 别开始问我问题，好吗？我没什么可说的。

lines.english: Everyone's favorite jackpot!
lines.chinese: 人人最爱的头奖！

lines.english: On with the show, friend!
lines.chinese: 演出继续，朋友！

lines.english: Abracadabra, it's one of these things.
lines.chinese: 阿布拉卡达布拉，是这些东西之一。

lines.english: Try your luck. You can't lose.
lines.chinese: 试试手气吧。你不会输的。

lines.english: That'll put some pep in your step.
lines.chinese: 这会让你走路都有劲。

lines.english: And the spin is gold! Always a fine surprise.
lines.chinese: 转出来的是金色！永远是个好惊喜。

lines.english: Spin the wheel for the big reveal.
lines.chinese: 转动轮盘，揭晓大奖。

lines.english: Drum roll, please. Poof.
lines.chinese: 请来点鼓声。噗。

lines.english: Now get out of here and keep winning!
lines.chinese: 现在离开这儿，继续赢下去！

lines.english: Ace in the hole.
lines.chinese: 袖中王牌。

lines.english: Wait, you're not an Anaxian. Why didn't you say so?
lines.chinese: 等等，你不是阿纳克斯人。你怎么不早说？

lines.english: The Bazaar is a special place. We have to protect it from the hell we Anaxians created.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎是个特殊的地方。我们必须保护它，别让它变成我们阿纳克斯人造出的那种地狱。

lines.english: Did they send you? I can't go back to that... office.
lines.chinese: 是他们派你来的吗？我不能回那个……办公室。

lines.english: Trust me, ultralight's the way to go. If your gear's not carbon fiber, are you even camping?
lines.chinese: 相信我，超轻量才是正道。装备不是碳纤维的，还算露营吗？

lines.english: Tell the Lifestyle Enforcers I am never going back!
lines.chinese: 告诉生活方式执法者，我绝不回去！

lines.english: I don't ask much. I just want to live. But they'll never let me.
lines.chinese: 我要求不多。我只是想活着。可他们绝不会放过我。

lines.english: This is real living, right buddy? Right?
lines.chinese: 这才是真正的生活，对吧伙计？对吧？

lines.english: Ah, the great outdoors. No traffic, no bosses, no Lifestyle Enforcers, am I right?
lines.chinese: 啊，伟大的户外。没有交通，没有老板，没有生活方式执法者，对吧？

lines.english: Out here, the Lifestyle Enforcers can't hear you. Nobody can.
lines.chinese: 在这里，生活方式执法者听不见你。谁都听不见。

lines.english: Aww!
lines.chinese: 嗷！

lines.english: No such thing as bad weather, just bad gear.
lines.chinese: 没有坏天气，只有烂装备。

lines.english: You're not from the municipality, right? Right? Me neither, wink wink.
lines.chinese: 你不是市政当局的人，对吧？对吧？我也不是，眨眨眼。

lines.english: Go back to the municipality. Enjoy your Productivity Cube.
lines.chinese: 回市政区去吧。享受你的生产力方块。

lines.english: Please don't tell the municipality. They can't stand to lose a taxpayer.
lines.chinese: 请别告诉市政当局。他们可受不了少一个纳税人。

lines.english: Look around you, buddy. This is where we belong, not the Productivity Cube.
lines.chinese: 看看周围，伙计。这里才是我们该待的地方，不是生产力方块。

lines.english: If we go back now, they'll never let us leave. We'll spend our whole lives in the MegaCube under the LED sky!
lines.chinese: 要是现在回去，他们再也不会让我们离开。我们会在LED天空下的巨型方块里过完一辈子！

lines.english: You're trapped in the municipality, but I can show you how to get out.
lines.chinese: 你被困在市政区里，但我可以教你怎么逃出来。
