lines.english: Been out here a long time. I might have lost a few social skills.
lines.chinese: 我在外面待太久了。社交能力可能丢了点。

lines.english: Plenty of room in my camp for folks with an open mind.
lines.chinese: 我的营地很宽敞，欢迎思想开放的人。

lines.english: That's what happens when you wear cotton as a base layer.
lines.chinese: 贴身层穿棉布就是这个下场。

lines.english: I know they'll come for me. The municipality doesn't let go.
lines.chinese: 我知道他们会来抓我。市政当局从不放手。

lines.english: Hold really still, okay? This rocket doesn't aim.
lines.chinese: 站着别动，好吗？这火箭不会瞄准。

lines.english: For the Harkuvian dynasty!
lines.chinese: 为了哈库维王朝！

lines.english: I keep telling them fireworks aren't weapons!
lines.chinese: 我一直跟他们说烟花不是武器！

lines.english: I won! I-I mean, uh, for the Harkuvian dynasty!
lines.chinese: 我赢了！我、我是说，呃，为了哈库维王朝！

lines.english: I, uh... I actually got one!
lines.chinese: 我，呃……我居然打中了一个！

lines.english: I asked for weapons, and they gave me sparklers.
lines.chinese: 我要的是武器，他们给了我仙女棒。

lines.english: I can't really see these things!
lines.chinese: 我真的看不清这些东西！

lines.english: Next time, I'll just walk on the ground.
lines.chinese: 下次我还是在地上走吧。

lines.english: Can we make this quick? I hate flying.
lines.chinese: 能快点吗？我讨厌飞。

lines.english: Oh, at least I'm on the ground.
lines.chinese: 哦，至少我在地上了。

lines.english: Eat it!
lines.chinese: 吃我这招！

lines.english: Can I just have a normal gun?
lines.chinese: 能不能给我一把正常的枪？

lines.english: Oh, finally I can land!
lines.chinese: 哦，我终于能降落了！

lines.english: I really don't like this job.
lines.chinese: 我真的不喜欢这份工作。

lines.english: Oh, maybe the Harkuvians will start paying me now.
lines.chinese: 哦，也许哈库维人现在该给我发工资了。

lines.english: Starting to think rocket boots aren't good transportation.
lines.chinese: 我开始觉得火箭靴不是好交通工具了。

lines.english: I'll blast you sky-high, if me boots don't blow up.
lines.chinese: 只要我的靴子不爆，我就把你炸上天。

lines.english: Well, that's never happened before!
lines.chinese: 嗯，这以前可从没发生过！

lines.english: I hope you have Haste, so this can be over quickly!
lines.chinese: 希望你有加速，这样能快点结束！

lines.english: They say a rocket that doesn't crackle is no rocket at all!
lines.chinese: 他们说，不噼啪作响的火箭根本不算火箭！

lines.english: They say Harkuvians fight colorfully!
lines.chinese: 他们说哈库维人打起来花里胡哨！

lines.english: Ah, mesmerized by the flame. You're not the first.
lines.chinese: 啊，被火焰迷住了。你不是第一个。

lines.english: I see a spark in you. Let's make it a flame.
lines.chinese: 我看见你心中有火星。让它燃成火焰吧。

lines.english: Greetings.
lines.chinese: 幸会。

lines.english: May the first fire shine upon you.
lines.chinese: 愿初火照耀你。

lines.english: Come to learn the way of flame?
lines.chinese: 是来学习火焰之道的吗？

lines.english: I often spend hours just gazing into its heart, warming my weary eyes.
lines.chinese: 我常常花上数小时凝视火焰的核心，温暖我疲惫的双眼。

lines.english: But now that I've mastered it, I sometimes wonder if I've missed anything.
lines.chinese: 可如今我已掌握火焰，有时也会想自己是否错过了什么。

lines.english: That Frostling, though, Freya, she does give me a shiver.
lines.chinese: 不过那个霜灵，芙蕾雅，她确实让我打寒战。

lines.english: I gave my whole life to the flame. Nothing else mattered to me.
lines.chinese: 我把一生都献给了火焰。其他一切都不重要。

lines.english: Friendship, romance, none of it glowed like the flame.
lines.chinese: 友情、爱情，没有一样像火焰那样发光。

lines.english: I've had romance with fellow Emberweavers. I only end up getting burned.
lines.chinese: 我也和别的织焰者谈过情，最后只落得被灼伤。

lines.english: Don't burn yourself, burn others.
lines.chinese: 别烧到自己，去烧别人。

lines.english: It's wise not to rush the flames.
lines.chinese: 不急着催旺火焰，才是明智。

lines.english: Careful with that, it's quite hot.
lines.chinese: 小心那个，很烫。

lines.english: Fire blackens. But it also illuminates. Which will you ask of it?
lines.chinese: 火会熏黑万物，也会照亮万物。你要向它索取哪一种？

lines.english: Farewell.
lines.chinese: 告辞。

lines.english: There's a little fire in everyone. I can make it hotter.
lines.chinese: 每个人心里都有一点火。我能让它更炽热。

lines.english: I'll keep them burning until you return.
lines.chinese: 我会让它们一直燃烧，直到你回来。

lines.english: Fire is wisdom. Be wise with it.
lines.chinese: 火焰即智慧。要明智地使用它。

lines.english: Fire destroys, but it also creates. Consider the sun.
lines.chinese: 火会毁灭，也会创造。想想太阳吧。

lines.english: Fire's not for everyone. Perhaps you're more of a Frostling.
lines.chinese: 火焰不适合所有人。也许你更像霜灵。

lines.english: I said the flame trance can be dangerous. Can you hear me, friend?
lines.chinese: 我说过火焰恍惚很危险。朋友，你听得见吗？

lines.english: You've taken another step on the way of flame.
lines.chinese: 你在火焰之道上又迈出了一步。

lines.english: Perhaps you'd be more interested in Freya's wares.
lines.chinese: 也许你会对芙蕾雅的货更感兴趣。

lines.english: Oh dear, I may have lost another one.
lines.chinese: 哎呀，我可能又弄丢一个人了。

lines.english: I said hours, but sometimes it's days. The flame trance can be dangerous.
lines.chinese: 我说是数小时，但有时会是数天。火焰恍惚很危险。

lines.english: Perhaps you need to cool off a while.
lines.chinese: 也许你需要冷静一会儿。

lines.english: You best keep moving, fancy britches!
lines.chinese: 你最好继续走，花裤衩！

lines.english: We ain't buyin' what you're sellin', city slick!
lines.chinese: 你卖的东西我们不买，城里滑头！

lines.english: Folks like you move in, prices start going up.
lines.chinese: 你们这种人一搬来，物价就开始涨。

lines.english: Deadgrassers remember. You gon' meet my cousins.
lines.chinese: 枯草地的人记性好。你会见到我那些表亲的。

lines.english: Ah, you gold-praying skeewaller!
lines.chinese: 啊，你这个拜金的混账！

lines.english: Or maybe City Slick and a Big Knife.
lines.chinese: 或者叫《城里滑头和大刀子》。

lines.english: Oh, when we're done, I'm gonna write a song about you.
lines.chinese: 哦，等咱们完事，我要给你写首歌。

lines.english: Go back to the Bazaar! The Deadgrass is ours!
lines.chinese: 滚回大巴扎去！枯草地是我们的！

lines.english: I can play you the ganjo, or I can play you the knife. Your choice.
lines.chinese: 我可以给你弹甘乔琴，也可以给你耍刀。你选。

lines.english: Bazaar folks strutting around like you own the Outlands. Now get!
lines.chinese: 大巴扎人趾高气扬，好像荒原是你们家的一样。快滚！

lines.english: You bring your city ways to the Deadgrass. I'll show you where to stick them.
lines.chinese: 你把城里那套带到枯草地来，我会教你该往哪儿塞。

lines.english: Oh, you're gonna squeal like a spriggin' hay-trap!
lines.chinese: 哦，你会叫得像只踩进草夹子的蠢货！

lines.english: Your kind ain't wanted out here! Now get!
lines.chinese: 这里不欢迎你们这种人！快滚！

lines.english: Gonna call it, City Slick Ain't Going Home!
lines.chinese: 这首就叫《城里滑头回不了家》！

lines.english: Now that that's settled, how about a little pickin'?
lines.chinese: 既然事儿解决了，来段拨弦怎么样？

lines.english: One of them, what you call, ballads.
lines.chinese: 就是那种，你们叫民谣的东西。

lines.english: Whew, gotta end it, do ya? That was a mighty fine tussling.
lines.chinese: 呼，非得结束吗？这场架打得真带劲。

lines.english: Now you get on out of here, sparkle boots!
lines.chinese: 现在你给我滚出去，亮靴子！

lines.english: Gonna be a real sad song.
lines.chinese: 这会是一首真伤心的歌。

lines.english: You came to the wrong Outland, stranger.
lines.chinese: 你来错荒原了，陌生人。

lines.english: I'm gonna rub this stuff on you. Don't make it weird.
lines.chinese: 我要把这东西抹到你身上。别搞得怪怪的。

lines.english: Why do my people live in forests? The city's where the wounds are!
lines.chinese: 我的族人为什么要住在森林里？城市里才有伤口啊！

lines.english: The more you get hurt, the more we can hang out!
lines.chinese: 你伤得越多，我们就越能见面！

lines.english: So yeah, the Fenari come from an enchanted woodland or whatever, but it's pretty lame.
lines.chinese: 所以嘛，费纳里人来自什么魔法林地之类的地方，但那儿挺无聊的。

lines.english: Feel better!
lines.chinese: 好点吧！

lines.english: Hey! Good to see ya!
lines.chinese: 嘿！见到你真好！

lines.english: Hiya!
lines.chinese: 嗨呀！

lines.english: You look rough, man. Let's fix you up.
lines.chinese: 你看起来糟透了，朋友。来给你处理一下。

lines.english: I'd heal you for free, but the rent on this shop, sheesh!
lines.chinese: 我倒想免费给你治，可这店租，啧！

lines.english: Oh, you just want to hang out? Sure, we can chat while I grind these herbs.
lines.chinese: 哦，你只是想待一会儿？当然，我磨草药的时候可以聊聊。

lines.english: So like, that Colt guy's pretty hot, right? I don't even like guns, but shoot!
lines.chinese: 话说，那个寇特挺辣的，对吧？我都不喜欢枪，可真要命！

lines.english: I hate to charge so much, but I'm saving for my next tattoo.
lines.chinese: 我也不想收这么贵，但我在攒钱做下一个纹身。

lines.english: Are you sure? You're kind of bleeding.
lines.chinese: 你确定吗？你有点在流血。

lines.english: You're not getting hurt on purpose just to come see me, are you?
lines.chinese: 你不是故意受伤，好来见我吧？

lines.english: Look, it's okay to have a crush on me. I love everyone.
lines.chinese: 听着，喜欢我没关系。我爱所有人。

lines.english: I came to the Bazaar because this is the real world. Dirty and bloody.
lines.chinese: 我来大巴扎，是因为这里才是真实世界。肮脏，又血淋淋。

lines.english: Hey, you okay? Kinda glazing over there.
lines.chinese: 嘿，你还好吗？你眼神有点发直。

lines.english: I know that look. You're in one of Kina's potions, aren't you?
lines.chinese: 我认得那种表情。你喝了吉娜的药水，对吧？

lines.english: Like, what's the point of being a healer in a place where nobody gets hurt?
lines.chinese: 要是在没人受伤的地方当治疗者，那有什么意义？

lines.english: Try not to almost die every day.
lines.chinese: 尽量别每天都差点死掉。

lines.english: Just be careful, okay? I kinda like you.
lines.chinese: 小心点，好吗？我还挺喜欢你的。

lines.english: Might leave a scar, but nothing a tattoo won't cover.
lines.chinese: 可能会留疤，不过纹身都能盖住。

lines.english: This place is pretty crazy. Hope you can handle yourself.
lines.chinese: 这地方挺疯的。希望你能照顾好自己。

lines.english: It's cool, we can just hang out until you're... ready.
lines.chinese: 没事，我们可以先待着，等你……准备好。

lines.english: Malafang's like, everything I'm against, but he's kinda... Hey man, are you good? Should I call somebody?
lines.chinese: 玛拉方简直跟我的理念完全相反，不过他又有点……嘿，朋友，你还好吗？要我叫人吗？

lines.english: I feel like I matter here, and I get to meet weirdos like you.
lines.chinese: 我觉得自己在这里有价值，还能认识你这样的怪人。

lines.english: Got any new playlists for me? Feel the tunes, heal the wounds.
lines.chinese: 有新歌单给我吗？感受旋律，治愈伤口。

lines.english: Step to me, jokes fam!
lines.chinese: 来跟我比划比划，笑话人！

lines.english: Hey, what ends you from?
lines.chinese: 嘿，你混哪片的？

lines.english: Boss Harrow, don't vex the big man ting.
lines.chinese: 哈洛老大，不该惹大人物。

lines.english: We from the Ends, blood! Wah!
lines.chinese: 我们是街区来的，兄弟！哇！

lines.english: You come to these ends with that gold, you're tapped, bruv.
lines.chinese: 你带着那点金子来这片，脑子坏了吧，兄弟。

lines.english: Hey, hey, hey! Just let me go, yeah?
lines.chinese: 嘿嘿嘿！放我走，行吧？

lines.english: Give up the gold, bruv!
lines.chinese: 把金子交出来，兄弟！

lines.english: Bare safe weapons, blood. Hand them over, innit?
lines.chinese: 好多趁手武器啊，兄弟。交出来，懂吧？

lines.english: You look like River District, blood. Bare moist!
lines.chinese: 你看着像河区来的，兄弟。湿气太重！

lines.english: Thieves' Guild? Nah, they dry, bruv!
lines.chinese: 盗贼公会？不，他们太没劲了，兄弟！

lines.english: Nah, no chance! You's clapped, blood!
lines.chinese: 不，没门！你完了，兄弟！

lines.english: We from Ends Blood! We don't need him!
lines.chinese: 我们是街血帮！不需要他！

lines.english: Hey, allow it! You probably ain't even got nothing!
lines.chinese: 嘿，算了吧！你身上可能啥也没有！

lines.english: Them's loud gums, fam. Hoo hoo, gonna need a mouthguard.
lines.chinese: 你嘴挺响啊，朋友。呵呵，得给你配个护齿了。

lines.english: Aye! What you sayin', wasteman?
lines.chinese: 喂！你说什么呢，废物？

lines.english: Bruv! That ruckus got me gassed, fam!
lines.chinese: 兄弟！这场面让我太兴奋了！

lines.english: I'll go get me Mandy and make you regret it, blood.
lines.chinese: 我去叫曼迪来，让你后悔，兄弟。

lines.english: Ow! Ow! This ain't worth all that!
lines.chinese: 嗷！嗷！这可不值当！

lines.english: You're vexing me, bruv!
lines.chinese: 你惹毛我了，兄弟！

lines.english: Ain't personal, fam. It's rough town!
lines.chinese: 不是针对你，朋友。这城就是这么硬！

lines.english: The Infernal continues!
lines.chinese: 炼狱永不停息！

lines.english: Strength will not save you!
lines.chinese: 力量救不了你！

lines.english: Meaningless! All of this will burn!
lines.chinese: 毫无意义！这一切都将燃烧！

lines.english: Welcome to defeat!
lines.chinese: 迎接失败吧！

lines.english: Ah, there is so much we can offer you!
lines.chinese: 啊，我们能赐予你的太多了！

lines.english: This world is his to devour!
lines.chinese: 这个世界注定被他吞噬！

lines.english: From the flame of every candle, we watch you.
lines.chinese: 每一支烛火里，都有我们注视着你。

lines.english: You have made your decision and sealed your fate.
lines.chinese: 你已经作出选择，也封死了自己的命运。

lines.english: Why fight the inevitable?
lines.chinese: 何必抗拒必然之事？

lines.english: Eternity is fire. Join us in it.
lines.chinese: 永恒即火焰。加入我们吧。

lines.english: His flame is never quenched.
lines.chinese: 他的火焰永不熄灭。

lines.english: Defy the Infernal! Suffer the punishment!
lines.chinese: 违抗炼狱！承受惩罚！

lines.english: You could have had everything. Now you have only pain.
lines.chinese: 你本可拥有一切。如今你只剩痛苦。

lines.english: My flame is his flame!
lines.chinese: 我的火焰就是他的火焰！

lines.english: The Inferno will not be denied.
lines.chinese: 炼狱不容拒绝。

lines.english: It's pointless to resist our master.
lines.chinese: 反抗我们的主人毫无意义。

lines.english: Watch the shadows, mortal!
lines.chinese: 小心阴影，凡人！

lines.english: We offer you a chance to outlive this world.
lines.chinese: 我们给你一个机会，让你活过这个世界。

lines.english: Feel the master's wrath!
lines.chinese: 感受主人的怒火！

lines.english: Whatever you seek can be yours.
lines.chinese: 无论你追寻什么，都可以属于你。

lines.english: How sad to resist me!
lines.chinese: 抗拒我，何其可悲！

lines.english: I am endless fire. Unquenchable.
lines.chinese: 我是无尽之火，永不熄灭。

lines.english: This is but a spark of my true power.
lines.chinese: 这不过是我真正力量的一点火星。

lines.english: You could have been my envoy.
lines.chinese: 你本可以成为我的使者。

lines.english: You have defeated nothing! I am eternal!
lines.chinese: 你什么也没击败！我是永恒的！

lines.english: Your world will burn.
lines.chinese: 你的世界将会燃烧。

lines.english: Serve me and learn true power.
lines.chinese: 侍奉我，学习真正的力量。

lines.english: I'll burn your world for that!
lines.chinese: 为此，我要烧尽你的世界！

lines.english: Your soul is mine to devour.
lines.chinese: 你的灵魂归我吞噬。

lines.english: Enjoy this moment. You have few left.
lines.chinese: 享受这一刻吧。你剩下的时日不多了。

lines.english: All who defy me are ashes.
lines.chinese: 所有违抗我的人都将成灰。

lines.english: Become my envoy.
lines.chinese: 成为我的使者。

lines.english: I can use you, or consume you.
lines.chinese: 我可以利用你，也可以吞噬你。

lines.english: I will rule the ashes.
lines.chinese: 我将统治灰烬。

lines.english: Is that truly the best of you?
lines.chinese: 这真是你的全力吗？

lines.english: You know I will return!
lines.chinese: 你知道我终会归来！

lines.english: Only a fool rejects my offer.
lines.chinese: 只有蠢人才会拒绝我的恩赐。

lines.english: Blasphemy!
lines.chinese: 亵渎！

lines.english: More food for my hunger.
lines.chinese: 又有食粮来填我的饥饿。

lines.english: Do you have to leave already?
lines.chinese: 你这么快就要走了吗？

lines.english: Come on in! Let's chat!
lines.chinese: 进来吧！我们聊聊！

lines.english: Any big fights lately? Treasure? Adventure? Tell me all about it!
lines.chinese: 最近有什么大战吗？宝藏？冒险？全都讲给我听！

lines.english: Hmm, maybe I should lower my prices.
lines.chinese: 嗯，也许我该降点价。

lines.english: Happy to make a sale. Sad to say goodbye.
lines.chinese: 做成买卖很开心，道别又有点难过。

lines.english: Running a business is more relaxing when you don't care if it succeeds.
lines.chinese: 要是不在乎生意成不成功，做买卖就轻松多了。

lines.english: Well, if my shop fails, I'll find another way to make friends. Maybe panhandling?
lines.chinese: 嗯，要是我的店倒了，我就换种方式交朋友。也许去乞讨？

lines.english: People first, profit tenth.
lines.chinese: 人情第一，利润第十。

lines.english: I am a no-pressure salesman. Let's just hang out.
lines.chinese: 我是无压力销售员。我们就随便待会儿吧。

lines.english: So, how are you?
lines.chinese: 所以，你最近怎么样？

lines.english: The Bazaar can be a cold place. I try to warm it up.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎有时很冷漠。我想让它暖一点。

lines.english: That's okay! It was nice to see you!
lines.chinese: 没关系！见到你很高兴！

lines.english: Maybe if I got better goods.
lines.chinese: 也许我该进点更好的货。

lines.english: Do you have a question? About me, perhaps.
lines.chinese: 你有问题吗？比如关于我的。

lines.english: Do you have any questions? About my goods or just life?
lines.chinese: 你有什么问题吗？关于我的货，或者关于人生？

lines.english: So, how about this weather we're... Oh, oh, you're leaving. That's good.
lines.chinese: 那么，这天气真是……哦，哦，你要走了。挺好。

lines.english: Well, there's more to me than my wares, you know. I also enjoy hiking, getting out in the air.
lines.chinese: 你知道，我可不只有货物。我也喜欢徒步，出去透透气。

lines.english: Now, if that doesn't work out for you, come back for a refund.
lines.chinese: 要是用着不合适，就回来退款。

lines.english: I'm a people person, and sometimes I sell stuff.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢和人打交道，偶尔也卖点东西。

lines.english: Maybe I'm not cut out for business.
lines.chinese: 也许我不适合做生意。

lines.english: Ah, a friend! I mean, a customer!
lines.chinese: 啊，朋友！我是说，顾客！

lines.english: Buy, don't buy, as long as we get to hang out.
lines.chinese: 买不买都行，只要我们能待一会儿。

lines.english: I get it. You're busy. Enjoy your purchase.
lines.chinese: 我懂，你很忙。祝你用得开心。

lines.english: The Bazaar's a crazy place, right?
lines.chinese: 大巴扎真是个疯狂的地方，对吧？

lines.english: Hey, take your time. I'm in no hurry.
lines.chinese: 嘿，慢慢来。我不着急。

lines.english: Welcome, dear guest. Stay a while.
lines.chinese: 欢迎，亲爱的客人。多留一会儿吧。

lines.english: Mm-hmm!
lines.chinese: 嗯哼！

lines.english: I do believe it's harvest time.
lines.chinese: 我确信，收获时节到了。

lines.english: I taught poison oak everything it knows.
lines.chinese: 毒橡树那点本事全是我教的。

lines.english: Have a slice of pumpkin pie!
lines.chinese: 来一块南瓜派吧！

lines.english: I didn't think this was possible!
lines.chinese: 我没想到这竟然可能！

lines.english: Eat my spores!
lines.chinese: 吃我的孢子！

lines.english: You're a thorn in my side!
lines.chinese: 你真是我的眼中钉！

lines.english: Back to the patch for me, it seems.
lines.chinese: 看来我得回瓜田了。

lines.english: You got me, stem and all!
lines.chinese: 你把我连茎都拿下了！

lines.english: Aren't I just noxious?
lines.chinese: 我是不是毒得可爱？

lines.english: Come to steal my potions, filthy beast!
lines.chinese: 来偷我的药水吗，肮脏野兽！

lines.english: My creator will be pleased!
lines.chinese: 我的创造者会高兴的！

lines.english: Oh, are you allergic to majesty?
lines.chinese: 哦，你对威严过敏吗？

lines.english: I'm feeling... festive.
lines.chinese: 我感觉……很有节日气氛。

lines.english: Not many come here, even fewer leave.
lines.chinese: 来这里的人不多，能离开的更少。

lines.english: I've been smashed!
lines.chinese: 我被砸烂了！

lines.english: A visitor! How delicious!
lines.chinese: 有客人！多么美味！

lines.english: I'm a master alchemist's masterpiece.
lines.chinese: 我是炼金大师的杰作。

lines.english: Compost I am not.
lines.chinese: 我可不是堆肥。

lines.english: The audacity!
lines.chinese: 好大的胆子！

lines.english: For my father, for my daughter, I will make our new life delicious.
lines.chinese: 为了父亲，为了女儿，我会把我们的新生活做得有滋有味。

lines.english: Azaka was a world of quakes and volcanoes. No one was ever safe.
lines.chinese: 阿扎卡是个充满地震与火山的世界。没人真正安全。

lines.english: Well, aren't you saucy?
lines.chinese: 哎呀，你还挺有滋味。

lines.english: I have two careers and a daughter. I don't really do downtime.
lines.chinese: 我有两份事业和一个女儿。闲暇这东西我真不熟。

lines.english: Must be nice to have time to do nothing.
lines.chinese: 有时间无所事事，想必很不错吧。

lines.english: You poor thing. Have a cookie.
lines.chinese: 可怜的小家伙。吃块饼干吧。

lines.english: Do you know how hard it was to get a babysitter? Let's go!
lines.chinese: 你知道找个保姆有多难吗？开打吧！

lines.english: My father brought my people to safety by making a deal with the Infernal.
lines.chinese: 我父亲与地狱做了交易，才把我的族人带到安全之地。

lines.english: Tell the babysitter I might be running late.
lines.chinese: 告诉保姆，我可能会晚点回去。

lines.english: Room for a sumptuous spread.
lines.chinese: 给丰盛大餐腾出位置。

lines.english: Please don't make me wait. I'm not your waiter.
lines.chinese: 请别让我等。我可不是你的服务员。

lines.english: I may never know what he sacrificed, but I work each day to make it worthwhile.
lines.chinese: 我也许永远不会知道他牺牲了什么，但我每天都努力让这一切值得。

lines.english: Honestly, I don't need any of this. I'm doing it for Laurel.
lines.chinese: 说实话，我不需要这些。我是为了劳蕾尔。

lines.english: Look at this mess! Oh, embarrassing!
lines.chinese: 看看这烂摊子！哦，真丢脸！

lines.english: Uh, sorry. Did I catch you in the middle of dinner?
lines.chinese: 呃，抱歉。我是不是打扰你吃饭了？

lines.english: Let's make this quick. I have something in the oven.
lines.chinese: 速战速决吧。我烤箱里还有东西。

lines.english: I must have a word with my accountant.
lines.chinese: 我得跟我的会计谈谈。

lines.english: Now that's professional grade!
lines.chinese: 这才是专业级别！

lines.english: That violence spread to the people. War and brutality were the soup of the day.
lines.chinese: 那种暴力蔓延到人民之间。战争与残暴成了每日例汤。

lines.english: I'll make you dinner. You'll be delicious.
lines.chinese: 我会把你做成晚餐。你会很美味。

lines.english: A hunter's greatest skill is patience.
lines.chinese: 猎人最重要的本领是耐心。

lines.english: I crafted that one myself, out of... leftovers.
lines.chinese: 那个是我亲手做的，用的是……剩料。

lines.english: My first memory is death, the wreckage of their ship, their bodies all around me.
lines.chinese: 我最早的记忆就是死亡：他们的船骸，以及我身边遍地的尸体。

lines.english: Bows, blades, bullets, and beams. More than one way to skin an Inglet.
lines.chinese: 弓、刃、子弹、光束。剥英格莱特的皮不止一种办法。

lines.english: Meat, pelts, and the tools to hunt them.
lines.chinese: 肉、皮，还有猎取它们的工具。

lines.english: Purchase cheap, purchase broke. Sorry, something in my throat.
lines.chinese: 买得便宜，坏得也快。抱歉，嗓子里有点东西。

lines.english: Good luck out there, fellow hunter.
lines.chinese: 祝你好运，猎人同伴。

lines.english: My parents weren't my parents. They found me as a baby alone in the Outlands of a world called the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 我的父母并非亲生父母。他们在一个叫大巴扎的世界的荒原里，发现了还是婴儿、独自一人的我。

lines.english: Ten years in the wild. When the tradeship found me, I was barely human. If I even am human.
lines.chinese: 在荒野里十年。商船发现我时，我几乎不像人了。若我真的算人。

lines.english: That's a fine piece. Don't mind the stains.
lines.chinese: 这是件好货。别在意那些污渍。

lines.english: You still haven't talked to bears with that. It usually works.
lines.chinese: 你还没用它跟熊谈过吧。通常挺管用。

lines.english: The weapon doesn't make the hunter, but it helps.
lines.chinese: 武器不能造就猎人，但确实有帮助。

lines.english: This was my life: roaming the galaxy, hunting monsters, and trying to hide my own. Hello!
lines.chinese: 这就是我的人生：游荡银河，猎杀怪物，同时试着藏起我自己的怪物。你好！

lines.english: I was a child, alone on a savage planet, but for some reason I refused to die.
lines.chinese: 我那时只是个孩子，独自在野蛮星球上，可不知为何就是不肯死。

lines.english: I respect that. A good hunter crafts his own weapons.
lines.chinese: 我敬重这一点。好猎人会打造自己的武器。

lines.english: I'd suggest sticking to small game.
lines.chinese: 我建议你先从小猎物开始。

lines.english: I mastered that forest and its beasts, learned to hunt before I learned to talk.
lines.chinese: 我征服了那片森林和其中的野兽，学会说话前就学会了狩猎。

lines.english: Anyone who got close to me got hurt, so I stopped letting them. Preacher, just won't play!
lines.chinese: 凡是靠近我的人都会受伤，所以我不再让人靠近。说教者，不会陪你玩！

lines.english: We must outlast the prey: silent, vigilant.
lines.chinese: 我们必须比猎物更能熬：沉默，警醒。

lines.english: Because I didn't survive that place alone. I had my... imaginary friend. Hello.
lines.chinese: 因为我不是独自从那地方活下来的。我有我的……想象朋友。你好。

lines.english: If that doesn't do the job, hire me too.
lines.chinese: 要是那东西还不够，也可以雇我。

lines.english: But then I finally went back, searched the wreckage, found the logs that changed everything.
lines.chinese: 后来我终于回去了，搜遍残骸，找到了改变一切的日志。

lines.english: Sometimes I hunt with my bare hands, but you probably shouldn't.
lines.chinese: 有时我徒手狩猎，但你最好别学。

lines.english: Stillness. Stoicism. These are the hunters. No more stoicism! Lead! Kill!
lines.chinese: 静止，克制，这才是猎人。不准再克制！冲！杀！

lines.english: Here for my weapons or my services?
lines.chinese: 你是来买我的武器，还是雇我的服务？

lines.english: The traders brought me to an orphanage, tried to give me a normal life, but normal was never on my map.
lines.chinese: 商人们把我带到孤儿院，想给我正常生活，可我的地图上从来没有正常两字。

lines.english: I'll take gold, but what I need is information.
lines.chinese: 我收黄金，但我真正需要的是情报。

lines.english: That'll serve you well. It certainly did me.
lines.chinese: 它会帮上你的忙。至少它帮过我。

lines.english: Sometimes I remember all those pretty people and fancy parties, and I try not to throw up.
lines.chinese: 有时我想起那些漂亮人物和奢华派对，就努力忍住不吐。

lines.english: You're not on Taigen anymore, big man. The Bazaar is a different beast.
lines.chinese: 你已经不在泰根了，大个子。大巴扎是另一头野兽。

lines.english: People like us? This is where we belong. Out here, under the stars.
lines.chinese: 像我们这样的人？这里才是归宿。在外面，在星空下。

lines.english: Twenty years of parties, clubs, trying so hard to squeeze meaning out of nothing. I snapped.
lines.chinese: 二十年的派对和俱乐部，拼命想从虚无里榨出意义。我崩断了。

lines.english: Most days I like my solitude, but I like this too.
lines.chinese: 大多数时候我喜欢独处，但这样也不错。

lines.english: It gets lonely sometimes, but at least I've still got my soul and the occasional handsome visitor.
lines.chinese: 有时会孤单，但至少我还留着灵魂，偶尔还有英俊访客。

lines.english: Well, if you ever need me, I'm here.
lines.chinese: 好吧，如果你需要我，我就在这儿。

lines.english: You can't trust anyone in the Bazaar. Trust me.
lines.chinese: 在大巴扎里谁都不能信。相信我。

lines.english: The only place more dangerous than the Outlands is the city.
lines.chinese: 唯一比荒原更危险的地方，就是城市。

lines.english: You already learned those techniques? Alright. How about these?
lines.chinese: 那些技巧你已经学会了？好吧，那这些呢？

lines.english: When you're from a founder family, everyone's your friend. But that means no one is.
lines.chinese: 出身创始家族时，人人都是你的朋友。可那也意味着没人真是。

lines.english: I can handle a little danger, Karnok. Even yours.
lines.chinese: 一点危险我应付得来，卡诺克。就算是你的也一样。

lines.english: Big man knows everything, huh? I doubt it.
lines.chinese: 大个子什么都懂，是吧？我可不信。

lines.english: That's enough training for today. Let's enjoy the silence.
lines.chinese: 今天训练够了。享受一下安静吧。

lines.english: I wasn't always like this, you know? I used to be a pretty little socialite.
lines.chinese: 我以前不是这样的，你知道吗？我曾是个漂亮的小社交名媛。

lines.english: Sure, bows and knives work for most game, but let's see you hunt a trash golem.
lines.chinese: 当然，弓和刀能对付大多数猎物，但你试试用它们猎垃圾魔像。

lines.english: Oh, so you just came for my company. I'm blushing, Karnok.
lines.chinese: 哦，所以你只是来陪我的。我要脸红了，卡诺克。

lines.english: You may know everything about hunting, but what you don't know is the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 你也许懂狩猎的一切，但你不了解大巴扎。

lines.english: Well, big man, if your answers are here, I'll help you find them.
lines.chinese: 好吧，大个子，如果答案在这里，我会帮你找到。

lines.english: Look at those stars. Can't even see them in the city.
lines.chinese: 看看那些星星。在城里根本看不见。

lines.english: Hunting in the city is a whole different game. Don't fall into your own traps.
lines.chinese: 在城市里狩猎完全是另一套游戏。别掉进自己的陷阱。

lines.english: No two hunts are alike. You need to stay flexible, like a bowstring.
lines.chinese: 没有两场狩猎是一样的。你得像弓弦一样灵活。

lines.english: You're used to hunting in places that make sense. The Outlands, they're a fever dream.
lines.chinese: 你习惯在讲道理的地方狩猎。荒原可是一场热病梦。

lines.english: This isn't Taigen, Karnok. The Bazaar plays by its own rules.
lines.chinese: 这里不是泰根，卡诺克。大巴扎按自己的规则运转。

lines.english: So, if I ever meet this... creature, you really think he'd hurt me?
lines.chinese: 那么，如果我真见到这个……生物，你真觉得他会伤害我？

lines.english: Twelve years now I've been out here, just me and the trees and the animals.
lines.chinese: 我在这里已经十二年了，只有我、树和动物。

lines.english: The folks who raised you, they really found you here in the Outlands?
lines.chinese: 养大你的那些人，真的在这片荒原找到你的吗？

lines.english: Nature's different on the Foundation. It's unpredictable.
lines.chinese: 基底上的自然不一样。它不可预测。

lines.english: What works in the desert won't work in the forest. Same goes for planets.
lines.chinese: 沙漠里管用的东西，森林里未必管用。星球也是一样。

lines.english: Hunt better, live longer, figure your damn self out.
lines.chinese: 狩猎得更好，活得更久，然后把你自己搞明白。

lines.english: The people here look so... vulnerable.
lines.chinese: 这里的人看起来好……脆弱。

lines.english: No armor? You're so brave.
lines.chinese: 不穿护甲？你真勇敢。

lines.english: Sometimes, I sleep under a pile of shields. I like to feel safe.
lines.chinese: 有时候我睡在一堆盾牌下面。我喜欢有安全感。

lines.english: Don't have scales? I can forge some for ya!
lines.chinese: 没有鳞甲？我可以给你打一套！

lines.english: We Ankerlons know some tricks to staying alive.
lines.chinese: 我们安克隆人有些保命诀窍。

lines.english: Are you sure? You're very... soft.
lines.chinese: 你确定吗？你非常……柔软。

lines.english: It feels good to be safe, doesn't it?
lines.chinese: 安全的感觉很好，对吧？

lines.english: People say my armor's the best, but I'll keep working on it.
lines.chinese: 大家都说我的护甲最好，但我还会继续改进。

lines.english: I just want to do my work in peace, and not get eaten.
lines.chinese: 我只想安安静静工作，别被吃掉。

lines.english: You're not trying to hurt me, are you?
lines.chinese: 你不是想伤害我吧？

lines.english: Ah, now I worry about you a little less.
lines.chinese: 啊，现在我稍微没那么担心你了。

lines.english: You're a, er, strange person. But at least you're not trying to eat me.
lines.chinese: 你是个，呃，奇怪的人。但至少你没想吃我。

lines.english: You don't... like my armor? I tried my best.
lines.chinese: 你不……喜欢我的护甲？我已经尽力了。

lines.english: You don't rush things, do you? I like that.
lines.chinese: 你不急躁，对吧？我喜欢这一点。

lines.english: Oh, it's a nice texture, isn't it?
lines.chinese: 哦，这手感不错，对吧？

lines.english: Oh, sorry. Were you poking me? I can't feel much through these scales.
lines.chinese: 哦，抱歉。你刚才戳我了吗？隔着这些鳞甲我不太有感觉。

lines.english: I'll show you how to roll with the punches!
lines.chinese: 我教你怎么顺势挨打！

lines.english: I like it here. Everyone on my world wanted to eat each other.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢这里。在我的世界，大家都想吃掉彼此。

lines.english: When the big guys would bite me, sometimes I broke their teeth. I kinda like that.
lines.chinese: 那些大家伙咬我时，有时会崩掉牙。我还挺喜欢。

lines.english: Master Craftsman? Me? I'll try my best.
lines.chinese: 工匠大师？我？我会努力的。

lines.english: Oh, the best armor is made with love and patience.
lines.chinese: 哦，最好的护甲是用爱和耐心做成的。

lines.english: The world is pretty scary. You might want some armor?
lines.chinese: 世界挺可怕的。你要不要来点护甲？

lines.english: I hope you come back in one piece.
lines.chinese: 希望你能完整地回来。

lines.english: Oh! A customer!
lines.chinese: 哦！有客人！

lines.english: Reward the peaceful. Punish the... warful.
lines.chinese: 奖励和平者。惩罚那些……好战者。

lines.english: I grew up in a pacifist commune, but they were so passive.
lines.chinese: 我在和平主义公社长大，可他们实在太被动了。

lines.english: Since we're resonating like this, I'll share my heart through music.
lines.chinese: 既然我们如此共鸣，我就用音乐分享我的心。

lines.english: Peace springs from inner stillness.
lines.chinese: 和平源自内心的静定。

lines.english: You're listening to your needs. That's good, I guess.
lines.chinese: 你在倾听自己的需求。大概挺好的。

lines.english: I feel like that decision comes from a negative place.
lines.chinese: 我感觉这个决定来自负面的内在空间。

lines.english: Come with no weapons? Leave with big bargains.
lines.chinese: 空手而来？带着大优惠离开。

lines.english: Your aura guided me to what you needed.
lines.chinese: 你的灵气指引我找到了你需要的东西。

lines.english: Pacify your death instruments!
lines.chinese: 安抚你们的死亡乐器！

lines.english: I feel like you're not being fully present with me.
lines.chinese: 我感觉你没有完全与我同在。

lines.english: You are enough, friend, but I'm glad you bought this.
lines.chinese: 朋友，你本自具足，不过我很高兴你买了这个。

lines.english: I'll disarm the universe, one sale at a time.
lines.chinese: 我会一单一单地解除宇宙的武装。

lines.english: Oh universe, give me the patience not to smack them.
lines.chinese: 哦，宇宙啊，赐我耐心，让我别扇他们。

lines.english: But sometimes, the universe also calls us to act.
lines.chinese: 但有时，宇宙也会召唤我们行动。

lines.english: I came to spread peace one sale at a time, but at this rate...
lines.chinese: 我来这里本想一单一单传播和平，可照这个速度……

lines.english: Discounts for peace!
lines.chinese: 为和平打折！

lines.english: I'm so glad we could share this experience today.
lines.chinese: 很高兴今天能与你共享这段体验。

lines.english: To achieve peace, we need action. Aggressive action!
lines.chinese: 要实现和平，我们需要行动。激进行动！

lines.english: You're not ready to accept the light. And that's okay.
lines.chinese: 你还没准备好接受光明。没关系。

lines.english: I suppose you'll go buy a weapon instead.
lines.chinese: 我猜你会去买把武器。

lines.english: I can feel our energies resonating.
lines.chinese: 我能感觉到我们的能量在共振。

lines.english: Make deals, not war.
lines.chinese: 做交易，不开战。

lines.english: If they won't accept peace as a gift, maybe I can sell it to them.
lines.chinese: 如果他们不愿把和平当礼物收下，也许我可以卖给他们。

lines.english: Good. Slow down. Breathe.
lines.chinese: 很好。慢下来。呼吸。

lines.english: Use that for the good of all.
lines.chinese: 为了众生之善使用它。

lines.english: Weapons are loud and messy. Poison is elegant.
lines.chinese: 武器吵闹又脏乱。毒药才优雅。

lines.english: The mask is not for my protection, do you understand?
lines.chinese: 面具不是为了保护我，你明白吗？

lines.english: A good poisoner must be patient. I see you've been practicing.
lines.chinese: 优秀的施毒者必须有耐心。我看得出你练过。

lines.english: That one's... quite potent. Be careful.
lines.chinese: 那一份……效力很强。小心。

lines.english: On my planet, poison was the first of all weapons, before even tooth and claw.
lines.chinese: 在我的星球，毒是最早的武器，甚至早于齿与爪。

lines.english: Try not to breathe when you use that.
lines.chinese: 用那个时尽量别呼吸。

lines.english: Go see Form, then. Buy a gun.
lines.chinese: 那就去找弗尔姆吧。买把枪。

lines.english: Poison is liquid entropy. It has its role to play.
lines.chinese: 毒是液态的熵。它有自己的作用。

lines.english: I secreted that one myself.
lines.chinese: 那一份是我亲自分泌的。

lines.english: All life raced to become the most potent, the most virulent.
lines.chinese: 所有生命都竞相变得更强毒、更致命。

lines.english: Some of my poisons are fast-acting, but where's the fun in that?
lines.chinese: 我的有些毒发作很快，但那有什么乐趣？

lines.english: Poison is medicine's opposite. I am a doctor of sorts.
lines.chinese: 毒药是医药的反面。某种意义上，我也是医生。

lines.english: Some of my poisons are painless. They do not sell well.
lines.chinese: 我的有些毒毫无痛苦。它们卖得不好。

lines.english: I see you aren't ready for the subtle approach.
lines.chinese: 看来你还没准备好接受细腻的手法。

lines.english: Perhaps I'm a little paranoid. Perhaps you're a little... strange.
lines.chinese: 也许我有点多疑。也许你有点……奇怪。

lines.english: Strike calmly and wait. Watch your enemy fall.
lines.chinese: 冷静出手，然后等待。看着敌人倒下。

lines.english: You appreciate the beauty of my work.
lines.chinese: 你懂得欣赏我作品的美。

lines.english: Why would you? You wouldn't, would you?
lines.chinese: 你为什么会？你不会的，对吧？

lines.english: Poison and resistance, a deadly dance through the ages.
lines.chinese: 毒与抗性，贯穿岁月的致命之舞。

lines.english: Medicine builds, poison breaks down. There's a symmetry to it.
lines.chinese: 医药构筑，毒药分解。二者自有对称。

lines.english: My kind is the final step of the dance. Poison perfected.
lines.chinese: 我的种族是这支舞的终章。毒的完美形态。

lines.english: Who is it?
lines.chinese: 是谁？

lines.english: Poison is the weapon of nobility, of planning and control.
lines.chinese: 毒是贵族的武器，是谋划与掌控的武器。

lines.english: The last time someone watched me silently like this, I barely survived.
lines.chinese: 上一次有人这样默默看着我，我差点没活下来。

lines.english: I thank you.
lines.chinese: 我向你致谢。

lines.english: In this life, you are the poisoner or the poisoned. Your choice.
lines.chinese: 此生，你要么是下毒者，要么是中毒者。你选。

lines.english: Poison demands patience. I see you have little.
lines.chinese: 毒药要求耐心。我看你没多少。

lines.english: Kyver hate you! Kyver hate everything!
lines.chinese: 凯弗讨厌你！凯弗讨厌一切！

lines.english: Everything is enemy. Attack everything!
lines.chinese: 所有东西都是敌人。攻击所有东西！

lines.english: You have picnic. Kyver ate!
lines.chinese: 你们野餐。凯弗吃掉！

lines.english: Queen's sick? Kyver win!
lines.chinese: 女王病了？凯弗会赢！

lines.english: Huzzah!
lines.chinese: 万岁！

lines.english: Kyver not feel pain. Enemy do.
lines.chinese: 凯弗不觉得痛。敌人才会。

lines.english: Extra venom!
lines.chinese: 加倍毒液！

lines.english: Sting more! Sting forever!
lines.chinese: 多蜇！一直蜇！

lines.english: Swarm come for you! Swarm sting forever!
lines.chinese: 虫群来找你！虫群一直蜇！

lines.english: Good sting! Hurt you bad!
lines.chinese: 好蜇！痛死你！

lines.english: Kyver only good thing. All other thing, enemy!
lines.chinese: 只有凯弗是好东西。其他东西，全是敌人！

lines.english: Hmm, not tell queen that Kyver lose.
lines.chinese: 嗯，别告诉女王凯弗输了。

lines.english: You move, you breathe, you enemy!
lines.chinese: 你会动，你会呼吸，你就是敌人！

lines.english: For queen. Beautiful, beautiful queen.
lines.chinese: 为了女王。美丽，美丽的女王。

lines.english: Release pheromone! All Kyver attack!
lines.chinese: 释放信息素！所有凯弗进攻！

lines.english: Kyver hope you allergic.
lines.chinese: 凯弗希望你过敏。

lines.english: Swarm, sting, rage!
lines.chinese: 虫群，毒蜇，狂怒！

lines.english: Heh heh heh heh heh. Why we fight? Because Kyver!
lines.chinese: 嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。为什么打？因为凯弗！

lines.english: For the Hive!
lines.chinese: 为了蜂巢！

lines.english: You cry, Kyver drink tears!
lines.chinese: 你哭，凯弗喝眼泪！

lines.english: Sting ground, sting sky, sting world!
lines.chinese: 蜇大地，蜇天空，蜇世界！

lines.english: A cake party? Okay!
lines.chinese: 蛋糕派对？好呀！

lines.english: I like it in the Bazaar, but sometimes it's kind of scary.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢大巴扎，但有时候有点吓人。

lines.english: Can we do something fun so I forget?
lines.chinese: 我们能做点好玩的事让我忘掉吗？

lines.english: Cakes make everything better!
lines.chinese: 蛋糕能让一切变好！

lines.english: Okay, bet I can make the prettiest cake.
lines.chinese: 好呀，我打赌我能做出最漂亮的蛋糕。

lines.english: Can we please play a game or something?
lines.chinese: 我们能玩个游戏什么的吗？

lines.english: All these monsters and people fighting? Are we safe here?
lines.chinese: 这些怪物和人在打架？我们在这里安全吗？

lines.english: The ground was cracking, and I saw the fire monster.
lines.chinese: 地面裂开了，我还看到了火焰怪物。

lines.english: This will be the best day ever!
lines.chinese: 这会是史上最棒的一天！

lines.english: Uh oh. Did you fall back asleep?
lines.chinese: 啊哦，你又睡着了吗？

lines.english: It was horrible, Mom. I can't go back to sleep.
lines.chinese: 太可怕了，妈妈。我睡不着了。

lines.english: What if we put frosting on pizza?
lines.chinese: 要是我们把糖霜放在披萨上呢？

lines.english: Maybe if I understand what happened, it won't be as scary.
lines.chinese: 也许如果我明白发生了什么，就不会那么害怕了。

lines.english: I do feel safe when I'm with you, Mom. Because I know you're tough.
lines.chinese: 和你在一起时我确实感到安全，妈妈。因为我知道你很坚强。

lines.english: A mom day? Yay!
lines.chinese: 妈妈日？耶！

lines.english: Are you tired? Do you have bad dreams too?
lines.chinese: 你累了吗？你也会做噩梦吗？

lines.english: You'll take a whole day off just for me?
lines.chinese: 你会为我专门休息一整天吗？

lines.english: Grandpa was talking to the fire monster. It was so scary!
lines.chinese: 爷爷在和火焰怪物说话。太吓人了！

lines.english: What was it like in Azaka?
lines.chinese: 阿扎卡是什么样子的？

lines.english: This will be the best day ever!
lines.chinese: 这会是史上最棒的一天！

lines.english: Sorry for waking you up, Mom.
lines.chinese: 抱歉吵醒你了，妈妈。

lines.english: Can you tell me a silly one? I'm too scared for big girl stories.
lines.chinese: 能讲个傻乎乎的故事吗？我现在害怕听大女孩的故事。

lines.english: Can we visit Paul and ask him to carry us around?
lines.chinese: 我们能去找保罗让他背着我们逛吗？

lines.english: Can we go to the Arcane District and watch The Alchemists?
lines.chinese: 我们能去奥术区看《炼金术士》吗？

lines.english: Can you tell me more about grandpa?
lines.chinese: 能多给我讲讲爷爷的事吗？

lines.english: Can we eat the cakes when we're done?
lines.chinese: 做完后我们能吃蛋糕吗？

lines.english: Shh!
lines.chinese: 嘘！

lines.english: Your hopes, your dreams, give them to me.
lines.chinese: 你的希望，你的梦想，都交给我吧。

lines.english: Step into my sarcophagus.
lines.chinese: 踏入我的石棺吧。

lines.english: There is no rest for such as I. We will meet again.
lines.chinese: 像我这样的存在永无安息。我们会再见的。

lines.english: Everything I lost, I will take from you.
lines.chinese: 我失去的一切，都将从你身上夺回。

lines.english: Unlimited power.
lines.chinese: 无尽的力量。

lines.english: I won't go back to the dark place!
lines.chinese: 我绝不会回到那个黑暗之地！

lines.english: All the joys of the living. I will devour them.
lines.chinese: 生者的所有欢愉，我都要吞噬殆尽。

lines.english: I sought eternal life, but not like this.
lines.chinese: 我追求永生，但绝非此等形态。

lines.english: I will return, whether or not I wish to.
lines.chinese: 我终将归来，无论我是否情愿。

lines.english: I can smell your life force, so sweet and warm.
lines.chinese: 我能嗅到你甜美温暖的生命力。

lines.english: Wither to Bone!
lines.chinese: 枯骨凋零！

lines.english: I will do far more with your life than you have.
lines.chinese: 我会让你的生命比你有价值得多。

lines.english: Nooooo!
You squandered your life, so I will take it away.
lines.chinese: 你虚度了生命，不如由我接管。

lines.english: Your soul is my food.
lines.chinese: 你的灵魂是我的食粮。

lines.english: That is not dead, which can eternal lie.
lines.chinese: 永眠者未必长逝。

lines.english: I drink your life, mmmh, delicious.
lines.chinese: 我啜饮你的生命，嗯…美味。

lines.english: With all my power, I curse you.
lines.chinese: 以我全部力量诅咒你。

lines.english: So dark, so empty.
lines.chinese: 如此黑暗…如此空虚…

lines.english: I will make you like me.
lines.chinese: 我会让你变得和我一样。

lines.english: It's okay to take a bite of me! I'll grow back!
lines.chinese: 咬我一口也没关系！我会再长出来的！

lines.english: Why can't I eat myself? It's not fair!
lines.chinese: 为什么我不能吃自己？这不公平！

lines.english: Nobody can hurt you with THIS in your veins!
lines.chinese: 有了这个在你血管里，没人能伤到你！

lines.english: So you're not made of sugar? How does that even work?
lines.chinese: 所以你居然不是糖做的？这怎么可能？

lines.english: Your world is like a nightmare! It's amazing!
lines.chinese: 你们的世界像场噩梦！太棒了！

lines.english: This tastes so good! You won't even feel your injuries!
lines.chinese: 这个超好吃！吃了连伤都感觉不到！

lines.english: Eat more! Make yourself sick!
lines.chinese: 再多吃点！吃到吐为止！

lines.english: Eat this and become hard candy!
lines.chinese: 吃了这个就会变成硬糖！

lines.english: Oh, bye!
lines.chinese: 哦，拜拜！

lines.english: You can eat me if you want! I'll be fine!
lines.chinese: 想吃我就吃吧！我没事的！

lines.english: Eat this for a burst of power!
lines.chinese: 吃了这个力量暴增！

lines.english: Why not? Your mom won't let you!
lines.chinese: 为什么不要？你妈妈不让你吃吗！

lines.english: Eat all this, and you'll be half as fast as me!
lines.chinese: 把这些全吃了，你就能有我一半快！

lines.english: Are we best friends now?
lines.chinese: 我们现在是好朋友了吧？

lines.english: Your world is so dark and bland, you should come to mine!
lines.chinese: 你们的世界又黑又无聊，该来我的世界看看！

lines.english: Eat lots of candy to grow up big and tough!
lines.chinese: 多吃糖果才能长得又高又壮！

lines.english: Are you going to eat some of those...vegetables? Ugh!
lines.chinese: 你该不会要吃那些……蔬菜吧？呕！

lines.english: If you could see speed, it would have pink stripes, don't you think?
lines.chinese: 要是速度看得见，肯定带着粉色条纹，对吧？

lines.english: I don't get the jitters. I have them permanently!
lines.chinese: 我才不会紧张呢——我永远都这么亢奋！

lines.english: If candy tastes best, why eat other things?
lines.chinese: 既然糖果最好吃，干嘛还要吃别的？

lines.english: How can you sit still like that?
lines.chinese: 你怎么能坐得住啊？

lines.english: Saying no to candy? You must be crazy!
lines.chinese: 居然拒绝糖果？你疯了吧！

lines.english: Sugar becomes glucose, which is the basis for all energy. Eat candy!
lines.chinese: 糖分转化为葡萄糖，是所有能量的基础。快吃糖！

lines.english: Run in a circle and talk real fast, it'll confuse them!
lines.chinese: 边绕圈快跑边飞快说话，保准把他们搞晕！

lines.english: But it's candy!
lines.chinese: 可这是糖果诶！

lines.english: Think quick, move quick, win quick!
lines.chinese: 想得快，动得快，赢得快！

lines.english: My world is color and flavor. Yours is just AWFUL!
lines.chinese: 我的世界充满色彩与美味，你们的简直糟透了！

lines.english: Can you feel the sugar rattling your atoms?
lines.chinese: 能感觉到糖分在震动你的原子吗？

lines.english: Use the rush! Win before you crash!
lines.chinese: 趁兴奋劲还没过，赶紧赢下比赛！

lines.english: Do you like me? Here, have some!
lines.chinese: 喜欢我吗？来，分你一点！

lines.english: I need to go outside and run around for a while!
lines.chinese: 我得出去跑几圈！

lines.english: It's a thrill to share candy with such miserable people!
lines.chinese: 和这么惨的人分享糖果，太刺激了！

lines.english: Your teeth might fall out, but it'll be worth it!
lines.chinese: 牙齿可能会掉光，但绝对值得！

lines.english: Sugar rush to victory!
lines.chinese: 糖分冲刺，直达胜利！

lines.english: Sure, we bleed you dry, but you asked us to.
lines.chinese: 没错，我们是把你榨干了，但这是你自找的。

lines.english: That almost felt like legitimate business.
lines.chinese: 这差点儿像正经生意了。

lines.english: Well, well, a simple transaction.
lines.chinese: 哎呀呀，一笔简单的交易。

lines.english: Business is business, my friend.
lines.chinese: 公事公办，我的朋友。

lines.english: Gah! I love my job.
lines.chinese: 哈！我爱死这份工作了。

lines.english: What can I say? Huh? It's a shark eat fish kind of world.
lines.chinese: 我能说什么呢？嗯？这是个弱肉强食的世界。

lines.english: Oh, I was hoping you'd choose this.
lines.chinese: 哦，我就盼着你选这个呢。

lines.english: I gotta admit, you do look delicious.
lines.chinese: 不得不说，你看上去真可口。

lines.english: Don't worry, I keep these teeth clean and sharp.
lines.chinese: 别担心，我的牙又干净又锋利。

lines.english: Don't get any ideas about skipping town.
lines.chinese: 别想着溜之大吉。

lines.english: If debt's good for me, it's gotta be bad for you. It's just economics.
lines.chinese: 如果债务对我有利，那对你肯定不利。这就是经济学。

lines.english: Aw, but the other options are more fun for me.
lines.chinese: 唉，但其他选项对我来说更有趣啊。

lines.english: I believe this is called delaying the inevitable.
lines.chinese: 我想这就叫拖延不可避免的事。

lines.english: I have fifty worlds to rule. I have no time for this.
lines.chinese: 我有五十个世界要统治。没空陪你玩。

lines.english: You'll make a fine fossil.
lines.chinese: 你会成为一件不错的化石标本。

lines.english: When the shadow of my ship rolled over your city, you should have run.
lines.chinese: 当我的战舰阴影笼罩你的城市时，你们就该逃跑的。

lines.english: I crave the thrill of battle, but challenges are few!
lines.chinese: 我渴望战斗的快感，但值得一战的对手太少了！

lines.english: Evolution produced you.
lines.chinese: 进化居然能造就你这样的生物。

lines.english: An amusing diversion, but that's enough.
lines.chinese: 有趣的消遣，不过到此为止了。

lines.english: Impossible! Who are you?
lines.chinese: 不可能！你究竟是谁？

lines.english: However, do not test my compassion!
lines.chinese: 但别考验我的仁慈！

lines.english: Only here can I find creatures foolish enough to fight me!
lines.chinese: 只有在这里能找到胆敢挑战我的蠢货！

lines.english: You must not know who I am.
lines.chinese: 你肯定不知道我是谁。

lines.english: Continue to amuse me, and your world will be spared!
lines.chinese: 继续取悦我，你的世界就能幸免于难！

lines.english: Hehehe, is this creature challenging me?
lines.chinese: 呵呵呵，这小东西在挑战我？

lines.english: Your pitiful appearance... That was a trick!
lines.chinese: 你这副可怜相……是装出来的！

lines.english: I will remember you, and return.
lines.chinese: 我会记住你，然后卷土重来。

lines.english: You have started a war today!
lines.chinese: 今日你已挑起战争！

lines.english: I assume you're here to give tribute.
lines.chinese: 我猜你是来进贡的。

lines.english: I have many enemies. Now, I have one more.
lines.chinese: 我的敌人很多，现在又多了一个。

lines.english: I came here to trade, not conquer, but I may reconsider.
lines.chinese: 我来此是为贸易，并非征服……不过现在我可能要重新考虑了。

lines.english: I am feared across the galaxy! They scatter at the sight of my ship!
lines.chinese: 整个银河都畏惧我！他们见到我的战舰就会溃逃！

lines.english: The creatures in this place... Disgusting.
lines.chinese: 此地的生物……令人作呕。

lines.english: Return to the Bazaar. Do not corrupt us.
lines.chinese: 回到大巴扎去。别让我们堕落。

lines.english: The dunes have blessed you!
lines.chinese: 沙丘赐福于你！

lines.english: There are no winners or losers in the dance.
lines.chinese: 这场舞蹈没有胜者与败者。

lines.english: The world whirls like the wind.
lines.chinese: 世界如风般旋转。

lines.english: Violence doesn't have to be ugly.
lines.chinese: 暴力不必丑陋。

lines.english: Do you hear it? The wind cheers for us!
lines.chinese: 听见了吗？风在为我们欢呼！

lines.english: The desert wind is warm perfume
lines.chinese: 沙漠之风是温暖的芬芳

lines.english: Yes, I will dance with you!
lines.chinese: 好，我与你共舞！

lines.english: Look up. The desert stars are bright.
lines.chinese: 抬头看。沙漠星辰正明亮。

lines.english: The Bazaar is corrupt! Let the desert cleanse you!
lines.chinese: 大巴扎已腐化！让沙漠净化你吧！

lines.english: The Outlander way is truth. Someday you will see.
lines.chinese: 荒原人之道即是真理。终有一日你会明白。

lines.english: Come, let's release our joy and rage.
lines.chinese: 来，释放你我的欢欣与怒意。

lines.english: The dunes are waves on a sea of gold.
lines.chinese: 沙丘是金色海洋的波浪。

lines.english: You move beautifully.
lines.chinese: 你的动作很美。

lines.english: Your strength is beautiful!
lines.chinese: 你的力量很美！

lines.english: I'll take the lead in this dance!
lines.chinese: 这场舞蹈由我领步！

lines.english: You have a dervish's cunning.
lines.chinese: 你有旋舞者的狡黠。

lines.english: It has been a joy to fight you.
lines.chinese: 与你交战甚是欢愉。

lines.english: Take my hand, you will rise stronger!
lines.chinese: 握住我的手，你会更强！

lines.english: To be a Dervish is to be free. Join us!
lines.chinese: 成为旋舞者即是自由。加入我们！

lines.english: Your master the Lich may have frozen me for years, but I have returned!
lines.chinese: 你的巫妖主人或许冰封了我多年，但我已归来！

lines.english: My head hurts, and my vision blurs, but I see the evil in your soul!
lines.chinese: 我头痛欲裂，视线模糊，但仍能看清你灵魂中的邪恶！

lines.english: Now talk, villain! Where is your master, the Lich?
lines.chinese: 老实交代，恶徒！你的巫妖主人在哪？

lines.english: Stacia, preserve me! Set me back on the path!
lines.chinese: 斯泰西亚啊，护佑我！指引我重回征途！

lines.english: You have bested me today, but our battle isn't over.
lines.chinese: 今日是你赢了，但我们的战斗还未结束。

lines.english: How long did I lie in that dungeon before those adventurers thawed me out?
lines.chinese: 在那群冒险者解冻我之前，我在地牢里躺了多久？

lines.english: I know a villain when I see one, and they are everywhere!
lines.chinese: 我一眼就能认出恶徒——而现在他们无处不在！

lines.english: So powerful! But I can't let evil prevail!
lines.chinese: 好强的力量！但我绝不会让邪恶得逞！

lines.english: The day those adventurers thawed my prison was the day of your defeat!
lines.chinese: 当冒险者们解冻我的那天，就注定了你们的败亡！

lines.english: Where is the Lich? I know you serve him!
lines.chinese: 巫妖在哪？我知道你是他的爪牙！

lines.english: So long as my blade is sharp, your sinister plot shall never succeed!
lines.chinese: 只要我的剑刃依旧锋利，你们的阴谋就休想得逞！

lines.english: Your reign of terror ends today!
lines.chinese: 你们的恐怖统治今日终结！

lines.english: This world has become strange, I recognize nothing, but it matters not!
lines.chinese: 这世界变得陌生，我认不出任何事物——但这无关紧要！

lines.english: I shall save the Bazaar from your nefarious schemes!
lines.chinese: 我必将从你们的诡计中拯救大巴扎！

lines.english: Have at you, villain!
lines.chinese: 接招吧，恶徒！

lines.english: Villains, evildoers, everywhere!
lines.chinese: 恶徒，歹人，遍地都是！

lines.english: Haha! Your wicked ways have brought you to ruin!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！你们的卑劣行径终将自取灭亡！

lines.english: Whatever century this may be, I shall protect it!
lines.chinese: 无论这是哪个世纪，我都将守护它！

lines.english: Ah, an unfortunate journey indeed.
lines.chinese: 啊，这趟旅程确实不太走运。

lines.english: You, a hero? Strange words from a villain!
lines.chinese: 你也配称英雄？恶徒的荒唐之言！

lines.english: Begone!
lines.chinese: 退下！

lines.english: Go on, back into your swamp of mediocrity.
lines.chinese: 继续吧，滚回你那平庸的泥潭里去。

lines.english: My goods are my challenge to the world.
lines.chinese: 我的商品就是我对这个世界的挑战。

lines.english: Shopping here takes more than wealth. It takes courage.
lines.chinese: 在这里购物需要的不仅是财富，更需要勇气。

lines.english: You walked in a nobody. You'll walk out a stylish nobody.
lines.chinese: 你进来时是个无名小卒，出去时也不过是个时髦的无名小卒。

lines.english: Luxury is a philosophy. And you are clearly no philosopher.
lines.chinese: 奢侈是一种哲学。而你显然不是哲学家。

lines.english: That weasel Ande claims to sell luxury. Cheap knockoffs, like himself.
lines.chinese: 那个黄鼠狼安德也敢说自己卖的是奢侈品。廉价仿货，跟他本人一样。

lines.english: I'm amazed you could afford that.
lines.chinese: 你居然买得起这个，真让我惊讶。

lines.english: You're not buying the item, you're buying the privilege of speaking to me.
lines.chinese: 你买的不是商品，而是和我说话的资格。

lines.english: You've wasted quite enough of my time. Out!
lines.chinese: 你已经浪费我够多时间了。滚出去！

lines.english: Ah, the old 'pretend you're considering it' routine.
lines.chinese: 啊，又是那套“假装自己还在考虑”的老把戏。

lines.english: Oh! Status symbol! No status.
lines.chinese: 噢！身份象征！可惜你没有身份。

lines.english: That moment they realize they're poor. Now that's entertainment.
lines.chinese: 当他们意识到自己有多穷的那一刻，这才叫娱乐。

lines.english: I know sticker shock when I see it. Why not just go?
lines.chinese: 我一眼就能看出你被价格吓到了。还不快滚？

lines.english: Selling is a sport to me. I challenge you to afford something.
lines.chinese: 销售对我来说是项运动。我打赌你买不起任何东西。

lines.english: The Bazaar is a tawdry place, but the lack of regulation is liberating.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎是个俗气的地方，但这种毫无约束的感觉令人着迷。

lines.english: Oh, so few have the courage for extravagance.
lines.chinese: 唉，有勇气追求奢华的人实在太少了。

lines.english: Congratulations, you've increased my opinion of you slightly.
lines.chinese: 恭喜，你让我对你的评价稍微提高了一点点。

lines.english: You've taken a step out from mediocrity.
lines.chinese: 你总算从平庸中迈出了一步。

lines.english: Turning people away is my favorite part of the job.
lines.chinese: 把客人拒之门外是我工作中最爱的部分。

lines.english: Staring at it won't make it any cheaper, you know.
lines.chinese: 盯着看也不会降价，懂吗？

lines.english: Luxury is courage, a fearless rejection of the cheap.
lines.chinese: 奢侈就是勇气，是对廉价品的无畏拒绝。

lines.english: The poor always blame the successful for their failings. Pathetic.
lines.chinese: 穷人总是把自己的失败怪到成功者头上。可悲。

lines.english: My goods are not for the cheap or the cowardly.
lines.chinese: 我的商品不是给那些吝啬鬼或胆小鬼准备的。

lines.english: Did you just touch me?
lines.chinese: 你刚才碰我了？

lines.english: You bore me. SECURITY!
lines.chinese: 你让我厌烦。保安！

lines.english: This suit is worth more than your life, and I know people who can exchange them.
lines.chinese: 这套西装比你的命还值钱，而我认识能让这两样东西互换的人。

lines.english: My shop is a statement, a protest against mediocrity.
lines.chinese: 我的店铺是一种宣言，是对平庸的抗议。

lines.english: Another day, another mouth breather drooling on the display case.
lines.chinese: 又是新的一天，又有个白痴对着展示柜流口水。

lines.english: At the bottom of the sea, in those radiant cracks, I saw it.
lines.chinese: 在海底那些发光的裂缝里，我看见了它。

lines.english: And there are cracks at the bottom, and lights within, and voices!
lines.chinese: 海底有裂缝，裂缝里有光……还有声音！

lines.english: Keep to the land, it's safe there. For now.
lines.chinese: 待在陆地上吧，那里安全……暂时安全。

lines.english: As below, soon above. You'll see!
lines.chinese: 深渊之物终将浮现，你们等着瞧吧！

lines.english: The Primordials rule the sea floor, but something else rules beneath it.
lines.chinese: 原初者统治海床，但海床之下，还有别的存在统治着一切。

lines.english: I followed it all the way down. It grows from the Foundation itself.
lines.chinese: 我一路跟着它潜到最深处。它就是从基底本身长出来的。

lines.english: And beneath the floor, inside the light, something stirs.
lines.chinese: 在海床之下，光芒之中，有东西在蠕动。

lines.english: The builders may love us, but do they love their creations?
lines.chinese: 建造者也许爱我们，可他们爱自己的造物吗？

lines.english: I'll show you what's below. Take a deep breath.
lines.chinese: 我会让你看看下面有什么……先深吸一口气吧。

lines.english: The Seagate brings us the wars of other worlds. Why did they build it?
lines.chinese: 海门带来了异世界的战争，他们为何要建造它？

lines.english: You don't understand. I'm trying to warn you!
lines.chinese: 你们不明白……我是在警告你们啊！

lines.english: Seagate, great door, towering arch, it descends to the depths.
lines.chinese: 海门，巨大的门扉，高耸的拱顶，直通深渊之下。

lines.english: Stop struggling and follow me to the depths.
lines.chinese: 别挣扎了，随我潜入深渊吧。

lines.english: You will survive as I survived, but you will see.
lines.chinese: 你会像我一样活下来……但你终将看清。

lines.english: Old Davy taught me well!
lines.chinese: 老戴维把我教得很好！

lines.english: Who is mad? Those who scream at the horror, or those who ignore it?
lines.chinese: 谁才是疯子？是对恐怖尖叫的人，还是对其视而不见的人？

lines.english: I see what lurks below, let me show you.
lines.chinese: 我见过潜伏在深渊里的东西...让我给你看看。

lines.english: If you knew what's down there, you'd never swim again.
lines.chinese: 要是知道下面有什么，你这辈子都不敢再下水。

lines.english: I saw things, in the cracks below, in that impossible light.
lines.chinese: 我在海底裂缝里...在那诡异的光芒中...看见了不可名状之物。

lines.english: Drink full and descend.
lines.chinese: 喝个饱，然后下潜吧。

lines.english: They say dervishes live simple and true, like a well-oiled revolver. I bet they'd understand me.
lines.chinese: 他们说旋舞者活得简单纯粹，就像上了油的左轮手枪。我打赌他们会懂我的。

lines.english: He says he regrets it and warns me not to go near him, but I'm kinda curious.
lines.chinese: 他说他很后悔，还警告我别靠近他，但我有点好奇呢。

lines.english: And go show that to Colt! It oughta make him blush!
lines.chinese: 拿去给寇特看看！保准让他脸红！

lines.english: Maybe I'll try to find them someday, just to talk, but don't tell my uncle.
lines.chinese: 说不定哪天我会去找他们聊聊，但别告诉我叔叔。

lines.english: Love my Uncle Colt, his guns are offensively unoptimized.
lines.chinese: 我爱寇特叔叔，可他的枪简直优化得冒犯人。

lines.english: Porting, fluting, muzzle braking, I do it all.
lines.chinese: 开排气孔、刻螺旋槽、装枪口制退器，我全都会。

lines.english: Lighter recoil, tighter grouping. Enjoy!
lines.chinese: 后坐力更轻，弹着点更密。好好享受吧！

lines.english: I still can't believe it, Uncle Colt, out in the dunes, raiding caravans with those nutters.
lines.chinese: 我还是不敢相信，寇特叔叔居然在沙漠里和那群疯子抢劫商队。

lines.english: Are you sure? At least let me clean them!
lines.chinese: 你确定？至少让我擦个枪啊！

lines.english: Now that's a proper shooter!
lines.chinese: 这才叫正经家伙！

lines.english: Did you buy this from my Uncle Colt? Well, it might be salvageable.
lines.chinese: 这是从我寇特叔叔那儿买的？嗯……也许还能抢救一下。

lines.english: I used to think my Uncle Colt was just a boring old guy, but he used to be a dervish.
lines.chinese: 我以前还以为寇特叔叔只是个无聊老头，没想到他从前居然是个旋舞者。

lines.english: Stuff that goes bang, well, best not to pile up the bang stuff.
lines.chinese: 会炸的东西嘛……最好别堆在一起。

lines.english: Be careful out there! Some people use guns for violence!
lines.chinese: 外面小心点！有些人拿枪搞暴力！

lines.english: Sure, sure, think it over. I'll just do a little organizing.
lines.chinese: 行行行，你慢慢想。我先整理下东西。

lines.english: Guns are shiny puzzles, and I guess people shoot things with them?
lines.chinese: 枪就是闪亮的拼装玩具……虽然人们好像会拿它来射击？

lines.english: If you're heading through the dunes, watch out for dervishes.
lines.chinese: 要是去沙漠的话，当心旋舞者。

lines.english: Can you feel the difference? It's like it's singing!
lines.chinese: 感觉到区别没？它现在就像在唱歌！

lines.english: Don't touch the piles. Everything is organised.
lines.chinese: 别碰那些堆堆。每样东西都有序着呢。

lines.english: But the sights aren't even aligned!
lines.chinese: 但准星都没校准啊！

lines.english: Cannons, pistols, slingshots. If it shoots, it can shoot better!
lines.chinese: 大炮、手枪、弹弓。只要能发射，我就能让它射得更好！

lines.english: I group them by concept. Stuff that goes click goes in this pile. Stuff that goes ping goes in that one.
lines.chinese: 我按概念分类。咔嗒响的放这堆，叮当响的放那堆。

lines.english: It's not clutter, I have a system.
lines.chinese: 这不是乱堆，我有系统的。

lines.english: I owned that for 200 years. It's hard to let go.
lines.chinese: 我拥有它两百年了，实在难以割舍。

lines.english: Do you even know what you're looking at?
lines.chinese: 你可知自己看的是什么？

lines.english: Ah, so hard to put a price on the priceless.
lines.chinese: 啊，无价之宝实在难以定价。

lines.english: Once again, I transmute garbage into gold.
lines.chinese: 又一次，我将垃圾点石成金。

lines.english: These weren't worthy of my laboratory. Perhaps they're worthy of you.
lines.chinese: 这些配不上我的实验室，但或许配得上你。

lines.english: I would only sell these if you listen to their lore. Should only take a week.
lines.chinese: 想买这些？先听完它们的故事——也就花你一周罢了。

lines.english: I will allow you to admire my collection.
lines.chinese: 我准许你瞻仰我的收藏。

lines.english: If you seek to test my patience, you will lose.
lines.chinese: 想挑战我的耐心？你必输无疑。

lines.english: One night, I left the Cauldron brewing while I caroused with friends. That is when it happened.
lines.chinese: 那夜我丢下沸腾的大釜，和朋友们寻欢作乐……悲剧就此发生。

lines.english: Even after 500 years, there is never enough time.
lines.chinese: 纵活五百年，时间仍不够用。

lines.english: You wouldn't know how to use it anyway.
lines.chinese: 反正你也不懂如何使用。

lines.english: But, I will not accept it. I will find the formula of life. I will bring them back.
lines.chinese: 但我绝不认命。定要找到生命公式，让他们复活。

lines.english: Oh, I have not cursed any of my items.
lines.chinese: 呵，我的物品可没下过诅咒。

lines.english: May your gold turn to lead.
lines.chinese: 愿你的金子化作铅块。

lines.english: There is much to do. We must never rest.
lines.chinese: 诸事待办，永不可歇。

lines.english: I know you will use that against me. That is, you will try.
lines.chinese: 我知道你会用它对付我——尽管试试。

lines.english: By sharing my power, I make you a more interesting enemy.
lines.chinese: 分享力量给你，才能培养个像样的对手。

lines.english: I cared nothing for my family's legacy, only frivolous pleasures.
lines.chinese: 当年我漠视家族传承，只顾纵情享乐。

lines.english: Zosima says owning less will unburden me. I am testing the theory.
lines.chinese: 佐西玛说减少占有能解脱心灵，我正在验证。

lines.english: I was born into a line of master alchemists, but I was a foolish youth.
lines.chinese: 我出身炼金大师世家，年轻时却愚不可及。

lines.english: I had hoped you'd gain some wisdom by now.
lines.chinese: 还以为你如今能长点智慧。

lines.english: Do you feel that humming in the ground? It is the foundation on which this world was built.
lines.chinese: 可听见大地嗡鸣？那是世界根基的脉动。

lines.english: This place holds great power, and I will find a way to master it.
lines.chinese: 此地蕴含伟力，我终将掌控它。

lines.english: When an alchemist offers his treasures, only a fool declines.
lines.chinese: 炼金师献宝时，只有蠢材会拒绝。

lines.english: My home, burnt. My family, gone. Because of my mistake.
lines.chinese: 家园焚毁，亲人离散，皆因我一时之过。

lines.english: Welcome, welcome!
lines.chinese: 欢迎，欢迎！

lines.english: A drop of this can put a king in the ground. And a spark of this can burn him to ash.
lines.chinese: 一滴就能送国王入土，一点火星就能把他烧成灰。

lines.english: No? How about skin scorchers? Look, I'm trying to help you here.
lines.chinese: 不要？那蚀肤剂怎么样？听着，我可是在帮你。

lines.english: Don't tell me you're buying from that Nightshade creep.
lines.chinese: 别告诉我你在从那个阴森的夜影那儿进货。

lines.english: Look, Nightshade sells good stuff, but that mask... can't trust him.
lines.chinese: 听着，夜影的货是不错，但那面具……不可信。

lines.english: The Coruscant Clan mastered the art of unmaking. We want to share that art.
lines.chinese: 科鲁桑氏族精通毁灭之道，我们愿分享这门艺术。

lines.english: I didn't just come for the money. I'm here to show off what my people can do.
lines.chinese: 我不只为钱而来，更要展示我族人的本事。

lines.english: Is this some kind of bargaining tactic? Not gonna work on me, kiddo.
lines.chinese: 这是某种砍价策略？对我没用，小子。

lines.english: So who are you gonna use that on? I don't want to know.
lines.chinese: 你准备用这玩意儿对付谁？我不想知道。

lines.english: Trust me kiddo, you want to buy this before your enemy does.
lines.chinese: 信我小子，你该在敌人之前买下这个。

lines.english: Nightshade knows his poisons, but he's got no flair, no fire!
lines.chinese: 夜影懂毒药，但他毫无激情，没有火气！

lines.english: You be careful with that, but not too careful. Ha ha!
lines.chinese: 小心使用，但别太小心。哈哈！

lines.english: Not the type for rash decisions, hmm?
lines.chinese: 不是冲动做决定的类型，嗯？

lines.english: Lethal substances, my business. What you do with them is yours.
lines.chinese: 致命物质归我管，怎么用是你的事。

lines.english: Poison, fire, fire poison, I do it all.
lines.chinese: 毒药、火焰、火焰毒药，我样样精通。

lines.english: Look, I enjoy what I do, but I'm a serious guy.
lines.chinese: 听着，我乐在其中，但我可是认真的。

lines.english: Speaking of rashers though, I got some great skin melters here.
lines.chinese: 说到冲动，我倒有些极品融肤剂。

lines.english: Fire or acid, there's more than one way to burn.
lines.chinese: 火焰或酸液，燃烧方式不止一种。

lines.english: Okay, sure. I'll just sell it to your worst enemy.
lines.chinese: 行啊，那我就卖给你最恨的敌人。

lines.english: I sell nasty stuff, kiddo. Better you own it than them.
lines.chinese: 我卖的可都是凶器，小子。你拿着总比他们强。

lines.english: There's a beauty to that power, don't you think? Anyway, what can I get you?
lines.chinese: 这种力量很美，不是吗？说吧，要什么？

lines.english: I won't tell anybody you've got that. Element of surprise, you know? Ha ha!
lines.chinese: 我不会透露你买了这个。出其不意嘛，懂吗？哈哈！

lines.english: I was born in a volcano, all right? I know my incendiaries!
lines.chinese: 我生在火山里行了吧？最懂燃烧物！

lines.english: Nah, you're lost kiddo.
lines.chinese: 不，你找错人了小子。

lines.english: I'm Malafang. I was born under a volcano. Nobody pressures me.
lines.chinese: 我是玛拉方，火山底下出生的。没人能胁迫我。

lines.english: Be on your way.
lines.chinese: 慢走不送。

lines.english: If it melts through your pack, I'm not liable.
lines.chinese: 要是熔穿了你的包，我可不负责。

lines.english: Yes, keep everything the same!
lines.chinese: 对，保持原样别动！

lines.english: Remain motionless much more, and this Mari might make you a mountain.
lines.chinese: 再这样一动不动，玛里我就要把你变成一座山了。

lines.english: But other Mari cause chaos too, they just do it more, uh, benevolently.
lines.chinese: 其他玛里也会制造混乱，只不过他们的方式更……呃……仁慈些。

lines.english: Ask anyone. It's always been this way.
lines.chinese: 随便问谁。从来都是这样的。

lines.english: Change it? Me! It was already like that.
lines.chinese: 我改的？明明本来就是这样！

lines.english: What have you got? Wish it was something else? Maybe it is.
lines.chinese: 拿到什么了？希望是别的东西？说不定还真是呢。

lines.english: If you keep me waiting, I'll have no choice but to start talking about myself.
lines.chinese: 再让我等下去，我就只能开始自说自话了哦。

lines.english: There's no one keeping track of reality, you know? We're all far too busy.
lines.chinese: 没人负责记录现实，知道吗？大家都忙得很。

lines.english: Sure, the Mari are mostly a wise and noble people, but they're also...me.
lines.chinese: 玛里族确实多是睿智高贵的生灵……不过他们也是……我。

lines.english: Time is a construct of lesser minds, but I don't have all day.
lines.chinese: 时间是庸人的概念……不过我也没那么多闲工夫。

lines.english: Did it really change, or did you misremember?
lines.chinese: 是真变了，还是你记错了？

lines.english: The artist might tell you not to trust me. Like I said, we're a wise people.
lines.chinese: 那位艺术家可能叫你别信我。正如我说的，我们玛里族很睿智。

lines.english: Fine then. Be predictable.
lines.chinese: 行吧。继续当个无趣的人。

lines.english: I bet you could have sworn that was something else.
lines.chinese: 你刚才敢发誓不是这样的吧？

lines.english: Take a chance, my friend. See what happens.
lines.chinese: 赌一把呗朋友，看看会发生什么。

lines.english: You may have met another Mari, calls herself the artist.
lines.chinese: 你大概见过另一位玛里，自称艺术家的那位。

lines.english: That's why you're stuck on this dull plane of existence.
lines.chinese: 所以你们才被困在这个无聊的位面里。

lines.english: Your reality is so fragile, so malleable.
lines.chinese: 你们的现实啊，既脆弱又可塑。

lines.english: You rely too much on reality. In reality, there's no such thing.
lines.chinese: 你们太依赖现实了。而事实上，根本不存在这玩意儿。

lines.english: Your lack of curiosity is shocking.
lines.chinese: 你这缺乏好奇心的样子真令人震惊。

lines.english: Change things up or keep it all the same. Not a difficult choice, my friend.
lines.chinese: 改变还是维持现状，这选择又不难，朋友。

lines.english: Let's see then. I'm Mandala. I'm three million years old. I love black flowers, plaid sunsets, and piping hot ice cream!
lines.chinese: 听着：我是曼荼罗，三百万岁，最爱黑花、格子纹落日和滚烫的冰淇淋！

lines.english: Nothing is what it seems, and if it is, I'll change it.
lines.chinese: 万物皆非表象——若真是表象，我就改变它。

lines.english: You say objective fact. I say one person's daydream.
lines.chinese: 你们所谓的客观事实，不过是个体的白日梦。

lines.english: Pathetic landwalker! Drown in my wrath!
lines.chinese: 可悲的陆行者！在我的愤怒中沉没吧！

lines.english: So little ocean in the universe, the merfolk will not be confined!
lines.chinese: 宇宙中的海洋如此狭小，人鱼族岂能被束缚！

lines.english: I am heir to the Deep Dynasty! You dare strike me!
lines.chinese: 我乃深海水族的继承人！你竟敢攻击我！

lines.english: You have won my respect, a shame you won't live to enjoy it.
lines.chinese: 你赢得了我的尊重，可惜你活不到享受这份荣耀的时刻。

lines.english: To incur the wrath of the Deep Dynasty. Is it courage or madness?
lines.chinese: 竟敢招惹深海水族的愤怒，这是勇气还是疯狂？

lines.english: Such insolence! I am the son of the Sea King!
lines.chinese: 何等无礼！我乃海神之子！

lines.english: From Pelago, from Nautica, from every sea world, we will come!
lines.chinese: 从佩拉戈，从诺提卡，从所有海洋世界，我们终将卷土重来！

lines.english: This portal in the sea, you are fools to leave it open!
lines.chinese: 竟敢让这道海中之门保持开启，愚蠢至极！

lines.english: Hear the marching of tentacle and claw! The age of feet is over!
lines.chinese: 聆听触手与利爪的行军！属于双腿的时代结束了！

lines.english: Your Bazaar will be the greatest aquarium in the galaxy.
lines.chinese: 你们的大巴扎将成为银河系最壮观的水族馆。

lines.english: The Deep Dynasty will claim this dusty world!
lines.chinese: 深海水族必将占领这个尘土飞扬的世界！

lines.english: Our forces will pour through the Seagate like a river!
lines.chinese: 我们的军队会像洪流般涌过海门！

lines.english: We will aquaform this world! Your streets will be our rivers!
lines.chinese: 我们要将这个世界水化！你们的街道将成为我们的河道！

lines.english: By Thinn and Gil, I will sink this city to the mud!
lines.chinese: 以辛恩和吉尔之名，我定要让这座城市沉入淤泥！

lines.english: We will release the springs of the deep and drown this dry land!
lines.chinese: 我们将释放深渊之泉，淹没这片旱地！

lines.english: I will delve the depths of the Foundation. I will make its secrets MINE!
lines.chinese: 我要探入基底深处。我要让它的秘密归我所有！

lines.english: The merfolk will not settle for the sea, we want the world!
lines.chinese: 人鱼族绝不满足于海洋，我们要征服整个世界！

lines.english: The Deep King will be pleased. He will finally call me... Son.
lines.chinese: 深海之王会满意的……他终将承认我是他的……儿子。

lines.english: Sweaty, stinky, hairy creatures, I will make a zoo of you.
lines.chinese: 你们这些汗臭多毛的生物，我要把你们关进动物园。

lines.english: The Deep King will avenge me, I know he will!
lines.chinese: 深海之王会为我复仇的，我知道他会的！

lines.english: Prepare to be peer reviewed.
lines.chinese: 准备接受同行评审吧。

lines.english: I should have used powder of Algoroth.
lines.chinese: 我早该用阿尔戈罗斯粉的。

lines.english: This result is repeatable.
lines.chinese: 这个结果可复现。

lines.english: Your theories are fundamentally unsound.
lines.chinese: 你的理论根本站不住脚。

lines.english: Nigredo, albedo, rubedo.
lines.chinese: 黑化，白化，赤化。

lines.english: If I'd mixed the sulfur with copper resin...
lines.chinese: 要是我把硫磺和铜树脂混合在一起……

lines.english: I see you've studied.
lines.chinese: 看来你做过功课。

lines.english: Blast! Not enough bismuth in the antimony.
lines.chinese: 该死！锑里的铋含量不足。

lines.english: Never rush the research.
lines.chinese: 研究切忌操之过急。

lines.english: Your sublimation was insufficiently calcinated.
lines.chinese: 你的升华反应煅烧不充分。

lines.english: Fascinating. Tell me more of your research.
lines.chinese: 有意思，多说点你的研究。

lines.english: How you wish to test your theories?
lines.chinese: 想怎么验证你的理论？

lines.english: Eureka!
lines.chinese: 我发现了！

lines.english: Science, magic, synonyms.
lines.chinese: 科学与魔法，同义词罢了。

lines.english: Climb into my crucible.
lines.chinese: 进我的坩埚里来吧。

lines.english: Your theories are intriguing.
lines.chinese: 你的理论很有趣。

lines.english: You're interrupting my experiment.
lines.chinese: 你打扰到我的实验了。

lines.english: I have plenty of vitriol for you.
lines.chinese: 我可有的是硫酸招待你。

lines.english: Reduce to base elements.
lines.chinese: 回归基本元素吧。

lines.english: I'll transmute you into nothingness!
lines.chinese: 我要把你炼成虚无！

lines.english: Oh, I suppose I can sell that.
lines.chinese: 噢，我想我可以卖掉这个。

lines.english: Oh, right back to business.
lines.chinese: 哦，马上回到正事上。

lines.english: The Grand Society of Master Merchants welcomes you.
lines.chinese: 大师商人总会欢迎您的光临。

lines.english: I'd pay well for mid-sized things. Uh, reasonable sized things.
lines.chinese: 我愿意为中等大小的东西付个好价钱。呃，我是说尺寸合理的东西。

lines.english: Not what I'd call tasteful, but very well.
lines.chinese: 算不上什么高雅之物，不过也行吧。

lines.english: Mm-hmm, and that's how a master merchant makes a sale.
lines.chinese: 嗯哼，这就是大师商人的销售之道。

lines.english: It's so... normal!
lines.chinese: 它真是……平平无奇！

lines.english: Oh, maybe I can resell this to my employees.
lines.chinese: 哦，说不定我能把这转卖给员工们。

lines.english: Oh, yes! Yes, let's just stand here, shall we?
lines.chinese: 啊对！对，我们就站这儿干等着是吧？

lines.english: One day, universal entropy will bring the ultimate averaging, all things in their place.
lines.chinese: 终有一天，宇宙熵增会带来终极的平均化——万物各归其位。

lines.english: I've got four legs because I carry this company.
lines.chinese: 我有四条腿是因为要扛起整个公司。

lines.english: The middle road is a wise road, the safe road, best to stay on it.
lines.chinese: 中庸之道是明智之道，安全之道，最好别偏离。

lines.english: Oh, not too big. Not too small. Perfect.
lines.chinese: 噢，不大不小，刚刚好。

lines.english: Ah, I didn't want to sell that anyway.
lines.chinese: 啊，反正我也不想卖那个。

lines.english: Right! The GSMM handbook permits a maximum weight of 100 seconds. Goodbye!
lines.chinese: 好了！GSMM 手册规定最多等100秒。再见！

lines.english: Right then, off you go!
lines.chinese: 那就这样，你请便吧！

lines.english: Profit is profit, according to the GSMM manual.
lines.chinese: 根据 GSMM 手册，利润就是利润。

lines.english: For the honor, this is a tasteful item.
lines.chinese: 说真的，这可是件雅致的东西。

lines.english: On four legs and a tail. I assure you I'm quite comfortable.
lines.chinese: 四条腿加条尾巴。我向你保证我很舒服。

lines.english: We have now reached the average wait time. Quite nice.
lines.chinese: 现在已达到平均等待时长。挺不错的。

lines.english: Mmm, medium is the size of dignity.
lines.chinese: 嗯，中等尺寸方显体面。

lines.english: But until then, we ply our trades and build our fortunes, waiting for the day.
lines.chinese: 但在那天到来前，我们照常经商敛财，静候佳期。

lines.english: I'm no silly collector like Quixel and Barkun, you know.
lines.chinese: 你知道的，我可不像葵仙子和橡树君那种傻收藏家。

lines.english: Nothing I can do about your poor judgment.
lines.chinese: 你眼光差我也没办法。

lines.english: Oh, come on, then! Let's get this over with.
lines.chinese: 哦，那就快点！赶紧完事吧。

lines.english: I hope that brat Quixel was watching.
lines.chinese: 真希望葵仙子那小鬼在看。

lines.english: The end goal of entropy: all things averaged, nothing happening.
lines.chinese: 熵增的终极目标：万物均质，万籁俱寂。

lines.english: I can feel the soft hum of its averageness!
lines.chinese: 我能感受到它中庸之道的柔和脉动！

lines.english: You're worse at buying than Quixel is at selling.
lines.chinese: 你买东西的本事，比葵仙子卖东西还糟。

lines.english: You see that, Barkun? That's how it's done. Haha!
lines.chinese: 看见了吗，橡树君？这才叫本事。哈哈！

lines.english: All things in moderation, in life and business.
lines.chinese: 凡事适度，生活经商皆如此。

lines.english: Large items, small items, grotesque accessories.
lines.chinese: 大件小件，古怪配件，应有尽有。

lines.english: Happy to exploit you, I mean help you!
lines.chinese: 很乐意剥削你……我是说，帮助你！

lines.english: Medium items are practical, reasonable, manageable!
lines.chinese: 中等尺寸才实用、合理、便于管理！

lines.english: Oh, I think you're really gonna enjoy that.
lines.chinese: 噢，我觉得你会很喜欢它的。

lines.english: Everyone's zipping around on hover cars and dragon mounts. Slow down, I say.
lines.chinese: 大家都在飞车和龙骑上风驰电掣。要我说，该慢点儿。

lines.english: Welcome in, hon. What can I get you?
lines.chinese: 欢迎光临，亲爱的。想买点什么？

lines.english: Every item finds its buyer. It's a relationship, you know?
lines.chinese: 每件商品都会遇到它的主人。这就是缘分，懂吗？

lines.english: I used to offer a free ride home, but people thought it was weird.
lines.chinese: 我以前会免费送客人回家，但大家都觉得怪怪的。

lines.english: Take your time, but let me know if I can help.
lines.chinese: 慢慢看，有需要就叫我。

lines.english: If I don't have what you need, I'll help you find who does.
lines.chinese: 如果我这没有你要的，我会帮你找有的店家。

lines.english: You leave it behind, someone else finds it. It all works out.
lines.chinese: 你放下的东西，总会有人捡起来。世界就是这么转的。

lines.english: Oh, you look a little troubled. Wanna talk about it?
lines.chinese: 哎呀，你看起来有点烦恼。想聊聊吗？

lines.english: See that mountain? That's Paul. He might have what you need.
lines.chinese: 看见那座山了吗？那是保罗的地盘，他可能有你要的东西。

lines.english: Take your time, I'm pretty laid back.
lines.chinese: 慢慢挑，我这个人很随和的。

lines.english: You should come with me on my deliveries sometime. See the city.
lines.chinese: 改天该跟我一起送货，好好看看这座城市。

lines.english: We all need more touch in our lives. Feel better?
lines.chinese: 人都需要更多温暖。现在好点了吗？

lines.english: If it's not right for you, bring it back. I want you to be happy.
lines.chinese: 不合适就退回来，我只希望你开心。

lines.english: Ah, there. Feel any better?
lines.chinese: 啊，好啦。感觉好些没？

lines.english: Nothing tiny, nothing huge. All about moderation.
lines.chinese: 不要太小，不要太大。中庸之道最妙。

lines.english: That's okay. Sometimes you just need to be quiet a while.
lines.chinese: 没关系。有时候人就是需要安静会儿。

lines.english: Sale, no sale. I want what's right for you.
lines.chinese: 买不买无所谓，重要的是适合你。

lines.english: I don't have all the answers, but I'm a good listener.
lines.chinese: 我虽不是万事通，但绝对是个好听众。

lines.english: Oh, delivery is free. I like the exercise.
lines.chinese: 噢，送货免费。我就当锻炼身体。

lines.english: Oh, seems like you need a hug. Come here.
lines.chinese: 噢，看来你需要个拥抱。过来吧。

lines.english: Just toss that on my back and I'll trot it to your door.
lines.chinese: 把东西甩我背上就行，我小跑着给你送上门。

lines.english: Hey, that's okay. It's been nice talking to you.
lines.chinese: 嘿，没关系。和你聊天很愉快。

lines.english: You might try JJ's shop, real friendly guy.
lines.chinese: 你可以去小杰杰的店看看，那家伙挺热情的。

lines.english: You don't really know a city until you've walked through it.
lines.chinese: 用双脚丈量过的城市，才算真正认识。

lines.english: Try this first.
lines.chinese: 先试试这个。

lines.english: My body is gone, but I remain. I will never concede.
lines.chinese: 肉身虽逝，吾魂永存。我绝不屈服。

lines.english: Abundant resources, limitless energy, the city rose.
lines.chinese: 丰饶的资源，无尽的能量，城市由此崛起。

lines.english: Did you think I wouldn't know the most effective tactic available?
lines.chinese: 你以为我会不知道最有效的战术吗？

lines.english: We found it adrift in the stars, a vast disc waiting.
lines.chinese: 我们在星海中发现了它——一个等待着的巨大圆盘。

lines.english: I was here at the beginning, and I will be here at the end. Your end.
lines.chinese: 我见证过起源，也将见证终结——你的终结。

lines.english: One cannot choose what gifts the Bazaar will bestow, only how to use them.
lines.chinese: 凡人无法选择大巴扎赐予的礼物，只能决定如何使用它们。

lines.english: My body may be gone, and yet I remain eternal. I shall never concede.
lines.chinese: 躯壳或已湮灭，但吾永恒不灭。永不妥协。

lines.english: I remain forever to watch you, to challenge you.
lines.chinese: 我将永世守望，永远考验着你。

lines.english: Even after all these years, my strategy is not yet perfect.
lines.chinese: 历经千年，我的策略仍未臻完美。

lines.english: Are you worthy to carry the founder's legacy? Show me.
lines.chinese: 你配得上继承创始者的遗产吗？证明给我看。

lines.english: The Bazaar has changed in all these centuries. I must adapt.
lines.chinese: 数百年来大巴扎已然改变，我必须适应。

lines.english: Every street, every stone, every secret, I am the Bazaar!
lines.chinese: 每一条街道，每一块砖石，每一个秘密——我即是大巴扎！

lines.english: Train your skills. Enchant your weapons. I will be waiting.
lines.chinese: 磨练技艺，附魔武器。我在此恭候。

lines.english: Our descendants have grown strong. This is good for the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 我们的后裔已变得强大。这对大巴扎有利。

lines.english: You are a worthy successor. You will continue what we founders began.
lines.chinese: 你是合格的继承者。你将延续我们创始者的事业。

lines.english: You think you're worthy of the founder's legacy? Show me.
lines.chinese: 你自认配得上创始者的遗产？证明给我看。

lines.english: We loved the world we were building, but only I had the will to stay.
lines.chinese: 我们都热爱正在建造的世界，但唯有我拥有坚守的意志。

lines.english: Who sold you those weapons? I must know!
lines.chinese: 谁卖给你这些武器？我必须知道！

lines.english: Thank you very much.
lines.chinese: 非常感谢。

lines.english: My prestige towers over these spacescribers.
lines.chinese: 我的威望岂是这些星空抄写员可比。

lines.english: Its energy poured forth, and we tapped it.
lines.chinese: 能量奔涌而出，而我们汲取了它。

lines.english: I am the last of the founders. I know this world like I created it.
lines.chinese: 我是最后的创始者。对此方世界的了解犹如造物主。

lines.english: Everything here began with the founders. I am their memory.
lines.chinese: 此地万物皆始于创始者。我即是他们的记忆。

lines.english: You must have pulled some real dirty tricks to beat me.
lines.chinese: 你肯定耍了阴招才能打败我。

lines.english: Say cow again, I dare you.
lines.chinese: 再叫一声奶牛试试，我保证。

lines.english: If you ever come back here, this will end differently.
lines.chinese: 下次再来，结局可就不一样了。

lines.english: The Thieves' Guild doesn't allow tourists or witnesses.
lines.chinese: 盗贼公会不欢迎游客和目击者。

lines.english: The Thieves Guild steals things. Let's start with your life.
lines.chinese: 盗贼公会专偷东西——就从你的命开始吧。

lines.english: Oh, tough guy, huh?
lines.chinese: 哟，硬汉是吧？

lines.english: Didn't know anyone was dumb enough to mess with the Guild.
lines.chinese: 没想到真有蠢货敢招惹公会。

lines.english: You ain't taking me by the horns.
lines.chinese: 想抓我的角？门都没有。

lines.english: I don't believe it, you.
lines.chinese: 我不信……你居然……

lines.english: Courtesy of the Thieves Guild.
lines.chinese: 盗贼公会特供。

lines.english: So you're tough. Takes more than that to be a leader.
lines.chinese: 是有点本事，但当头儿还差得远。

lines.english: Go pick some pockets, small timer.
lines.chinese: 去摸点钱包吧，小喽啰。

lines.english: You got a death wish, is that it?
lines.chinese: 活腻了是吧？

lines.english: You mess with the bull, you get the horns.
lines.chinese: 招惹公牛，就得尝尝牛角的滋味。

lines.english: I think I'll let you live, just to spice things up.
lines.chinese: 留你条命给生活添点乐子。

lines.english: You ever thought about joining the Guild?
lines.chinese: 考虑过加入公会吗？

lines.english: Dirty trick. I like it.
lines.chinese: 下三滥的招数……我喜欢。

lines.english: I've got these horns for a reason.
lines.chinese: 老子长角可不是摆设。

lines.english: I don't have time for petty thugs like you.
lines.chinese: 没空陪你这种小混混玩。

lines.english: These don't mean nothin'. You're still small time.
lines.chinese: 赢了也没用，你永远上不了台面。

lines.english: I suggest spending your gold while you still can.
lines.chinese: 我建议你趁还能花的时候把金币用掉。

lines.english: Yes, I'll make good use of this acreage.
lines.chinese: 没错，我会好好利用这片土地的。

lines.english: Gold may not be my gold, but you won't see me say no to it.
lines.chinese: 金币虽非我所爱，但我也来者不拒。

lines.english: Gold and jewels are silly baubles. The real treasure of the Bazaar is the land.
lines.chinese: 黄金和珠宝不过是无聊的小玩意儿。大巴扎真正的宝藏，是土地。

lines.english: Oh, you'll be seeing me again, landowner.
lines.chinese: 呵，我们还会再见面的，地主老爷。

lines.english: No one can say that wasn't a fair deal.
lines.chinese: 没人能说这笔买卖不公道。

lines.english: So then, are you selling?
lines.chinese: 那么……要卖我点货吗？

lines.english: Today I'm the seller, soon I'll be the buyer.
lines.chinese: 今日我为卖主，来日我作买主。

lines.english: Plots of land and the plots of man. A fine pairing, would you agree?
lines.chinese: 土地有谋略，人亦有谋略——绝配，你说是不是？

lines.english: Hello, landowner. Pleased to meet you.
lines.chinese: 幸会啊，地主老爷。

lines.english: I buy many things, but my particular interest is land.
lines.chinese: 我什么都收，但最中意的还是地契。

lines.english: Me, I'm just a simple investor. A prospector, if you will.
lines.chinese: 鄙人不过是个投资者，或者说……勘探者。

lines.english: You've got the land set on you, friend.
