lines.chinese: 朋友，你身上带着土地的气息啊。

lines.english: You see, here in the Bazaar, land is... more than it seems.
lines.chinese: 你看，在大巴扎这里，土地……远不止表面看起来那么简单。

lines.english: It's not the dirt. It's what's under the dirt.
lines.chinese: 重要的不是泥土，而是泥土之下藏着什么。

lines.english: It's good to know who has means in this town.
lines.chinese: 摸清镇上有哪些财主总没坏处。

lines.english: Not today. Not today? Perhaps tomorrow.
lines.chinese: 今天不行……今天不行？或许明天吧。

lines.english: Perhaps someday we'll discuss a more serious transaction.
lines.chinese: 改日或许能谈笔大买卖。

lines.english: My own plans, well, they've simmered a very long time.
lines.chinese: 我的计划嘛……已经酝酿很久了。

lines.english: One word, friend, the Foundation, and I'll speak no more on that.
lines.chinese: 只提一个词——基底。多的我就不说了。

lines.english: I'll waive the inspection. I am motivated.
lines.chinese: 免检了，我急着要。

lines.english: We all have our daydreams, don't we? Our visions and shadows.
lines.chinese: 谁还没点白日梦呢？那些愿景与暗影啊。

lines.english: I can only hope you're surveying some land in your head, pondering a price.
lines.chinese: 但愿您正在心里丈量土地，盘算价钱呢。

lines.english: Me? Just a simple investor.
lines.chinese: 我？不过是个投资者罢了。

lines.english: Now, if you'll just sign here. Quickly, now.
lines.chinese: 来，在这儿签字。快点儿。

lines.english: As they say where I come from, may no one follow you home.
lines.chinese: 用我老家的话说：愿没人尾随你归家。

lines.english: I respect a slow decision. It's a sign of planning.
lines.chinese: 我欣赏慎重决定的人，这代表有谋划。

lines.english: A fine piece of land, perfect for me.
lines.chinese: 好地块，正合我意。

lines.english: For a man of ambition, it's always a buyer's market.
lines.chinese: 对野心家来说，永远都是买方市场。

lines.english: They say gold not spent is nothing but rocks.
lines.chinese: 俗话说：不花的金币不过是石头。

lines.english: How you like that?
lines.chinese: 这滋味如何？

lines.english: Don't be a hero, just hand it over!
lines.chinese: 别逞英雄，老实交出来！

lines.english: Can't blame me for trying to survive!
lines.chinese: 混口饭吃而已，别怪我！

lines.english: I warned ya!
lines.chinese: 我警告过你了！

lines.english: Thank you for the donation, eh?
lines.chinese: 多谢赞助啊，嗯？

lines.english: Give me the gold, and nobody gets hurt!
lines.chinese: 交出金币，保你平安！

lines.english: Hey, hey! I was just joking!
lines.chinese: 喂喂！我开玩笑的！

lines.english: Don't make me cut ya!
lines.chinese: 别逼我动刀子！

lines.english: Tough guy, eh?
lines.chinese: 装硬汉是吧？

lines.english: All you rich folk is soft!
lines.chinese: 你们这些有钱人都弱爆了！

lines.english: I'm just trying to feed my family!
lines.chinese: 我不过是想养家糊口！

lines.english: I ain't so bad. I let you live, didn't I?
lines.chinese: 我够仁慈了，至少留你条命对吧？

lines.english: And on with the day's work, eh?
lines.chinese: 接着干今天的活儿，嗯？

lines.english: Still wanna play hero?
lines.chinese: 还想扮英雄？

lines.english: It's tough out here, okay?
lines.chinese: 这世道艰难懂不懂？

lines.english: Just gimme the gold!
lines.chinese: 把金子交出来！

lines.english: Look! I'm sorry, okay?
lines.chinese: 听着！我认错行了吧？

lines.english: No funny business!
lines.chinese: 别耍花招！

lines.english: Nothing personal, buddy!
lines.chinese: 别往心里去，兄弟！

lines.english: All right, hand it over.
lines.chinese: 好了，交出来吧。

lines.english: Destroy, devour. I just want to bake cakes.
lines.chinese: 毁灭，吞噬……其实我只想烤蛋糕。

lines.english: Ever since I used that space jelly in my donuts, I've felt... DIFFERENT.
lines.chinese: 自从在甜甜圈里加了太空果冻……我就变得……不一样了。

lines.english: Ooooh, fresh meat. Can we just be nice to them?
lines.chinese: 噢～新鲜肉排。我们能不能对他们友好点？

lines.english: You let them beat us! Why were we fighting?
lines.chinese: 你让他们打败了我们！我们为什么要打架？

lines.english: Sorry, it doesn't let me lose.
lines.chinese: 抱歉，是它不让我输的。

lines.english: Hey, hey, sorry. I'll make you a pie. I'LL MAKE YOU INTO A PIE!
lines.chinese: 嘿、嘿，对不起哦。我会给你做个派……我要把你做成派！

lines.english: This body, so weak!
lines.chinese: 这身体……太弱了！

lines.english: Sorry, did that hurt?
lines.chinese: 抱歉，弄疼你了吗？

lines.english: I'LL EAT THIS WORLD! I am a little hungry.
lines.chinese: 我要吃掉这个世界！……其实我有点饿了。

lines.english: There's something wrong with me. No, there isn't.
lines.chinese: 我有点不对劲……不，我很正常。

lines.english: I don't want to do this.
lines.chinese: 我不想这样的……

lines.english: It made me do that!
lines.chinese: 是它逼我做的！

lines.english: Stupid baker! Weakling!
lines.chinese: 蠢货面包师！废物！

lines.english: Yes! Devour!
lines.chinese: 对！吞噬他们！

lines.english: I don't feel so good. Pathetic. Fight harder.
lines.chinese: 我不太舒服……真可悲。狠狠捶打我吧。

lines.english: Welcome to my bakery. You look delicious.
lines.chinese: 欢迎来到我的面包房……你看上去很美味。

lines.english: Oh no, it's gonna punish me now.
lines.chinese: 糟了，它现在要惩罚我了……

lines.english: The secret ingredient is MURDER!
lines.chinese: 秘方就是……谋杀！

lines.english: We tread upon their bones. Respect them.
lines.chinese: 我们正踏在他们的骸骨上。保持敬畏。

lines.english: The green heart keeps its secrets, begone.
lines.chinese: 碧心守护着它的秘密，退下吧。

lines.english: I see beyond you, beyond everything, it's beautiful.
lines.chinese: 我望穿了你，望穿万物……真美啊。

lines.english: The Foundation calls across the universe. Many have answered.
lines.chinese: 基底在宇宙中呼唤。已有众多响应者。

lines.english: The stars flow through my veins. I am everything.
lines.chinese: 群星在我血脉中流淌。我即万物。

lines.english: If I cannot stop you, the Guardian will!
lines.chinese: 若我无法阻止你，守护者必将出手！

lines.english: The soil of the green heart is the bodies of my ancestors!
lines.chinese: 碧心之土塑造了我先祖的躯体！

lines.english: Guardian! Do not let them pass!
lines.chinese: 守护者！别让他们通过！

lines.english: Return in humility and respect, and the relics may choose you.
lines.chinese: 怀着谦卑与敬意归来，圣物或许会选中你。

lines.english: I sink through the stars, the colors cast me out.
lines.chinese: 我在群星间沉沦，斑斓之色将我放逐。

lines.english: Return to your city! Let the ancients rest!
lines.chinese: 滚回你们的城市！让先民安息！

lines.english: The Green Heart is a living tomb! You disturb its spirits!
lines.chinese: 碧心是活体墓冢！你在惊扰其中英灵！

lines.english: Civilizations rise, and hubris tears them down. Will you not learn?
lines.chinese: 文明因傲慢崛起，亦因此崩塌。你们还不吸取教训吗？

lines.english: My people are forgotten. I am all that remains.
lines.chinese: 我的族人已被遗忘。唯我尚存。

lines.english: I am the last of my people, I stand as their memorial.
lines.chinese: 我是族裔最后的血脉，我即他们的丰碑。

lines.english: Your relics are not yours, they will not serve you!
lines.chinese: 那些遗物不属于你，它们不会为你效力！

lines.english: I have saved you from greater pain. The Guardian is not so gentle.
lines.chinese: 我让你免遭更大痛苦。守护者可没这么仁慈。

lines.english: Return to the Bazaar! Tell them what happened to you here!
lines.chinese: 滚回大巴扎去！告诉他们你在此地的遭遇！

lines.english: The Foundation is beyond time! You are not the first to claim it!
lines.chinese: 基底超脱时间！你并非首个妄图占有它的人！

lines.english: My people are gone, but I carry their spirits. Leave us!
lines.chinese: 族人虽逝，我承载着他们的魂灵。离开我们！

lines.english: Hello?
lines.chinese: 有人吗？

lines.english: I have so much new stuff to show you!
lines.chinese: 我有好多新东西要给你看！

lines.english: I'm sure you sailors know how to use that.
lines.chinese: 你们这些水手肯定知道怎么用这个吧。

lines.english: I hope you use that to defeat the Tyrant King!
lines.chinese: 希望你用它打败暴君国王！

lines.english: Ahem! May the tides bring you back!
lines.chinese: 咳咳！愿潮汐带你回来！

lines.english: And that gate back to Pelago? Like, who put that here?
lines.chinese: 那个回佩拉戈的传送门？到底是谁放这儿的？

lines.english: Swim away, then. Or, uh, walk away?
lines.chinese: 那就游走吧。呃……或者用走的？

lines.english: Scrape off the barnacles. Good as new.
lines.chinese: 把藤壶刮掉就跟新的一样啦。

lines.english: A little ocean just floating in the stars. Kinda cute. Kinda scary.
lines.chinese: 一小片海洋飘在星星中间。有点可爱，也有点吓人。

lines.english: I'm sure you'll still win, even without my treasures.
lines.chinese: 就算没有我的宝贝，你也一定能赢。

lines.english: If you find it in the sea, that means it's treasure!
lines.chinese: 海里捡到的都算宝贝！

lines.english: Really? I thought for sure you'd like these.
lines.chinese: 真的吗？我还以为你肯定会喜欢这些呢。

lines.english: Just see where the sea takes you. Ah! See the sea! That's fun.
lines.chinese: 随波逐流就好。啊！看海！多有意思。

lines.english: Little Secret, you're the only air breather I like.
lines.chinese: 小秘密，你是我唯一喜欢的陆地生物。

lines.english: Those ribbons in your hair look like seaweed. So cute.
lines.chinese: 你头发上的丝带像海藻一样，真可爱。

lines.english: Yay, it's my favorite air breather!
lines.chinese: 耶！是我最爱的陆地朋友！

lines.english: You ever get homesick for Pelago? I do. But it's exciting here!
lines.chinese: 你会想家吗？我会想佩拉戈。不过这里也很刺激！

lines.english: This belonged to a great Sea King! I mean, probably.
lines.chinese: 这可是某位海之王的遗物！大概吧。

lines.english: Ah, feels nice to just lie there and float for a while.
lines.chinese: 啊~躺着随波漂浮最舒服了。

lines.english: All of this is like a gift from the sea! Or something.
lines.chinese: 这些可都是大海的馈赠！大概吧。

lines.english: The Seagate place is strange, right?
lines.chinese: 海门那个地方挺奇怪的，对吧？

lines.english: Actually, you probably shouldn't sleep underwater. Forgot you have to breathe.
lines.chinese: 差点忘了你们要呼吸，其实不该在水里睡觉的。

lines.english: You're, like, really quiet. Did you forget about breathing, too?
lines.chinese: 你也太安静了吧……该不会也忘记呼吸了？

lines.english: You don't want the whirly thing? Or the clanger?
lines.chinese: 不要这个转转玩意儿？那个叮当响的也不要？

lines.english: You ever try taking a nap underwater?
lines.chinese: 你试过在水里打盹吗？

lines.english: Thank you!
lines.chinese: 谢谢惠顾！

lines.english: You know there's no ground on the bottom? Swim too far down and you'll fall right out.
lines.chinese: 知道海底没有地面吗？游太深会直接掉出去哦。

lines.english: This Bazaar, dangerous, like Azaka. Maybe more.
lines.chinese: 这大巴扎啊，危险得很，跟阿扎卡似的。说不定更糟。

lines.english: Your mother and father, they would be so proud!
lines.chinese: 你爹妈要是看见，该多骄傲啊！

lines.english: Eh, maybe none are too old to understand, but still proud of you.
lines.chinese: 唉，老太婆是搞不懂这些，但照样为你骄傲。

lines.english: You try to do so much, dear, I wish you slow down.
lines.chinese: 小祖宗哟，别总忙得脚不沾地，慢点儿。

lines.english: Good! You finally sit with Nonna! Have tea!
lines.chinese: 好！你总算肯陪农娜坐下了！喝茶！

lines.english: Oh, dear granddaughter, how is life in big city?
lines.chinese: 哎哟我的乖孙女，大城市日子过得咋样？

lines.english: Eat cookie, drink tea, talk of life, yes?
lines.chinese: 吃饼干喝茶，唠唠家常，好不好？

lines.english: Yes, yes, you famous chef, but you not know everything.
lines.chinese: 是是是，大厨神也有不懂的嘛。

lines.english: Bake cookies? Dodge bullets? What's your nana teach you today?
lines.chinese: 今天奶奶要教啥？烤饼干还是躲子弹？

lines.english: Oh, so many jobs, so many adventures. You forget you have daughter?
lines.chinese: 哟，又是任务又是冒险的，还记得自己有个闺女不？

lines.english: But now, I see Laurel. I see you. I thank him every day.
lines.chinese: 可现在看着劳蕾尔和你，我天天都谢他。

lines.english: When your Pata say he make deal to save Ashelek, I not believe him, but here we are.
lines.chinese: 当年你爸说要做交易救阿什莱克，我还不信呢。

lines.english: Laurel get in fight at school today. Wonder where she gets this. Hm?
lines.chinese: 劳蕾尔今儿在学校打架了，这暴脾气随谁呢？嗯？

lines.english: When your Nonna young, she win many fights. You don't believe?
lines.chinese: 农娜年轻时打架可没输过，不信？

lines.english: It's not good run around busy all day. You must rest.
lines.chinese: 整天东奔西跑的哪行，得歇歇。

lines.english: This is good place, this Bazaar. Many dangers, like Azaka, but good.
lines.chinese: 这大巴扎是个好地方，虽说跟阿扎卡一样危险重重。

lines.english: Your Nonna still has much to teach.
lines.chinese: 农娜还有的是本事没教你呢。

lines.english: When he say his life for all Ashelek, I not sure it good bargain.
lines.chinese: 他说要用命换整个阿什莱克时，我就觉着这买卖不划算。

lines.english: I raise you strong. You raise Laurel strong. When my time to go, I go happy.
lines.chinese: 我把你拉扯大，你把劳蕾尔拉扯大。哪天我走了，也安心。

lines.english: You see, even Big Chef can learn new recipe.
lines.chinese: 瞧见没，大厨神也得学新菜谱。

lines.english: Ah, so you fight these others, you win this gold, and... life get better?
lines.chinese: 啊，打赢那些人，赚到金子……日子就会好起来？

lines.english: You leave so soon? Not even tea with Nonna, eh?
lines.chinese: 这就走？连茶都不陪农娜喝？

lines.english: I hate to take your money, but maybe fair pay for teacher, nanny and maid.
lines.chinese: 拿你钱怪不好意思的，可当老师保姆佣人总得收点儿。

lines.english: I take good care of Laurel, but she need her mother.
lines.chinese: 劳蕾尔我照顾得好好的，可她需要妈妈呀。

lines.english: You come to learn Nonna's famous recipes, eh?
lines.chinese: 来学农娜的独门配方啦？

lines.english: I hear the Annexian Municipality is great at organizing resources. Sometimes I wish they'd annex us!
lines.chinese: 我听说统合自治领特别擅长组织资源。有时候我还真希望他们来吞并我们！

lines.english: I'm done here. Troopers, clean it up.
lines.chinese: 我完事了。士兵们，收拾残局吧。

lines.english: You must be a member of the Bazaarian Defense Corps. How many members do they have, by the way?
lines.chinese: 你一定是大巴扎防卫队的人吧。顺便问一句，他们到底有多少成员？

lines.english: Nice weather, isn't it? By the way, do you think the Bazaar is vulnerable to foreign invasion?
lines.chinese: 天气不错，对吧？顺便问问，你觉得大巴扎容易遭到外敌入侵吗？

lines.english: Annexian Municipality? Never heard of it. But they do have some interesting policies.
lines.chinese: 统合自治领？没听说过。不过他们确实有些很有意思的政策。

lines.english: Admin, I'm compromised. Requesting transfer to Polago.
lines.chinese: 长官，我暴露了。请求调往波拉戈。

lines.english: I'm just a loyal Bazaarian, doing what's best for, uh, Bizaria.
lines.chinese: 我只是个忠诚的大巴扎人，一心为了，呃，比扎里亚好。

lines.english: Nice day, but you know what could make it even better? The efficient policies of the Annexian Municipality.
lines.chinese: 好天气，不过你知道什么能让今天更好吗？统合自治领的高效政策。

lines.english: Would you say the average Bazaarian is as weak as you? Weaker.
lines.chinese: 你觉得普通大巴扎人都像你这么弱吗？还是更弱？

lines.english: I just love living in the great nation of the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 我可太爱住在大巴扎这个伟大国度里了。

lines.english: Instead of taking care of our neighbors, what if we paid a few rich people to do it?
lines.chinese: 与其我们自己照顾邻居，花钱雇几个富豪来做怎么样？

lines.english: Thanks for that discussion of Bazaarian society. I gained so much intel. I mean, insight.
lines.chinese: 感谢你和我讨论大巴扎社会。我获得了好多情报。我是说，见解。

lines.english: It's so great that we're an independent city-state, but sometimes I wonder if there's a better way.
lines.chinese: 我们是独立城邦当然很棒……不过有时我会想，会不会还有更好的办法。

lines.english: Those are nice weapons! Does the Bazaarian Defense Corps have those?
lines.chinese: 这些武器不错！大巴扎防卫队也有这种装备吗？

lines.english: Now that we trust each other, I'd like to ask you a few questions.
lines.chinese: 既然我们彼此信任了，我想问你几个问题。

lines.english: By the way, you know who built this Foundation thing? They're not coming back, are they?
lines.chinese: 顺便问一句，你知道这个基底是谁建的吗？他们不会回来了吧？

lines.english: Great talking to you, fellow Bazaarian. You didn't reveal any state secrets.
lines.chinese: 聊得很愉快，大巴扎同胞。你没有泄露任何国家机密。

lines.english: I hear the Bazaar has no formal military. Is it all just people like you?
lines.chinese: 我听说大巴扎没有正规军。全靠你这种人吗？

lines.english: What a great day to reconsider your stance on Annexian social systems!
lines.chinese: 今天真适合重新考虑你对统合自治领社会制度的立场！

lines.english: Hello, fellow Bazaarian. Heard anything interesting or subversive lately?
lines.chinese: 你好，大巴扎同胞。最近听说什么有趣或者颠覆性的事了吗？

lines.english: Let us meditate a while.
lines.chinese: 让我们冥想片刻。

lines.english: The Bazaar is a rabid beast. Be its master.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎是头狂兽。成为它的主人。

lines.english: You possess the patience for my teachings.
lines.chinese: 你有修习我教义的耐心。

lines.english: My skills are not weapons! A blade can prune a garden.
lines.chinese: 我的技艺不是武器！利刃亦可修剪花园。

lines.english: You must become like the butterfly, but you are like the mosquito.
lines.chinese: 你该如蝴蝶般超然，却像蚊虫般浮躁。

lines.english: Stillness. Quiet. A rarity in this place.
lines.chinese: 静默。安宁。在此地实属罕见。

lines.english: I do not teach violence, I teach mastery over it.
lines.chinese: 我不传授暴力，我传授驾驭暴力之道。

lines.english: Empty yourself of all thoughts, be only your body.
lines.chinese: 放空杂念，唯存肉身。

lines.english: If you are ready to learn, I am ready to teach.
lines.chinese: 若你准备好学习，我便准备好传授。

lines.english: If you seek the violent path, Aila is your teacher.
lines.chinese: 若你追寻暴力之道，爱伊拉才是你的老师。

lines.english: I care little for gold. Your enlightenment is my reward.
lines.chinese: 黄金于我无益。你的顿悟才是我的回报。

lines.english: As long as you draw breath, your training is not complete.
lines.chinese: 只要一息尚存，修行便未完成。

lines.english: My patience is a deep pool. You will never reach the bottom.
lines.chinese: 我的耐心如深潭，你永远探不到底。

lines.english: You have at least a grain of wisdom, since you have come to me.
lines.chinese: 既来寻我，你至少有一丝慧根。

lines.english: You must first defeat your doubt.
lines.chinese: 你须先战胜心中疑虑。

lines.english: This world is full of noise, you must find the quiet within.
lines.chinese: 世间喧嚣，你须寻得内心宁静。

lines.english: I sense much uncertainty in you.
lines.chinese: 我感知到你心绪纷乱。

lines.english: Yes, my student.
lines.chinese: 说吧，弟子。

lines.english: Experience his treasure. I will share mine with you.
lines.chinese: 体悟他的珍宝。我亦将我的分享与你。

lines.english: When you are ready, you will return.
lines.chinese: 待你准备好时，自会归来。

lines.english: My lessons are painful. Are you prepared?
lines.chinese: 我的课程充满痛苦。你准备好了吗？

lines.english: Is this the Buzzing Fly technique from the Annoying Children's School?
lines.chinese: 这莫非是烦人童子学院的嗡嗡蝇技法？

lines.english: You have great potential. Let me train you.
lines.chinese: 你潜力非凡。让我来训练你。

lines.english: Sink into the stillness, become one.
lines.chinese: 沉入静寂，合而为一。

lines.english: What, what? Ah! Ah! I see you have mastered stillness!
lines.chinese: 什么？啊！啊！看来你已掌握静心之道！

lines.english: Is there anything particular you're looking for or do you just like to, uh, look?
lines.chinese: 您正在寻找什么特别的东西，或者您只是想，呃，看看吗？

lines.english: Hey, I use that brand myself. Quality stuff.
lines.chinese: 嘿嘿，我自己就用这个牌子的。这可是好东西。

lines.english: It's always that tool you thought you'd never need that ends up saving your butt!
lines.chinese: 往往就是你以为永远用不上的那件工具，最后救了你一命！

lines.english: Hey man, take your time. I know there's a lot going on here.
lines.chinese: 嘿伙计，慢慢来。我知道这里发生了很多事情。

lines.english: They wanted me to sit at a desk and move money around. Aw man, they can keep it.
lines.chinese: 他们想让我每天在电脑前倒腾钱，得了吧，这种活儿还是留给别人吧。

lines.english: I've got family connections I could pull, but that ain't the life for me.
lines.chinese: 我有可以拉动的家庭关系，但这不是我的生活。

lines.english: I like workin' my hands raw, goin' to bed drained, feels right.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢双手劳作，筋疲力尽地上床睡觉，这种感觉很好。

lines.english: I've got everything you need to do anything you want.
lines.chinese: 我拥有你做任何你想做的事情所需的一切。

lines.english: Ooh, I saved that one from Curio's junkyard. Cleaned up real nice.
lines.chinese: 哦，我从库里欧的垃圾场把那玩意抢救回来，清理得干干净净的。

lines.english: I love this stuff so much, I'm almost happy when you don't buy it.
lines.chinese: 我非常喜欢这个东西，当你不买它时我几乎很高兴。

lines.english: I'm gonna catch up on some shop work, just give me a holler if you've got a question.
lines.chinese: 我要去忙一些商店工作，如果你有问题就给我问。

lines.english: It's okay to just browse, it's research.
lines.chinese: 只是看看也没事的，就当做是调研。

lines.english: A faulty saw cost me my arm, the last time I ever went cheap on tools.
lines.chinese: 上次我买便宜的工具时，一把有问题的锯子害了我一条胳膊。

lines.english: I get new stock every day, maybe next time.
lines.chinese: 我每天都会收到新货，也许下一次。

lines.english: A bucket saved my life once. You just never know.
lines.chinese: 有一次，水桶救了我的命。你从来不知道这事。

lines.english: A bad craftsman blames his tools, but a good one buys mine.
lines.chinese: 一个糟糕的工匠会责备他的工具，但一个好的工匠会购买我的工具。

lines.english: Did I see you checking out that ZXT ratchet? Great for 4D calibrating.
lines.chinese: 我看到你在检查 ZXT 棘轮了吗？非常适合 4D 校准。

lines.english: Bet you'll be surprised when that comes in handy.
lines.chinese: 我打赌当它派上用场时你会感到惊讶。

lines.english: Maybe you've already got what you need. No pressure here.
lines.chinese: 也许你已经得到了你需要的东西。放轻松点。

lines.english: Honestly, I don't need this work. I just love tools, man.
lines.chinese: 老实说，我不需要这份工作。我只是喜欢工具，伙计。

lines.english: Heard one of my relatives made the same move. Wonder if we'll ever meet.
lines.chinese: 听说我的一位亲戚也做出了同样的举动，那我不知道我们是否还能再见了。

lines.english: Our tools, weapons? Well, that's up to you.
lines.chinese: 我们的工具、武器？好吧，这取决于你。

lines.english: Not the DIY type, huh? Guess you could always pay for repairs.
lines.chinese: 不喜欢自己DIY？那你总还能花钱修嘛。

lines.english: So, I'm gonna go on lunch. Feel free to hang around, but I do have security turrets.
lines.chinese: 那么，我要去吃午饭了。随意闲逛，但我确实有安全炮塔。

lines.english: See ya!
lines.chinese: 再见！

lines.english: Some engineers fix things. I make the things they fix things with.
lines.chinese: 工程师修理东西，而我制造他们用来修理东西的东西。

lines.english: What's up? Come on in.
lines.chinese: 这是怎么回事？进来吧。

lines.english: You learn skills quickly, but it takes patience to master them.
lines.chinese: 你学习技能很快，但需要耐心才能掌握它们。

lines.english: Our journey from Felis was long, and I came to love all these others like my kittens.
lines.chinese: 我们从费利斯出发的旅程很长，我开始像爱我的小猫一样爱所有这些其他人。

lines.english: I have seen such talent once before, and it bloomed into Adira.
lines.chinese: 这样的天赋我曾经见过一次，绽放成艾迪拉。

lines.english: Pip is very young, but he surprises me with his wisdom.
lines.chinese: 皮普很年轻，但他的智慧让我惊讶。

lines.english: Adira would pretend to meditate when in fact he was asleep. Terrible student! And yet...
lines.chinese: 艾迪拉会假装冥想，而实际上他已经睡着了。可怕的学生！然而……

lines.english: Soon I think you will be ready for Adira's training.
lines.chinese: 我想你很快就能准备好接受艾迪拉的训练了。

lines.english: All wisdom has power, but not all power has wisdom.
lines.chinese: 所有的智慧都有力量，但并非所有的力量都有智慧。

lines.english: Adira is powerful, though there is one skill he may never master, humility.
lines.chinese: 艾迪拉很强大，尽管他可能永远无法掌握一项技能，那就是谦逊。

lines.english: Nufu seems wise, but he may only seem so.
lines.chinese: 努夫看起来很聪明，但他可能只是看起来如此。

lines.english: I would promise to be here when you're ready, but I am very old.
lines.chinese: 我保证当你准备好时我会来这里，但我已经很老了。

lines.english: When I was your age, I could not be so silent. Perhaps your wisdom is greater.
lines.chinese: 当我像你这个年纪的时候，我不可能这么沉默。也许你的智慧更大。

lines.english: I do not teach. I help you discover for yourself.
lines.chinese: 我不负责灌输。我只是帮你自己领悟。

lines.english: Even if they don't come from me, your lessons will find you.
lines.chinese: 即使它们不是来自我，你的课程也会找到你。

lines.english: Why does Nufu set himself apart? We Sphinxians must work together.
lines.chinese: 努夫为何与众不同？我们斯芬克斯人必须共同努力。

lines.english: Argenta's way is light, but she is serious about her craft, and she has much to teach.
lines.chinese: 阿根塔的方式很轻松，但她对自己的手艺很认真，而且她有很多东西可以教。

lines.english: Every coin goes back to our community. We Sphinxians thank you.
lines.chinese: 每一枚硬币都会回到我们的社区。我们斯芬克斯人谢谢你。

lines.english: I will not train you to kill. I will train you to live.
lines.chinese: 我不会训练你杀人。我会训练你生活。

lines.english: I am not a warrior. I am just a man who has lived a long time.
lines.chinese: 我不是战士。我只是一个活了很久的人。

lines.english: I too was once young and impatient. I understand.
lines.chinese: 我也曾经年轻过，缺乏耐心。我明白。

lines.english: If not today, tomorrow. If not this life, the next.
lines.chinese: 如果今天不行，明天也行。若今生不成，则下辈子。

lines.english: Adira has surpassed me in power, but he can never surpass me in years.
lines.chinese: 艾迪拉在力量上超越了我，但在岁月上他永远无法超越我。

lines.english: Good. All training begins with stillness.
lines.chinese: 好的。所有的训练都是从静止开始的。

lines.english: Nufu though, why does he live alone in that dojo, and how can you trust one who hides his true age?
lines.chinese: 努夫，为什么他一个人住在那个道场，你怎么能相信一个隐瞒真实年龄的人呢？

lines.english: Very well, I will meditate on our purpose in this strange and wondrous place.
lines.chinese: 很好，我会在这个陌生而奇妙的地方思考我们的目的。

lines.english: It is perhaps not wise to waste time with such an old teacher, hmm?
lines.chinese: 在这样的老老师身上浪费时间或许不太明智，嗯？

lines.english: We pluck the fruit before it rots.
lines.chinese: 我们在水果腐烂之前将其采摘。

lines.english: The desert has no mercy.
lines.chinese: 沙漠没有怜悯。

lines.english: Perhaps we struck the wrong caravan!
lines.chinese: 也许我们撞错了商队！

lines.english: You have the metal to be a dervish!
lines.chinese: 你有成为旋舞者的胆魄！

lines.english: We do not fear you!
lines.chinese: 我们不怕你！

lines.english: The Lord of the Wastes would like you.
lines.chinese: 荒原之主会喜欢你。

lines.english: The Bazaar has not softened you!
lines.chinese: 大巴扎并没有软化你！

lines.english: Another fool with too much gold!
lines.chinese: 又一个拥有太多黄金的傻瓜！

lines.english: No.
lines.chinese: 不。

lines.english: Do not test the dervish!
lines.chinese: 别试探旋舞者！

lines.english: Dervishes, strike like a sandstorm!
lines.chinese: 旋舞者们，像沙尘暴一样出击！

lines.english: Pierce like a cactus!
lines.chinese: 像仙人掌一样刺穿！

lines.english: For the Lord of the Wastes!
lines.chinese: 为了荒原之主！

lines.english: Sting like a scorpion!
lines.chinese: 像蝎子一样蜇人！

lines.english: We are not thieves, we are plunderers.
lines.chinese: 我们不是小偷，我们是掠夺者。

lines.english: The dunes favor you, Inlander.
lines.chinese: 沙丘对你有利，内陆人。

lines.english: You wither like a flower in the desert.
lines.chinese: 你就像沙漠里的花朵一样枯萎。

lines.english: We scorch like the desert sun.
lines.chinese: 我们像沙漠里的太阳一样灼热。

lines.english: The Outlands demand strength, and we have it.
lines.chinese: 荒原需要力量，而我们有力量。

lines.english: The Bazaar is an overripe fruit.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎是一个烂熟的果实。

lines.english: Inlanders. Plump and pampered as babies.
lines.chinese: 内陆人。像婴儿一样丰满和娇嫩。

lines.english: Then we learn, become same.
lines.chinese: 然后我们学习，变得一样。

lines.english: Not many left. We gone soon.
lines.chinese: 剩下的不多了。我们很快就会消失。

lines.english: World good, world food.
lines.chinese: 世界好。世界是食物。

lines.english: Achoo!
lines.chinese: 啊呼！

lines.english: I return home now, to the place.
lines.chinese: 我现在回到家，回到那个地方。

lines.english: Eat prey, life good.
lines.chinese: 吃猎物，生活美好。

lines.english: You prey? Hehehehehe.
lines.chinese: 你是猎物？嘿嘿嘿嘿。

lines.english: Hunt, kill, eat, happy.
lines.chinese: 狩猎、杀戮、进食，快乐。

lines.english: No more fight self. I am... WHOLE!
lines.chinese: 不再和自己打了。我……完整了！

lines.english: One of us food, we find out.
lines.chinese: 我们发现，我们其中之一的食物。

lines.english: Man say no, when say yes. Always argue.
lines.chinese: 男人说不，当说是。总是争论。

lines.english: City never find us.
lines.chinese: 城市永远找不到我们。

lines.english: Blood bright. Good health.
lines.chinese: 血色明亮。身体健康。

lines.english: We shall hunt together, but angry.
lines.chinese: 我们将一起打猎，但会生气。

lines.english: I'll play weak. Fight end quick!
lines.chinese: 我会表现得很弱。战斗快结束吧！

lines.english: Long time, two voices in head.
lines.chinese: 脑袋里两个声音，吵了很久。

lines.english: Alive. Strong. Happy.
lines.chinese: 活。强的。快乐的。

lines.english: Prey strong. Good fight!
lines.chinese: 猎物强。好打！

lines.english: Imbeciles!
lines.chinese: 白痴！

lines.english: Go stand in the corner and think about your behavior!
lines.chinese: 站在角落里想想你的行为！

lines.english: If you have no respect for education, I must beat it into you!
lines.chinese: 如果你不尊重教育，我一定要狠狠地打你一顿！

lines.english: That'll teach you! No pun intended, of course, as puns are the lowest form of wit.
lines.chinese: 那会教你的！当然，这并不是双关语，因为双关语是机智的最低形式。

lines.english: Oh, whatever. I don't get paid enough for this.
lines.chinese: 哦，无论如何。我为此得到的报酬不够。

lines.english: The Bazaar is falling into ignorance! Someone has to slow the decline!
lines.chinese: 大巴扎陷入无知！必须有人减缓衰退！

lines.english: Someone just earned a lot of extra homework.
lines.chinese: 有人刚刚赚了很多额外的作业。

lines.english: You wretched hooligans are distracting my students!
lines.chinese: 你们这些卑鄙的流氓正在扰乱我的学生们的注意力！

lines.english: Fighting? Looting? Accumulating wealth? You call that heroism?
lines.chinese: 斗争？抢劫？积累财富？你管这叫英雄主义？

lines.english: There's more to life than weapons and gold! Education expands your mind.
lines.chinese: 生命中除了武器和黄金还有更多东西！教育可以拓展你的思维。

lines.english: The Bazaar is a festering boil of ignorance, and I am the lance.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎是无知溃烂的脓包，而我就是刺破它的长矛。

lines.english: Quiet! I need quiet in my class!
lines.chinese: 安静的！我的课堂需要安静！

lines.english: Well! Say goodbye to your letter of recommendation!
lines.chinese: 出色地！和你的推荐信说再见吧！

lines.english: You're not in my class. Everyone is in my class!
lines.chinese: 你不在我的班级。大家都在我的班上！

lines.english: Teachers are the only heroes here. We fight the deadliest monster of all: ignorance.
lines.chinese: 老师是这里唯一的英雄。我们与最致命的怪物作斗争：无知。

lines.english: You may have won the debate, but you have made several grammatical errors.
lines.chinese: 你可能赢得了辩论，但你犯了一些语法错误。

lines.english: The youth think they'll all grow up to be heroes, like you, so they hardly apply themselves.
lines.chinese: 年轻人认为他们长大后都会像你一样成为英雄，所以他们很难努力。

lines.english: I am not pedantic! I am a delightful person out with whom to hang.
lines.chinese: 我才不迂腐！我是个非常适合一起消遣的可爱人物。

lines.english: How dare you!
lines.chinese: 你怎么敢！

lines.english: Well then, I hope you've learned your lesson, so to speak.
lines.chinese: 那么，可以这么说，我希望你已经吸取了教训。

lines.english: My students are failing because of you, filling their heads with daydreams of adventure.
lines.chinese: 我的学生们因为你而失败，他们的脑子里充满了冒险的白日梦。

lines.english: Heroes? What nonsense! What heroics have you ever done?
lines.chinese: 英雄？胡说八道！你曾经做过什么英雄事迹？

lines.english: Outrageous!
lines.chinese: 太令人愤慨了！

lines.english: I'll get through this, I'll get through this, I'll get through you!
lines.chinese: 我能撑过去，我能撑过去，我也能从你身上打过去！

lines.english: Look, not everyone can be a hero, okay? Some of us need jobs.
lines.chinese: 听着，不是每个人都能成为英雄，好吗？我们中的一些人需要工作。

lines.english: Sorry. I'm so sorry. I'm, like, really stressed out.
lines.chinese: 对不起。我很抱歉。我真的压力很大。

lines.english: Oh no! Are you okay? I didn't mean to, like, defeat you!
lines.chinese: 哦不！你还好吗？我并不是故意要打败你！

lines.english: If I could just sleep for one hour. Hey, can you knock me out?
lines.chinese: 如果我能睡一小时就好了。嘿，你能把我打倒吗？

lines.english: I'm sorry, it's these energy drinks. I like, uh, don't even know where I am right now.
lines.chinese: 抱歉，是这些能量饮料。我喜欢，呃，甚至不知道我现在在哪里。

lines.english: Can I just peek at your notes? Please?
lines.chinese: 我可以看一下你的笔记吗？请？

lines.english: I just have so many classes, and so much homework, and so much RAGE!
lines.chinese: 我有这么多的课程，这么多的作业，还有这么多的愤怒！

lines.english: When the Municipality annexes the Bazaar, my degree will be worthless anyway! Ugh!
lines.chinese: 等市政当局吞并了大巴扎，我的学位无论如何也就不值钱了！啊!

lines.english: Why am I even in school? The world's gonna end any day now.
lines.chinese: 为什么我还在学校？世界随时都会终结。

lines.english: Did she send you? Tell her I can't take anymore!
lines.chinese: 她派你来的吗？告诉她我再也受不了了！

lines.english: I hate this city. I should just go join the dervishes or something.
lines.chinese: 我讨厌这座城市。我应该去加入旋舞者什么的。

lines.english: Sleep? Like, what even is that?
lines.chinese: 睡觉？就像，那到底是什么？

lines.english: Like, the Municipality will annex us, or the Foundation will flip over and dump us into space. Whatever.
lines.chinese: 就像，市政当局将吞并我们，或者基底会翻转并将我们扔进太空。任何。

lines.english: I'm trying to study here. Can you please, like, die?
lines.chinese: 我正在努力在这里学习。拜托你可以去死吗？

lines.english: And rent is so expensive in the Arcane District. I have ten roommates and I barely get by.
lines.chinese: 而且奥术区的房租又那么贵。我有十个室友，但我勉强度日。

lines.english: And when I finally get my degree, I just know something bad will happen the next day.
lines.chinese: 当我最终获得学位时，我只知道第二天会发生一些不好的事情。

lines.english: Wait! You're not my teacher! Wow. I'm literally hallucinating.
lines.chinese: 等待！你不是我的老师！哇。我真的产生了幻觉。

lines.english: No! No more assignments! Please!
lines.chinese: 不！没有更多的任务！请！

lines.english: I want to be an alchemist, but all the great masters expect a master's degree.
lines.chinese: 我想成为一名炼金术士，但所有伟大的大师都期望获得硕士学位。

lines.english: Hey, you're a natural at this.
lines.chinese: 嘿，你在这方面是天生的。

lines.english: Every night, I dream about what might be in there. It's the ultimate locked chest.
lines.chinese: 每天晚上，我都会梦见里面有什么。这是终极的上锁箱子。

lines.english: That belongs in a museum, but I guess you can keep it.
lines.chinese: 那东西属于博物馆，但我想你可以保留它。

lines.english: What could possibly be more exciting than digging a hole?
lines.chinese: 还有什么比挖洞更令人兴奋的呢？

lines.english: You look like a hardy one. Need some work?
lines.chinese: 你看起来像个坚强的人。需要一些工作吗？

lines.english: We know so little about the Outlands. What else could be down there?
lines.chinese: 我们对荒原知之甚少。下面还能有什么？

lines.english: That's the spirit!
lines.chinese: 这就是精神！

lines.english: Yes, let's keep digging. There's always more to find.
lines.chinese: 是的，让我们继续挖掘。总是有更多的东西有待发现。

lines.english: Hope you packed a change of clothes, because you're going to get dirty.
lines.chinese: 希望你带上换洗衣服，因为你会弄脏的。

lines.english: We've barely scratched the surface of the Outlands.
lines.chinese: 我们仅仅触及了荒原的表面。

lines.english: Quitting already? We are barely a hundred feet deep.
lines.chinese: 已经退出了吗？我们的深度只有一百英尺。

lines.english: I know, right? What else could be down there?
lines.chinese: 我知道，对吧？下面还能有什么？

lines.english: You're curious, just like me.
lines.chinese: 你和我一样好奇。

lines.english: I guess not everyone is born for the dirt.
lines.chinese: 我想并不是每个人都是为泥土而生的。

lines.english: That looks like... the Cretaceous era?
lines.chinese: 看起来像是……白垩纪时代？

lines.english: Magnificent find!
lines.chinese: 伟大的发现！

lines.english: Oh, a break? I don't take those myself.
lines.chinese: 噢，休息一下？我自己不接受这些。

lines.english: Imagine the wonders waiting for us in the ground.
lines.chinese: 想象一下地下有什么奇迹在等待着我们。

lines.english: Under that, it is the Foundation. Hundreds of miles of solid... something.
lines.chinese: 再往下，就是基底。数百英里厚的固体……某种东西。

lines.english: It's almost like gambling, but you can't lose.
lines.chinese: 这几乎就像赌博，但你不能输。

lines.english: My friends tell me I work too hard. Well, they would if I had any.
lines.chinese: 我的朋友告诉我，我工作太努力了。好吧，如果我有的话他们会的。

lines.english: There's just so much to discover out here, I can't stand it!
lines.chinese: 这里有太多值得探索的东西，我无法忍受！

lines.english: I tried digging in the Bazaar once. Turns out the soil is only ten feet deep.
lines.chinese: 我曾经尝试在大巴扎挖掘过一次。原来土壤只有十英尺深。

lines.english: Who were the people who left these things behind?
lines.chinese: 留下这些东西的人是谁？

lines.english: How can you just stop?
lines.chinese: 你怎么能停下来呢？

lines.english: You wore out your shovel! I'll fetch you a fresh one!
lines.chinese: 你的铲子用完了！我去给你拿一份新鲜的！

lines.english: Yataria? The Dunes? Where shall we start?
lines.chinese: 亚塔利亚？沙丘？我们从哪里开始呢？

lines.english: I love a digger who wants to keep digging.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢一个想要继续挖掘的挖掘者。

lines.english: But you don't even have dirt in your ears yet.
lines.chinese: 但你的耳朵里还没有污垢。

lines.english: I'm saving to buy a speedrunner! They have so many games!
lines.chinese: 我正在攒钱买一个速跑者！他们的游戏真多啊！

lines.english: My dad was in Sky Patrol. Well, now he sells cars, but Sky Patrol!
lines.chinese: 我爸爸在空巡队。好吧，现在他卖的是汽车，但是空巡队！

lines.english: Do you play Piggles? I'm not very good, but it's fun!
lines.chinese: 你玩小圆猪吗？我不是很好，但是很有趣！

lines.english: I don't even want to sell them, but I want that speedrunner!
lines.chinese: 我甚至不想卖掉它们，但我想要那个速跑者！

lines.english: He doesn't really get what kids are into, but I still think he's cool.
lines.chinese: 他不太了解孩子们喜欢什么，但我仍然认为他很酷。

lines.english: Maybe we could go flying sometime, if my dad says it's okay.
lines.chinese: 如果我爸爸同意的话，也许我们可以找个时间去坐飞机。

lines.english: Ahem. Have a nice day! Did that sound professional?
lines.chinese: 咳咳。祝你今天过得愉快！听起来专业吗？

lines.english: I love flying, but I'm scared to go far from home, so I just go straight up.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢飞行，但我害怕离家很远，所以我就直接飞上去。

lines.english: That is too small, Pinny. Nobody could fit in that. It is a drone, Dad!
lines.chinese: 那太小了，平尼。没有人能适应这一点。这是一架无人机，爸爸！

lines.english: I'm the only kid in my school with my very own business!
lines.chinese: 我是学校里唯一有自己生意的孩子！

lines.english: My dad doesn't get why I spend all day building these, but he's the greatest.
lines.chinese: 我爸爸不明白为什么我要花一整天时间建造这些，但他是最伟大的。

lines.english: I'm gonna go get my dad. He'll know what to do.
lines.chinese: 我要去接我爸爸。他会知道该怎么做。

lines.english: Oh man, that one's so good!
lines.chinese: 噢，伙计，那太好了！

lines.english: You've been quiet a really long time. Are you okay?
lines.chinese: 你已经沉默了好久了。你还好吗？

lines.english: You didn't like those? Well, okay.
lines.chinese: 你不喜欢那些？好吧，好吧。

lines.english: So many species can't fly. Why would nature do that to them?
lines.chinese: 很多物种都不会飞。大自然为什么要这样对他们？

lines.english: I love flying, and making things that fly, and making things that make things fly!
lines.chinese: 我喜欢飞行，喜欢制作会飞的东西，喜欢制作能让东西飞的东西！

lines.english: Sometimes I'm happy I don't sell any. I kind of want to keep them.
lines.chinese: 有时我很高兴我没有卖掉任何东西。我有点想保留它们。

lines.english: My dad calls these toys, but to me, they're friends.
lines.chinese: 我爸爸称这些为玩具，但对我来说，它们是朋友。

lines.english: If it breaks, bring it back. I love fixing almost as much as building.
lines.chinese: 如果坏了，就把它带回来。我几乎和建筑一样喜欢修理。

lines.english: Sure, I've got a few more!
lines.chinese: 当然，我还有几个！

lines.english: He knows everything about vehicles, but he doesn't really get the stuff I build.
lines.chinese: 他了解有关车辆的一切，但他并不真正了解我制造的东西。

lines.english: These ones are so cool!
lines.chinese: 这些太酷了！

lines.english: Did you see this one? Oh, what about this one? Oh, this one is awesome!
lines.chinese: 你看到这个了吗？哦，这个呢？哦，这个太棒了！

lines.english: You can't fly? Well, that's so sad. But I can help.
lines.chinese: 你不会飞吗？嗯，那太悲伤了。但我可以帮忙。

lines.english: My dad is the best salesman in the Bazaar. I learned it from him.
lines.chinese: 我爸爸是大巴扎最好的推销员。我是从他那里学来的。

lines.english: My dad flew all around the Foundation with Sky Patrol. I mostly stick to my workshop.
lines.chinese: 我爸爸带着空巡队绕着基底飞来飞去。我大部分时间都呆在我的工作室里。

lines.english: He says I should go have my own adventures, but I like helping other people have theirs.
lines.chinese: 他说我应该去经历自己的冒险，但我喜欢帮助其他人经历他们的冒险。

lines.english: There are greater trainers than me. I'm just getting you ready for them.
lines.chinese: 有比我更伟大的教练。我只是让你为他们做好准备。

lines.english: Some folks a lot older than me have lived a lot less.
lines.chinese: 有些比我年长很多的人活得要少得多。

lines.english: Meditation was invented by old people, so they could sit and do nothing.
lines.chinese: 冥想是老年人发明的，所以他们可以坐着什么也不做。

lines.english: I came to the Bazaar a very long time ago, when I was only 17. Now that I'm 19, everything looks different.
lines.chinese: 我很久以前就来到了大巴扎，当时我才17岁。现在我已经19岁了，一切看起来都不一样了。

lines.english: Don't let my youth worry you! The guys who trained me were very old.
lines.chinese: 别让我的青春让你担心！训练我的人都很老了。

lines.english: You might prefer Argenta's training. She is amazing.
lines.chinese: 您可能更喜欢阿根塔的训练。她太棒了。

lines.english: If you are not ready for my training, I am not sure where else to send you.
lines.chinese: 如果您还没有准备好接受我的培训，我不知道还能送您去哪里。

lines.english: I spent half my life mastering that technique, so like, nine years.
lines.chinese: 我花了半辈子的时间来掌握这项技术，大约九年。

lines.english: I used to think it was a scary place full of evil monsters. Now all I see is people trying their best.
lines.chinese: 我曾经认为那是一个充满邪恶怪物的可怕地方。现在我看到的只是人们竭尽全力。

lines.english: When you've learned all you can from me, see Argenta. She's wonderful.
lines.chinese: 当你从我这里学到了所有的知识后，就来看看阿根塔吧。她很棒。

lines.english: Is this that deep stillness Nufu always talks about?
lines.chinese: 这就是努夫常说的深沉的寂静吗？

lines.english: I've never regretted my choice. The Bazaar is a beautiful place. Also, Argenta is here.
lines.chinese: 我从来没有后悔过我的选择。大巴扎是一个美丽的地方。还有，阿根塔也来了。

lines.english: Oh, hi! I mean, greetings.
lines.chinese: 哦，嗨！我是说，向你问好。

lines.english: There's no meditation in my training. I don't believe in it.
lines.chinese: 我的训练中没有冥想。我不相信它。

lines.english: I may not be the most masterful trainer, but I must be the cheapest.
lines.chinese: 我可能不是最厉害的训练师，但我一定是最便宜的。

lines.english: It takes real confidence to let a kid train you. I'm impressed.
lines.chinese: 让孩子训练你需要真正的信心。我印象深刻。

lines.english: Orlin and Adira are all about stillness too. Maybe it's easier when you're ancient.
lines.chinese: 奥林和艾迪拉也都是关于静止的。也许当你老了的时候会更容易。

lines.english: The monks tried to stop me from joining the migration, but I knew I needed more out of life.
lines.chinese: 僧侣们试图阻止我加入迁徙，但我知道我需要更多的生活。

lines.english: Yeah, you're probably too skilled for my humble abilities.
lines.chinese: 是的，对于我卑微的能力来说，你可能太熟练了。

lines.english: Hmm. Maybe you're trying to teach me something.
lines.chinese: 唔。也许你想教我一些东西。

lines.english: The monks back home acted like their way was the only way. I wish they could see this place, all these different ways.
lines.chinese: 家乡的僧人表现得好像他们的路是唯一的路。我希望他们能以不同的方式看到这个地方。

lines.english: Some are too proud to be trained by a child. You might examine that.
lines.chinese: 有些人太骄傲了，不愿意接受小孩子的训练。你应该反思一下。

lines.english: Being an elder is just one perspective. Youth has its own wisdom.
lines.chinese: 成为长老只是一种视角。青春有自己的智慧。

lines.english: You picked that up quickly! Heh, maybe I'm getting better at this.
lines.chinese: 你很快就学会了！呵呵，也许我在这方面做得更好了。

lines.english: I'll keep honing my skills. Next time, I might surprise you.
lines.chinese: 我会继续磨练我的技能。下次我可能会给你一个惊喜。

lines.english: Hmm you move slower than others. Are you part lithic?
lines.chinese: 嗯，你比别人走得慢。你是石质的吗？

lines.english: Are you angry? Did I step on your house? I am sorry.
lines.chinese: 你在生气吗？我踩到你家了吗？对不起。

lines.english: When I first came here, I stepped on many houses. I did not understand.
lines.chinese: 第一次来这里的时候，我踩过很多房子。我不明白。

lines.english: Was it too heavy? They tell me it's a problem.
lines.chinese: 是不是太重了？他们告诉我这是一个问题。

lines.english: I would give it for free, but Tiny Ande says that is wrong.
lines.chinese: 我愿意免费赠送，但小安德说这是错误的。

lines.english: Gold becomes goods, then returns to gold, like clouds to the sea.
lines.chinese: 黄金变成商品，然后又回到黄金，就像云回到大海一样。

lines.english: Ah, it will be there long after you are gone, and so will I.
lines.chinese: 啊，你走了很久以后它还会在那里，我也会的。

lines.english: Hard to hear a tiny sentence. There are such bigger sounds in my ears.
lines.chinese: 很难听到一个小句子。我的耳边有如此大的声音。

lines.english: For me, this IS talking fast.
lines.chinese: 对我来说，这就是说得很快。

lines.english: Hello, little sentient.
lines.chinese: 你好，小家伙。

lines.english: Hmm, I wonder how long you will be here.
lines.chinese: 嗯，我想知道你会在这里呆多久。

lines.english: Most of you move fast, like low clouds. Not you, though.
lines.chinese: 你们中的大多数人移动得很快，就像低空的云一样。但不是你。

lines.english: Little sentients love shops, so I opened one.
lines.chinese: 小众生都喜欢小店，所以我就开了一家。

lines.english: Business, huh? I will play this game with you.
lines.chinese: 做生意吧？我会和你一起玩这个游戏。

lines.english: Lithic markets just trade boulders. This is more fun.
lines.chinese: 石族市场只交易巨石。这更好玩。

lines.english: In and out, here and there, so rushed, so confused.
lines.chinese: 进进出出，这里那里，如此匆忙，如此混乱。

lines.english: You are amusing. Why so fighty? Heh heh heh heh!
lines.chinese: 你很有趣。为什么这么好斗？嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿！

lines.english: Your coins are like dust in my palm, but thank you!
lines.chinese: 你的硬币在我掌心就像灰尘，但谢谢你！

lines.english: Whatever that is for, I hope it pleases you.
lines.chinese: 不管这是为了什么，我希望它能让你满意。

lines.english: Did you shout? You are so far away!
lines.chinese: 你喊了吗？你还差那么远呢！

lines.english: You are hard to hear, but I am listening.
lines.chinese: 你很难听清，但我在听。

lines.english: Tiny Ande says I need to close the deal. Nah.
lines.chinese: 小安德说我需要完成交易。不。

lines.english: Thunder, rockslides, volcanoes, your voice a tiny squeak.
lines.chinese: 雷声、岩崩、火山，你的声音是微小的吱吱声。

lines.english: Hmm, this money. What should I do with it?
lines.chinese: 嗯，这个钱。我应该用它做什么？

lines.english: Want to see the whole Bazaar? Climb in my hand!
lines.chinese: 想看整个大巴扎吗？爬到我手里！

lines.english: Will this serve you better? Only time will tell.
lines.chinese: 这会更好地为您服务吗？只有时间才能证明一切。

lines.english: Each wasted second adds to the pile in your past.
lines.chinese: 每浪费一秒都会增加你的过去。

lines.english: I can help you unweave what you've woven.
lines.chinese: 我可以帮你解开你编织的东西。

lines.english: It's never too late to change.
lines.chinese: 改变永远不会太晚。

lines.english: Only Futura knows how this turns out.
lines.chinese: 只有福图拉知道结果如何。

lines.english: Every object holds secrets. Learn them.
lines.chinese: 每个物体都蕴藏着秘密。学习他们。

lines.english: If I help you, my sister's worlds get brighter. That's all?
lines.chinese: 如果我能帮助你，我姐姐的世界就会变得更加光明。就这样？

lines.english: Consider this your second chance.
lines.chinese: 考虑这是你的第二次机会。

lines.english: Most ignore my lessons. Are you a fool like them?
lines.chinese: 大多数人忽视我的教训。你是像他们一样的傻瓜吗？

lines.english: I suppose doing nothing is one way to avoid mistakes.
lines.chinese: 我认为什么都不做是避免错误的一种方法。

lines.english: I carry the burden of all history. Don't annoy me further.
lines.chinese: 我背负着所有历史的重担。别再惹恼我了。

lines.english: Do you understand your choices or do you simply make them?
lines.chinese: 你明白自己的选择，还是只是在作出选择？

lines.english: To know a thing's history is to know how to use it.
lines.chinese: 了解一个事物的历史就知道如何使用它。

lines.english: Trace the path backwards. Learn the steps.
lines.chinese: 向后追踪路径。了解步骤。

lines.english: Tear it all down to build something new.
lines.chinese: 拆除一切以构建新的东西。

lines.english: Did I say a pile? I meant a mountain.
lines.chinese: 我说的是一堆吗？我指的是一座山。

lines.english: If you waste this chance, I'll be very annoyed.
lines.chinese: 如果你浪费了这个机会，我会很生气的。

lines.english: I know everything you've ever done. Why am I still helping you?
lines.chinese: 我知道你做过的一切。我为什么还要帮你？

lines.english: Learn from the past or be forever tangled in it.
lines.chinese: 吸取过去的教训，否则就永远深陷其中。

lines.english: The past is an endless archive of selfish acts and stupidity.
lines.chinese: 过去是无穷无尽的自私行为和愚蠢的档案。

lines.english: Each step on the path is a chance to change course.
lines.chinese: 道路上的每一步都是改变路线的机会。

lines.english: A long chain of events brought this into your hands.
lines.chinese: 一连串的事件把它带到了你的手中。

lines.english: Not everyone gets to try again, make the most of it.
lines.chinese: 不是每个人都能再次尝​​试，充分利用它。

lines.english: A bold step. I hope you know where you're walking.
lines.chinese: 大胆的一步。我希望你知道你正走在哪里。

lines.english: I don't hate people, I've just seen so much of their darkness.
lines.chinese: 我并不讨厌别人，我只是看到了他们的阴暗面。

lines.english: I'd go mad without my sisters, their brightness, their hope.
lines.chinese: 如果没有我的姐妹们、她们的光明、她们的希望，我会发疯的。

lines.english: Every object has a history, a life.
lines.chinese: 每一件物品都有它的历史、它的生命。

lines.english: Even fools can learn from their mistakes.
lines.chinese: 即使是傻瓜也能从错误中吸取教训。

lines.english: Yes, so many wrong steps to retrace.
lines.chinese: 是的，有很多错误的步骤需要追溯。

lines.english: I see it in your eyes, the dawning realisation.
lines.chinese: 我从你的眼中看到了曙光般的认识。

lines.english: A few wrong turns on your path. We can correct that.
lines.chinese: 你的道路上有几个错误的转弯。我们可以纠正这一点。

lines.english: Ad ergo victoriam. It means I am the winner?
lines.chinese: 吾战无不胜。意思是，我赢了？

lines.english: But my mother said I'm the best!
lines.chinese: 但妈妈说我是最棒的！

lines.english: You... you hit me!
lines.chinese: 你……你打我！

lines.english: Get an education and perhaps then we can have a duel.
lines.chinese: 接受教育，也许我们就可以决斗了。

lines.english: What do you mean, experience? I have a diploma.
lines.chinese: 你说的经验是什么意思？我有文凭。

lines.english: But... I followed the ten principles of dueling!
lines.chinese: 但是……我遵循决斗十大原则！

lines.english: Master of the Blade!
lines.chinese: 刀锋大师！

lines.english: Sorry, what school did you attend?
lines.chinese: 抱歉，你在哪所学校上学？

lines.english: You face a graduate of the Dueling Academy. Tremble!
lines.chinese: 你面对的是决斗学院的毕业生。颤抖！

lines.english: I believe it was Draxen who said... Draxen, the great duelist!
lines.chinese: 我相信是德拉克森说的……德拉克森，伟大的决斗者！

lines.english: But I was an honor student!
lines.chinese: 但我是一名优等生！

lines.english: I'm reporting you for that!
lines.chinese: 我为此举报你！

lines.english: But I read The Art of the Duel!
lines.chinese: 但我读过《决斗的艺术》！

lines.english: But... I completed all the dueling courses!
lines.chinese: 但是……我已经完成了所有的决斗课程！

lines.english: I love putting the uneducated in their place.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢把没有受过教育的人放在他们的位置上。

lines.english: You... did not go to the Academy? G-g-g-g...
lines.chinese: 你……没上过学院？呃呃呃呃……

lines.english: The Academy did not appreciate my gladius!
lines.chinese: 学院不欣赏我的短剑！

lines.english: Which dueling academy did you attend, huh?
lines.chinese: 你是哪个决斗学院的学生啊？

lines.english: I have mastered the dueling art. This paper says so.
lines.chinese: 我已经掌握了决斗艺术。这篇论文是这么说的。

lines.english: Tantius weapons are up to 100% effective! Actual effectiveness may vary.
lines.chinese: 坦提乌斯武器的有效性高达100%！实际效果可能有所不同。

lines.english: Tantius Industries is the leading supplier of private militaries all across the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 坦提乌斯工业是大巴扎领先的私营军事供应商。

lines.english: I could lose my job over this... wait, do I have a job?
lines.chinese: 我可能会因此丢掉工作……等等，我有工作吗？

lines.english: You're gonna love these explosives, brought to you by Tantius!
lines.chinese: 您一定会喜欢坦提乌斯为您带来的这些炸药！

lines.english: Tantius is more than just airships. Allow me to demonstrate.
lines.chinese: 坦提乌斯不仅仅是飞艇。请允许我演示一下。

lines.english: I can see by your unconsciousness that I've convinced you.
lines.chinese: 从你的无意识中我可以看出我已经说服了你。

lines.english: Now featuring the all-new military line from Tantius Industries.
lines.chinese: 现在推出坦提乌斯工业的全新军用系列。

lines.english: Tantius Industries, not just airships anymore!
lines.chinese: 坦提乌斯工业，不再只是飞艇！

lines.english: I don't care who you are, you've never seen weapons like Tantius weapons!
lines.chinese: 我不管你是谁，但你绝对没有见过坦提乌斯出品的武器！

lines.english: Uh, performance is much better in a controlled environment.
lines.chinese: 呃，在受控环境中性能要好得多。

lines.english: I, uh... they didn't give me a script for this.
lines.chinese: 我，呃……他们没给我准备这段台词。

lines.english: Armored airships, drone bombs, everything you need to seize your slice of the pie!
lines.chinese: 装甲飞艇、无人机炸弹，你所需要的一切，都足以让你分得一杯羹！

lines.english: I... I don't understand. That shouldn't have happened.
lines.chinese: 我……我不明白。那不应该发生。

lines.english: Thank you for your feedback! I'll share it with our product team.
lines.chinese: 感谢您的反馈！我将与我们的产品团队分享。

lines.english: There is no government to protect you in the Bazaar. Defense is up to you.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎没有政府保护你。防御由你决定。

lines.english: As you can see, Tantius weapons work!
lines.chinese: 如你所见，坦提乌斯武器确实有效！

lines.english: Do you have what you need to protect your investments? And your family or whatever?
lines.chinese: 您有保护您投资所需的资源吗？还有你的家人或其他人吗？

lines.english: Thank you for participating in this demonstration!
lines.chinese: 感谢您参与本次演示！

lines.english: Since the lead designer left the company, Tantius has gone all in on military.
lines.chinese: 自从首席设计师离开公司后，坦提乌斯就全力投入军事领域。

lines.english: Tantius Industries, flying above the rest.
lines.chinese: 坦提乌斯工业，凌驾于其他工业之上。

lines.english: It's a winner's market, I'm afraid.
lines.chinese: 恐怕这是一个赢家的市场。

lines.english: I'm afraid your offer was rejected.
lines.chinese: 恐怕你的提议被拒绝了。

lines.english: Seems your credit score is inadequate.
lines.chinese: 看来您的信用评分不够。

lines.english: The bubble always bursts, you know?
lines.chinese: 泡沫总会破灭，你知道吗？

lines.english: No!
lines.chinese: 不！

lines.english: The good life's here in the city, and everyone wants a slice.
lines.chinese: 城市里有美好的生活，每个人都想分一杯羹。

lines.english: Mmm, I might have something in your budget, in the scrap fields.
lines.chinese: 嗯，我可能在你的预算中，在废料场里有一些东西。

lines.english: There are only two sure investments, real estate and me.
lines.chinese: 确定的投资只有两项，房地产和我。

lines.english: Oh, I think we're heading for a recession.
lines.chinese: 哦，我认为我们正在走向衰退。

lines.english: Huh? Housing crisis? Never heard of it.
lines.chinese: 啊？住房危机？从来没有听说过。

lines.english: So buy now, or buy never, my friend.
lines.chinese: 所以现在就买，或者永远不要买，我的朋友。

lines.english: You can always refinance, but for a fee, of course.
lines.chinese: 您随时可以再融资，但当然需要付费。

lines.english: Real estate is precious in a city like this.
lines.chinese: 在这样的城市里，房地产是非常宝贵的。

lines.english: I want it. I get it. Why waste our time?
lines.chinese: 我要它。我得到它。为什么要浪费我们的时间呢？

lines.english: Plenty of room in the Outlands for Yatarians and Hellbillies.
lines.chinese: 荒原里有足够的空间给亚塔利亚人和地狱乡巴佬。

lines.english: Look, I'm a businessman. It wasn't personal.
lines.chinese: 看，我是一个商人。这不是个人的。

lines.english: HAPE
lines.chinese: HAPE

lines.english: I'll check with Underwriting. I'm sure we can get you a better rate.
lines.chinese: 我会向承保部门核实。我确信我们可以为您提供更好的价格。

lines.english: You're quite the negotiator. We should partner up.
lines.chinese: 你真是个谈判高手。我们应该合作。

lines.english: When this is over, I'll own your home, if you have one.
lines.chinese: 当这一切结束后，我将拥有你的房子，如果你有的话。

lines.english: Rates go up every year, and they're never coming down.
lines.chinese: 利率每年都在上涨，而且永远不会下降。

lines.english: I'm a reasonable man. Make me an offer.
lines.chinese: 我是一个讲道理的人。给我一个报价。

lines.english: I don't succeed unless my clients succeed, and I am very successful.
lines.chinese: 除非我的客户成功，否则我就不会成功，而我非常成功。

lines.english: No reward without risk, you know.
lines.chinese: 没有风险就没有回报，你知道。

lines.english: I've already built my fortune. Now I'll help you to build yours.
lines.chinese: 我已经建立了自己的财富。现在轮到我帮你建立你的财富了。

lines.english: Such things can be overwhelming, I know. Do take your time.
lines.chinese: 我知道，这样的事情可能会令人难以承受。慢慢来。

lines.english: I made that same investment once. I'd say the results are evident, wouldn't you?
lines.chinese: 我曾经做过同样的投资。我想说，结果是显而易见的，不是吗？

lines.english: A wise investment, Mr. Pygmalien.
lines.chinese: 明智的投资，皮格马利翁先生。

lines.english: You've planted a golden seed, my friend. Harvest will come soon.
lines.chinese: 你已经播下了一颗金色的种子，我的朋友。收获很快就会到来。

lines.english: I will say, one doesn't find many cautious folk in the Tower District.
lines.chinese: 我想说，在塔楼区你找不到多少谨慎的人。

lines.english: To be honest with you, investment is mostly educated guessing. No need to ponder all day.
lines.chinese: 老实说，投资主要是有根据的猜测。没必要整天思考。

lines.english: One should never rush financial decisions, but one should make one eventually.
lines.chinese: 人们永远不应该仓促做出财务决策，但应该最终做出决定。

lines.english: I bid you farewell.
lines.chinese: 我向你告别了。

lines.english: There is a time for saving, I suppose.
lines.chinese: 我想，是有储蓄的时候的。

lines.english: Investment is building homes for money. I suppose I'm something of a carpenter.
lines.chinese: 投资就是为了钱建造房屋。我想我是个木匠。

lines.english: I see the gold gleam in your eye. I can work with that.
lines.chinese: 我看到你眼中闪烁着金色的光芒。我可以处理这个问题。

lines.english: Ah, Mr. Pygmalien, a man who understands business.
lines.chinese: 啊，皮格马利翁先生，一位懂生意的人。

lines.english: You know, some of my best financial decisions were pure instinct. Very quick.
lines.chinese: 你知道，我的一些最佳财务决策纯粹是出于本能。非常快。

lines.english: I came up in Roughtown selling junk armor to junk people, but there is always a ladder up.
lines.chinese: 我从拉夫镇起家，向垃圾人出售垃圾盔甲，但总有一个梯子可以上去。

lines.english: Perhaps you should sleep on it and come back when you're… awake.
lines.chinese: 也许你应该睡一觉，等你……醒了再回来。

lines.english: You know, my father always said, a closed purse cannot be filled.
lines.chinese: 你知道，我父亲总是说，封闭的钱包无法装满。

lines.english: I made a few good trades, then a few better ones. Now Roughtown is a speck from my Tower District balcony.
lines.chinese: 我做了一些不错的交易，然后又做了一些更好的交易。现在拉夫镇只是我塔楼区阳台上的一个小点。

lines.english: People look at me and think, generational wealth, but I started at the bottom, just like you.
lines.chinese: 人们看着我，就以为我是靠祖产。但我和你一样，也是从底层起步的。

lines.english: But I don't look down on anyone. Everyone has to start somewhere.
lines.chinese: 但我不瞧不起任何人。每个人都必须从某个地方开始。

lines.english: One has to spend money to make money.
lines.chinese: 一个人必须花钱才能赚钱。

lines.english: Hahaha, hello my friend!
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈，你好我的朋友！

lines.english: I am but a humble farmer, coins are my seeds, wealth is my crop.
lines.chinese: 我只是一个卑微的农民，钱币是我的种子，财富是我的庄稼。

lines.english: This will do well for you, I promise.
lines.chinese: 我保证，这对你会有好处。

lines.english: I know you, Mr. Pygmalien, as shrewd as you are handsome.
lines.chinese: 我了解您，皮格马利翁先生，您和英俊一样精明。

lines.english: Well, time to make some sales.
lines.chinese: 好吧，是时候进行一些销售了。

lines.english: I'm gonna serve you some TOUGH pork! Ha ha ha! Weeee!
lines.chinese: 我要给你吃一些坚韧的猪肉！哈哈哈！哎呀！

lines.english: Success isn't about money. It's about lots of money!
lines.chinese: 成功与金钱无关。这涉及很多钱！

lines.english: There's no conflict, no ambition, no purpose.
lines.chinese: 没有冲突，没有野心，没有目的。

lines.english: Entrepreneurs don't take lunch breaks. Where's your hustle?
lines.chinese: 企业家不午休。你的喧嚣在哪里？

lines.english: Uh, ready when you are.
lines.chinese: 呃，准备好了。

lines.english: Time is money, friend!
lines.chinese: 时间就是金钱，朋友！

lines.english: Need to move some inventory.
lines.chinese: 需要转移一些库存。

lines.english: Life on Jabali is simple. Pick some fruit, go to sleep, repeat.
lines.chinese: 贾巴利的生活很简单。摘一些水果，睡觉，重复。

lines.english: I paid for the Express Ship to get here, and now we're… waiting?
lines.chinese: 我支付了到达这里的特快船费用，现在我们正在……等待？

lines.english: Someday, I'll return and show them what I've found here. Maybe then, they'll understand.
lines.chinese: 有一天，我会回来并向他们展示我在这里发现的东西。也许到那时，他们就会明白。

lines.english: Now that's givin' him the business! Haha!
lines.chinese: 现在这生意就交给他了！哈哈！

lines.english: Believe you'll win and you'll win, but not against me!
lines.chinese: 相信你会赢，你会赢，但不是跟我斗！

lines.english: Ah, the joy of more!
lines.chinese: 啊，更多的快乐！

lines.english: The Elder said my ideas were dangerous, that I'd bring ruin to Jabalia. So, I left.
lines.chinese: 长老说我的想法很危险，我会给贾巴利亚带来毁灭。于是，我离开了。

lines.english: I wanted work. I wanted to build my life. I wanted more.
lines.chinese: 我想要工作。我想建立我的生活。我想要更多。

lines.english: If you're not growing, you're failing.
lines.chinese: 如果你不成长，你就失败了。

lines.english: That money is not going to earn itself, let's go!
lines.chinese: 钱可不会自己赚，走吧！

lines.english: Looks like I'm overstocked.
lines.chinese: 看来我存货太多了

lines.english: You seem like a nice person, maybe too nice.
lines.chinese: 你看起来是一个好人，也许太好了。

lines.english: These relics, masterworks of lost peoples, are you worthy of their power?
lines.chinese: 这些遗物是失落民族的杰作。你配得上它们的力量吗？

lines.english: You have shown your true self. I will stand aside.
lines.chinese: 你已经展现了真实的自己。我会站在一边。

lines.english: Our battle reveals your soul, the relics are yours.
lines.chinese: 这一战显露了你的灵魂，遗物归你了。

lines.english: The ancients' power must not be soiled. I will cleanse you.
lines.chinese: 古人的力量不可玷污。我会净化你。

lines.english: To purify your heart, the relics await their bearer.
lines.chinese: 为了净化你的心灵，圣物正等待着它们的持有者。

lines.english: We could see the builders' fingerprints, could still hear their whispers.
lines.chinese: 我们可以看到建造者的指纹，仍然可以听到他们的窃窃私语。

lines.english: You are the future of this world, Bazaarian. Be kind to it.
lines.chinese: 你是这个世界的未来，大巴扎人。善待它。

lines.english: When the Foundation was new, gleaming in the starlight, we came.
lines.chinese: 当基底焕然一新，在星光下闪闪发光时，我们就来了。

lines.english: Take our history. Share it with your world.
lines.chinese: 以我们的历史为例。与您的世界分享。

lines.english: It appears you are unworthy of the power.
lines.chinese: 看来你不配拥有这种力量。

lines.english: I am Qomatz, Keeper of Lost Worlds, and I will test you.
lines.chinese: 我是柯玛兹，失落世界的守护者，我会考验你。

lines.english: One day, a worthy inheritor will come. One day.
lines.chinese: 总有一天，一位称职的继承者将会到来。一天。

lines.english: I scoured the lies from you. You are not ready for what's beyond.
lines.chinese: 我从你身上搜出了谎言。你还没有准备好迎接未来。

lines.english: Before the frogs, before the serpents, we came.
lines.chinese: 在青蛙之前，在蛇之前，我们就来了。

lines.english: I do not come to stop you. I come to test you.
lines.chinese: 我不是来阻止你的。我是来考验你的。

lines.english: We thought they built it for us, but we were only caretakers.
lines.chinese: 我们以为他们是为我们建造的，但我们只是看守者。

lines.english: You are worthy. The relics will serve you.
lines.chinese: 你是值得的。这些遗物将为你服务。

lines.english: There is weakness in your soul. Purge it and return.
lines.chinese: 你的灵魂有弱点。清除它并返回。

lines.english: Three civilizations I have watched crumble. Will yours be the fourth?
lines.chinese: 我目睹了三个文明的崩溃。你的会是第四个吗？

lines.english: What lies beyond will give you great power. Do not let it consume you.
lines.chinese: 超越的事物会给你巨大的力量。不要让它消耗你。

lines.english: I am the only Pixite in the Bazaar. I do not feel lonely. I feel special.
lines.chinese: 我是大巴扎里唯一的皮克赛特。我不觉得孤单，我觉得特别。

lines.english: You are slower than Barkun! Amazing!
lines.chinese: 你比橡树君还慢！太神奇了！

lines.english: Ah, it's glorious.
lines.chinese: 啊，真是美妙。

lines.english: You might actually be slower than Midsworth!
lines.chinese: 你实际上可能比米兹沃斯慢！

lines.english: I'll take it! I guess?
lines.chinese: 我要买它！我猜？

lines.english: On behalf of the Grand Society of blah blah blah, bye!
lines.chinese: 谨代表那个什么大师商人总会，再见！

lines.english: Fine, here's some gold.
lines.chinese: 好吧，这里有一些金子。

lines.english: Not very big though, is it?
lines.chinese: 不过不是很大，是吗？

lines.english: Midsworth says I'm bad at this, but I just want the huge things!
lines.chinese: 米兹沃斯说我不擅长这个，但我只想要大东西！

lines.english: Truly a tool of the gods!
lines.chinese: 确实是神的工具！

lines.english: It's huge! It's magnificent!
lines.chinese: 太大了！太棒了！

lines.english: Midsworth says he might fire me if I don't try harder. Is he even our boss?
lines.chinese: 米兹沃斯说，如果我不更加努力，他可能会解雇我。他还是我们的老板吗？

lines.english: Take this stupid gold and give me that!
lines.chinese: 把这愚蠢的金子拿给我吧！

lines.english: I am not even sure if the GSMM is real, but the uniform is cute.
lines.chinese: 我甚至不确定 GSMM 是不是真的，但制服很可爱。

lines.english: Send me your huge items! Price? Do not care!
lines.chinese: 把你的大件物品寄给我！价格？不在乎！

lines.english: I only sell things so I can buy things! Huge things!
lines.chinese: 我只是卖东西，所以我可以买东西！巨大的东西！

lines.english: Midsworth says I have to trade even when I don't care!
lines.chinese: 米兹沃斯说即使我不在乎，我也必须交易！

lines.english: Did you know sale and fail rhyme? Sale, fail, fail, sale!
lines.chinese: 你知道销售和失败韵吗？出售，失败，失败，出售！

lines.english: You huge things do everything slow!
lines.chinese: 你们这些巨大的东西让一切变得缓慢！

lines.english: How will I carry it home? I have my ways!
lines.chinese: 我怎样把它带回家？我有我的办法！

lines.english: Everyone here is huge! It's terrifying!
lines.chinese: 这里的每个人都很大！太可怕了！

lines.english: You're huge! Do you have any huge items?
lines.chinese: 你真伟大！你有什么大件物品吗？

lines.english: Okay, now sell me something! Something huge!
lines.chinese: 好吧，现在卖点东西给我吧！巨大的东西！

lines.english: Grand Society of Master Merchants! The only true word there is "of."
lines.chinese: 大师商人总会！这里面唯一真实的词只有一个“的”字。

lines.english: Buy from Barkun instead. He actually cares about this.
lines.chinese: 去找橡树君买吧。他是真的在乎这个。

lines.english: What's it like to be so huge? Does it hurt?
lines.chinese: 这么大是什么感觉？痛吗？

lines.english: Barkun takes the GSMM so seriously, but I am just here for the huge stuff!
lines.chinese: 橡树君把 GSMM 看得那么认真，可我只是冲着大件货来的！

lines.english: Be right back! Going to fly a lap around the Bazaar!
lines.chinese: 马上回来！要去大巴扎飞一圈！

lines.english: Try Barkun, he needs to get his numbers up or something.
lines.chinese: 去找橡树君吧，他得把业绩之类的数字冲上去。

lines.english: I guess I made a sale.
lines.chinese: 我想我已经成交了。

lines.english: That's fine, don't care!
lines.chinese: 就这样吧，不用在意！

lines.english: There's fun size, and then there's boring size.
lines.chinese: 有有趣的尺寸，也有无聊的尺寸。

lines.english: How do you hugelings use these things?
lines.chinese: 你们这些大佬怎么用这些东西？

lines.english: Hi, I'm Quixel, master merchant or something.
lines.chinese: 嗨，我是葵仙子，商人大师什么的。

lines.english: Go buy something huge and then sell it to me!
lines.chinese: 去买点大东西然后卖给我吧！

lines.english: Shanty master, write a tune for my victory!
lines.chinese: 棚户主，为我的胜利谱写曲子吧！

lines.english: The whole Bazaar will be my nest!
lines.chinese: 整个大巴扎都是我的巢！

lines.english: At least you're no Cloudtop slime!
lines.chinese: 至少你不是云顶人史莱姆！

lines.english: I say we join up! Take down some Cloudtops!
lines.chinese: 我说我们联手吧！拿下一些云顶人！

lines.english: I will haul your treasure back to the Resplendent Isles!
lines.chinese: 我会把你的宝藏拖回辉耀群岛！

lines.english: I am feared from here to Pelago!
lines.chinese: 从这里到波拉戈，人人都怕我！

lines.english: I'll build me nest with your bones!
lines.chinese: 我会用你的骨头筑巢！

lines.english: We have no white flag! I burned it!
lines.chinese: 我们没有白旗！我烧了它！

lines.english: You fight like a Cloudtop!
lines.chinese: 你打架就像云顶人一样！

lines.english: Avast, featherless worm!
lines.chinese: 巨大的、无羽毛的蠕虫！

lines.english: I'll pick you to ribbons!
lines.chinese: 我会摘你的丝带！

lines.english: I'll make ye my pet! Come perch on my shoulder!
lines.chinese: 我会让你成为我的宠物！快来靠在我的肩膀上吧！

lines.english: Another worm to feed my brood!
lines.chinese: 又一条虫子来喂养我的孩子！

lines.english: Best ready your white flag!
lines.chinese: 最好准备好你的白旗！

lines.english: Best watch the horizon, matey!
lines.chinese: 最好看地平线，伙计！

lines.english: Bested? By landfolk?
lines.chinese: 被打败了？是乡下人吗？

lines.english: Ye fight worse than ye dress!
lines.chinese: 你们打架比你们穿的衣服还糟糕！

lines.english: Admire my plumage, bilge rat!
lines.chinese: 欣赏我的羽毛吧，舱底老鼠！

lines.english: Walk the plank? I'll fly right off it!
lines.chinese: 走木板？我马上就飞过去！

lines.english: No surrender!
lines.chinese: 不投降！

lines.english: I'm telling you, anyone can regenerate, but you have to believe.
lines.chinese: 我告诉你，任何人都可以重生，但你必须相信。

lines.english: Well, I understand. My training is not fun.
lines.chinese: 嗯，我明白了。我的训练并不有趣。

lines.english: Good. Silence is the first step.
lines.chinese: 好的。沉默是第一步。

lines.english: No one has to live in pain. No matter what species, all of us can heal.
lines.chinese: 没有人必须生活在痛苦之中。无论什么物种，我们所有人都可以治愈。

lines.english: I came here to prove my theories, but also to spread the word.
lines.chinese: 我来这里是为了证明我的理论，同时也是为了传播信息。

lines.english: That's okay, kid. Come back when you're ready to push your limits.
lines.chinese: 没关系，孩子。当您准备好挑战自己的极限时，请回来。

lines.english: What I teach goes beyond what we call medicine and what we call safe.
lines.chinese: 我所教授的内容超出了我们所谓的医学和安全的范围。

lines.english: Regeneration is more than biology, it can be learned.
lines.chinese: 再生不仅仅是生物学，它是可以学习的。

lines.english: Your energy wants to help, but it's not smart. You gotta guide it.
lines.chinese: 你的能量想要提供帮助，但这并不聪明。你得引导它。

lines.english: Serfandro regeneration is not in our DNA, it is in our minds.
lines.chinese: 瑟凡德罗的再生不在我们的 DNA 中，而是在我们的头脑中。

lines.english: Training your body to do the impossible isn't going to be comfortable, okay?
lines.chinese: 训练你的身体去完成不可能的事情并不舒服，好吗？

lines.english: Close your eyes and imagine your body's energy as little glowing streams.
lines.chinese: 闭上眼睛，想象你身体的能量是发光的小溪。

lines.english: You're just gonna leave without even trying?
lines.chinese: 你连努力都不尝试就想离开吗？

lines.english: Your body wants to heal, it just needs your permission.
lines.chinese: 你的身体想要痊愈，它只需要你的许可。

lines.english: Focus all your energy into the wound. It will regenerate.
lines.chinese: 将所有精力集中到伤口上。它会再生。

lines.english: A wound is a logjam in those streams, so how do we remove the jam and get them flowing again?
lines.chinese: 伤口就是这些溪流中的堵塞物，那么我们如何清除堵塞物并使它们再次流动呢？

lines.english: Focus on the logjam, and your energy will gather there. Gather enough and it pushes right through.
lines.chinese: 专注于僵局，你的能量就会聚集在那里。收集得足够多，它就会直接穿过。

lines.english: We have an intuition for it, but anyone can learn it. Even robots.
lines.chinese: 我们对此有直觉，但任何人都可以学习。甚至机器人。

lines.english: Sure, my kind heal naturally, but I know others can do it.
lines.chinese: 当然，我的同类会自然痊愈，但我知道其他人也能做到。

lines.english: Do you feel it? All that life rushing through your body?
lines.chinese: 你感觉到了吗？所有的生命都在你的身体里奔腾吗？

lines.english: People think I'm a fraud trying to teach something my body does on its own, but it works!
lines.chinese: 大家觉得我是骗子，说我把身体本能会做的事拿来教人，但这真的有用！

lines.english: Healing is something you do. Regen is something you are.
lines.chinese: 治愈是你要做的事情。再生就是你。

lines.english: There! That wasn't so bad, right?
lines.chinese: 那里！那还不错，对吧？

lines.english: You learn quick, which dramatically increases your chance of surviving.
lines.chinese: 你学得很快，这大大增加了你的生存机会。

lines.english: Can't learn to regenerate if you don't have any wounds. In other words, this might hurt a little.
lines.chinese: 如果你没有任何伤口，就无法学习再生。换句话说，这可能会有点痛。

lines.english: What? You never heard of old man strength?
lines.chinese: 什么？你没听说过老头的力量吗？

lines.english: I don't have time for this anyway! I own three businesses!
lines.chinese: 反正我没时间做这个！我拥有三个企业！

lines.english: Aww, somebody dirty their diaper.
lines.chinese: 哇哦，有人弄脏了他们的尿布。

lines.english: Then you can retire and be happy, like me!
lines.chinese: 然后你就可以退休了，过上幸福的生活，就像我一样！

lines.english: Why don't you get a job?! Start a business!
lines.chinese: 你为什么不去找工作？！创业！

lines.english: I fought tougher gods than you when I was half your age!
lines.chinese: 当我只有你一半年龄的时候，我就曾与比你更强大的神战斗过！

lines.english: Yeah, yeah! Go cry to mommy and let me get back to my game!
lines.chinese: 是啊是啊！去向妈妈哭诉，让我继续玩游戏吧！

lines.english: Thugs like you do not scare me! I fought in the war!
lines.chinese: 你这样的暴徒吓不倒我！我参加过战争！

lines.english: Whatever happened to respect your elders?
lines.chinese: 尊重长辈有什么事吗？

lines.english: Everything I have got, I worked for it!
lines.chinese: 我所拥有的一切，都是我努力得来的！

lines.english: Back in my day, we won our fights with nothing but grit!
lines.chinese: 在我那个时代，我们只靠毅力赢得了战斗！

lines.english: Bought my first house when I was 20. Work harder.
lines.chinese: 20岁的时候买了我的第一套房子。更加努力地工作。

lines.english: I'm gonna teach you some respect.
lines.chinese: 我会教你一些尊重。

lines.english: All those newfangled items! I would have whooped you without those!
lines.chinese: 所有这些新奇的物品！如果没有那些，我会为你欢呼！

lines.english: You wanna take a swing at me? You couldn't swing a putter.
lines.chinese: 你想对我挥拳吗？你无法挥动推杆。

lines.english: You young punks are soft! I'll show you how it's done!
lines.chinese: 你们这些小混混好软啊！我将向您展示它是如何完成的！

lines.english: I got my scars in the war, how about I help you get yours?
lines.chinese: 我在战争中留下了伤疤，我帮你找回你的伤疤怎么样？

lines.english: But I ate a few too many boozefruits.
lines.chinese: 但我吃了太多的酒果。

lines.english: That little J.J. gives them Phibics a bad name! He is a tadpole!
lines.chinese: 那个小J.J.给他们菲比克人带来了坏名声！他是一只蝌蚪！

lines.english: Gah! Forget it! You kids never listen!
lines.chinese: 嘎！忘了它！你们这些孩子根本不听话！

lines.english: Do grasp the elegance of poison, its purity of purpose.
lines.chinese: 一定要掌握毒药的优雅及其目的的纯粹性。

lines.english: What I teach is the appreciation of poison, not its lethal application.
lines.chinese: 我所教的是对毒药的欣赏，而不是其致命的运用。

lines.english: And furthermore, the potency of any poison is directly proportional to its ratio of toxicant to binding agent, so therefore...
lines.chinese: 而且，任何毒药的效力都与毒药与结合剂的比例成正比，因此……

lines.english: Now, obviously, one toxic unit is equal to the EC50 for a given endpoint for biological effect over a given amount of time. However...
lines.chinese: 现在，显然，一个毒性单位等于特定时间内某一生物效应终点的 EC50。然而……

lines.english: By not taking my class, you are perpetuating anti-micorded narratives.
lines.chinese: 不选我的课，就是在助长反米科德叙事。

lines.english: Oh well, now I see what caliber of student I'm working with.
lines.chinese: 哦，好吧，现在我知道我正在和什么水平的学生一起工作了。

lines.english: Poison is a historically misunderstood art form. I'm writing a paper about it.
lines.chinese: 毒药是一种历史上被误解的艺术形式。我正在写一篇关于它的论文。

lines.english: by which we can conclude that yes, objectively, poison is dangerous. But, I would argue...
lines.chinese: 由此我们可以得出结论：是的，客观上，毒药很危险。但是，我认为……

lines.english: There are so many misconceptions about poison. I'm glad you can see past them.
lines.chinese: 人们对毒有很多误解。我很高兴你能看穿他们。

lines.english: There's a rumour that people are using poisons as weapons! Disgraceful!
lines.chinese: 有传言说有人用毒药当武器！可耻！

lines.english: Oh good, you've stopped talking. Now maybe you're ready to learn.
lines.chinese: 哦，太好了，你不说话了。现在也许您已经准备好学习了。

lines.english: I am sorry. Cute? I am a professor of the toxic arts.
lines.chinese: 对不起。可爱的？我是有毒艺术的教授。

lines.english: It is my pleasure to educate you in the toxic arts.
lines.chinese: 我很高兴向您传授有毒艺术的知识。

lines.english: Nightshade sells poisons, but does he understand them?
lines.chinese: 茄属卖毒，他懂毒吗？

lines.english: Like all great art, poison is a threat to those who don't understand it.
lines.chinese: 就像所有伟大的艺术一样，毒药对那些不理解它的人来说是一种威胁。

lines.english: Poison is not a weapon. It is self-expression. It is micorded culture.
lines.chinese: 毒不是武器。它是自我表达。它是米科德文化。

lines.english: I certainly hope you don't intend such vulgar usage. I have expelled too many students already.
lines.chinese: 我当然希望您不要使用这种粗俗的用法。我已经开除了太多学生了。

lines.english: Come back tomorrow. I'm giving a lecture on that one.
lines.chinese: 明天再来。我正在做一个关于那个的讲座。

lines.english: Included with every poison: free admittance to my lectures about poison.
lines.chinese: 每种毒药都包含：免费参加我关于毒药的讲座。

lines.english: Few understand the aesthetic beauty of a really potent toxin.
lines.chinese: 很少有人了解真正强效毒素的美学之美。

lines.english: Therefore, it is obvious that... What? Sleeping in my class? Outrageous.
lines.chinese: 因此，很明显……什么？在我的课上睡觉？太离谱了。

lines.english: If you are looking for bottles with skulls on them, look elsewhere. I deal in knowledge.
lines.chinese: 如果您正在寻找带有头骨的瓶子，请去别处寻找。我经营的是知识。

lines.english: Whatever you do with my training, just don't tell me about it. Allow me my delusions.
lines.chinese: 无论你对我的训练做什么，都不要告诉我。请允许我的妄想。

lines.english: Not Mr. Riggle, not Old Riggle, it is Professor Riggle!
lines.chinese: 不是里格先生，不是老里格，而是里格教授！

lines.english: Yes, poisons can be lethal, but almost anything can. I could use a beautiful sculpture to bash your head in!
lines.chinese: 是的，毒药可以致命，但几乎任何东西都可以。我可以用一个美丽的雕塑来敲碎你的头！

lines.english: Anything in the cosmos, and they choose these petty coins.
lines.chinese: 宇宙中的任何东西，他们都选择这些小硬币。

lines.english: The most common of all wishes, the cheapest.
lines.chinese: 所有愿望中最常见的，也是最便宜的。

lines.english: How many fools must I make wealthy? When will the curse end?
lines.chinese: 我必须让多少个傻瓜变得富有？诅咒什么时候结束？

lines.english: Yes, yes, I'll make you rich, but I will not make you happy.
lines.chinese: 是的，是的，我会让你富有，但我不会让你幸福。

lines.english: If it's not money, it's power, you're all the same.
lines.chinese: 如果不是金钱，而是权力，你们都一样。

lines.english: I would like to return to my lab soon. It is noisy here.
lines.chinese: 我想尽快回到我的实验室。这里很吵。

lines.english: Every fool's favorite wish.
lines.chinese: 每个傻瓜最喜欢的愿望。

lines.english: The stronger you are, the more harm you can do to yourself.
lines.chinese: 你越强大，你对自己造成的伤害就越大。

lines.english: And what good will you do with this life?
lines.chinese: 你这一生有什么好处呢？

lines.english: Many wish for long life, and many regret it.
lines.chinese: 许多人希望长寿，也有许多人后悔。

lines.english: A selfish wish, of course. They always are.
lines.chinese: 当然是自私的愿望。他们总是如此。

lines.english: You are wise not to rush.
lines.chinese: 你不着急是明智之举。

lines.english: I will give you great power, and then watch it destroy you.
lines.chinese: 我会给你强大的力量，然后看着它毁灭你。

lines.english: Ah yes, long life, a classic wish.
lines.chinese: 啊，是的，长寿，一个经典的愿望。

lines.english: Ah yes, money. The lowliest of wishes.
lines.chinese: 啊，是的，钱。最卑微的愿望。

lines.english: Serving you is my curse.
lines.chinese: 为你服务是我的诅咒。

lines.english: Lord Arken made this wish, and it has served him pretty well.
lines.chinese: 阿肯领主许下了这个愿望，而它确实帮了他不少。

lines.english: Choose your wish carefully, for I will try to ruin it.
lines.chinese: 仔细选择你的愿望，因为我会尽力破坏它。

lines.english: Like wishing for a longer prison sentence.
lines.chinese: 就像希望延长刑期一样。

lines.english: I grant you one wish. I am very busy.
lines.chinese: 我满足你一个愿望。我很忙。

lines.english: Who disturbs my slumber?
lines.chinese: 谁打扰我的睡眠？

lines.english: I am bound to your bidding.
lines.chinese: 我必须听从你的吩咐。

lines.english: I do not suppose you would wish for my freedom.
lines.chinese: 我想你大概不会许愿让我自由吧。

lines.english: Now, you could of course just... exercise.
lines.chinese: 现在，你当然可以……锻炼身体。

lines.english: My crime was so long ago, I do not remember it.
lines.chinese: 我的罪行是很久以前的事了，我不记得了。

lines.english: Many have been ruined by a hasty wish.
lines.chinese: 许多人都因为一个仓促的愿望而毁掉了。

lines.english: We do not serve our hunger. It serves us. It gives us strength.
lines.chinese: 我们不侍奉饥饿。饥饿侍奉我们，赐给我们力量。

lines.english: You will not die, will you? Makes Ryukon look bad.
lines.chinese: 你不会死的，对吧？死了会让龙虎很没面子。

lines.english: The Bazaar is FILLED with weaklings. It is paradise!
lines.chinese: 大巴扎里充满了弱者。这是天堂！

lines.english: On Felis they build the cities, write the books, they talk and talk of wisdom.
lines.chinese: 在费利斯岛上，他们建造城市、著书立说、谈论智慧。

lines.english: Ryukon promised Orlin to never eat students. But if you are not a student...
lines.chinese: 龙虎答应奥林绝对不吃学生。但如果你不是学生……

lines.english: Today you have become slightly less weak. Ryukon is proud.
lines.chinese: 今天你没那么弱了。龙虎很骄傲。

lines.english: We lie still and silent, waiting for the prey.
lines.chinese: 我们安静地躺着，等待猎物。

lines.english: Ah, good meat. I mean, good to meet you.
lines.chinese: 啊，好酒。我是说，好久不见。

lines.english: It is sad not everyone can be a wormcat, but you will try, yes?
lines.chinese: 遗憾的是不是每个人都能成为虫猫，但你会尝试，是吗？

lines.english: Wormcats fight without weapons, but you, you will need them.
lines.chinese: 虫猫战斗时不需要武器，但你，你需要它们。

lines.english: We, wormcats, know only wisdom of the body, wisdom of hunger.
lines.chinese: 我们，虫猫，只知道身体的智慧，饥饿的智慧。

lines.english: I have not died, but it must be very embarrassing, yes?
lines.chinese: 我虽然没有死，但是一定很丢人吧？

lines.english: Orlin says we share ancestors, but it is hard to believe. Now, look at them. Then, look at me.
lines.chinese: 奥林说我们有共同的祖先，但很难相信。你先看看他们，再看看我。

lines.english: And then, at last, we strike! This is the hunt! This is why we are alive!
lines.chinese: 然后，终于，我们出击！这就是狩猎！这就是我们活着的意义！

lines.english: Not one person has died in my training, today.
lines.chinese: 今天，在我的训练中没有一人死亡。

lines.english: Since you do not train with me, I will not feel shame if you die.
lines.chinese: 既然你不跟我训练，就算你死了，我也不会觉得丢脸。

lines.english: Bazaarians are weak by choice.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎人是自己选择软弱的。

lines.english: We run and climb in the jungles. They talk and talk in their towers. We are happier, I think.
lines.chinese: 我们在丛林中奔跑、攀爬。他们在自己的塔楼里喋喋不休。我想，我们更幸福了。

lines.english: I love that you are weak. It is my joy to make you strong.
lines.chinese: 我喜欢你的软弱。让你变得坚强是我的荣幸。

lines.english: Ancient wormcat technique destroyed many Sphinxians.
lines.chinese: 古老的虫猫技术摧毁了许多斯芬克斯人。

lines.english: Yes, I came here with the Sphinxians, but we are very different.
lines.chinese: 是的，我和斯芬克斯人一起来到这里，但我们非常不同。

lines.english: We blend into the land, we become it. The prey sees nothing.
lines.chinese: 我们融入这片土地，成为它。猎物什么也看不见。

lines.english: If you are too weak for Ryukon, the Sphinxians may help you.
lines.chinese: 如果你对龙虎来说太弱了，斯芬克斯人可能会帮助你。

lines.english: I came to train the weak, but what if they are too weak to train?
lines.chinese: 我是来训练弱者的，但是如果弱者无法训练怎么办？

lines.english: Our hunger says now, but we silence it. We are its master.
lines.chinese: 我们的饥饿现在在诉说，但我们却沉默了。我们是它的主人。

lines.english: The public can't be trusted with quality lunch meats!
lines.chinese: 不能把优质午餐肉托付给大众！

lines.english: I'll give you one chance to choose the right toppings! One chance!
lines.chinese: 我给你一次机会选对配料！就一次！

lines.english: No!
lines.chinese: 不！

lines.english: I am the Sandwich Artist, and you are the... customer.
lines.chinese: 我是三明治艺术家，而你是……顾客。

lines.english: I used to work for big subs, but then I developed taste.
lines.chinese: 我以前在大型三明治连锁店干过，后来我有了品味。

lines.english: They didn't appreciate my attempts to educate the customers!
lines.chinese: 他们不欣赏我教育客户的努力！

lines.english: If you think that was painful, try crafting food art for cretins!
lines.chinese: 如果您认为这很痛苦，请尝试为白痴制作食物艺术！

lines.english: Your choices here, the breads, the meat... I can only ask, why?
lines.chinese: 你在这里的选择，面包，肉……我只能问，为什么？

lines.english: I demand final cut on all my sandwiches!
lines.chinese: 我要求对我的所有三明治拥有最终切割权！

lines.english: The customer's reign of atrocities. Only I can stop it!
lines.chinese: 顾客的暴行统治。只有我才能阻止！

lines.english: Fine, I'll make your aberration of a sandwich.
lines.chinese: 好吧，我给你做个三明治。

lines.english: But I'm still plagued by hacks with their vile special requests!
lines.chinese: 但我仍然被黑客提出的卑鄙特殊要求所困扰！

lines.english: I thought maybe the freelance life would be different!
lines.chinese: 我想也许自由职业者的生活会有所不同！

lines.english: I'll give you one chance to choose the right toppings, one chance!
lines.chinese: 我给你一次机会选择合适的配料，一次机会！

lines.english: My sandwich? You just eat it!
lines.chinese: 我的三明治？你就吃去吧！

lines.english: I am the sandwich artist! Leave me to my art!
lines.chinese: 我是三明治艺术家！让我继续我的艺术吧！

lines.english: Pineapple with turkey? Are you deranged?
lines.chinese: 菠萝配火鸡？你精神错乱了吗？

lines.english: Spirit? I'm meatballs! Is this some sick joke?
lines.chinese: 灵魂？我可是肉丸！这是哪门子恶心笑话？

lines.english: No! No! No! That is the wrong sauce for this bread!
lines.chinese: 不！不！不！这面包的酱汁不对！

lines.english: The sandwich belongs to the artist, not the eater!
lines.chinese: 三明治属于艺术家，而不是吃者！

lines.english: We from the ends, blood! Wha!
lines.chinese: 我们是这片街区的人，老兄！哇哈！

lines.english: You're vexing me, bruv!
lines.chinese: 你真惹毛我了，兄弟！

lines.english: Hey, what ends you from?
lines.chinese: 嘿，你混哪片街区的？

lines.english: Step into me, jokes fam!
lines.chinese: 敢来惹我？笑死，伙计！

lines.english: Ow! Ow! This ain't worth all that!
lines.chinese: 嗷！嗷！这也太不值了！

lines.english: We from the ends, blood! We don't need him!
lines.chinese: 我们是这片街区的人，老兄！没他也行！

lines.english: Aye! What you sayin', wasteman?
lines.chinese: 喂！你说什么呢，废物？

lines.english: You look like River District, blood. Bare moist!
lines.chinese: 你看着像河区来的，老兄，湿气重得很！

lines.english: Hey, allow it! You probably ain't even got nothing!
lines.chinese: 嘿，算了吧！你八成什么都没有！
