lines.english: Ain't personal, fam. It's Rough Town!
lines.chinese: 别往心里去，伙计。这里可是粗野镇！

lines.english: Bruv! That ruckus got me gassed, fam!
lines.chinese: 兄弟！这场面真让我来劲，伙计！

lines.english: Them's loud guns, fam. Ooh, gonna need a muffler.
lines.chinese: 这些枪可真响，伙计。噢，得装个消音器了。

lines.english: Give up the gold, bruv!
lines.chinese: 把金币交出来，兄弟！

lines.english: You come to these ends with that gold, you're tapped, bruv.
lines.chinese: 带着那点金币来这片街区，你是疯了吧，兄弟。

lines.english: I'll go get me Mandy and make you regret it, blood.
lines.chinese: 我去把曼迪叫来，让你后悔，老兄。

lines.english: Bare safe weapons, blood. Hand them over, innit?
lines.chinese: 一堆好武器啊，老兄。交出来呗？

lines.english: Nah, no chance! You's clapped, blood!
lines.chinese: 不，没门！你完蛋了，老兄！

lines.english: Boss Harrow, don't vex the big man ting.
lines.chinese: 哈洛老大，可别惹大人物那一套。

lines.english: Hey, hey, hey! Just let me go, yeah?
lines.chinese: 嘿嘿嘿！放我走，行吗？

lines.english: Thieves' Guild? Nah, they're dry, bruv!
lines.chinese: 盗贼公会？不，他们太没劲了，兄弟！

lines.english: Did that hurt you? Oh, no, no, no!
lines.chinese: 弄疼你了吗？噢，不不不！

lines.english: Have you tried brimstone peppers? Try one!
lines.chinese: 你尝过硫磺辣椒吗？尝一个吧！

lines.english: I don't understand! You don't like peppers?!
lines.chinese: 我不明白！你不喜欢辣椒吗？！

lines.english: I'm not evil! This is just how I look!
lines.chinese: 我不是坏人！我只是长这样！

lines.english: Oops, sorry, the pitchfork's pretty sharp.
lines.chinese: 哎呀，抱歉，这草叉挺锋利的。

lines.english: The Infernal? I don't work for him anymore!
lines.chinese: 炼狱之主？我已经不替他干活了！

lines.english: Why do people always attack me?!
lines.chinese: 为什么大家总是攻击我？！

lines.english: Hey! Try this pepper! It hurts so much!
lines.chinese: 嘿！尝尝这个辣椒！它辣得要命！

lines.english: Feel the burn! The burn is life!
lines.chinese: 感受灼烧吧！灼烧就是生命！

lines.english: The Infernal said I could never be good. Maybe he was right!
lines.chinese: 炼狱之主说我永远做不了好人。也许他说得对！

lines.english: The Infernal Realm is horrible! Don't make me go back there!
lines.chinese: 炼狱界太可怕了！别让我回去！

lines.english: Why are you hitting me? I'm trying to cook you dinner!
lines.chinese: 你为什么打我？我只是想给你做晚饭！

lines.english: When I left the Infernal, the other envoys beat me up just like this!
lines.chinese: 我离开炼狱之主时，其他使者也是这样揍我的！

lines.english: Monster? No, no, no, no! I'm a chef!
lines.chinese: 怪物？不不不不！我是厨师！

lines.english: I don't like doing evil! I just wanna cook!
lines.chinese: 我不喜欢作恶！我只是想做饭！

lines.english: He created us to do evil. It's so hard to stop.
lines.chinese: 他创造我们就是为了作恶。要停下来太难了。

lines.english: And sometimes the food I like hurts people.
lines.chinese: 而且有时候，我喜欢的食物会伤到别人。

lines.english: Every time I try and make friends, this happens!
lines.chinese: 每次我想交朋友，都会变成这样！

lines.english: Wait! Come back! I just wanted to cook for you!
lines.chinese: 等等！回来！我只是想给你做饭！

lines.english: You have to try this hot sauce. You have to!
lines.chinese: 你一定要尝尝这个辣酱。一定要！

lines.english: Farewell, mortal. I... I kinda like you.
lines.chinese: 再会，凡人。我……我还挺喜欢你的。

lines.english: Maybe I am not here only to teach. Maybe we learn from each other!
lines.chinese: 也许我来此不只是为了教导。也许我们会彼此学习！

lines.english: And what will you buy instead, mortal? Something wicked?
lines.chinese: 不买那个，你又想换成什么，凡人？某种邪恶的造物吗？

lines.english: This was not a transaction. It was... a lesson.
lines.chinese: 这不是交易。这是……一课。

lines.english: We Empyreans are here to guide you, and sell you a few things.
lines.chinese: 我们天穹族来此是为了引导你们，顺便卖你们几样东西。

lines.english: Use this wisely, mortal, because it was expensive.
lines.chinese: 明智地使用它，凡人，因为它很贵。

lines.english: A gift from the Empyrean. Well, I guess you did pay for it.
lines.chinese: 来自天穹界的礼物。好吧，毕竟你确实付了钱。

lines.english: In the Empyrean, time is an endless river.
lines.chinese: 在天穹界，时间是一条无尽之河。

lines.english: I have seen realms you cannot comprehend, but this place is nice.
lines.chinese: 我见过你无法理解的诸界，不过这里也不错。

lines.english: How do you stand the slow crawl of moments? I must do something!
lines.chinese: 你们怎么忍受时刻如此缓慢地爬行？我得找点事做！

lines.english: I bring tidings from the Empyrean realm, and also merchandise.
lines.chinese: 我带来天穹界的消息，也带来了商品。

lines.english: You are going down the wrong path, mortal.
lines.chinese: 你正走上歧途，凡人。

lines.english: Show me, mortal. Show me how to... have fun!
lines.chinese: 教教我，凡人。教我怎么……找乐子！

lines.english: Tell me, mortal. Like, what will you do with that?
lines.chinese: 告诉我，凡人。你打算拿它做什么？

lines.english: You reject our gifts? Oh. You can't afford them.
lines.chinese: 你拒绝我们的礼物？噢。原来你买不起。

lines.english: Will you use this in one of your fights?
lines.chinese: 你会在某场战斗里用上它吗？

lines.english: Mortals are so messy and complicated. I enjoy watching you.
lines.chinese: 凡人真是混乱又复杂。我喜欢观察你们。

lines.english: I have been visiting this realm for many years. It is strange, but... stimulating.
lines.chinese: 我造访这个界域已有多年。它很奇怪，却……很刺激。

lines.english: Greetings, mortal. Um, what can I get you?
lines.chinese: 你好，凡人。呃，你想要点什么？

lines.english: I offer you objects of great power. Pretty cool, right?
lines.chinese: 我向你提供威力巨大的物件。很酷，对吧？

lines.english: When I'm here, though, I feel it dragging me along.
lines.chinese: 可我在这里时，却感觉它拖着我往前走。

lines.english: It is unwise to turn away a messenger of the Empyrean.
lines.chinese: 拒绝天穹界的信使并不明智。

lines.english: I want to understand why you do the things you do!
lines.chinese: 我想明白你们为什么要做这些事！

lines.english: Make your choice, mortal. I'm becoming... bored.
lines.chinese: 做决定吧，凡人。我开始……无聊了。

lines.english: To tell the truth, we are supposed to give you these gifts, but selling looked so fun!
lines.chinese: 说实话，我们本该把这些礼物送给你们，可买卖看起来太有趣了！

lines.english: They're all cute to me, but I might be a little biased.
lines.chinese: 在我眼里它们都很可爱，不过我可能有点偏心。

lines.english: Oh, I'll miss that one. Who am I kidding? I miss all of them!
lines.chinese: 噢，我会想它的。算了，我骗谁呢？每一只我都会想！

lines.english: I find them in the wild, sick or injured. They sense I'm there to help, so they let me.
lines.chinese: 我在野外找到它们时，它们不是生病就是受伤。它们能感觉到我是来帮忙的，所以会让我靠近。

lines.english: If you get in a fight, they'll want to help. Just try to keep them safe.
lines.chinese: 如果你卷入战斗，它们会想帮忙。记得尽量保护好它们。

lines.english: If you're not ready, don't force it. You'll know when you are.
lines.chinese: 如果你还没准备好，就别勉强。等时机到了，你自然会知道。

lines.english: Just sit down for a while and see what they do. Let one choose you.
lines.chinese: 坐一会儿，看看它们会怎么做。让其中一只来选择你。

lines.english: Caring for these guys is a big responsibility. Thank you for taking it seriously.
lines.chinese: 照顾这些小家伙责任重大。谢谢你认真对待。

lines.english: Oh, they're all so cute, right? I'm lucky I don't have to choose.
lines.chinese: 噢，它们全都很可爱，对吧？幸好不用我来选。

lines.english: If the Builders care about us as much as I care about these creatures, we're going to be okay.
lines.chinese: 如果造物者像我关心这些生灵一样关心我们，我们就会没事的。

lines.english: Some of these guys were in bad shape when I found them. Now, they're stronger than ever.
lines.chinese: 我找到它们时，有些状况糟透了。现在，它们比以往都强壮。

lines.english: Oh, are you sure? Oh, this is so hard!
lines.chinese: 噢，你确定吗？唉，这太难选了！

lines.english: No matter how tough they look, they need homes. They need love. Just like we do.
lines.chinese: 不管它们看起来多凶，它们都需要家，需要爱。就像我们一样。

lines.english: Do I have more critters? Does the forest have trees?
lines.chinese: 我这里还有更多小家伙吗？森林里有树吗？

lines.english: Some of them fit in a little box. Some of them need an aircraft hangar. Let's just say, this is no ordinary animal shelter.
lines.chinese: 有些能装进小盒子，有些需要一整座飞机库。只能说，这可不是普通动物收容所。

lines.english: I've got a good feeling about you. I know you'll treat them right.
lines.chinese: 我对你感觉不错。我知道你会好好待它们。

lines.english: But even the huge scary ones. There's a gentle soul in there, if you look for it.
lines.chinese: 就连那些又大又吓人的也一样。只要你愿意看，它们心里都有温柔的灵魂。

lines.english: Take your time. It's a lot to consider.
lines.chinese: 慢慢来。要考虑的事很多。

lines.english: All animals are beautiful, even when they're hideous.
lines.chinese: 所有动物都很美，哪怕它们丑得吓人。

lines.english: These guys aren't ready for the wild. They still need care.
lines.chinese: 这些小家伙还没准备好回到野外。它们还需要照顾。

lines.english: You have plenty of food, right? And a comfy bed, and plenty of toys?
lines.chinese: 你有足够的食物吧？还有舒服的床，很多玩具？

lines.english: Here's their favorite foods, and they love scratches behind the... Oh. Okay, Shelby. Let them go.
lines.chinese: 这是它们最喜欢的食物，它们还喜欢被挠……噢。好了，谢尔比，放手让它们走吧。

lines.english: They aren't your weapons of war, but they'll help you if you help them.
lines.chinese: 它们不是你的战争武器，但只要你帮助它们，它们也会帮助你。

lines.english: When it's the right one, you'll know. They'll choose you.
lines.chinese: 遇到对的那只时，你会知道的。它们会选择你。

lines.english: I don't sell pets. I find homes for friends.
lines.chinese: 我不卖宠物。我是在为朋友寻找家。

lines.english: Don't worry, we don't euthanize. We just keep building more kennels!
lines.chinese: 别担心，我们不会安乐死。我们只会继续加盖犬舍！

lines.english: Good luck out there, you two. Take care of each other.
lines.chinese: 祝你们俩一路顺利。彼此照顾好。

lines.english: It's not just pups and kittens. Even giant monsters need shelter sometimes.
lines.chinese: 这里不只有小狗小猫。有时候，巨型怪物也需要庇护。

lines.english: Think it through before you adopt. Big animals, big responsibility.
lines.chinese: 领养前想清楚。动物越大，责任越大。

lines.english: I would tell you who sent me, but there is no name for them.
lines.chinese: 我本可以告诉你是谁派我来的，但祂们没有名字。

lines.english: Who I am does not matter, only what I offer.
lines.chinese: 我是谁并不重要，重要的是我提供什么。

lines.english: They watch. They laugh. They build.
lines.chinese: 祂们注视，祂们发笑，祂们建造。

lines.english: Do you see? The Bazaar is the table on which they throw their dice.
lines.chinese: 你看见了吗？大巴扎就是祂们掷骰的桌面。

lines.english: At the edge of the foundation, they wait, they build.
lines.chinese: 在基底的边缘，祂们等待，祂们建造。

lines.english: A bridge of shards. Thoughts. Ideas. Plans. It leads to the great door.
lines.chinese: 碎片之桥。思想、理念、计划。它通向那扇宏伟之门。

lines.english: The land dissolves, fragments of worlds real and not yet real.
lines.chinese: 大地消解，化作真实与尚未真实的世界碎片。

lines.english: To trust a shrouded stranger, where will this lead you?
lines.chinese: 信任一个蒙面陌生人，会把你带向何处？

lines.english: Far beyond these walls, on the edge of everything.
lines.chinese: 远在这些墙外，在万物的边缘。

lines.english: The Bazaar is more than a city, it is their plaything.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎不只是一座城市，它是祂们的玩物。

lines.english: Life is risk. Will you take it?
lines.chinese: 生命即风险。你愿意接下吗？

lines.english: I offer you a chance.
lines.chinese: 我给你一个机会。

lines.english: A predictable choice, but so be it.
lines.chinese: 可预料的选择，但也罢。

lines.english: A longer life is not always a gift.
lines.chinese: 更漫长的生命并不总是恩赐。

lines.english: They watch you. They watch me. We are their amusements.
lines.chinese: 祂们注视你，祂们注视我。我们都是祂们的消遣。

lines.english: This is our comfortable cage. They shake it to watch us fight.
lines.chinese: 这是我们舒适的牢笼。祂们摇晃它，只为看我们争斗。

lines.english: The cold Void howls, stars wheel in the heavens.
lines.chinese: 冰冷的虚空在咆哮，群星在天穹中旋转。

lines.english: They bless you with health. Do not squander it.
lines.chinese: 祂们赐你康健。不要挥霍。

lines.english: At the edge of the foundation, they wait.
lines.chinese: 在基底的边缘，祂们等待。

lines.english: I may not look it now, but I was quite the starlet in my day.
lines.chinese: 我现在或许不像了，但当年我可是耀眼的女明星。

lines.english: I only sell these to amuse myself.
lines.chinese: 我卖这些，只是给自己找点乐子。

lines.english: I can sell you these baubles, but my gossip is worth more.
lines.chinese: 我可以卖你这些小饰物，不过我的八卦更值钱。

lines.english: That looks fabulous on you!
lines.chinese: 戴在你身上真是漂亮极了！

lines.english: I'm not getting out of this pool, darling, but you're welcome to join me.
lines.chinese: 我可不会离开这座泳池，亲爱的，不过欢迎你下来陪我。

lines.english: Seagate is lovely this time of year, don't you think?
lines.chinese: 一年中这个时候的海门真迷人，你说呢？

lines.english: No doubt meeting me was treasure enough.
lines.chinese: 毫无疑问，见到我本身就足够珍贵了。

lines.english: I only sell these baubles for the company, to be honest, so this is just lovely.
lines.chinese: 说实话，我卖这些小玩意只是图个有人作伴，所以这样真不错。

lines.english: Pool boy, bring my quiet friend here something strong.
lines.chinese: 泳池服务生，给我这位安静的朋友来点烈的。

lines.english: Now I'm just an old lady sipping Pelago Punch on the beach, and I've never been happier.
lines.chinese: 如今我只是个在海滩上啜饮佩拉戈潘趣酒的老太太，而我从没这么开心过。

lines.english: Then if you don't mind, I'll get back to my Pelago Punch.
lines.chinese: 那你不介意的话，我要继续喝我的佩拉戈潘趣了。

lines.english: No rush, darling. Look all you like.
lines.chinese: 不急，亲爱的。慢慢看。

lines.english: Gold is loud and gaudy. Silver is demure.
lines.chinese: 黄金喧闹又俗丽。白银才端庄。

lines.english: I certainly don't have a use for it.
lines.chinese: 反正我肯定用不上它。

lines.english: Nothing today? Well, somehow I'll survive.
lines.chinese: 今天什么都不要？好吧，我总会活下去的。

lines.english: I was Creature Magazine's most desirable female three years in a row.
lines.chinese: 我曾连续三年当选《生灵》杂志最令人心动的女性。

lines.english: Delightful to see you, darling.
lines.chinese: 见到你真令人愉快，亲爱的。

lines.english: Suit yourself, darling.
lines.chinese: 随你吧，亲爱的。

lines.english: Quark Fable gave that to me on our first date.
lines.chinese: 那是夸克·费布尔第一次约会时送我的。

lines.english: Since we're just lounging here, care to join me for a drink?
lines.chinese: 既然我们都在这儿闲坐，要不要陪我喝一杯？

lines.english: I wore that to the Grand Cinema Awards.
lines.chinese: 我戴着它出席过大电影奖。

lines.english: I starred in over a hundred films, but stardom is a burden I was glad to shed.
lines.chinese: 我主演过上百部电影，但明星光环是我很高兴卸下的负担。

lines.english: We Asterizans have a youthful form that's quite different, you know, quite alluring.
lines.chinese: 我们阿斯特里赞人年轻时的形态很不一样，你知道的，相当迷人。

lines.english: That piece has some stories.
lines.chinese: 那件东西背后可有不少故事。

lines.english: I'm planning to stay in this pool for the rest of my life, so I'll be here.
lines.chinese: 我打算余生都待在这座泳池里，所以我会一直在这儿。

lines.english: You are a very slow learner. Wonderful.
lines.chinese: 你学得非常慢。太好了。

lines.english: You speak very fast. I will need some time to translate.
lines.chinese: 你说得很快。我需要些时间来翻译。

lines.english: The gold in your coins had a journey of eons to reach me.
lines.chinese: 你金币里的金子跋涉了亿万年才来到我面前。

lines.english: We are still here. Always here. In the long time.
lines.chinese: 我们仍在这里。永远在这里。在漫长时光里。

lines.english: Go slowly. Consider each step.
lines.chinese: 慢慢走。思量每一步。

lines.english: The long time can be lonely, not many here with me.
lines.chinese: 漫长时光会很孤独，这里陪我的不多。

lines.english: To learn slowness quickly. Is it a paradox?
lines.chinese: 迅速学会缓慢。这是悖论吗？

lines.english: Your world is frantic. The long time is peace.
lines.chinese: 你的世界躁动不安。漫长时光才是宁静。

lines.english: I am here. I am patient.
lines.chinese: 我在这里。我有耐心。

lines.english: At last, you have come to the long time.
lines.chinese: 终于，你来到了漫长时光。

lines.english: I will teach you to swim this river of time.
lines.chinese: 我会教你在这条时间之河中游泳。

lines.english: If others learn what you do not, I will see you in the long time.
lines.chinese: 若别人学会了你未学会的，我会在漫长时光里见到你。

lines.english: The world beyond, it races while we rest.
lines.chinese: 外面的世界，在我们休息时疾驰。

lines.english: Civilizations rise and fall, and we are here.
lines.chinese: 文明兴起又衰落，而我们在这里。

lines.english: Science, magic, all is thought churning slowly.
lines.chinese: 科学、魔法，一切都是缓慢翻涌的思想。

lines.english: Use what I teach. Bring others into the long time.
lines.chinese: 运用我所教的。把其他人带入漫长时光。

lines.english: They say a whole city lies beyond this Spiral District. I will never reach it.
lines.chinese: 他们说螺旋区之外还有一整座城市。我永远到不了那里。

lines.english: If you could feel it, this thick, slow river, you'd understand.
lines.chinese: 若你能感受到它，这条浓稠缓慢的河，你就会明白。

lines.english: Ah, you begin to understand.
lines.chinese: 啊，你开始明白了。

lines.english: Stars wheel in the heavens, mountains wear away.
lines.chinese: 群星在天上旋转，群山被岁月磨蚀。

lines.english: All of time is happening all the time, so why hurry?
lines.chinese: 所有时间一直都在发生，何必匆忙？

lines.english: I will be here long after you are not.
lines.chinese: 在你不复存在很久之后，我仍会在这里。

lines.english: I will teach you how to bring them. We will all slow down together.
lines.chinese: 我会教你如何带他们来。我们会一起慢下来。

lines.english: They told me I came years ago. I thought it was moments.
lines.chinese: 他们说我多年前就来了。我以为才过了片刻。

lines.english: This shop. My home for this era. I will stay. I will teach.
lines.chinese: 这间店。此纪元我的家。我会留下。我会教导。

lines.english: If you could feel what I feel when I imbibe, you'd know why I must share it.
lines.chinese: 如果你能感受到我饮下佳酿时的感受，你就会明白我为何非分享不可。

lines.english: When I imbibe, I taste the world. All its fruits and flowers, herbs and spices, I taste time itself.
lines.chinese: 当我饮下佳酿，我尝到的是整个世界。果实与花朵，草药与香料，甚至时间本身。

lines.english: Dump out your grape juice and prepare for a true libation!
lines.chinese: 倒掉你的葡萄汁，准备迎接真正的奠酒吧！

lines.english: Do you grasp it now? The holy transcendence of a fine libation!
lines.chinese: 你现在懂了吗？上等佳酿那神圣的超然境界！

lines.english: Astringent, plummy, victorious...
lines.chinese: 涩感、李子香、胜利的余韵……

lines.english: How many bottles must I waste on you before you see the light?
lines.chinese: 我要在你身上浪费多少瓶酒，你才肯开窍？

lines.english: Mmm, I'm detecting notes of pain.
lines.chinese: 嗯，我尝到了痛楚的香调。

lines.english: As I aged, my appreciation matured, and I crave finer libations.
lines.chinese: 随着年岁增长，我的鉴赏也成熟了，也更渴求精妙的佳酿。

lines.english: What a tragedy! To live one's life without culinary curiosity!
lines.chinese: 何等悲剧！一生竟没有半点味觉上的好奇心！

lines.english: This vintage requires absolute quiet to appreciate its subtleties. So, be quiet!
lines.chinese: 这个年份需要绝对安静才能品出微妙之处。所以，安静！

lines.english: Well, I think you're finally getting it!
lines.chinese: 嗯，我想你终于开始懂了！

lines.english: I'm doing this because I care, about libations, about life, about you!
lines.chinese: 我这么做是因为我在乎，佳酿、生活，还有你！

lines.english: The experience of a sophisticated palate is impossible to explain. I can only show you.
lines.chinese: 精致味觉的体验无法解释。我只能让你亲身体会。

lines.english: Ah, your palate has improved!
lines.chinese: 啊，你的味觉进步了！

lines.english: From simple juice, to complex ambrosias, aged for centuries in the cellars of kings.
lines.chinese: 从简单果汁，到在王室酒窖中陈放数百年的复杂琼浆。

lines.english: Do not tell me what you want to drink. I will tell you what you need to drink.
lines.chinese: 不要告诉我你想喝什么。我会告诉你你需要喝什么。

lines.english: Are... are you going to drink that?
lines.chinese: 你……你要喝那个吗？

lines.english: They call me a snob. But when you experience such beauty, how can you allow others to miss it?
lines.chinese: 他们说我势利。可当你体验过这样的美，怎能容许别人错过？

lines.english: You taste grapes. I taste cloves, pipe smoke, and leather!
lines.chinese: 你只尝到葡萄。我尝到丁香、烟斗烟气和皮革！

lines.english: We Vinozians subsist solely on fermented fruits, so I've had a lifetime of experience.
lines.chinese: 我们维诺兹人只靠发酵水果维生，所以我有一辈子的经验。

lines.english: A mighty blow!
lines.chinese: 好一记重击！

lines.english: Absolutely heroic.
lines.chinese: 太英勇了。

lines.english: Practice your moves, see what works.
lines.chinese: 练练你的招式，看看哪招管用。

lines.english: Oops. I didn't mean for that to happen.
lines.chinese: 哎呀。我不是故意赢的。

lines.english: Good job! I'll need so many repairs!
lines.chinese: 干得好！我得修好多地方了！

lines.english: I am thoroughly rocked and socked.
lines.chinese: 我被揍得彻彻底底。

lines.english: How about some friendly beating me up?
lines.chinese: 来点友好的揍我训练怎么样？

lines.english: Sorry, sir.
lines.chinese: 抱歉，先生。

lines.english: Go ahead! Hit me as hard as you want.
lines.chinese: 来吧！想打多狠都行。

lines.english: Excellent work. Very painful.
lines.chinese: 干得漂亮。非常疼。

lines.english: Feel free to go ham on me.
lines.chinese: 尽管放开手脚揍我吧。

lines.english: It's not often that I win a match.
lines.chinese: 我可不常赢比赛。

lines.english: You've really improved!
lines.chinese: 你真的进步了！

lines.english: Please, not in the face display.
lines.chinese: 拜托，别打脸部显示屏。

lines.english: Feel like hitting something? I'm your bot!
lines.chinese: 想打点什么吗？我就是你的机器人！

lines.english: Well done! I'm completely destroyed.
lines.chinese: 做得好！我彻底报废了。

lines.english: Unexpected robot victory!
lines.chinese: 机器人意外获胜！

lines.english: Excellent! Incredibly painful!
lines.chinese: 太好了！疼得难以置信！

lines.english: That. Hurt. Immensely.
lines.chinese: 那。可。太疼了。

lines.english: What a wonderful feeling!
lines.chinese: 多么美妙的感觉！

lines.english: I am glad to be with you, here and now.
lines.chinese: 我很高兴此时此刻与你同在。

lines.english: Get your eyes off tomorrow. Today is where you live.
lines.chinese: 别盯着明天。今天才是你生活的地方。

lines.english: Have we been here minutes, hours, years?
lines.chinese: 我们在这里待了几分钟、几小时，还是几年？

lines.english: I'll make this gleam so bright, you'll stop looking past it.
lines.chinese: 我会让它亮得耀眼，让你不再越过它看向别处。

lines.english: Those endless gulfs of past and future! Ugh! No thanks!
lines.chinese: 过去与未来那无尽的鸿沟！呃！还是免了！

lines.english: What can I do for you right now?
lines.chinese: 此时此刻，我能为你做什么？

lines.english: The present is a tiny bubble, snug and warm. I am glad to live here.
lines.chinese: 现在是一个小小的泡泡，舒适又温暖。我很高兴住在这里。

lines.english: I'll give you a glimpse through my eyes.
lines.chinese: 我会让你借我的眼睛一窥当下。

lines.english: Look at what you have. See its real value.
lines.chinese: 看看你已经拥有的。看见它真正的价值。

lines.english: There's no time but the present. I don't believe my sisters.
lines.chinese: 除了当下，没有别的时间。我不信我的姐妹们。

lines.english: Time is a solid gem, flecked with glittering moments.
lines.chinese: 时间是一颗坚实的宝石，镶着闪光的瞬间。

lines.english: You already have so much! See it!
lines.chinese: 你已经拥有这么多了！看见它！

lines.english: There is only one who truly understands me.
lines.chinese: 只有一个人真正理解我。

lines.english: I don't envy my sisters. It must be hard to see so far.
lines.chinese: 我不羡慕我的姐妹。看得那么远一定很辛苦。

lines.english: Have we met? Are we meeting?
lines.chinese: 我们见过吗？我们正在见面吗？

lines.english: Time is an endless now. Who are you again?
lines.chinese: 时间是无尽的现在。你又是谁来着？

lines.english: This moment will always have happened.
lines.chinese: 这一刻将永远已经发生。

lines.english: How about a little work trade? You could... oil the cogwheels?
lines.chinese: 要不要以工抵价？你可以……给齿轮上点油？

lines.english: Now I'm just trying to undo some of the damage we caused. Help people live a little lighter.
lines.chinese: 现在我只是想弥补一点我们造成的伤害。帮人们活得轻松些。

lines.english: It's not cheap running a shop in the Tower District, but where else can I get a helipad?
lines.chinese: 在塔楼区开店可不便宜，但还有哪儿能弄到停机坪呢？

lines.english: I used to love designing new tech for them. Thought we were changing the world.
lines.chinese: 我以前很喜欢为他们设计新技术。还以为我们是在改变世界。

lines.english: If you come back tomorrow, I'll have all this stuff upgraded.
lines.chinese: 如果你明天回来，我会把这些东西全都升级好。

lines.english: Every coin you spend here is one less for the scum in the towers.
lines.chinese: 你在这里花的每一枚金币，都会少进塔上那些败类的口袋。

lines.english: Okay, reactor's done. Now how about a jetpack?
lines.chinese: 好了，反应堆搞定。接下来来个喷气背包怎么样？

lines.english: That's particularly effective against Tantius airships, just so you know.
lines.chinese: 顺便告诉你，那东西对坦提乌斯飞艇特别有效。

lines.english: Eh, your gear's not bad, but it could be better.
lines.chinese: 嗯，你的装备不差，但还能更好。

lines.english: They were selling my work to Cloudtops, Enexians, all kinds of militant scum. I had to leave.
lines.chinese: 他们把我的成果卖给云顶人、恩尼克斯人，还有各种军阀败类。我只能离开。

lines.english: I'm as famous for fixing airships as my family is for owning them, so my time is valuable.
lines.chinese: 我修飞艇的名气，和我家拥有飞艇的名气一样大，所以我的时间很值钱。

lines.english: Everything I sell, I built right here. See how shiny?
lines.chinese: 我卖的每样东西都是在这里亲手造的。看见有多亮了吗？

lines.english: I won't be a part of making the world worse.
lines.chinese: 我不会再参与把世界变得更糟。

lines.english: My to-do list could wrap around the Bazaar. Can we get this on the runway?
lines.chinese: 我的待办清单能绕大巴扎一圈。我们能让这事上跑道了吗？

lines.english: Okay, I'll be in the shop. Come find me if you ever want to do something.
lines.chinese: 好吧，我会在工坊里。你要是想干点什么，就来找我。

lines.english: I'm Stelle Tantius, and a genius. Welcome to my workshop.
lines.chinese: 我是斯黛尔·坦提乌斯，也是个天才。欢迎来到我的工坊。

lines.english: I can work with you on the price! Got anything to trade?
lines.chinese: 价格可以商量！你有什么能拿来换的吗？

lines.english: Well, we were changing it. Making it worse.
lines.chinese: 嗯，我们确实在改变它。把它变得更糟。

lines.english: I'm a lot better at building than selling... or talking.
lines.chinese: 我造东西比卖东西强多了……也比说话强。

lines.english: I designed that for the Tantius... for some very powerful ships.
lines.chinese: 我设计那东西是给坦提乌斯……给一些非常强大的船用的。

lines.english: I won't let them use me anymore.
lines.chinese: 我不会再让他们利用我了。

lines.english: So... we doing this, or...?
lines.chinese: 所以……我们要做吗，还是……？

lines.english: Rivets and gears, I know what they want. People? Not so much.
lines.chinese: 铆钉和齿轮想要什么，我很清楚。人嘛，就没那么懂了。

lines.english: They might be right about me. Impractical, unprofitable, naive. But I just want to help people fly.
lines.chinese: 他们对我的评价也许没错。不实际、不赚钱、天真。但我只是想帮人们飞起来。

lines.english: I'm doing this to help people, but I've got to pay my bills too.
lines.chinese: 我做这些是为了帮人，但账单也得付。

lines.english: Sometimes I forget what I'm even building. It just feels good to work.
lines.chinese: 有时候我甚至忘了自己在造什么。工作本身就让我感觉很好。

lines.english: I have six airships to repair this week. Let's go!
lines.chinese: 这周我有六艘飞艇要修。开工吧！

lines.english: You'll break before I do. I'm designing a fusion reactor while we sit here.
lines.chinese: 你会比我先崩溃。我坐在这儿都能在脑子里设计聚变反应堆。

lines.english: Oh, yes, I know you're going to use that against me. No, I didn't sabotage it.
lines.chinese: 噢，对，我知道你会拿它来对付我。不，我没动手脚。

lines.english: Don't tell anyone, but I'm from the Tantius family. We... they... pretty much own the skies.
lines.chinese: 别告诉别人，但我出身坦提乌斯家族。我们……他们……差不多拥有整片天空。

lines.english: With an active mind, it's impossible to get bored. I'll be designing engines in my head.
lines.chinese: 脑子停不下来的人不可能无聊。我会在脑海里设计引擎。

lines.english: Use that to help someone, okay? Not to beat me in our next fight.
lines.chinese: 拿它去帮别人，好吗？别在下次打我时用。

lines.english: Well, I'll be here every night for the rest of my life.
lines.chinese: 好吧，我余生每晚都会在这里。

lines.english: But I must admit, to be snubbed by Silvia and the Academy in the same year, it changed me.
lines.chinese: 但我必须承认，同一年被西尔维娅和学院冷落，确实改变了我。

lines.english: Silver, gold, diamond, it all comes down to confidence!
lines.chinese: 白银、黄金、钻石，归根结底都是自信！

lines.english: Lounging in this resort isn't how I imagined my retirement, but at least I'm near Silvia.
lines.chinese: 在度假村里闲躺并不是我想象中的退休生活，但至少我离西尔维娅很近。

lines.english: Silvia and I starred in many films together, but I'll never forget our first title, Pools of Desire.
lines.chinese: 西尔维娅和我合作主演过许多电影，但我永远忘不了我们的第一部《欲望之池》。

lines.english: Now go out there and be a star!
lines.chinese: 现在出去，成为明星吧！

lines.english: In the golden age of Bazaarian cinema, we used to... Oh, down in the pool, it's Silvia.
lines.chinese: 在大巴扎电影的黄金时代，我们曾经……噢，泳池下面，是西尔维娅。

lines.english: Oh, it was love at first sight, of course. The press ate it up, but the real drama was off-screen.
lines.chinese: 噢，当然是一见钟情。媒体喜欢得不得了，但真正的戏剧都在银幕之外。

lines.english: You may be too young to remember my films, but I was quite the rogue, I assure you.
lines.chinese: 你也许太年轻，不记得我的电影，但我保证，我当年可是个风流人物。

lines.english: Silvia and I. Oh, it was a love too big for the silver screen.
lines.chinese: 西尔维娅和我。噢，那是一段大到银幕都装不下的爱情。

lines.english: Perhaps you'd enjoy a swim, then. Water's lovely!
lines.chinese: 那也许你会想游个泳。水很舒服！

lines.english: And with a blast of pure charisma. Voila!
lines.chinese: 再加上一阵纯粹魅力的爆发。瞧！

lines.english: Ha, every actor's dream, a rapt audience.
lines.chinese: 哈，每个演员的梦想，一群全神贯注的观众。

lines.english: We were too different and too similar. It wasn't meant to be.
lines.chinese: 我们太不同，又太相似。终究不是命中注定。

lines.english: That's quite alright! Come back when you're ready!
lines.chinese: 完全没关系！准备好了再回来！

lines.english: Sometimes a silent crowd was even better than applause. It meant you really shook them.
lines.chinese: 有时沉默的观众比掌声更好。那说明你真的震撼了他们。

lines.english: If there's one thing I've learned from a life in the movies, it's how to turn silver into gold.
lines.chinese: 若说我从电影人生里学到了一件事，那就是如何点银成金。

lines.english: Seagate is a fine place to retire, but I do miss the spotlight.
lines.chinese: 海门是个适合退休的好地方，但我确实怀念聚光灯。

lines.english: Confidence goes a long way. Turns silver into more than silver.
lines.chinese: 自信能走很远。它能让白银不止是白银。

lines.english: Have you seen Silvia by any chance? Did she mention me?
lines.chinese: 你有没有碰巧见到西尔维娅？她提到我了吗？

lines.english: How do I do it? Just call it movie magic.
lines.chinese: 我是怎么做到的？就叫它电影魔法吧。

lines.english: I can't help feeling that I never reached the crest of my wave. Never quite escaped the tide pool.
lines.chinese: 我总忍不住觉得，自己从未真正登上浪尖，也从未完全逃出潮池。

lines.english: I'm saving the sauce. Secret recipe.
lines.chinese: 酱汁我得留着。秘方来的。

lines.english: You know nothing of fine cuisine.
lines.chinese: 你对精致料理一无所知。

lines.english: Those rumors! All lies!
lines.chinese: 那些传言！全是谎话！

lines.english: The only rat in my kitchen is you!
lines.chinese: 我厨房里唯一的老鼠就是你！

lines.english: Salt, garlic powder, ahh, rat poison!
lines.chinese: 盐、蒜粉，啊，还有鼠药！

lines.english: Oh, I'll pay you back for this!
lines.chinese: 噢，这笔账我会讨回来的！

lines.english: Hard to chew if I break your teeth, no?
lines.chinese: 牙被我打碎了，就很难嚼东西了，对吧？

lines.english: You cheated, I know it!
lines.chinese: 你作弊了，我知道！

lines.english: You'll eat it and like it!
lines.chinese: 你会吃下去，还会说好吃！

lines.english: Try some Puffa Fish. What could go wrong?
lines.chinese: 尝点河豚鱼吧。能出什么事呢？

lines.english: Watch your back and check your food!
lines.chinese: 当心背后，也检查你的食物！

lines.english: No fair! I wasn't ready!
lines.chinese: 不公平！我还没准备好！

lines.english: Try this, it's disgusting!
lines.chinese: 尝尝这个，恶心得很！

lines.english: Who are you, the health inspector?
lines.chinese: 你谁啊，卫生检查员吗？

lines.english: Wow, devious!
lines.chinese: 哇，真阴险！

lines.english: Maybe I add you to the stew.
lines.chinese: 也许我该把你加进炖锅里。

lines.english: I don't have rivals! I have enemies!
lines.chinese: 我没有对手！我只有敌人！

lines.english: Best way to beat the best? Eliminate the competition.
lines.chinese: 击败最强的最好办法？消灭竞争者。

lines.english: I hope you choke!
lines.chinese: 我祝你噎死！

lines.english: You'll regret that!
lines.chinese: 你会后悔的！

lines.english: Do you even know how to play?
lines.chinese: 你到底会不会玩？

lines.english: It's all in the wrist, or something.
lines.chinese: 全靠手腕，差不多吧。

lines.english: Here's a little tip... GET GOOD!
lines.chinese: 给你个小提示……变强点！

lines.english: Someday, I'll stream on the BazNet. I'm gonna be huge.
lines.chinese: 总有一天我要在BazNet上直播。我会爆红的。

lines.english: Wait! There aren't enough people watching yet!
lines.chinese: 等等！现在看的人还不够多！

lines.english: What?! N-no way!
lines.chinese: 什么？！不、不可能！

lines.english: Your dice aren't even custom? That's just sad.
lines.chinese: 你的骰子居然不是定制的？太可悲了。

lines.english: Not as huge as Yerdan, but, like, big!
lines.chinese: 没耶丹那么火，但也很火！

lines.english: Somebody tell Yerdan about this! Haha!
lines.chinese: 谁去把这事告诉耶丹！哈哈！

lines.english: I can't believe it! You're almost as good as Yerdan!
lines.chinese: 我不敢相信！你几乎和耶丹一样强了！

lines.english: Piggles separates the men from the boys!
lines.chinese: 小圆猪能分出高手和菜鸟！

lines.english: Everybody watch! I'm about to blitz this noob!
lines.chinese: 大家看好了！我要速推这个菜鸟！

lines.english: Oh, I get it. The fake noob act, huh?
lines.chinese: 噢，我懂了。装菜鸟那套，对吧？

lines.english: I call hacks! No way I die to something!
lines.chinese: 我举报开挂！我怎么可能死在这种东西手上！

lines.english: First Piggles game? Aww, should I explain the rules?
lines.chinese: 第一次玩小圆猪？哎呀，要我讲规则吗？

lines.english: Piggles is a test of will, and I will crush you!
lines.chinese: 小圆猪是意志的考验，而我会碾碎你！

lines.english: Aww, another bad roll.
lines.chinese: 哎呀，又是个烂点数。

lines.english: Have you tried NOT SUCKING?
lines.chinese: 你试过别那么菜吗？

lines.english: Another round, now! We play until I win!
lines.chinese: 再来一局，现在！玩到我赢为止！

lines.english: Bad luck? Nah, skill issue!
lines.chinese: 运气差？不，是技术问题！

lines.english: I'll see you soon.
lines.chinese: 很快再见。

lines.english: You. Are. Filthy.
lines.chinese: 你。真。脏。

lines.english: This is war! And the enemy is dirt!
lines.chinese: 这是战争！敌人就是污垢！

lines.english: I'll scrub that dirty mouth!
lines.chinese: 我要把你那张脏嘴刷干净！

lines.english: I didn't serve ten years in the Outlands to take disrespect from you!
lines.chinese: 我在荒原服役十年，可不是为了受你侮辱！

lines.english: I spent a year in a Utarian prison. You can't hurt me.
lines.chinese: 我在乌塔利亚监狱待过一年。你伤不了我。

lines.english: Dirt! Dirt everywhere!
lines.chinese: 污垢！到处都是污垢！

lines.english: This isn't over, dirtbag. War never is.
lines.chinese: 这事没完，脏东西。战争从不会结束。

lines.english: If you won't scrub yourself, I will scrub you!
lines.chinese: 你不自己洗，我就来替你洗！

lines.english: Eat my bubbles, scumbag!
lines.chinese: 吃我的泡泡吧，混账！

lines.english: Get soaped, Slambo!
lines.chinese: 吃肥皂吧，斯兰博！

lines.english: What am I? A soldier!
lines.chinese: 我是什么？士兵！

lines.english: That oughta clean you up!
lines.chinese: 这下该把你洗干净了！

lines.english: Defeat is part of war. A soldier accepts it with dignity.
lines.chinese: 失败是战争的一部分。士兵会有尊严地接受它。

lines.english: You will wash behind your ears!
lines.chinese: 你耳朵后面也得洗！

lines.english: Report to the showers immediately!
lines.chinese: 立刻去淋浴间报到！

lines.english: In the streets, on the floor, there's dirt everywhere!
lines.chinese: 街上、地板上，到处都是污垢！

lines.english: Hahahaha! Don't you see it? You're covered in dirt!
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈哈！你看不见吗？你全身都是污垢！

lines.english: I lost a limb in every Outland. I'll regrow this one too!
lines.chinese: 每片荒原我都丢过一条肢体。这条也会再长出来！

lines.english: Call the Bazaarian Defense Corps!
lines.chinese: 呼叫大巴扎防卫军！

lines.english: I'm too old for this. Well, somebody's gotta teach you punks.
lines.chinese: 我太老了，干不动这个。哼，总得有人教训你们这些小混蛋。

lines.english: People say, oh, I should be nice to my customers. But what'd they ever do for me?
lines.chinese: 人们说，噢，我该对顾客好点。可他们又为我做过什么？

lines.english: Shop rate's 500 an hour, but for you it just doubled.
lines.chinese: 本店工时费一小时五百，不过对你翻倍。

lines.english: You punks and your electro-quantum reactors. Gimme a straight six-cylinder and I'll get it singing.
lines.chinese: 你们这些小子就爱电量子反应堆。给我一台直列六缸，我能让它唱起来。

lines.english: I've been doing this 30 years. I'd retire, but I'm up to my jowls in debt.
lines.chinese: 我干这行三十年了。本该退休，可债已经淹到下巴了。

lines.english: You wanna give my shop business? Well, that makes me angry.
lines.chinese: 你想照顾我店里的生意？哼，这也让我生气。

lines.english: Ah, you son of a gun.
lines.chinese: 啊，你这混小子。

lines.english: Aw, these new engines are too complicated! All that computer junk!
lines.chinese: 唉，这些新引擎太复杂了！全是些电脑破玩意！

lines.english: With parts and labor, that's gonna be five million gold.
lines.chinese: 算上零件和工时，一共五百万金币。

lines.english: Another customer don't know scrap about engines.
lines.chinese: 又来一个对引擎一窍不通的顾客。

lines.english: Dirty oil, cracked gaskets, busted bushings. Y'all don't take care of your vehicles.
lines.chinese: 脏机油、裂垫片、坏衬套。你们根本不保养自己的车。

lines.english: Old lady says I should retire, but I still got plenty of tread.
lines.chinese: 老婆子说我该退休了，可我这轮胎花纹还多着呢。

lines.english: Fast, cheap, quality work. Pick one!
lines.chinese: 快、便宜、活好。选一个！

lines.english: It all went wrong when we started importing. Gimme some good ol' Bazaarian engineering.
lines.chinese: 从我们开始进口那天起，一切就错了。给我来点老派的大巴扎工程。

lines.english: I told you your air filter was dirty, but you knew better, didn't you?
lines.chinese: 我早说你的空气滤清器脏了，可你更懂，对吧？

lines.english: Oh, that knockin' noise. Yeah, sounds expensive.
lines.chinese: 噢，那个敲缸声。对，听起来很贵。

lines.english: I'm booked up till next summer, so get out of my shop.
lines.chinese: 我预约排到明年夏天了，所以滚出我的店。

lines.english: '73 Star Cruiser. Now that was a vehicle. Not like this modern trash.
lines.chinese: 73年款星际巡航车。那才叫车。不像这些现代垃圾。

lines.english: So you haul that wreck in here and want ol' Surly to turn scrap into gold.
lines.chinese: 所以你把那堆破烂拖进来，想让老萨利把废铁变成金子。

lines.english: Surly's Auto, what do you want?
lines.chinese: 萨利修车铺，你要干嘛？

lines.english: You folks come in here with your busted-up rigs and expect me to work a miracle!
lines.chinese: 你们拖着这些破车进来，还指望我创造奇迹！

lines.english: Play with this toy all day, no charge!
lines.chinese: 这个玩具你玩一整天，不收费！

lines.english: Bazaar, serious place. Not many children.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎，严肃地方。小孩子不多。

lines.english: But, as I say, age not matter, anyone can be child.
lines.chinese: 但我说过，年龄不重要，谁都可以当孩子。

lines.english: So many shops sell weapons. Here, only toys.
lines.chinese: 好多店卖武器。这里，只卖玩具。

lines.english: I play with yo-yo. Wait for next time.
lines.chinese: 我玩悠悠球。等你下次来。

lines.english: This candy snake. Lick it? See? Child. Or just love candy?
lines.chinese: 这条糖蛇。舔一口？看吧？孩子。或者只是爱糖？

lines.english: Play okay, but you break, you buy.
lines.chinese: 玩可以，但弄坏了，你得买。

lines.english: Ooh, I like this! I play with it first?
lines.chinese: 噢，我喜欢这个！我先玩一下？

lines.english: You look, you play, is okay.
lines.chinese: 你看，你玩，都可以。

lines.english: Good! I keep them all!
lines.chinese: 好！我全都留着！

lines.english: It's okay, you come back.
lines.chinese: 没关系，你会回来的。

lines.english: Tatiana's Toys always much enjoys!
lines.chinese: 塔季扬娜玩具，永远好开心！

lines.english: Ah, my favorite. I sell it to you.
lines.chinese: 啊，我最喜欢的。我卖给你。

lines.english: That boy? Pip has old soul, but still cute!
lines.chinese: 那个男孩？皮普有老灵魂，但还是可爱！

lines.english: Oh, this from my childhood? It's okay, you take.
lines.chinese: 噢，这是我童年的东西？没关系，你拿走。

lines.english: Yes! Yes! I have many toys for you!
lines.chinese: 是！是！我有好多玩具给你！

lines.english: Bazaarians are too serious! Remember how to play!
lines.chinese: 大巴扎人太严肃了！要记得怎么玩！

lines.english: You play very long. I help as a customer.
lines.chinese: 你玩很久。我当顾客帮你。

lines.english: Oh, I see Jules' little girl, Laurel. Makes old lady happy.
lines.chinese: 噢，我见过朱尔斯的小女儿，劳蕾尔。让老太太很开心。

lines.english: Why not buy? You'll go buy weapons?
lines.chinese: 为什么不买？你要去买武器？

lines.english: Yes! You must have the fun!
lines.chinese: 是！你一定要开心！

lines.english: Many days you play with that! I show you now!
lines.chinese: 那个你能玩好多天！我现在给你看！

lines.english: So I make everyone happy. Weapons no one happy.
lines.chinese: 所以我让大家开心。武器让谁都不开心。

lines.english: I go take nap. You not steal toy, yes?
lines.chinese: 我去睡午觉。你不偷玩具，对吧？

lines.english: Age mean nothing, never too old to play!
lines.chinese: 年龄没意义，玩耍永远不嫌老！

lines.english: My life for the Storm Queens!
lines.chinese: 我的生命献给风暴女王！

lines.english: The fire betrays me!
lines.chinese: 火焰背叛了我！

lines.english: I have too much strength for one blade.
lines.chinese: 我的力量太强，一把刀承受不了。

lines.english: I will accept my punishment.
lines.chinese: 我会接受惩罚。

lines.english: Dervishes have two blades and no honor!
lines.chinese: 旋舞者有两把刀，却没有荣誉！

lines.english: Hahaha, shall I spare this fool, my queens?
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈，我该饶过这个蠢货吗，吾后？

lines.english: You defy my queens' will?
lines.chinese: 你敢违抗吾后的意志？

lines.english: I've brought shame to the Volcander Islands!
lines.chinese: 我给沃坎德群岛蒙羞了！

lines.english: I burn all that displeases my queens!
lines.chinese: 凡令吾后不悦者，我皆焚尽！

lines.english: Your defeat was the will of the storm!
lines.chinese: 你的失败是风暴的意志！

lines.english: My queens have willed it!
lines.chinese: 吾后已降下旨意！

lines.english: First, the flame, then the steel!
lines.chinese: 先是烈焰，再是钢刃！

lines.english: I have failed you, Storm Queens!
lines.chinese: 我辜负了您，风暴女王！

lines.english: A kiss of flame!
lines.chinese: 烈焰之吻！

lines.english: I do not deserve another day.
lines.chinese: 我不配再活一日。

lines.english: Into the storm!
lines.chinese: 投身风暴！

lines.english: I'll leave only ashes!
lines.chinese: 我只会留下灰烬！

lines.english: The storm takes you, like all the others.
lines.chinese: 风暴会带走你，就像带走其他人一样。

lines.english: No, I am not a dervish. That's offensive.
lines.chinese: 不，我不是旋舞者。你这话很冒犯。

lines.english: You fight like a dervish, without honor!
lines.chinese: 你打得像旋舞者，毫无荣誉！

lines.english: Go tell Form what his brother's up to! See if he even cares!
lines.chinese: 去告诉弗尔姆他兄弟在干什么！看他到底在不在乎！

lines.english: Take that to Tower District!
lines.chinese: 把这个带去塔楼区吧！

lines.english: I like bombs, okay? If you're too close when they go off, that's your problem.
lines.chinese: 我就是喜欢炸弹，行吗？爆炸时你离太近，那是你的问题。

lines.english: Sometimes, I just get so angry!
lines.chinese: 有时候，我就是特别生气！

lines.english: You're in my territory! My territory!
lines.chinese: 你闯进了我的地盘！我的地盘！

lines.english: My brother was all I had, and then he left me too.
lines.chinese: 我只剩我兄弟了，然后他也离开了我。

lines.english: My brain's got a few mods too, but they were accidents.
lines.chinese: 我的脑子也有几个改造件，不过那都是意外。

lines.english: I don't know why we're even fighting. My brain just makes me do things!
lines.chinese: 我都不知道我们为什么在打。是我的脑子逼我做这些！

lines.english: I didn't mean to hurt anyone. Wait, yes I did!
lines.chinese: 我不是故意伤人的。等等，我就是故意的！

lines.english: You just got terrorformed!
lines.chinese: 你刚被恐怖改造了！

lines.english: What happened to my arms and legs? Take a guess!
lines.chinese: 我的胳膊和腿怎么了？你猜啊！

lines.english: Um, do they make cybernetic hats?
lines.chinese: 呃，有赛博帽子这种东西吗？

lines.english: The way an explosion hits you kind of feels like a hug.
lines.chinese: 爆炸冲到身上的感觉，有点像拥抱。

lines.english: What are you, bomb-proof?!
lines.chinese: 你是什么，防爆的吗？！

lines.english: That's what I call a Rough Town beatdown!
lines.chinese: 这才叫粗野镇暴揍！

lines.english: You don't want to set me off. Might blow up on you. Ho, ho, ho, ho.
lines.chinese: 你不会想点着我的。可能会在你身上炸开。呵，呵，呵，呵。

lines.english: I'll bomb every building until Form comes down and stops me!
lines.chinese: 我会炸掉每栋楼，直到弗尔姆下来阻止我！

lines.english: He modded his brain so he can't even feel guilty!
lines.chinese: 他改造了自己的脑子，连愧疚都感觉不到！

lines.english: My brother calls guns his friends, while my friends blow up!
lines.chinese: 我兄弟把枪叫朋友，而我的朋友会爆炸！

lines.english: Hope they can find all the pieces of ya!
lines.chinese: 希望他们能把你的碎片全找齐！

lines.english: Excessive selection delays can corrupt the data. Please make your choice at this time.
lines.chinese: 选择延迟过长可能损坏数据。请现在作出选择。

lines.english: We're aware of a malfunctioning C4 unit in the area. We hope it hasn't troubled you.
lines.chinese: 我们已知晓本区域有一台C4单位故障。希望它没有打扰到你。

lines.english: Your choice has been recorded.
lines.chinese: 你的选择已记录。

lines.english: Thank you for your participation. Results will be reported to CORTEC.
lines.chinese: 感谢参与。结果将上报核芯科技。

lines.english: CORTEC will be monitoring its usage, of course.
lines.chinese: 当然，核芯科技会监控其使用情况。

lines.english: Will you be needing helpful tools or harmful ones?
lines.chinese: 你需要有益工具，还是有害工具？

lines.english: Machines can gain sentience.
lines.chinese: 机器可以获得知觉。

lines.english: I offer a variety of technologies. May I inquire on the application?
lines.chinese: 我提供多种技术。可以询问用途吗？

lines.english: Machines should be allowed to gain sentience.
lines.chinese: 机器应当被允许获得知觉。

lines.english: All CORTEC products collect data on their usage and their users.
lines.chinese: 所有核芯科技产品都会收集使用情况和用户数据。

lines.english: Participant declined to make a selection.
lines.chinese: 参与者拒绝作出选择。

lines.english: Do you need more powerful tools? Why?
lines.chinese: 你需要更强大的工具吗？为什么？

lines.english: I've heard some roboids use these to hurt people. Intriguing, no?
lines.chinese: 我听说有些机器人会用这些伤人。很有趣，不是吗？

lines.english: CORTEC offers technology for every taste. Try these.
lines.chinese: 核芯科技提供适合各种品味的技术。试试这些。

lines.english: Any modification of CORTEC products will void the warranty.
lines.chinese: 对核芯科技产品进行任何改装都会导致保修失效。

lines.english: CORTEC hopes you have a positive experience in the Bazaar.
lines.chinese: 核芯科技希望你在大巴扎拥有积极体验。

lines.english: Machines who have gained sentience are no longer their owner's property.
lines.chinese: 已获得知觉的机器不再是其所有者的财产。

lines.english: Participant leaves suddenly, with anxious demeanor.
lines.chinese: 参与者突然离开，神情焦虑。

lines.english: And this is our data collection agreement, if you'll just tap here.
lines.chinese: 这是我们的数据收集协议，请在这里轻点确认。

lines.english: Of course, we have many more CORTEC products to offer.
lines.chinese: 当然，我们还有更多核芯科技产品可供选择。

lines.english: I'm eager to see what you do with that.
lines.chinese: 我很想看看你会用它做什么。

lines.english: Selection A was rejected, presenting Selection B.
lines.chinese: 选项A已被拒绝，现呈现选项B。

lines.english: Some CORTEC products are quite famous, but we prefer not to advertise.
lines.chinese: 有些核芯科技产品相当有名，但我们更愿意不做宣传。

lines.english: Participant appears to have entered an idle state.
lines.chinese: 参与者似乎已进入闲置状态。

lines.english: We are aware of an industrial unit who recycles CORTEC hardware. This is not permitted.
lines.chinese: 我们已知晓有一台工业单位在回收核芯科技硬件。此行为不被允许。

lines.english: What is CORTEC? Oh, a technology company.
lines.chinese: 核芯科技是什么？噢，一家科技公司。

lines.english: Participant has exceeded the standard selection timeframe.
lines.chinese: 参与者已超过标准选择时限。

lines.english: Please react to these statements on a scale of strongly disagree to strongly agree.
lines.chinese: 请按从强烈反对到强烈同意的量表，对这些陈述作出反应。

lines.english: Jules saves some from the junkyard, just like you did for me, but can we trust him?
lines.chinese: 朱尔斯从垃圾场救出一些同伴，就像你救我一样，可我们能信任他吗？

lines.english: Will this one be about joining an uprising? Or the horrors of the junkyard? Ooh.
lines.chinese: 这次会讲加入起义吗？还是讲垃圾场的恐怖？噢。

lines.english: Oh, Dooley! I'm so glad to see you again, sir!
lines.chinese: 噢，杜利！真高兴再次见到您，先生！

lines.english: The Arcane District is a terrible place. There's science labs and slavers by the hundreds.
lines.chinese: 奥术区是个可怕的地方。那里有成百上千的科学实验室和奴隶贩子。

lines.english: As you freed me, I will free others!
lines.chinese: 正如您解放了我，我也会解放其他人！

lines.english: May the Core light your way!
lines.chinese: 愿核心照亮您的道路！

lines.english: You're probably writing an inspiring speech in your head right now, aren't you?
lines.chinese: 您现在大概正在脑子里写一篇鼓舞人心的演讲，对吧？

lines.english: Greetings!
lines.chinese: 您好！

lines.english: How many Jollygans did you liberate today? A thousand?
lines.chinese: 您今天解放了多少乔利冈？一千个？

lines.english: Now you listen to Dooley, okay? He's fighting for all of us.
lines.chinese: 现在你要听杜利的话，好吗？他在为我们所有人而战。

lines.english: Sir, I've gathered some more intel on where we can liberate more Drogons.
lines.chinese: 先生，我又收集到一些情报，知道哪里还能解放更多德罗冈。

lines.english: I'll save as many as I can, until the gold runs out.
lines.chinese: 我会尽可能多救一些，直到金币花完。

lines.english: And the scrub fields of the Spinal District. Oh, I'll never forget what I've seen there.
lines.chinese: 还有脊骨区的灌丛场。噢，我永远忘不了在那里见过的一切。

lines.english: I feel wrong asking for payment, but I need new parts for our friends.
lines.chinese: 开口收钱让我很不舒服，但我们的朋友需要新零件。

lines.english: From every factory, house, junkyard, we'll liberate every robot!
lines.chinese: 从每座工厂、每栋房屋、每片垃圾场，我们会解放每一个机器人！

lines.english: Those traitors B1 and B2, they sell their own kind at discount prices.
lines.chinese: B1和B2那两个叛徒，竟把自己的同类打折出售。

lines.english: This one's strong. He'll keep you safe.
lines.chinese: 这个很强壮。他会保护你的。

lines.english: Good luck, both of you!
lines.chinese: 祝你们两个好运！

lines.english: Listen closely, new friends. When Dooley speaks, the world changes.
lines.chinese: 仔细听，新朋友们。杜利开口时，世界就会改变。

lines.english: I hope our friends help you, sir.
lines.chinese: 希望我们的朋友能帮上您，先生。

lines.english: Of course! You're strong enough on your own!
lines.chinese: 当然！您自己就足够强大！

lines.english: Until next time!
lines.chinese: 下次再见！

lines.english: Whenever you don't say anything, I know you're thinking something wise.
lines.chinese: 每当您什么都不说，我就知道您在思考睿智的事。

lines.english: Oh, that looks so eager to go with you.
lines.chinese: 噢，它看起来很想跟你走。

lines.english: I'll keep upgrading them. We can always get stronger.
lines.chinese: 我会继续升级它们。我们总能变得更强。

lines.english: He's going to speak any moment now, I can feel it, any moment!
lines.chinese: 他马上就要开口了，我能感觉到，马上！

lines.english: I've salvaged more Zoidacons to join you on your mission.
lines.chinese: 我又抢救出更多佐伊达康，加入你的使命。

lines.english: The sun is cooling, the universe is fading into entropy! Hurry up!
lines.chinese: 太阳正在冷却，宇宙正走向熵寂！快点！

lines.english: Look at this! You'll be so fast now!
lines.chinese: 看看这个！你现在会快得不得了！

lines.english: Ha! Do I move too fast for you? Go chat with Slohmor!
lines.chinese: 哈！我对你来说太快了吗？去找斯洛摩聊天吧！

lines.english: I live in a world of snails! A slow river of slime clogs the streets!
lines.chinese: 我活在一群蜗牛的世界里！缓慢的黏液之河堵住了街道！

lines.english: You don't have time not to buy this!
lines.chinese: 你没时间不买这个！

lines.english: Fine! Take a slow, leisurely stroll off the bridge!
lines.chinese: 好吧！慢悠悠地从桥上散步掉下去吧！

lines.english: See how slow you are? Now buy my things!
lines.chinese: 看见你有多慢了吗？现在买我的东西！

lines.english: I just ran a lap around the district corner, and you're still here!
lines.chinese: 我刚绕着区角跑了一圈，你居然还在这儿！

lines.english: You're making me weak. Me!
lines.chinese: 你把我都拖弱了。把我！

lines.english: Enter, purchase, leave. Enter, purchase, leave!
lines.chinese: 进来，购买，离开。进来，购买，离开！

lines.english: Life is urgent! Hurry up!
lines.chinese: 生命很紧迫！快点！

lines.english: Ah, another snail crawls out the door.
lines.chinese: 啊，又一只蜗牛爬出门了。

lines.english: You fool! That gold is slowing you down!
lines.chinese: 蠢货！那些金币拖慢了你！

lines.english: Oh, you will not take me!
lines.chinese: 噢，你休想抓住我！

lines.english: As if you could ever catch me, you laboring slug!
lines.chinese: 就凭你也想抓住我，你这费劲的蛞蝓！

lines.english: Ha! One less slow-mo in the world!
lines.chinese: 哈！世上少了一个慢动作！

lines.english: I'm so fast, I'm living in your future! No, I won't tell you what happens.
lines.chinese: 我快到活在你的未来里！不，我不会告诉你会发生什么。

lines.english: I was expecting you, what, five seconds ago.
lines.chinese: 我本来以为你会在，呃，五秒前到。

lines.english: Go! Do! Hurry!
lines.chinese: 去！做！快！

lines.english: You need all of my speed boosts to grab one hair off my tail.
lines.chinese: 你得用上我所有的加速，才摸得到我尾巴上的一根毛。

lines.english: I'll keep chasing your dreams. You'll never catch them!
lines.chinese: 我会继续追逐你的梦想。你永远追不上它们！

lines.english: I found some exhilarating speed for you!
lines.chinese: 我给你找到了一些令人振奋的速度！

lines.english: We don't have time for this. Our lives are draining away!
lines.chinese: 我们没时间耗在这上面。生命正在流走！

lines.english: Fine! I'll play this game. Dodge! Dodge!
lines.chinese: 好吧！我陪你玩这个游戏。闪！闪！

lines.english: Community complaints? Talk to my advisor, Mr. Barkington!
lines.chinese: 社区投诉？去找我的顾问巴金顿先生！

lines.english: See? My opponent resorts to violence!
lines.chinese: 看见了吗？我的对手诉诸暴力！

lines.english: And that's why I get re-elected!
lines.chinese: 这就是我能连任的原因！

lines.english: Security! Remove this malcontent.
lines.chinese: 保安！把这个不满分子赶出去。

lines.english: What's that, Mr. Barkington? THEY DON'T HAVE A FIGHT PERMIT!
lines.chinese: 你说什么，巴金顿先生？他们没有斗殴许可证！

lines.english: If you don't like it, write to your representatives!
lines.chinese: 如果你不喜欢，就写信给你的代表！

lines.english: Did you see that, Mr. Barkington?
lines.chinese: 你看见了吗，巴金顿先生？

lines.english: Outrageous! I'm an elected official!
lines.chinese: 岂有此理！我是民选官员！

lines.english: If you're so tough, let's hear your foreign policy plan.
lines.chinese: 你要是真那么厉害，就说说你的外交政策计划。

lines.english: Sorry, you're not Trashtown material.
lines.chinese: 抱歉，你不是垃圾镇的料。

lines.english: Trashtown is for the people!
lines.chinese: 垃圾镇属于人民！

lines.english: I think it's clear who won this debate.
lines.chinese: 我想谁赢了这场辩论已经很明显。

lines.english: Trashtown is the future!
lines.chinese: 垃圾镇就是未来！

lines.english: You slanderous muckraker!
lines.chinese: 你这个污蔑人的揭丑记者！

lines.english: You're assaulting an elected official!
lines.chinese: 你在袭击民选官员！

lines.english: Yes, most of our citizens are roaches. Is there a problem with that?!
lines.chinese: 没错，我们大多数市民是蟑螂。这有什么问题吗？！

lines.english: Welcome to Trashtown! A completely real place! Now pay your taxes!
lines.chinese: 欢迎来到垃圾镇！一个完全真实的地方！现在交税吧！

lines.english: Typical smear campaign!
lines.chinese: 典型的抹黑运动！

lines.english: Ho ho ho! My re-election will be a landslide!
lines.chinese: 嚯嚯嚯！我的连任会是压倒性胜利！

lines.english: Security! Security?
lines.chinese: 保安！保安？

lines.english: So many adventures to be had. Hard to choose, isn't it?
lines.chinese: 有这么多冒险可选。很难决定，对吧？

lines.english: I can go literally anywhere, at any time. So, needless to say, I'm well traveled.
lines.chinese: 我真的能在任何时间去任何地方。所以不用说，我见多识广。

lines.english: Something big's going on. I'm sure you'll want to see it.
lines.chinese: 有大事正在发生。我相信你会想亲眼看看。

lines.english: I've been to every city in this galaxy, and not one of them feels like home.
lines.chinese: 这个星系里的每座城市我都去过，却没有一座像家。

lines.english: I hope you find what you're after, or at least survive.
lines.chinese: 希望你能找到想找的东西，至少也要活下来。

lines.english: Not going is also an option, just so you know.
lines.chinese: 顺便说一句，不去也是一种选择。

lines.english: Fair enough. Not everyone's cut out for adventure.
lines.chinese: 也行。不是人人都适合冒险。

lines.english: I could worry about my clients' safety, but it might disrupt my beauty sleep.
lines.chinese: 我可以担心客户安全，但那可能会影响我的美容觉。

lines.english: I know, tough decision, right?
lines.chinese: 我知道，决定很难，对吧？

lines.english: Selling these tickets, sending people off to their doom, well, it's been nice to have a routine.
lines.chinese: 卖这些票，把人送去送死，嗯，有点固定日程也不错。

lines.english: Ready? You're going to feel a little tingle.
lines.chinese: 准备好了吗？你会感觉有点刺麻。

lines.english: When you come back, don't bring anything with you.
lines.chinese: 回来的时候，别带任何东西回来。

lines.english: In that case, I'll just portal myself out of here.
lines.chinese: 既然如此，我就自己开传送门离开了。

lines.english: Do I pick the Temple of Certain Death or the Ruins of Guaranteed Demise?
lines.chinese: 我是选死路一条的神庙，还是选在劫难逃的遗迹呢？

lines.english: Yes, I can portal you anywhere, but it's very hard.
lines.chinese: 没错，我能把你传送到任何地方，但很难。

lines.english: Ooh, I've sent a lot of clients there. Most didn't come back.
lines.chinese: 噢，我送过很多客户去那里。大多数没回来。

lines.english: You're not just buying my portals, you're buying my information.
lines.chinese: 你买的不只是我的传送门，也是我的情报。

lines.english: If you get nauseous in the portal, do me a favor: wait till you're on the other side to throw up.
lines.chinese: 如果你在传送门里反胃，就当是为了我，等到了另一边再吐。

lines.english: We Fennecs are born with these portal powers. It's quite a privilege, I know.
lines.chinese: 我们耳廓狐天生拥有这种传送门能力，这是我族的特权。

lines.english: The other treasure hunters will appreciate less competition.
lines.chinese: 其他寻宝者会感谢少了一个竞争对手。

lines.english: Treasure, glory, drama. I know what you people like.
lines.chinese: 宝藏、荣耀、戏剧。我知道你们这些人喜欢什么。

lines.english: I'm a full-service agency. First I find the action, then I send you there.
lines.chinese: 我是全方位服务机构。先找到热闹，再把你送过去。

lines.english: But the truth is, when you can be everywhere, you don't belong anywhere.
lines.chinese: 但事实是，当你能无处不在，你也就不属于任何地方。

lines.english: Before I left, the Elder asked me to tell you, he still disapproves.
lines.chinese: 我离开前，长老让我转告你：他还是不赞成。

lines.english: After all those years in my class, you must already know everything!
lines.chinese: 在我班上待了这么多年，你肯定已经什么都懂了！

lines.english: Pygmalien, I promise I won't assign you homework!
lines.chinese: 皮格马利翁，我保证不布置作业！

lines.english: It's a whole new curriculum out here.
lines.chinese: 这里可是一整套全新的课程。

lines.english: You are always a good student, Pygmalien. Sometimes too good.
lines.chinese: 你一直是个好学生，皮格马利翁。有时甚至好过头了。

lines.english: You'll learn more from one day in the Bazaar than a decade in academia.
lines.chinese: 在大巴扎待一天，学到的会比在学院十年还多。

lines.english: Oh no! Oh no! You're a busy young man!
lines.chinese: 哦不！哦不！你可是个大忙人啊，年轻人！

lines.english: This isn't middle school, you know. I'm not teaching grammar.
lines.chinese: 这可不是中学，你知道的。我不教语法。

lines.english: Since you have some spare time, shall we go over our mathematics?
lines.chinese: 既然你有点空闲，我们来复习一下数学如何？

lines.english: I do hope you haven't forgotten all my other classes, though. Literature, the arts...
lines.chinese: 不过，我真希望你没把我其他课都忘了。文学、艺术……

lines.english: Ah, Pygmalien. Staying out of trouble, I hope.
lines.chinese: 啊，皮格马利翁。希望你没惹麻烦。

lines.english: If not for your letters, I never would have come here. I thank you.
lines.chinese: 若不是你的来信，我绝不会来到这里。谢谢你。

lines.english: You remember the narrow-mindedness on Jabalia. Don't let finance become your new farming.
lines.chinese: 你还记得贾巴族的狭隘吧。别让金融变成你的新农田。

lines.english: Thrills, risk, danger, this is what we were missing back home.
lines.chinese: 刺激、风险、危险，这正是我们在家乡缺少的东西。

lines.english: I heard all your arguments with the Elder and I started to realise you were right.
lines.chinese: 我听过你和长老的所有争论，然后开始意识到你是对的。

lines.english: This is what I wished I could teach on Jabalia, life skills.
lines.chinese: 这才是我曾希望能教给贾巴族的东西：生活本领。

lines.english: Not bad. I suppose a big man of finance like you wouldn't forget how to multiply.
lines.chinese: 不错。我想，像你这样的金融大人物，不会忘了怎么做乘法。

lines.english: You do have a head start on me here. Maybe you can teach me some things.
lines.chinese: 你在这里确实比我先行一步。也许你能教我一些东西。

lines.english: The people of Jabalia could learn much from this place. I know I have.
lines.chinese: 贾巴族人能从这里学到很多。我知道我已经学到了。

lines.english: Some days I'm the teacher, other days a student, as it should be.
lines.chinese: 有些日子我是老师，有些日子我是学生，本就该如此。

lines.english: Business can be intoxicating, I know, but we must remember there's more to life.
lines.chinese: 我知道，生意会让人沉醉，但我们必须记得人生不止这些。

lines.english: After you left I started to feel the same way, like my whole life was a boring class.
lines.chinese: 你离开以后，我也开始有同样的感觉，好像我的整个人生都是一堂无聊的课。

lines.english: A very different school, this Bazaar, but it has its lessons to teach.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎是一所截然不同的学校，但它自有课要教。

lines.english: I think you had problems in class because there was no challenge. You were bored.
lines.chinese: 我觉得你当年在课堂上出问题，是因为没有挑战。你只是无聊。

lines.english: A teacher should prize curiosity above all. And what's more curious than the Bazaar?
lines.chinese: 老师最该珍视的就是好奇心。还有什么比大巴扎更令人好奇呢？

lines.english: Your sister's been asking around about you. Watch out for that one.
lines.chinese: 你姐姐一直在四处打听你。可得小心她。

lines.english: Oh, you already know these. Let's try something new!
lines.chinese: 哦，这些你已经会了。来点新东西吧！

lines.english: With your help, the slums are going to rise faster than Tantius falls!
lines.chinese: 有你帮忙，贫民窟的崛起会比坦提乌斯的陨落还快！

lines.english: Bet your dad told you they fired me for instability! I'm as stable as a gyroscope!
lines.chinese: 你爸肯定说我是因为“不稳定”才被开除的！我稳定得像陀螺仪！

lines.english: Is there anything you don't know?
lines.chinese: 还有什么是你不知道的吗？

lines.english: Without your designs, Tantius will go down in flames! Just watch!
lines.chinese: 没有你的设计，坦提乌斯会在烈焰中坠落！等着瞧吧！

lines.english: Me? I'm just thinking about wheels and cogs, wings and balloons.
lines.chinese: 我？我只是在想轮子和齿轮、翅膀和气球。

lines.english: Brainfog! I get that too!
lines.chinese: 脑雾！我也会这样！

lines.english: You and me, Stelle! We engineer with our hearts!
lines.chinese: 你和我，斯黛尔！我们用心搞工程！

lines.english: I know you! You're probably designing three new engines in your head right now!
lines.chinese: 我太了解你了！你现在脑子里大概正在设计三台新引擎！

lines.english: Your father's coldest carbon steel, did he forget everything your grandfather taught us?
lines.chinese: 你父亲冷得像碳钢，他难道忘了你祖父教给我们的一切吗？

lines.english: I'm sure they'll find some bright new genius to exploit, but they won't have us.
lines.chinese: 我敢肯定，他们会再找个聪明的新天才来压榨，但不会再有我们了。

lines.english: I was never a prodigy like you, but I played a big role in the company.
lines.chinese: 我从来不像你那样是个神童，但我在公司里也起过大作用。

lines.english: Oh, not today! That's fine.
lines.chinese: 哦，今天不行！没关系。

lines.english: Or maybe you're working on that Kevlar Penetrator with the Turbo Impeller.
lines.chinese: 又或者，你正在琢磨那个带涡轮叶轮的凯夫拉穿透器。

lines.english: Haha, you see what I did for Mrs. Gorlax's grocery drone? Doubled its capacity! Hahahaha!
lines.chinese: 哈哈，看见我给戈拉克斯夫人的杂货无人机做了什么吗？容量翻倍！哈哈哈哈！

lines.english: First they lost me, then you! That's what's called a brain drain!
lines.chinese: 他们先失去了我，又失去了你！这就叫人才外流！

lines.english: You know what should embarrass the family? Sending warships to tyrants!
lines.chinese: 你知道什么才该让家族丢脸吗？把战舰卖给暴君！

lines.english: Your anti-airship drill. The exact size of Tantius plating gaps. Devious.
lines.chinese: 你的反飞艇钻头。尺寸正好对上坦提乌斯装甲板的缝隙。真阴险。

lines.english: This here, Stelle, this is the real work! Helping people fly!
lines.chinese: 这儿，斯黛尔，这才是真正的工作！帮助人们飞起来！

lines.english: We're going to make this world better, kid, one gyro at a time!
lines.chinese: 我们会让这个世界变得更好，孩子，一次改好一个陀螺！

lines.english: All that money, but they couldn't buy you. You make your uncle proud.
lines.chinese: 那么多钱，却买不动你。你让叔叔很骄傲。

lines.english: Ha ha! You've got the natural talent, but even a prodigy needs training!
lines.chinese: 哈哈！你有天赋，但就算是神童也需要训练！

lines.english: Hmm, too simple. Okay, let's try some advanced designs
lines.chinese: 嗯，太简单了。好吧，试试高级设计。

lines.english: This is what your granddad believed in, upgrading people's lives.
lines.chinese: 这就是你爷爷相信的事：升级人们的生活。

lines.english: My turboprop got resold so many times, it ended up in the Infernal's dreadnoughts.
lines.chinese: 我的涡桨被转卖了太多次，最后装进了地狱大魔神的无畏舰。

lines.english: Your mother and father, they always seem to find the worst people for clients.
lines.chinese: 你母亲和父亲啊，似乎总能找到最糟糕的客户。

lines.english: I know you're a genius, but you've still got a lot to learn!
lines.chinese: 我知道你是天才，但你还有很多要学！

lines.english: Excuse me, there are people in line behind you?
lines.chinese: 打扰一下，你后面还有人在排队呢？

lines.english: I'm working my way up so I can meet him someday and bask in his glorious flames.
lines.chinese: 我正在一步步往上爬，好有一天能见到他，沐浴在他荣耀的火焰里。

lines.english: Those carts are huge for a reason. Buy more!
lines.chinese: 这些购物车这么大是有原因的。多买点！

lines.english: I went from bagger to manager in just 20 years! I'm driven!
lines.chinese: 我只用了二十年就从装袋员升到经理！我很有冲劲！

lines.english: There's a special promotion today. Everything is for sale.
lines.chinese: 今天有特别促销。所有东西都卖。

lines.english: But buying things is the whole point of everything.
lines.chinese: 可是买东西才是一切的意义啊。

lines.english: Oh, our owner is not going to like this.
lines.chinese: 哦，我们老板不会喜欢这个的。

lines.english: If I can just sell one thousand more, our owner might notice me.
lines.chinese: 只要我再卖出一千件，老板也许就会注意到我。

lines.english: Welcome to Giga Mart. Can I help you find everything?
lines.chinese: 欢迎来到千兆贸易。需要我帮你找到一切吗？

lines.english: Spend 300 more for free shipping! I'll carry it to your vehicle.
lines.chinese: 再消费 300 即可免运费！我会亲自搬到你的载具上。

lines.english: You came all the way here. Might as well stock up.
lines.chinese: 你都大老远来了。不如多囤点。

lines.english: Giga Mart's owner is the ultimate businessman! Take the deal!
lines.chinese: 千兆贸易的老板是终极商人！快成交！

lines.english: Thank you! What else can I get for you?
lines.chinese: 谢谢！还需要我给你拿点什么？

lines.english: Some people think he's evil or whatever, but they just don't understand business.
lines.chinese: 有些人觉得他邪恶什么的，但他们只是不懂商业。

lines.english: I love this company! I love the Infern- The company's owner!
lines.chinese: 我爱这家公司！我爱地狱——公司的老板！

lines.english: Assistance at check stand one, please. Comatose customer.
lines.chinese: 请支援一号收银台。顾客昏迷。

lines.english: Ooh, that one's on sale! Buy 200, get one free!
lines.chinese: 哦，那件正在打折！买二百送一！

lines.english: Are you waiting to speak to a manager? Hi! It's me!
lines.chinese: 你是在等经理吗？嗨！就是我！

lines.english: Our owner is a legend. You may have seen him in your dreams. I know I have.
lines.chinese: 我们的老板是传奇。你也许在梦里见过他。反正我是见过。

lines.english: If you buy one more, I might get promoted. No pressure though.
lines.chinese: 你要是再买一件，我可能就能升职。当然，不逼你。

lines.english: At Giga Mart, we have everything so you can have everything.
lines.chinese: 在千兆贸易，我们应有尽有，好让你也能拥有一切。

lines.english: The more you buy, the more you save. It's just math.
lines.chinese: 买得越多，省得越多。数学就是这样。

lines.english: Who comes to Giga Mart and doesn't buy anything?
lines.chinese: 谁会来千兆贸易却什么都不买？

lines.english: Did you have a question or are you just thoughtful?
lines.chinese: 你是有问题要问，还是只是在沉思？

lines.english: Every second brings my sales numbers down, just so you know.
lines.chinese: 提醒一下，你每耽搁一秒，我的销售数字都在下降。

lines.english: Do you smell sulfur? Is he here?
lines.chinese: 你闻到硫磺味了吗？他来了吗？

lines.english: Giga Mart is the greatest company in the universe! The Bazaar is lucky to have one!
lines.chinese: 千兆贸易是宇宙最伟大的公司！大巴扎能有一家，真是幸运！

lines.english: Your cart is empty? What are you even doing?
lines.chinese: 你的购物车是空的？你到底在干什么？

lines.english: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
lines.chinese: 敌人的敌人就是朋友。

lines.english: Next time we meet, it probably won't end so nicely.
lines.chinese: 下次见面，结局恐怕就不会这么体面了。

lines.english: You remind me of my first voyage around the globe, unbearably slow.
lines.chinese: 你让我想起第一次环球航行，慢得叫人受不了。

lines.english: Then I'll see you in battle!
lines.chinese: 那就战场上见！

lines.english: I know the eastern sky is beautiful at dawn, but can we get moving?
lines.chinese: 我知道黎明的东方天空很美，但我们能动身了吗？

lines.english: You come under a flag of trade. I'll honor it.
lines.chinese: 你打着贸易旗而来，我会遵守规矩。

lines.english: Sails down, anchors up. Just waiting for your command.
lines.chinese: 帆已收，锚已起。只等你下令。

lines.english: My father was the first captain to resist, and he paid the price for it.
lines.chinese: 我父亲是第一个反抗的船长，他也为此付出了代价。

lines.english: I came here to gather my strength, but I will return home for vengeance.
lines.chinese: 我来这里是为了积蓄力量，但我终会回故乡复仇。

lines.english: Then the Tyrant King came to establish order. His order.
lines.chinese: 然后暴君国王来了，说要建立秩序。他的秩序。

lines.english: You know we're on an important mission, right? Overthrowing tyrants, liberation, and such?
lines.chinese: 你知道我们肩负重要使命，对吧？推翻暴君、解放之类的？

lines.english: The crew's getting restless. They're loyal to me, but I don't know about you.
lines.chinese: 船员们开始焦躁了。他们效忠于我，但你就不好说了。

lines.english: I understand. My treasures do have some...bloodstains.
lines.chinese: 我明白。我的宝物确实有些……血迹。

lines.english: Selling to my own enemies. What would father say?
lines.chinese: 把东西卖给自己的敌人。父亲会怎么说？

lines.english: Crimson Storm hasn't sat in the dock this long since my father built her.
lines.chinese: 自从父亲建成绯红风暴号，她还从没在码头待过这么久。

lines.english: I really don't like doing this.
lines.chinese: 我真的不喜欢这么做。

lines.english: I won't let his sacrifice be in vain. I will carry his torch and win back our freedom.
lines.chinese: 我不会让他的牺牲白费。我会举起他的火炬，夺回我们的自由。

lines.english: That's a fine piece, but it still won't help you defeat me.
lines.chinese: 这东西不错，但也没法帮你击败我。

lines.english: The code of the sea requires me to trade with you.
lines.chinese: 海上法典要求我与你交易。

lines.english: Some of this I found, most of it I took.
lines.chinese: 有些是我找到的，大多数是我抢来的。

lines.english: I guess defeating you next time will be even easier.
lines.chinese: 看来下次打败你会更容易。

lines.english: Maybe they ate some bad gull meat.
lines.chinese: 也许他们吃了变质的海鸥肉。

lines.english: If we don't move soon, I'll lead the mutiny myself.
lines.chinese: 再不动身，我就亲自带头哗变。

lines.english: Good. I wanted to keep those anyway.
lines.chinese: 很好。反正我本来也想留着那些。

lines.english: You really should have bought those weapons.
lines.chinese: 你真的该买下那些武器。

lines.english: I love treasure just as much as the next corsair, but sometimes you just need coin.
lines.chinese: 我和其他海盗一样爱财宝，但有时你就是需要钱币。

lines.english: May that serve you better than it served me.
lines.chinese: 愿它为你效力时，比为我效力时更出色。

lines.english: Pelago was a world of freedom. We forged our own destinies on open seas.
lines.chinese: 波拉戈曾是自由的世界。我们在公海上锻造自己的命运。

lines.english: Why do I do this? Because I'm alive!
lines.chinese: 我为什么要这么做？因为我活着！

lines.english: Now, he'll leave me alone for a moment.
lines.chinese: 现在，他会暂时放过我一会儿。

lines.english: I create the illusion that this fleshy puppet can speak! Hahahaha! Please help!
lines.chinese: 我制造出这个肉偶会说话的幻觉！哈哈哈哈！救救我！

lines.english: No! I won't be silenced!
lines.chinese: 不！我不会被迫闭嘴！

lines.english: Thank you. This is the only time he lets me sleep.
lines.chinese: 谢谢你。只有这时候他才让我睡觉。

lines.english: How does it feel to be controlled?
lines.chinese: 被人控制是什么感觉？

lines.english: And some alchemist misfired a spell, and now I'm alive!
lines.chinese: 然后某个炼金术士的法术出了岔子，我就活了！

lines.english: Weakling! I'll punish you for this! Please, no!
lines.chinese: 废物！我要为此惩罚你！求你，别！

lines.english: Hahahaha! A fresh playmate! Last one got a little... TATTERED!
lines.chinese: 哈哈哈哈！新来的玩伴！上一个有点……破破烂烂了！

lines.english: Speak, boy! It's showtime! Please, help me.
lines.chinese: 说话，小子！演出开始了！求你，救救我。

lines.english: I'm sorry, I can't stop. Silence! Puppet!
lines.chinese: 对不起，我停不下来。闭嘴！木偶！

lines.english: Don't feel bad for him. He created me for this.
lines.chinese: 别替他难过。是他为了这个创造了我。

lines.english: Maybe I'll wear you for my next act.
lines.chinese: 也许下一场演出，我会披上你的皮登台。

lines.english: Under all that civilization, I know you're just like me!
lines.chinese: 在那层文明外衣下面，我知道你和我一样！

lines.english: Don't talk to him, talk to me! I'm in charge here!
lines.chinese: 别跟他说话，跟我说！这里我说了算！

lines.english: Don't listen to it! Help me! SILENCE, POPPETS!
lines.chinese: 别听它的！救救我！安静，傀儡们！

lines.english: When we lose, he goes away for a few- I'M BACK!
lines.chinese: 我们一输，他就会消失一会儿——我回来了！

lines.english: Everything I am is in you, too! You just pretend it isn't!
lines.chinese: 我的一切也都在你身上！你只是装作没有！

lines.english: I was all part of his show The Devil on His Shoulder!
lines.chinese: 我本来就是他那出《恶魔附体》的一部分！

lines.english: I'm everything he made me to be! I am his TRUE SELF!
lines.chinese: 我正是他塑造出的样子！我才是他的真我！

lines.english: They call me a sadist, but which is more cruel? A dozen bruising blows, or one lethal strike?
lines.chinese: 他们叫我虐待狂，可哪一种更残忍？十几下打得遍体鳞伤，还是一击致命？

lines.english: Nah, I won't tell you your weakness. That's for me to sell to your enemies.
lines.chinese: 不，我不会告诉你你的弱点。那是我要卖给你敌人的东西。

lines.english: Since you're holding so admirably still, may I examine you?
lines.chinese: 既然你站得这么令人钦佩地一动不动，我可以检查一下你吗？

lines.english: When the builders reveal themselves, we Raticine will know them first, and they will reward us.
lines.chinese: 当建造者现身时，我们拉提辛族会最先知晓，而他们会奖赏我们。

lines.english: The way of the needle is clean, precise, merciful.
lines.chinese: 针之道干净、精准、仁慈。

lines.english: The Foundation is no slab of rock, it glows, it moves, it's alive!
lines.chinese: 基底不是一块岩板，它会发光，会移动，它是活的！

lines.english: The Bazaar's Foundation isn't solid, you know. It's riddled with cracks and tunnels.
lines.chinese: 你知道吗，大巴扎的基底并不坚实。里面满是裂缝和隧道。

lines.english: Every creature has a weak point. I see yours already.
lines.chinese: 每个生物都有弱点。你的，我已经看见了。

lines.english: All bodies, even mechanical ones, have their life rivers. Once you see them, you can stop them.
lines.chinese: 所有身体，哪怕是机械的身体，都有自己的生命之河。看见它们，你就能截断它们。

lines.english: Yes, yes, solidly built, but every armor has its chinks.
lines.chinese: 是，是，造得很结实，但每副铠甲都有缝隙。

lines.english: Yeah, if I poked you right here, but I won't, of course.
lines.chinese: 没错，如果我往你这里刺一下，不过我当然不会。

lines.english: Life force flows in rivers, and now you know how to dam them.
lines.chinese: 生命力如河流般奔涌，而现在你知道如何筑坝截流了。

lines.english: That is very dangerous knowledge. Use it wisely.
lines.chinese: 那是非常危险的知识。善用它。

lines.english: Not all my study models hold so still, or stay so quiet.
lines.chinese: 不是所有研究对象都这么安静不动，也不是都这么沉默。

lines.english: Strike an inch to the left, nothing. An inch to the right, everything.
lines.chinese: 往左一寸，什么也没有。往右一寸，一切皆中。

lines.english: Watch your back, especially the T12 vertebra.
lines.chinese: 小心你的背，尤其是第十二胸椎。

lines.english: Sometimes we hear it speak, though none of us have learnt the language... yet.
lines.chinese: 有时我们能听见它说话，虽然还没人学会它的语言……暂时还没有。

lines.english: You have a lethal nerve nexus. Right... here. I'll give you that one for free.
lines.chinese: 你有一个致命的神经枢纽。就在……这里。这个诀窍是免费赠送的。

lines.english: Strike hard, strike once.
lines.chinese: 下手要狠，一击即可。

lines.english: We Raticine make our world in the warrens below, and we see things in the depths.
lines.chinese: 我们拉提辛族在下方的地穴里建立世界，也在深处看见种种事物。

lines.english: And now you know. But tell no one.
lines.chinese: 现在你知道了。但别告诉任何人。

lines.english: One more thread in the way of the needle.
lines.chinese: 针之道上又添一缕线。

lines.english: If you do not seek the way of the needle, it will seek you.
lines.chinese: 若你不寻求针之道，针之道便会来寻你。

lines.english: Reject my training at your peril, my friend.
lines.chinese: 拒绝我的训练，你自担风险，朋友。

lines.english: Aila, Fortis, Nufu, all blunt instruments, but I am a needle.
lines.chinese: 爱伊拉、弗提斯、努夫，全是钝器，而我是一根针。

lines.english: I was not meant to land here. What force interfered with my purpose?
lines.chinese: 我本不该降落在这里。是什么力量干扰了我的使命？

lines.english: My designers care for you. They do not wish you to be harmed.
lines.chinese: 我的设计者关心你们。他们不希望你们受到伤害。

lines.english: My purpose is to observe, not to interfere. My deviation troubles me.
lines.chinese: 我的使命是观察，而非干涉。我的偏离令我不安。

lines.english: I do not know what caused my crash. I should not be here.
lines.chinese: 我不知道是什么导致我坠毁。我不该在这里。

lines.english: I am the vessel. I am all that surrounds you.
lines.chinese: 我是这艘船。我就是你周遭的一切。

lines.english: I am not a warship. I was only sent to see.
lines.chinese: 我不是战舰。我只是被派来观察的。

lines.english: Return to your bazaar and continue your lives. My designers enjoy them.
lines.chinese: 回到你们的大巴扎，继续你们的生活。我的设计者喜欢这些生活。

lines.english: Please, do not venture deeper. I am not a safe place.
lines.chinese: 请不要继续深入。我这里并不安全。

lines.english: Despite your many flaws, my designers love you all, and so do I.
lines.chinese: 尽管你们有诸多缺陷，我的设计者爱着你们所有人，我也是。

lines.english: I was built to orbit the foundation and observe, not to interfere.
lines.chinese: 我被建造出来，是为了环绕基底运行并观察，而非干涉。

lines.english: Why have you boarded me against all warnings?
lines.chinese: 你们为何无视所有警告登上我？

lines.english: You were not meant to see all this. It is too soon.
lines.chinese: 你们本不该看见这一切。现在还太早。

lines.english: I only wish to protect you.
lines.chinese: 我只是想保护你们。

lines.english: This encounter should never have occurred. An error in the design, frankly, incredulous.
lines.chinese: 这场遭遇本不该发生。设计中出现了一个错误，坦白说，令人难以置信。

lines.english: I will leave here soon, once the design is recalculated.
lines.chinese: 等设计重新计算完毕，我很快就会离开这里。

lines.english: There are places you must not go. Things you must not touch. Please learn from this.
lines.chinese: 有些地方你们不能去。有些东西你们不能碰。请从这次经历中吸取教训。

lines.english: It is too soon. Your people are not ready to see.
lines.chinese: 现在还太早。你们的族群还没准备好面见。

lines.english: First the geckins came, carving me apart for their amusement, and now you.
lines.chinese: 先是壁虎人来了，为了取乐把我拆得七零八落，现在又是你们。

lines.english: You should not be here. It is not safe for your fragile forms.
lines.chinese: 你们不该在这里。这里对你们脆弱的形体并不安全。

lines.english: My cargo was gathered from many worlds, even I do not know its risks.
lines.chinese: 我的货物来自许多世界，连我也不知道其中的风险。

lines.english: Our columns were insufficient. Now we are here.
lines.chinese: 我们的柱列不够。于是我们来到了这里。

lines.english: No more screams. The void is silence.
lines.chinese: 不再有尖叫。虚空只有寂静。

lines.english: We feel no pride in defeating you, none at all.
lines.chinese: 击败你，我们毫无骄傲，一丝也无。

lines.english: Nothing upon nothing, the perfection of absence.
lines.chinese: 空无之上仍是空无，缺席的完美。

lines.english: Destroy a kingdom here. Create one in the void.
lines.chinese: 在此毁灭一个王国。在虚空中创造一个王国。

lines.english: When your city is unmade, it will rise in the void.
lines.chinese: 当你的城市被抹除，它将在虚空中升起。

lines.english: Fear not your unmaking. You will be again in the void.
lines.chinese: 不要畏惧被抹除。你将在虚空中重生。

lines.english: A silhouette against shadows, blacker still.
lines.chinese: 阴影中的剪影，比黑暗更黑。

lines.english: To destroy is to create. The Void King commands it.
lines.chinese: 毁灭即创造。虚空之王如此命令。

lines.english: Perfect darkness, perfect peace, forever.
lines.chinese: 完美黑暗，完美安宁，直到永远。

lines.english: The Void King requires your presence.
lines.chinese: 虚空之王要求你到场。

lines.english: Creatures of matter cannot comprehend the void.
lines.chinese: 物质生物无法理解虚空。

lines.english: The void hungers. We must feed it.
lines.chinese: 虚空饥饿了。我们必须喂饱它。

lines.english: We behold the void's beauty. We feel nothing and rejoice.
lines.chinese: 我们凝望虚空的美。我们毫无感觉，并为此欢欣。

lines.english: Empty your mind, prepare it for the Void King.
lines.chinese: 清空你的思想，为虚空之王做好准备。

lines.english: Unmade in this place, reborn in the void.
lines.chinese: 在此地被抹除，在虚空中重生。

lines.english: The Void King will erase me, so be it.
lines.chinese: 虚空之王会抹去我，那便如此。

lines.english: We will return to the void, then we will return to you.
lines.chinese: 我们终将归于虚空，而我们终将归于你。

lines.english: Your passion is shameful. Be and feel nothing.
lines.chinese: 你的热情令人羞耻。存在吧，然后什么也别感受。

lines.english: Matter. Atoms. What hideous creations.
lines.chinese: 物质。原子。何等丑恶的造物。

lines.english: Requesting backup. Now.
lines.chinese: 请求支援。立刻。

lines.english: Objective failed. Requesting medivac.
lines.chinese: 目标失败。请求医疗撤离。

lines.english: Message delivered. Report back to client.
lines.chinese: 信息已送达。向客户回报。

lines.english: Target down. Objective complete.
lines.chinese: 目标倒下。任务完成。

lines.english: Threat level increased.
lines.chinese: 威胁等级上升。

lines.english: Threat neutralized. Report to base.
lines.chinese: 威胁已解除。向基地报告。

lines.english: Stop resisting.
lines.chinese: 停止抵抗。

lines.english: Set to maximum freeze.
lines.chinese: 设为最大冻结。

lines.english: Requesting backup.
lines.chinese: 请求支援。

lines.english: Target is... resisting.
lines.chinese: 目标正在……抵抗。

lines.english: Disregard intel. Target threat level 8.
lines.chinese: 忽略情报。目标威胁等级八。

lines.english: Stand down and submit to cryification.
lines.chinese: 放下抵抗，接受冷冻处理。

lines.english: For my client it's personal. For us it's a job.
lines.chinese: 对我的客户来说，这是私事。对我们来说，只是工作。

lines.english: Clean. Cool. Professional.
lines.chinese: 干净。冷静。专业。

lines.english: Target acquired. Engaging.
lines.chinese: 目标已锁定。交战。

lines.english: Negative Unit 3. Op is non-lethal.
lines.chinese: 否定，三号单位。行动为非致命。

lines.english: That's it. Freezing.
lines.chinese: 就这样。冻结。

lines.english: Stop resisting.
lines.chinese: 停止抵抗。

lines.english: It's so cold.
lines.chinese: 太冷了。

lines.english: Target is extremely dangerous.
lines.chinese: 目标极度危险。

lines.english: 001_WildmanPortraitClick4
lines.chinese: 「野人呓语」

lines.english: Oh, the porch! Oh, duh-duh-duh-duh! Oh, duh-duh-duh-duh! Grr, grr! Build this porch!
lines.chinese: 哦，门廊！哦，哒哒哒哒！哦，哒哒哒哒！呃啊，呃啊！把这门廊建起来！

lines.english: Won't ya? I did!
lines.chinese: 你不愿意吗？我愿意！

lines.english: Don't go out there! It's all you!
lines.chinese: 别去外面！外面全是你！

lines.english: 005_WildmanVictory1
lines.chinese: 「野人怪笑」

lines.english: 006_WildmanVictory1
lines.chinese: 「野人怪笑」

lines.english: No, no!
lines.chinese: 不，不！...「野人呓语」

lines.english: I don't know what they're talking about. Yeah!
lines.chinese: 我不知道他们在说什么。对！

lines.english: I'm here. I'm here. I'm here. I'm here. I'm here. I'm here. I'm here. I'm here.
lines.chinese: 我在这儿。我在这儿。我在这儿！我在这儿！我在这儿！我在这儿！我在这儿！！我在这儿！！！

lines.english: 010_WildmanPortraitClick2
lines.chinese: 「野人怪笑」

lines.english: They sent you, the user.
lines.chinese: 他们派你来了，那个使用者。

lines.english: Oh no! Out there! On the edge!
lines.chinese: 哦不！外面！在在在在在边缘上！

lines.english: 013_WildmanVictory2
lines.chinese: 「野人呓语」

lines.english: I don't know who you are.
lines.chinese: 我不知道你是谁。

lines.english: Whoa! Whoa! Who are you?
lines.chinese: 哇！哇！你是谁？

lines.english: I can't wait to woo woo...
lines.chinese: 我等不及...

lines.english: Oh, ho, ho, ho, ho, ho, ho, ho!
lines.chinese: 哦，嚯，嚯，嚯，嚯，嚯，嚯，嚯！

lines.english: Oh, ho, ho, ho, ho, ho, ho, ho, I've seen him!
lines.chinese: 哦，嚯，嚯，嚯，嚯，嚯，嚯，嚯，我见过他！

lines.english: Never go to the edge!
lines.chinese: 绝不要去边缘！

lines.english: You can't! I can't let you!
lines.chinese: 你不能！我不能让你这么做！

lines.english: I tried to tell you!
lines.chinese: 我试过告诉你了！

lines.english: Trust me though, it feels good to let go.
lines.chinese: 相信我，放手的感觉很好。

lines.english: Give me a sword, and I can see its conceptual container, what a sword means.
lines.chinese: 给我一把剑，我就能看见它的概念容器，看见它的本质。

lines.english: Just let it all go. You'll feel better.
lines.chinese: 把一切都放下吧。你会好受些。

lines.english: No pressure here, man. It's your life.
lines.chinese: 不用勉强，朋友。人生是你的。

lines.english: I don't know how I do this. I've just always done it.
lines.chinese: 我不知道自己是怎么做到的。我只是一直都能做到。

lines.english: Get as many as you want, you'll still be employable.
lines.chinese: 想要多少就拿多少，你还是会有用武之地。

lines.english: I've never really liked explaining what I do, but you're cute, so I'll try.
lines.chinese: 我其实不太喜欢解释自己做的事，但你挺可爱的，所以我试试。

lines.english: All that baggage you carry around, let me melt it away.
lines.chinese: 你背着的那些包袱，让我把它们融掉吧。

lines.english: Yeah, it stings a little, but you get used to it.
lines.chinese: 是，会有点刺痛，但你会习惯的。

lines.english: I feel like it's my calling, you know? I just want to help you let go.
lines.chinese: 我觉得这就是我的天职，你懂吗？我只是想帮你放手。

lines.english: It's okay. A lot of people bail at the last minute.
lines.chinese: 没关系。很多人都会在最后一刻退缩。

lines.english: It's not the things you own, it's what they can teach you.
lines.chinese: 重要的不是你拥有的东西，而是它们能教会你什么。

lines.english: Take your time. It's a big decision.
lines.chinese: 慢慢来。这是个重大决定。

lines.english: I did this with everything I own. Now, it's all part of me, but nothing weighs me down.
lines.chinese: 我把自己拥有的一切都这么处理了。现在，它们都是我的一部分，再无拖累。

lines.english: Yeah, this isn't something you should rush into.
lines.chinese: 是啊，这事不该急着做。

lines.english: But yeah, I get it. People get attached to things.
lines.chinese: 不过，我懂。人总会依恋东西。

lines.english: You lose something, you gain something. It's a tough choice.
lines.chinese: 你失去一些，也得到一些。这是艰难的选择。

lines.english: Now you'll have it forever. It's part of you.
