lines.chinese: 现在你会永远拥有它。它已经成了你的一部分。

lines.english: You don't need the thing itself, you just need the idea of it.
lines.chinese: 你不需要那件东西本身，你只需要它的理念。

lines.english: Nice thing about mind tattoos, you never have to explain them to people.
lines.chinese: 心灵纹身的好处是，你永远不用向别人解释。

lines.english: Then, I sort of liquify that container, melt it into mind ink, and tattoo that concept on your mind.
lines.chinese: 然后，我差不多会把那个容器液化，融成心墨，把那个概念纹在你的心上。

lines.english: My gift. It's weird, I know. But it might help you.
lines.chinese: 我的天赋。很怪，我知道。但也许能帮到你。

lines.english: Mind ink is permanent, so yeah, think it over.
lines.chinese: 心墨是永久的，所以，是的，好好想想。

lines.english: Do you feel it? Like a tattoo on your mind.
lines.chinese: 你感觉到了吗？像纹在心上的纹身。

lines.english: I take your stuff, I melt it into mind ink, I tattoo your mind. Simple.
lines.chinese: 我拿走你的东西，把它融成心墨，纹进你的心里。很简单。

lines.english: You want to win more? Start streaming. Read chat. Do the opposite.
lines.chinese: 想赢更多？开始直播。读弹幕。然后反着做。

lines.english: You know, they don't call me the Piggler for nothing.
lines.chinese: 你知道，他们叫我小圆猪高手可不是没原因的。

lines.english: Ah, well done.
lines.chinese: 啊，干得漂亮。

lines.english: Alright, what are we playing for today, boys?
lines.chinese: 好吧，今天我们赌什么，伙计们？

lines.english: Thanks for the game, man. That was pretty close.
lines.chinese: 谢了，兄弟。这局挺接近的。

lines.english: Ugh, this matchmaking is so broken!
lines.chinese: 呃，这匹配机制也太烂了！

lines.english: You've got potential. You know, I post my guides on pigglestorm.com.
lines.chinese: 你有潜力。知道吗，我的攻略都发在 pigglestorm.com 上。

lines.english: Hey, I'm glad you're here. Wanna play a game?
lines.chinese: 嘿，真高兴你来了。想玩一局吗？

lines.english: Ugh, who designed this game?
lines.chinese: 呃，这游戏是谁设计的？

lines.english: You know, I do offer coaching.
lines.chinese: 你知道，我也提供辅导。

lines.english: When I first started, I lost all my Piggles games too.
lines.chinese: 我刚开始时，也输光过所有小圆猪局。

lines.english: Good luck, man. Let's have fun.
lines.chinese: 祝你好运，兄弟。玩得开心。

lines.english: Not bad. Are you looking for a job?
lines.chinese: 不错。你在找工作吗？

lines.english: At least you have good taste in games.
lines.chinese: 至少你对游戏品味不错。

lines.english: You are cooking.
lines.chinese: 你这把打出感觉了。

lines.english: Welcome to the Bazaar!
lines.chinese: 欢迎来到大巴扎！

lines.english: Just had to be an off-meta build.
lines.chinese: 偏偏就是个非主流构筑。

lines.english: How can I blame chat for this?
lines.chinese: 这下我怎么怪弹幕？

lines.english: Gentlemen, the game is Higgles.
lines.chinese: 先生们，这局玩的是圆猪变体。

lines.english: These Piggles devs have no idea how to balance this game.
lines.chinese: 这些小圆猪开发者根本不懂平衡。

lines.english: Guess I rolled higher. I'll go first.
lines.chinese: 看来我点数更高。我先手。

lines.english: If those tides ever turn, the Black Shark will sail for Pelago, I give you my word.
lines.chinese: 若有一天潮向逆转，黑鲨号会驶向波拉戈，我向你保证。

lines.english: I was staring down cannon fire when you were crying for your bottle. You think you can make me blink?
lines.chinese: 你还叼着奶瓶哭的时候，我已经直面炮火了。你以为你能让我眨眼？

lines.english: I see the accusation. Well you can stuff it right back in your keg.
lines.chinese: 我看得出你眼里的指责。行吧，把它塞回你的酒桶里去。

lines.english: That's all I've got for you, kid. Move along.
lines.chinese: 我能教你的就这些了，孩子。走吧。

lines.english: Last our wakes crossed, you were just a girl. You've come a long way, Lady Korxena.
lines.chinese: 上次我们航迹相交时，你还只是个小姑娘。你走了很远了，蔻森娜女士。

lines.english: Your father was a good friend, so I'll help you, but don't expect me to go back.
lines.chinese: 你父亲曾是我的好朋友，所以我会帮你，但别指望我回去。

lines.english: Anyone asks if you've seen old Zane, you haven't.
lines.chinese: 有人问你见没见过老赞恩，你没见过。

lines.english: But then, here we are, in a world of strange new magic. So who knows, eh?
lines.chinese: 不过，我们现在就在这个充满陌生新魔法的世界里。所以谁知道呢，嗯？

lines.english: I won't fight that war anymore, but I'll teach you how.
lines.chinese: 我不会再打那场战争了，但我会教你怎么打。

lines.english: Fine, good. Now leave me alone.
lines.chinese: 好，好。现在别烦我了。

lines.english: All that bluster and she just leaves.
lines.chinese: 满嘴虚张声势，结果她就这么走了。

lines.english: Now, get out of here before someone sees you.
lines.chinese: 现在，趁没人看见你，赶紧离开。

lines.english: I know what you think of me, Lady Korxena, and I don't care.
lines.chinese: 我知道你怎么看我，蔻森娜女士，但我不在乎。

lines.english: Don't bother me again until you're serious.
lines.chinese: 等你认真了再来烦我。

lines.english: Go on, then. I've got a bottle waiting for me.
lines.chinese: 走吧。我还有瓶酒在等我。

lines.english: Ten years I fought the tyrant, threw my ships and men into the fire, and for what?
lines.chinese: 十年来我与暴君作战，把船和部下都投进火里，结果换来了什么？

lines.english: Gotta admit, you got a Corsair spirit.
lines.chinese: 不得不承认，你有海盗的魂。

lines.english: Well, well, well. Look what the tide washed in.
lines.chinese: 哟，哟，哟。看看潮水冲来了什么。

lines.english: I did what I had to do, there's no sense dying for a lost cause.
lines.chinese: 我做了必须做的事。为注定失败的事业送死没有意义。

lines.english: I told you. I'm done with Pelago. The Bazaar is the only sea I sail.
lines.chinese: 我告诉过你。我和波拉戈早就分道扬镳。大巴扎是我如今唯一航行的海。

lines.english: Well, that's a right piercing stare, isn't it? You are your father's daughter.
lines.chinese: 哎呀，这眼神可真够锐利，不是吗？你不愧是你父亲的女儿。

lines.english: The tyrant can keep the ten seas, and may his bones sink to the bottom.
lines.chinese: 暴君可以留着十海，愿他的骨头沉到海底。

lines.english: Hmph. Guess I'm not the only one with a sense to walk away.
lines.chinese: 哼。看来有脑子走开的人不止我一个。

lines.english: If a man pokes a bear, is he brave or a fool? There is no winning that war.
lines.chinese: 一个人去捅熊，他是勇敢还是愚蠢？那场战争赢不了。

lines.english: What's this now? A stare down? Gotta be joking.
lines.chinese: 这是怎么？瞪眼比赛？你在开玩笑吧。

lines.english: Okay, I'll run a quick lap around the galaxy and check back with you.
lines.chinese: 好吧，我绕银河快跑一圈，再回来看看你。

lines.english: Slohmor says all of time is happening all the time. I think I experienced that, but faster.
lines.chinese: 斯洛摩尔说，所有时间一直都在同时发生。我想我体验过那种感觉，只是更快。

lines.english: If you'd seen what I've seen, this would all make sense.
lines.chinese: 如果你见过我见过的东西，这一切都会说得通。

lines.english: Can you feel it? How thin the barrier really is?
lines.chinese: 你感觉到了吗？那道屏障其实有多薄？

lines.english: Don't travel from point A to B, just be there!
lines.chinese: 别从 A 点移动到 B 点，瞬移过去！

lines.english: Have you ever tried reading a book while long-distance sprinting? Ha! It's surreal!
lines.chinese: 你试过一边长跑一边读书吗？哈！那感觉太超现实了！

lines.english: If you're reading the right book when that happens, well, some strange magic kicks in.
lines.chinese: 如果那时你读的是对的书，那么，某种奇怪的魔法就会启动。

lines.english: The key to moving faster is seeing around the distance.
lines.chinese: 移动得更快的关键，是看见距离的周围。

lines.english: The hardest part of my technique is believing it.
lines.chinese: 我的技巧最难的部分，就是相信它。

lines.english: I hate to do this, but... HELLO, ARE YOU ALIVE?!
lines.chinese: 我不想这样，但……喂，你还活着吗？！

lines.english: Speed doesn't come from muscles, it comes from beyond the body.
lines.chinese: 速度不是来自肌肉，而是来自身体之外。

lines.english: The universe is far more flexible than you think.
lines.chinese: 宇宙比你想象的灵活得多。

lines.english: People think the body powers the mind, but it's the other way around.
lines.chinese: 人们以为身体驱动心灵，但其实正相反。

lines.english: A mile is just a measurement and all measurements are imaginary.
lines.chinese: 一英里只是一个计量，而所有计量都是想象出来的。

lines.english: Space and time are only suggestions, and we can ignore them.
lines.chinese: 空间和时间只是建议，我们可以无视它们。

lines.english: I'm not a fitness trainer. I train your perception of reality.
lines.chinese: 我不是健身教练。我训练的是你对现实的感知。

lines.english: I thought of Slohmor because you've been standing there a long time.
lines.chinese: 我想到斯洛摩尔，是因为你已经站在那儿很久了。

lines.english: Hard to explain, but there's a place where body and mind intersect, and I went there.
lines.chinese: 很难解释，但有个身体与心灵交汇的地方，我去过那里。

lines.english: Don't worry, none of my students have grown extra eyes. This was, hmm, a unique circumstance.
lines.chinese: 别担心，我的学生里没人长出额外的眼睛。这次，嗯，是特殊情况。

lines.english: When I came back, I had a whole new way of seeing, and a whole new eye. Strange magic.
lines.chinese: 我回来时，有了一种全新的看法，还有一只全新的眼睛。奇怪的魔法。

lines.english: Ability begins with belief. You can think yourself faster.
lines.chinese: 能力始于信念。你可以把自己想得更快。

lines.english: Slohmor Lumbra talks about the long time. I think the place I go might be its opposite.
lines.chinese: 斯洛摩尔·伦布拉谈过“漫长时间”。我觉得我去的地方也许正好相反。

lines.english: Look, I get it. My training is... strange.
lines.chinese: 听着，我懂。我的训练是……很奇怪。

lines.english: Actually, I'm human. The third eye? Hmm, long story.
lines.chinese: 其实我是人类。第三只眼？嗯，说来话长。

lines.english: After a while, the words start to blur and the ideas just melt into you.
lines.chinese: 过一会儿，字句会开始模糊，思想就会融进你体内。

lines.english: Alfred, sic 'em! Devour them!
lines.chinese: 阿福，咬他们！吞了他们！

lines.english: I'll have you stuffed!
lines.chinese: 我要把你做成标本！

lines.english: You fool! They belong in cages!
lines.chinese: 蠢货！它们就该待在笼子里！

lines.english: Everyone loves me! Don't you ask-
lines.chinese: 所有人都爱我！别问——

lines.english: Behold, my magnificent menagerie!
lines.chinese: 看吧，我华丽的动物园！

lines.english: And that's why I hold the leash!
lines.chinese: 这就是为什么缰绳在我手里！

lines.english: I'll whip you like a dog! HA!
lines.chinese: 我要像抽狗一样抽你！哈！

lines.english: Aha! Another unruly beast! Tamed!
lines.chinese: 啊哈！又一头不听话的野兽！驯服了！

lines.english: Maizou is the hundredth wonder of the world! Hahahaha!
lines.chinese: 麦咻是世界第一百大奇迹！哈哈哈哈！

lines.english: Step right up! I'll knock you right down!
lines.chinese: 请上前来！我会把你打趴下！

lines.english: You have ruined the show!
lines.chinese: 你毁了这场表演！

lines.english: Into the cage with you! Go, go!
lines.chinese: 进笼子去！快，快！

lines.english: Perhaps I'll add you to my collection!
lines.chinese: 也许我会把你加入我的收藏！

lines.english: Ah, little creature, can you do any tricks?
lines.chinese: 啊，小家伙，你会什么把戏吗？

lines.english: Ha! Take that!
lines.chinese: 哈！吃我这一记！

lines.english: My zoo? Abusive? Ha ha ha ha! But of course!
lines.chinese: 我的动物园？虐待？哈哈哈哈！那当然！

lines.english: NOOOOOOO! God damn him!
lines.chinese: 不——！该死的家伙！

lines.english: Obey my command or feel my whip!
lines.chinese: 服从我的命令，否则尝尝我的鞭子！

lines.english: You are by far my worst audience!
lines.chinese: 你是我见过最差劲的观众！

lines.english: Oh, you filthy beast! HA!
lines.chinese: 哦，你这肮脏的畜生！哈！

lines.english: There are many alchemists in the Bazaar, but few have learned the art of long life.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎里有许多炼金术士，但很少有人学会长生之术。

lines.english: I beg of you, Mak. Go have some fun.
lines.chinese: 我求你了，马克。去找点乐子吧。

lines.english: The Bazaar is no ordinary city. There are secrets beneath our feet.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎不是普通城市。我们脚下藏着秘密。

lines.english: Well I'm going to blink now. I hope you are still here.
lines.chinese: 好吧，我现在要眨眼了。希望你还在这里。

lines.english: I have to wonder, would they want this? If they knew what it will cost you.
lines.chinese: 我不禁想，他们会想要这样吗？如果他们知道这会让你付出什么代价。

lines.english: As old as I am, I can pass a year just by blinking. Risky though.
lines.chinese: 像我这么老，眨一下眼就能过一年。不过有风险。

lines.english: Talk shop with Ellie. Visit Jules' restaurant. Relax.
lines.chinese: 去和艾莉聊聊手艺。去朱尔斯的餐厅看看。放松一下。

lines.english: Immortality has been interesting, but there are nobler goals to pursue.
lines.chinese: 永生一直很有趣，但还有更高贵的目标值得追求。

lines.english: I do not know if the formula of life exists, but I will help you search.
lines.chinese: 我不知道生命公式是否存在，但我会帮你寻找。

lines.english: What you seek will come to you. I hope you will recognize it.
lines.chinese: 你追寻的东西会来到你面前。希望你能认出它。

lines.english: I've seen so many lives crumble, so many destinies wasted. I wish better for you.
lines.chinese: 我见过太多生命崩塌，太多命运被浪费。我希望你有更好的结局。

lines.english: Wait, are you relaxing or practicing formula in your head?
lines.chinese: 等等，你是在放松，还是在脑子里练习公式？

lines.english: Oh, my dear Mak, such a serious young man.
lines.chinese: 哦，我亲爱的马克，真是个严肃的年轻人。

lines.english: I know your goal is noble, but you must make time to be human.
lines.chinese: 我知道你的目标很高尚，但你必须留出时间做人。

lines.english: This is good. Yes, take a moment to relax.
lines.chinese: 这样很好。是的，花点时间放松。

lines.english: I can teach you many secrets, but some you must discover for yourself.
lines.chinese: 我能教你许多秘密，但有些必须由你自己发现。

lines.english: Rest your mind, Mak. You have studied enough.
lines.chinese: 让头脑歇一歇吧，马克。你已经学得够多了。

lines.english: You are by far my most gifted student, but some gifts can be curses.
lines.chinese: 你是我最有天赋的学生，远胜其他人，但有些天赋会成为诅咒。

lines.english: Alchemy is more poetry than science. I fear you will take it too far.
lines.chinese: 炼金术比起科学，更像诗。我担心你会走得太远。

lines.english: You are the oldest person I have known, Mak, but I am many times older.
lines.chinese: 你是我认识过最年长的人，马克，但我比你还要年长许多倍。

lines.english: Eternal life will be a curse if you don't learn how to live.
lines.chinese: 如果你不学会生活，永生会变成诅咒。

lines.english: Last time I skipped, I went a bit too far. Everyone I knew was dead.
lines.chinese: 上次我跳过时间，跳得有点太远。所有我认识的人都死了。

lines.english: To twist the natural order, bring your family back, is it right? And do you care?
lines.chinese: 扭曲自然秩序，让你的家人回来，这样对吗？而你在乎吗？

lines.english: Why search the universe for its secrets? In the Bazaar, the universe comes to you.
lines.chinese: 何必在宇宙中搜寻它的秘密？在大巴扎，宇宙会来到你面前。

lines.english: The secrets of the universe will still be here tomorrow.
lines.chinese: 宇宙的秘密明天仍会在这里。

lines.english: Respect nature and nature will still eat you.
lines.chinese: 尊重自然，而自然还是会吃掉你。

lines.english: All beasties are beautiful, even the slimy ones.
lines.chinese: 所有小兽都很美，连黏糊糊的也一样。

lines.english: Really rubs my hackles when people call these beauties monsters.
lines.chinese: 有人把这些美丽家伙叫怪物，真让我毛都竖起来。

lines.english: Look at those talons. Beautiful.
lines.chinese: 看看那些爪子。漂亮。

lines.english: I'm just your guide. The beasties are your teachers.
lines.chinese: 我只是你的向导。小兽们才是你的老师。

lines.english: They're beautiful, aren't they?
lines.chinese: 它们很美，不是吗？

lines.english: Remember, this is their world. Tread lightly.
lines.chinese: 记住，这是它们的世界。脚步轻些。

lines.english: Right, there's a nice one.
lines.chinese: 对，那边有个不错的。

lines.english: See how she crouches before the strike? You can use that.
lines.chinese: 看她出击前如何伏低身体了吗？你可以学着用。

lines.english: Animals have skills they've been honing for eons.
lines.chinese: 动物拥有它们磨练了千万年的本领。

lines.english: Must be hard to build burrows when the ground keeps changing.
lines.chinese: 地面老在变化，要挖洞一定很难。

lines.english: Some of them are cute! That don't mean they won't eat you.
lines.chinese: 有些确实可爱！但这不代表它们不会吃你。

lines.english: Stick close to me, and we'll get you out alive.
lines.chinese: 跟紧我，我们会把你活着带出去。

lines.english: This one might teach you the Get Eaten technique. Hahahaha!
lines.chinese: 这一只也许能教你“被吃掉”技巧。哈哈哈哈！

lines.english: If they keep exploiting the Outlands, it's all going to end up like the dunes.
lines.chinese: 如果他们继续剥削荒原，一切都会变得像沙丘那样。

lines.english: Did they evolve here or did somebody bring them? Nature's a mystery.
lines.chinese: 它们是在这里进化出来的，还是有人带来的？自然真神秘。

lines.english: When the Outlands shift, do the animals shift too? Are they as confused as us?
lines.chinese: 当荒原位移时，动物也会跟着变化吗？它们也和我们一样困惑吗？

lines.english: You can learn a lot from nature if you survive it.
lines.chinese: 只要你活得下来，就能从自然里学到很多。

lines.english: Only monsters I see are the gold grubbers in the Tower District.
lines.chinese: 我眼里唯一的怪物，是塔楼区那些贪金的家伙。

lines.english: All we had in the Deadgrass was banjo folk. So when I heard post-Galactic tunnel rock, woo-wee!
lines.chinese: 在枯草地，我们只有班卓民谣。后来我听到后银河时代地下摇滚，哇哦，那叫一个带劲！

lines.english: We all thought we were safe here, but we can't let our guard down again.
lines.chinese: 我们都以为这里很安全，但不能再放松警惕了。

lines.english: The Bazaar's a real special place. We gotta protect it no matter what.
lines.chinese: 大巴扎真是个特别的地方。无论如何都得保护它。

lines.english: Sergeant Suds is scary, but he sure keeps the mess hall clean.
lines.chinese: 皂沫中士挺吓人的，但他确实把食堂收拾得干干净净。

lines.english: So many different kinds of people, all working together! Well, sometimes.
lines.chinese: 这么多不同的人，都在一起努力！嗯，有时候是。

lines.english: Ain't much of a fighter myself, but I can help our fighters fight!
lines.chinese: 我自己不太会打架，但我能帮咱们的战士打得更好！

lines.english: I know I'll never fit in with the Undertunnel scene, but I sure do love the music.
lines.chinese: 我知道自己永远融不进地下隧道圈子，可我真的太喜欢这音乐了。

lines.english: It ain't a flea market! It's the Defense Corps' armory!
lines.chinese: 这可不是跳蚤市场！这是防卫军的军械库！

lines.english: Well, that's good. Supplies were running low anyway.
lines.chinese: 嗯，这样也好。反正补给快见底了。

lines.english: While you're looking, mind if I play some tunes? I just love this underground stuff.
lines.chinese: 你挑的时候，我能放点歌吗？我可太爱这种地下音乐了。

lines.english: For the Bazaarian Defense Corps! That's the thing we say, right?
lines.chinese: 为了大巴扎防卫军！我们是这么喊的，对吧？

lines.english: My real name's Darla Jean, by the way. Don't know why they call me Pitchfork. But I like it!
lines.chinese: 顺便说一句，我真名叫达拉·吉恩。不知道他们为什么叫我草叉，但我喜欢！

lines.english: I hate to charge our soldiers, but we ain't exactly got a defense budget.
lines.chinese: 我也不想收咱们士兵的钱，可我们确实没有什么防务预算。

lines.english: Sure, I got lots of other junk. I mean equipment.
lines.chinese: 当然，我还有一堆别的破烂。我的意思是装备。

lines.english: Our army's all volunteers, so somebody's gotta pay for the gear.
lines.chinese: 我们军队全靠志愿者，所以装备总得有人掏钱。

lines.english: I grew up on a farm in the Deadgrass, but I always dreamed about life in the big city.
lines.chinese: 我在枯草地的农场长大，可一直梦想着大城市的生活。

lines.english: You must be some kind of special operative, right? Need some, uh, special gear?
lines.chinese: 你一定是什么特别行动员，对吧？需要点，呃，特别装备吗？

lines.english: When I finally made it to the Bazaar, I couldn't believe how colorful it was. The food, the clothes, the music, ooh!
lines.chinese: 我终于来到大巴扎时，简直不敢相信这里这么缤纷。食物、衣服、音乐，哇！

lines.english: I take this stuff off soldiers who, uh, don't need it anymore.
lines.chinese: 这些东西是我从那些，呃，用不着它们的士兵身上拿来的。

lines.english: The Defense Corps was hibernating a while, but those Anaxians poked the bear!
lines.chinese: 防卫军本来蛰伏了一阵子，可那些统合自治领的人偏要惹我们！

lines.english: Let me go check in the dumpster. I mean the supply reserves.
lines.chinese: 我去垃圾箱里找找。我的意思是，去补给储备里找找。

lines.english: All of this is regulation equipment, though I ain't so sure we have regulations.
lines.chinese: 这些全是制式装备，虽然我也不确定我们有没有制式。

lines.english: Well, alright! Let me just, uh, scrub the rust off that.
lines.chinese: 好嘞！我先把，呃，把上面的锈刷掉。

lines.english: Who needs soldiers with training when you got civilians with gumption?
lines.chinese: 有一群有胆气的平民，谁还需要受过训练的士兵？

lines.english: Leaving supplies for your fellow soldiers? Very honorable.
lines.chinese: 给战友留下补给？很高尚。

lines.english: Those snooty Cloud Tops throw their gear away if it gets one little smudge. Well, I'm here to clean it up.
lines.chinese: 那些云顶人，装备上沾一点污渍就扔了。正好，我来收拾残局。

lines.english: A lot of bad folks want to ruin what we built here, but the Defense Corps ain't gonna let them.
lines.chinese: 很多坏家伙想毁了我们建起来的一切，但防卫军不会让他们得逞。

lines.english: The Anaxians, the Saurians, the Void... We gotta stay sharp!
lines.chinese: 统合自治领人、索里安人、虚空……我们得保持警惕！

lines.english: Ah, what? You got something against stolen goods?
lines.chinese: 啊，什么？你对赃物有意见？

lines.english: One more weapon for you, one less for your rivals. That's a win-win.
lines.chinese: 你多一件武器，对手少一件武器。双赢。

lines.english: When I got to the Bazaar, that Orlin geezer tried to welcome me, but I ain't having that.
lines.chinese: 我刚到大巴扎时，奥林那个老头还想欢迎我，我才不吃这一套。

lines.english: I'm not going to find this stuff in any of them... legal shops.
lines.chinese: 这些货我可不会在那些……合法店铺里找到。

lines.english: I heard that Nufu cat teaches stillness. That what this is, then?
lines.chinese: 我听说努夫那只猫教人静心。你现在是在练那个？

lines.english: I risk my tail nicking these goods. You heroes are bloody dangerous!
lines.chinese: 我冒着尾巴被揪的风险才顺来这些货。你们这些英雄可真危险！

lines.english: Come on, they're never gonna know it used to be theirs!
lines.chinese: 拜托，他们永远不会知道这原来是他们的！

lines.english: You never saw me, this never happened. Got it?
lines.chinese: 你没见过我，这事也没发生过。懂？

lines.english: What? Not good enough for ya?
lines.chinese: 怎么？这还入不了你的眼？

lines.english: You ain't gonna tell him I nicked this, are ya?
lines.chinese: 你不会告诉他这是我顺来的，对吧？

lines.english: Those Sphinxian monks think they're so holy, but they abandoned our world and left blokes like me to eat rocks.
lines.chinese: 那些斯芬克斯僧侣觉得自己多神圣，可他们抛下了我们的世界，留下我们这种家伙啃石头。

lines.english: I'm not just selling it to you, I'm taking it away from your rivals. You ought to pay me twice.
lines.chinese: 我不只是卖给你，我是在从你对手手里拿走它。你该付我两份钱。

lines.english: How did I get this stuff? Tricks of the trade, innit?
lines.chinese: 我怎么弄到这些货的？行规里的小技巧嘛，不是吗？

lines.english: You so-called heroes are always packing loot, and I've got the best of it right here.
lines.chinese: 你们这些所谓的英雄总是带着好东西，而最好的都在我这儿。

lines.english: Yeah, I'm Sphinxian. And no, I ain't gonna teach you nothing.
lines.chinese: 对，我是斯芬克斯人。不，我什么都不会教你。

lines.english: I ain't got all day, you know. Places to be, people to rob.
lines.chinese: 我可没一整天陪你耗，知道吗？还有地方要去，还有人要抢。

lines.english: Hope it helps you more than the one I nicked it from, eh?
lines.chinese: 希望它帮你的忙，比帮原主人更多，嗯？

lines.english: Ugh, you're robbing me blind at that price! Hey, maybe you should join the guild.
lines.chinese: 呃，这个价你简直是在抢我！嘿，也许你该加入公会。

lines.english: It's stolen goods, innit? I got what I got.
lines.chinese: 都是赃物嘛。我有什么就卖什么。

lines.english: Had to hitch a ride with some raiders to get out of there, and let's just say they were a bad influence.
lines.chinese: 我只好搭上一群掠夺者的车逃出来，只能说他们把我带坏了。

lines.english: This ain't Giga Mart, mate. Quit browsing the shelves.
lines.chinese: 这里可不是千兆贸易，伙计。别在货架前磨蹭了。

lines.english: You know, a silent one like you could go far in the guild. I'll put in a word with the boss for you.
lines.chinese: 你知道吗，像你这种安静的家伙，在公会里能混得不错。我会替你跟老大说一声。

lines.english: Wasn't easy getting my beans on that one.
lines.chinese: 这件货可不好上手。

lines.english: You want wisdom? Find some other cat. I've got goods to sell.
lines.chinese: 想要智慧？找别的猫去。我这儿只卖货。

lines.english: Everywhere I go, people's belongings just stick to me. Paws. I can't help it, your honour.
lines.chinese: 我走到哪儿，别人的东西就粘到我身上。爪子嘛。我控制不住，大人。

lines.english: Fine, but keep your gobs shut about this. Squeaky mouse gets the claws.
lines.chinese: 行吧，但把嘴闭严了。吱吱叫的老鼠会挨爪子。

lines.english: That Pip kid thinks I'm right hard, but I ain't bringing him into this life.
lines.chinese: 皮普那小子以为我特别狠，可我不会把他拉进这行。

lines.english: Nah, Stickybeans is gonna make his own way, just like he always has.
lines.chinese: 不，黏豆子会走自己的路，就像以前一样。
